name: Anil K Pinapala
title: Founder and Chief Executive Officer
bio: Anil is a serial entrepreneur with over 20 years of experience in the FinTech space,focussed on the non-prime segment, building & offering financial products & solutions that match the financially stressed borrower needs, who are typically out of favor with institutional lenders or banking institutions. Starting a career in Internet Technology Solutions, Anil has been successful in transforming the short-term alternate lending products to the deep subprime in the USA by building the first cloud-based lending/ PoS Financing platform, which captured over 50% market share within a few years. After a successful exit, Anil built a first of its kind bill payment processing platform in the USA before the advent of the current NFC payment options, transacting over $ 5 Bn per year. During this time, he founded a FinTech Lending company in Miami which offered a personal line-of-credit to a non-prime borrower in the USA and disbursed over $ 1.5 Bn within a span of 3 years. Using the same Line-of-Credit framework, Anil founded Vivifi, a fast-growing FinTech offering the non-prime borrowers an alternative to an amortizing loan with a vision to add a payment layer and build a credit-card like experience for the credit under-served borrower.

name: Dr. Abhishek Agrawal
title: Managing Partner
bio: Abhishek Agrawal is a Managing Partner, Accion Digital Transformation Fund, investing in financial services companies and helping them on their journey towards digital transformation. He comes with extensive experience in financial management, strategy and business planning, and microfinance operations. He sits on several boards as nominee director of financial services institutions. Abhishek is a Chartered Accountant, MBA in Finance and has a Ph.D. in municipal financial reforms.

name: Dr. Ajay Kumar Sood
title: Deputy Managing Director
org: National bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
bio: Dr. Ajay Kumar Sood is the Deputy Managing Director of National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), an apex government institution dedicated to agriculture and rural development in India. Dr. Sood earned his PhD in Agricultural Economics and possesses extensive experience in agricultural development and rural banking. Throughout his long tenure at NABARD, where he has served in various capacities, Dr. Sood has made significant contributions to rural and agricultural infrastructure development, strengthening of rural financial institutions, and promotion of grassroots and community groups. His efforts have been instrumental in creating a conducive ecosystem that fosters inclusive development.

name: Dr. Alok Misra
title: CEO & Director
bio: Dr. Alok Misra is the CEO & Director of MFIN. He has 33 years of professional experience in international development, rural finance, microfinance, inclusive finance and research at both policy and implementation level and has worked across 24 countries in Asia, Africa, Europe and Pacific. Dr. Alok Misra holds a PhD in Development Studies from Victoria University of Wellington, Master in Development Management (Gold Medallist) from Asian Institute of Management, Manila. He has been trained at Harvard Business School in "Strategic leadership for Microfinance" and was a Fellow, Fletcher Leadership Program for Financial Inclusion at Tufts University.

name: Dr. Amit Kumar Jain
title: Director Operations
bio: Serving Delhi Metro Rail Corporation as Director Operations and Services.

name: Dr. Ashish Desai
title: Associate Professor
org: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research
bio: Ashish has over 27 years of experience building greenfield technology-driven financial services businesses in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia. His expertise spans straddles entrepreneurship, industry, and policy-making. He was Director of Monitoring and Evaluation at the Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO), NITI Aayog, and was responsible for monitoring schemes M&E of all trade finance and commerce ministries. He was responsible for working on the TIME Lab (Technology and Innovation for Monitoring and Evaluation) Lab. Ashish has worked across various organizations such as Jumo, Aditya Birla Group, Motorola, First Rand Bank, and Comviva in areas of digital payments, lending and branchless banking. Ashish Desai’s research interests are firmly rooted in the intersection of technology and financial services. He is particularly interested in digital financial literacy and livelihoods, remote sensing, and alternative data for public policy, co-creation, and collaborative technology governance. His academic contributions are recognized through his roles as a senior visiting fellow at the National Council of Applied Economic Research. he is also a visiting faculty at IIT Bombay. Ashish holds a degree in engineering from VJTI, Mumbai, an MMS from JBIMS, and a PhD from IIM Kozhikode.

name: Dr. Atul Mehta
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Atul has done his Post-Graduation in Business Management from IIM, Ahmedabad and B.E. in Electrical Engineering from PEC, Chandigarh. He has been awarded the honoris causa degree of PhD in Enterprise Sales Management by the Maryland State University. He has 18+ years of hands-on Global experience in Fintech. He is an FMCG [Friend, Mentor, Coach and Guide]. He loves sharing his knowledge and has been a speaker at various prestigious institutions including IIMs, FMS, Chinese University HK, etc.

name: Dr. Florian Toncar
title: Parliamentary State Secretary
bio: Dr Florian Toncar has been a parliamentary state secretary at the German Federal Ministry of Finance since Dec. 2021. He served as a member of the German Bundestag from 2005 to 2013 and has been a Bundestag member again since 2017. From 2011 to 2013, he was the deputy head of the Free Democratic Party (FDP) parliamentary group, and from 2017 to 2021 he served as parliamentary secretary of the FDP parliamentary group. He worked as a lawyer specialising in financial market regulation until 2021.

name: Dr. Gugan Chandrashekhar Mallika Thoppe
title: Assistant Professor
bio: Dr. Gugan Chandrashekhar Mallika Thoppe Gugan Thoppe has been an Assistant Professor in the Computer Science and Automation (CSA) department at the Indian Institute of Science since 2019. He is also an Associate Researcher at the Robert Bosch Centre for Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, IIT Madras. He received his Ph.D. in 2016 from the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Mumbai, and subsequently completed postdoctoral research at the Technion Institute of Technology, Israel (2015-17) and Duke University, USA (2017-19). His research is supported by the DST-SERB’s Core Research Grant, the Indo-French Centre for the Promotion of Advanced Research “CEFIPRA”, and the Walmart Center for Tech Excellence. He has research collaborations with the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI). His awards include Pratiksha Trust's Young Investigator Award, the IISc Award for Excellence in Teaching, the TIFR Award for the Best Ph.D. Thesis, and two IBM Ph.D. fellowships. He is also a member of ACM-India's Eminent Speaker panel. His research interests include reinforcement learning, stochastic approximation, and random topology.

name: Dr. Harshdeep Kamble
title: Principal Secretary (Industries)
bio: Dr. Harshadeep Kamble is an alumnus of the Government Medical College, Nagpur (1987 batch) and an officer of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Maharashtra cadre (1997 batch). He is from Bhandara District & he completed his school education from Sainik School, Satara. Currently posted as the Principal Secretary, Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra and is responsible for overall Industrial Development & various policy formulations & its implementations including investments in the State. Maharashtra has regain top position in FDI (Foreign Direct Investment) during his ongoing tenure. He recently formulated much appreciated IT & ITeS Policy & Integrated Logistic Policy for the State. Dr. Harshadeep Kamble was posted as Development Commissioner (Industries Department) for almost five years, where he played very instrumental role in revamping of the Directorate of Industries. Played a major role in formulation of Industrial Policy 2019 for Maharashtra. The popular new scheme of CMEGP (Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme) is his brainchild. Dr. Harshadeep Kamble also served as Commissioner, Food & Drug Administration. He is remembered for his monumental work of bringing down the prices of Cardiac Stents by almost 100% which he attributes to his medical background. He was appointed as Chairman of Committee on Online Sale of Medicines by Government of India in recognition of his in depth knowledge in the field. He was instrumental in bringing the legislation in the State for Ease of Doing Business, whereby all permissions are to be given in prescribed timeline. Dr. Harshadeep Kamble has also served as District Magistrate & Collector of Yavatmal District, which was known for agrarian crisis. Dr. Manmohan Singh, the then Prime Minister of India had visited Yavatmal and Dr. Kamble presented him a draft on special package for farmers which was included in the Central & State Government Scheme. Apart from very demanding office works, he finds time to devote to Meditation and Mindfullness. He is also well known for his philanthropic and social activities, especially young entrepreneur’s development and education aid to students from lower socio-economic background.

name: Dr. Hart Montgomery
title: CTO, Hyperledger Foundation
bio: Hart Montgomery is the CTO of Hyperledger Foundation, the open, global ecosystem for enterprise-grade blockchain technologies hosted at the Linux Foundation. Hart also serves as the executive director of the Post-Quantum Cryptography Alliance at the Linux Foundation. Hart has extensive experience in blockchain and cryptography, and previously worked in blockchain and cryptography research at Fujitsu Research where he helped lead Fujitsu’s efforts in Hyperledger. Prior to Fujitsu, Hart received a Ph.D. in cryptography at Stanford University under Dan Boneh, where he was a Stanford Graduate Fellow. Hart has numerous academic publications and patents in cryptography and blockchain and brings a wealth of experience in these areas to the Hyperledger Foundation.

name: Dr. Kailash Nadh
title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Dr. Kailash Nadh has a PhD in Artificial Intelligence & Computational Linguistics from the Middlesex university. He has been the CTO at Zerodha since 2013, where he co-founded its tech arm. Zerodha is now one of the largest stock broker, and one of the largest fintech companies, in India. He has been a hobbyist software developer for close to two decades and writes codes every day, building technology at Zerodha, and building and contributing to open source projects. He also co-founded and volunteers at the FOSS United Foundation, a non-profit that promotes the open source software ecosystem in India, and Rainmatter Foundation, an initiative that works on climate change projects.

name: Dr. Ketan Virendrabhai Kotecha
title: Dean, FOE & Head, SCAAI Centre
bio: Ketan Kotecha, PhD (IIT Bombay) Dean, Faculty of Engineering, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) Director, Symbiosis Institute of Technology Head, Symbiosis Centre for Applied AI ( SCAAI) Education: PhD & MTech (IIT Bombay) Expertise: Deep learning; Artificial Intelligence, Computer Algorithms, Machine Learning, Deep Learning Higher Order Thinking Skills & Critical Thinking. Experience: A researcher‚ a teacher for the last 28 + years. A published author of more than 264 Scopus-indexed papers and 8 patents. Research Projects/Grants received Recipient grant from the Academy of medical sciences UK for research in Responsible and Trustable Healthcare, 25000 GBP (March 2024-2025) Recipient of PURSE grant from DST under Promotion of University Research and Scientific Excellence scheme on Fostering Multi-disciplinary AI-assisted Research for Health and Sustainable Environment, worth INR 5.2 cores as PI. ( 2023-2027) From Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology for cognitive behaviour analysis using AI (Rs 2.0 crores). Recipient of Indo-Canada Shastri grant SSTSG 2023-24 in collaboration with the University of Winnipeg on the project titled Multimodal Co-learning & tolerance based soft computing for Real-life Deep Learning Applications(CAD 1500) From MHRD GoI in collaboration with Arizona State University, USA and University of Queensland Australia resp.(INR 1.66 crores). From DST, GoI under Indo-Italy scheme for AI for Drones. (INR 40 lacs). From DST, GoI under Indo-Serbia scheme for AI for traffic control. (INR 30 lacs). From the European union under Erasmus plus faculty mobility grant to the University of Wroclaw Poland. DUO-India professors fellowship for research in Responsible AI with Brunel University the UK( INR 10 lacs). LEAP grant to visit and attend Leadership Program at Cambridge University UK. UKIERI grant and a grant from the Royal Academy of Engineering, the UK under the Newton Bhabha Fund. Global Partnerships¬†Exploratory¬†Grant from British Council, the UK in collaboration with Aston University.

name: Dr. Manish Gupta
title: Director of Google DeepMind
bio: Dr. Manish Gupta is a Director at Google DeepMind, leading teams conducting AI research across India and the US. Previously, Manish has led VideoKen, a video technology startup, and the research centers for Xerox and IBM in India. As a Senior Manager at the IBM T.J. Watson Research Center in Yorktown Heights, New York, Manish led the team developing system software for the Blue Gene/L supercomputer. IBM was awarded a National Medal of Technology and Innovation for Blue Gene by the then US President Barack Obama in 2009. Manish holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Illinois at Urbana Champaign. He has co-authored about 75 papers, with more than 8,000 citations in Google Scholar, and has been granted 19 US patents. While at IBM, Manish received two Outstanding Technical Achievement Awards, an Outstanding Innovation Award and the Lou Gerstner Team Award for Client Excellence. Manish is a Fellow of ACM and the Indian National Academy of Engineering, and a recipient of a Distinguished Alumnus Award from IIT Delhi.

name: Dr. N Rajendran
title: Chief Digital Officer
org: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd
bio: Dr. N. Rajendran, Ph.D., is a distinguished expert in computer science specializing in Payments, Market Infrastructure, and Banking Systems with over 25 years of proven leadership in the industry. With a track record of excellence in technical leadership, cybersecurity, and strategic management, he has played a pivotal role in shaping cutting-edge technologies. He was the founding member of India’s Digital Infrastructure Institutions (DPI), such as the Institute for Development and Research in Banking Technology (IDRBT), the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), and the Indian Financial Technology Allied Services (IFTAS). Dr. Rajendran has extensive experience in building payments and financial services institutions, products, platforms, technology, information security infrastructure, policies, and ecosystems. As the former Chief Technology Officer of NPCI, he spearheaded the implementation of transformative systems like UPI and RuPay, revolutionizing digital payments in India. Dr. Rajendran's contributions to the National Financial Switch, Immediate Payments System (IMPS), National Automated Clearing House (NACH), and Aadhar Enabled Payment System (AEPS) have been instrumental in India's digital transformation. Currently, Dr.N.Rajendran is working as Chief Digital Officer at Multi Commodity Exchange of India, He has led the team to successfully migrated the complex Exchange and Clearing platform to a new Exchange and Clearing platform in a big bang approach. Prior to joining the Multi Commodity Exchange of India, he served as the Chief Executive Officer of Indian Financial Technology and Allied Services (IFTAS). During his tenure at IFTAS, the RTGS was made live 24x7x365.

name: Dr. Neena R Jain
title: Chief General Manager (Consumer Education and Protection)

name: Dr. Ninad Gujarathi
title: Founder
bio: Ninad is a Chemical Engineering technology professional who holds a PhD from Colorado State University. In a span of over 16 years in the corporate sector, worked with several leading companies with primary focus on development and deployment of novel technologies in the field of renewables and energy. After starting his career as a chemical engineering scientist in the R&D department, Ninad gradually accrued experience in designing, project development, process scale-up, technology due diligence, technology commercialization, operations management and then business management in science & technology-based firms. As a natural progression to his learning curve, Ninad started his own technology development & consulting firm, Environalgae in 2022.

name: Dr. Pawan Bakhshi
title: India Country lead, Inclusive Financial Systems
bio: Dr. Pawan Bakhshi leads the Inclusive Financial Systems Program at the India country office of the Gates Foundation, where he works to broaden the reach of low-cost digital financial services for the poor. He is not focused on establishing a particular product or distribution channel, but rather on finding innovative ways to expand access & usage and encourage markets to determine which products and channels are most effective. He focuses on how to efficiently and effectively deliver digital financial services, especially built using Digital Public Infrastructure, to the poor & women which can be quickly scaled to national levels while closely working with the Government, Regulators, Public and Private sector players. He is a mentor/adviser to several FinTechs and startups. Â In the past, he has worked with two of the leading Asian telecom services providers, namely Bharti Airtel in India and SingTel in Singapore in the area of Mobile payments. He is considered a pioneer in the Digital Financial services arena and co-creator of Indiaâ€™s first mobile wallet - Airtel Money. He has been a part of several RBI committees on Financial Inclusion. and a global evangelist for bringing the unbanked and the underbanked into the formal economy.

name: Dr. Pramod Varma
title: Former Chief Architect - India Stack and Co-Author

name: Dr. Sanjay Bahl
title: Director General
bio: Dr Sanjay Bahl has almost four decades of experience in the ICT industry. Dr. Sanjay Bahl is currently the Director General, Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In), Ministry of Electronics and IT, Government of India. His background includes broad and deep skills and knowledge encompassing unique experiences in technology, business, global trade, and policy in the private and public sectors along with academic, public policy and legal areas. He was the Global Chief Security Officer (CS0O) for Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) and the CSO for Microsoft Corporation (India) Pvt Ltd. He was the Chief Information Officer (ClO) for Hughes Tele.com (India) Ltd on secondment from TCS. While at PT Infotimur Sistimatama, Jakarta, and CMC Ltd, New Delhi, he developed, executed and managed large complex software and turnkey projects. As resource person for UN-APCICT, Dr. Bahl has delivered the security and privacy training module of the Academy of ICT Essentials for government leaders. Member of various Security committees at National and International level. Winner of various awards at international and national level.

name: Dr. Supriya Sharma
title: Partner
bio: Supriya Sharma is a partner and head of research at IIMA Ventures. She has led development and publication of 400+ research articles, case studies, reports, infographics and research papers as well as designing and delivery of more than 30 bootcamps, courses and workshops. In the realm of inclusive fintech, Supriya has overseen three prominent research initiatives at IIMA Ventures - Bharat Inclusion Research Fellowships, People of Bharat and Financial Inclusion for Rural Transformation. She is currently leading a multiyear initiative, supported by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, aimed at boosting financial inclusion of over 25 million women in India. Supriya is a fellow of IIM Ahmedabad and retires to hindi poetry and effectual cooking at the end of both, long and short days.

name: Gurjodhpal Singh
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Gurjodhpal Singh was appointed CEO for Tide India, in January 2021. He is an experienced leader in the industry, with 13 years in FinTech and financial services. Gurjodhpal has extensive experience of providing superior services to MSMEs and boasts considerable experience in supporting Indian SMEs over many years. Being at the helm of Tide in India, he is working towards establishing the business in India and scale it over the coming years. Gurjodhpal is passionate about helping SMEs across India digitise and use intuitive technology to help them save time (and money) on the running of their businesses. With all this experience in the sector behind him, Gurjodhpal looks to create something new for Indian SMEs that will empower them to reach their full potential.

name: Lt General M U Nair
title: PVSM, AVSM, SM, the National Cyber Security Coordinator (NCSC)
org: National Security Council Secretariat, Government of India
bio: 1. Lt General MU Nair, Param Vishisht Seva Medal, Ati Vishisht Seva Medal, Sena Medal is an experienced Cybersecurity mentor, who has tenanted the appointment of National Cyber Security Coordinator in the National Security Council Secretariat, Government of India with effect from 01 st July 2023. In this capacity, he is responsible for coordinating all activities across multiple sectors to ensure a secure and resilient cyberspace in the country. 2. General Nair was commissioned into the Corps of Signals of the Indian Army in 1984. He has held several key appointments at all levels of military hierarchy in operational, logistics and technical command and staff assignment. He is a scholar warrior, who has used technology for deriving operational benefits, in key areas of intelligence gathering and information systems. He also was instrumental in steering several key projects on AI, Quantum, Cryptology and Cyber Operations while serving with the Armed Forces. 3. He was the Signal Officer-in-Chief of the Indian Army, when he took up the assignment of the National Cyber Security Coordinator with effect from 01 July 2023. He retired from the Army on 31 May 2024.

name: Mr. Aabhinna Suresh Khare
title: Chief Digital & Marketing Officer
bio: Aabhinna Suresh Khare holds the dual role of Chief Digital & Marketing Officer and Head of Strategy at BajajCapital. He's known for his ability to innovate and transform ideas into tangible products that make a difference. With a strong focus on digital product development and marketing, Aabhinna leads the charge in shaping BajajCapital's digital future. He's deeply committed to preserving the essence and values of BajajCapital while steering the company towards modernization. Aabhinna's strategic vision and proactive mindset have helped BajajCapital stand out in the competitive financial services sector. Outside of work, Aabhinna enjoys simple pleasures like indulging in a well-brewed cup of espresso and getting lost in a good book. He's also passionate about exploring the latest advancements in artificial intelligence and technology. Aabhinna's leadership is characterised by his dedication to excellence and innovation, serving as a source of inspiration within BajajCapital and the broader industry as it moves towards a more customer-centric and digitally-driven future.

name: Mr. Aakarsh Naidu
title: Head of Fintech and Startups
bio: Aakarsh Naidu is currently the Head of Fintech and Startups at Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Innovation Hub. He is an alumnus of the London School of Economics (LSE) and a Global Startup Enabler having managed one of India's Top Startup Incubators - NSRCEL at IIM Bangalore and also led the Startup Programs for Facebook in India and South Asia before starting his venture Startupreneur¬Æ that got successfully acquired by an early stage VC Fund in 2022. In his current role at the RBI Innovation Hub, he is working towards accelerating the growth of the fintech sector in India and globally. He has been featured in various media outlets across the globe for his work in the startup ecosystem.

name: Mr. Aamol Komar Chaudhary
title: Partner - Digital Advisory
bio: Aamol is a seasoned professional with over 15 years of experience in driving digital transformation and IT strategy in the Financial services industry. As a Partner at Financial Services - Technology Enablement practice at KPMG India, he specializes in leading Core Banking and Core Insurance transformation initiatives, helping organizations unlock their full potential through innovative technology solutions. He has successfully delivered complex projects, enabling organizations to streamline operations, reduce costs, and achieve competitive advantage. He holds a strong track record of partnering with C-suite executives and cross-functional teams to deliver results and exceed expectations. He is instrumental in leading multiple multimillion dollar pursuits with client engagements across India, Europe, Middle East and ASEAN.

name: Mr. Abeneazer Wondwossen Lakew
title: Chief Portfolio Office
bio: Abeneazer is a seasoned technology and management professional with over Twelve years of experience. Currently Leading the Chief Portfolio Office at the National Switch of Ethiopia, he brings a wealth of expertise in Product, Payments, Insurance, and Technology domains. Abeneazer leads multiple programs encompassing diverse payment & Digital transformation projects, providing strategic oversight and guidance to ensure successful implementation. He has also leveraged his extensive knowledge from the provision of consultancy services to organizations in Ethiopia and USA, helping them navigate and implementations of Projects & digital transformations. Abeneazer holds an MBA and a BA&IT degree, complemented by multiple certifications in Payment-specific areas, showcasing his proficiency in driving digital transformations and delivering impactful results in the Finance and Technology sector.

name: Mr. Abhay Agarwal
title: Founder & Fund Manager
bio: Abhay is the Founder and Fund Manager of Piper Serica Advisors (www.piperserica.com) with 30 years of investment experience. Piper Serica was founded in 2004. It is a SEBI registered PMS manager and advisor to Piper Serica India Numero Uno Fund, a FPI based in Mauritius. Both these entities invest in stocks listed in India. Piper Serica also manages Piper Serica Angel Fund, a SEBI Cat 1 AIF that invests in Indian start-ups. Piper Serica uses a top-down investment strategy. It identifies sectors that will grow rapidly for next 10-15 years and then invests in the most competitive company in the sector. It uses Michael Porter 5 Forces Competitive Edge Model to test the competitiveness of each portfolio company. Its research team scores each company on 35 parameters to assess its competitiveness after interacting with the management, suppliers, distributors, competitors, bankers etc. of the company. This rating is updated on a quarterly basis. The result is a portfolio that is made up of the best companies and portfolio returns are steady and non-volatile. For its Start-up Fund, Piper Serica has created an AI/ML based tool called yoda.ai to screen startups. This tool takes into account 17 variables to predict the probability of success of the start-up. This tool has led to successful investments in start-ups like Alt Mobility, FloWorks, Kivi Fintech, Driffle, Khatabook, Junio, DesignX, Castler, Univ Living and Pantherun. Prior to founding Piper Serica, Abhay worked as a Director with the Private Equity group of JP Morgan in India, HK and Singapore (1997-2004). He invested in companies in India, Korea, Australia, Singapore, China and the US. His investments include HDFC Bank, Piramal Glass, Jubilant Foodworks, Nicholas Piramal (acquired by Abbott), Bharat Forge, MTR Foods (acquired by Orkla), Mando Machinery Korea, Marico and HDFC Securities. Abhay worked with Citibank India from 1993-1997. He managed a direct investment program for the bank that made some very successful investments. Abhay has done B.com from Sydenham College, Mumbai (1991) and MBA from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management (1993). Abhay is an active martial artist. He is a third-degree black belt in Judo and a certified international Judo coach. He is also a black belt in Shotokan Karate. He trains under-privileged children and supports budding Judokas and martial artists.

name: Mr. Abhay Pareek
title: Lead, Fourth Industrial Revolution for Agriculture
bio: Abhay brings over 16 years of expertise in managing multi-stakeholder initiatives in agriculture and development finance. Currently, he serves as the Lead for Fourth Industrial Revolution in Agriculture at the World Economic Forum, India, where he drives Public-Private Partnerships to advance digital agriculture. Before joining the Forum, Abhay held various roles with the United Nations Capital Development Fund and MSC Consulting, working across Nepal, China, the Philippines, and India. He holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Rural Management from Xavier Institute of Management, Bhubaneswar.

name: Mr. Abhay Parekh
title: Head - AePS, NFS & Market Initiatives
bio: Abhay Parekh, has more than 20 years of experience in accounting & finance, banking and retails payments. He is with NPCI since December 2013 and presently heading two products viz. NFS ATM network and Aadhaar Enabled Payment Systems (AePS). He also heads other market initiatives at NPCI like eKYC services, DigiSaathi – helpline for information on digital payment products and services, member bank compliances, NPS, etc.

name: Mr. Abhijit Singh
title: Group Head – Banking as a service (BaaS), Digital Ecosystem Banking and International Banking
bio: Mr. Abhijit Singh is Group Head â€“ Banking as a service (BaaS), Digital Ecosystem Banking and International Banking at HDFC Bank. Prior to this, he was Member of Executive Management at HDFC Limited. He has an MBA in Finance from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai, India and holds a Bachelor's degree in Engineering from the University of Mumbai. He was the Chief Operating Officer (COO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) at OakNorth Bank, London. Before OakNorth, he had worked with ICICI Bank in various senior positions, including Head â€“ Technology Group (CIO). He has international banking experience through his stint at RBS, ANZ, and ABN AMRO Bank. Mr. Singh is a veteran in Banking technology, emerging technology and fintech with 25+ years of extensive background in product development, large-scale digital transformation, project execution and running of Operations of a digital bank. In a career spanning multiple countries, he has worked alongside diverse internal teams and partners across European MNC Banks, large Indian Private Sector Banks and a UK Challenger Bank. He has done pioneering work in emerging technologies like blockchain and aiding in large organisations' digital transformation.

name: Mr. Abhinav Thakur
title: Head of Analytics CoE
bio: Abhinav Thakur is the Head of Analytics CoE at Experian India, where he leads the analytics function to drive innovation and data-driven decision-making. With over 17 years of experience in the fields of digital lending, credit risk, and data science, Abhinav plays a critical role in shaping the analytics strategy at Experian, ensuring the company leverages advanced machine learning and predictive modeling techniques to enhance business outcomes. In his current role, Abhinav is responsible for overseeing the Analytics Center of Excellence, which focuses on developing and implementing cutting-edge analytical solutions that support Experian‚Äôs global operations. His work involves the application of statistical modeling and predictive analytics to solve complex business problems, particularly in the credit bureau and financial services sectors. Prior to joining Experian, Abhinav held senior positions in leading organizations, including Associate Director of Strategy and Analytics at Deloitte Consulting and General Manager at Reliance Jio. His extensive experience also includes key roles at HDFC Life, Barclays, and ICICI Bank, where he honed his expertise in credit scoring, data science, and analytics leadership. Abhinav holds an M.Phil and an M.Sc in Econometrics and Quantitative Economics from the Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research, Mumbai.

name: Mr. Abhishek Bali
title: CEO and Co-Founder
bio: Abhishek Bali is the CEO and Co-Founder of ZIGRAM, with over 17 years of expertise in anti-money laundering, financial crime compliance, data assets and third-party risks. He has worked on engagements and initiatives across the world as part of work with organizations like KPMG, BMR Advisors, Dun & Bradstreet, and Axis Bank. Abhishek leads various business initiatives and data solutions that leverage machine learning, artificial intelligence, data assets, and deep technology applications, to solve real-world problems in the risk and compliance domain. Products and technologies developed by him are in the space of Anti-Money Laundering (AML), politically exposed persons (PEPs), KYC/DD, adverse media, country watchlists, sanctions, cannabis-related businesses, high-risk individuals, and entity & news monitoring. Abhishek is ACAMS certified and a co-chair of the India Chapter of ACFCS.

name: Mr. Abhishek Bhagat
title: Managing Director, Digital & Technology Investment Banking

name: Mr. Abhishek Mishra
title: Chief Risk Officer
bio: Abhishek is the Chief Risk Officer of CAMS Group, overseeing risk, compliance, audit, and information security. With over 25 years of BFSI multinational experience, his expertise extends across operations, sales, digital transformations, and step-up productivity enhancements. Starting as Engineer Officer with the Indian Railways, Abhishek joined the financial services sector post his IIM MBA and worked with Washington Mutual Bank in US, GE & Accenture. Earlier, he was the CEO of CAMS Insurance Repository and Co-founder CEO of IN-D, an AI-driven company that specialised in free form information transformation. In this journey, he also picked up PMP certification from Project Management Institute US and six sigma black belt from the American Society for Quality.

name: Mr. Abhishek Poddar
title: CEO & Co-founder
bio: Abhishek Poddar is the Co-founder and CEO of Plum, an employee health insurance platform. Plum was founded in 2019 to accelerate the adoption of health insurance in India, by offering high quality and affordable employee health insurance. Abhishek founded his first venture RentZeal, Palo Alto, U.S. in 2013 and expanded it to the Bay Area. RentZeal, was an eBay for product rentals that brought together consumers and small rental shops. Prior to his venture, Abhishek had started his career as a consultant with McKinsey. He was also associated with 9.9 media as a Product Head and led technology businesses for the publication. His journey began as a venture capitalist, where he nurtured startups and helped them grow. But Ajay wanted to do more‚ he wanted to make a real difference. With a vision to democratize the $3 trillion investment market, he created StockGro, a platform where millions can learn, trade, and invest. Through StockGro, he’s not just teaching people about investments; he's giving them the tools to achieve their dreams and secure their futures. Ajay Lakhotia is more than an entrepreneur; he's a life-changer, inspiring countless individuals to take control of their financial destinies and build a brighter, more prosperous tomorrow.

Ajay also manages two strategic knowledge units for the Bank which engages with Government, Industry Bodies & Corporates on areas of policy creation & execution in the Food & Agri, EV etc space. In the ever-evolving landscape of finance and banking, Ajay has been at the forefront of driving change and innovation. His expertise lies in understanding the intricacies of the modern financial world and deliver the most innovative & optimal product proposition, built through collaboration & partnerships. He is a regular invitee to speak at various national and international forums related to Banking, Fintech, Innovation & Digital. Ajay brings with him more than 27 years of corporate banking experience and prior to joining YES Bank, he was the Global Head of Fintech for Deutsche Bank. With a decade of experience at companies like Stripe, Razorpay, and NIUM, Akash leverages his expertise to drive Glomopay's innovative solutions. The supportive regulatory environment at GIFT City enables Glomopay to meet global business needs effectively. Partnering with multiple International Banking Units (IBUs) in GIFT City, Glomopay is introducing programmable capabilities to automate financial operations. Over the years, he has been associated with industry leaders like Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited, Center for Insurance and Risk Management (CIRM) and Weather Risk Management Services Ltd. He joined Munich Re as a Regional Head of Agriculture in 2021. He was responsible for the agriculture business of India and sub-continents, Southeast Asia, Japan, and Korea. bio: An enterprising figure, Ambar Sur co-founded TerraPay Payment Services, a licensed digital payments infrastructure and solutions provider, with his close associates and friends, Mr. Ram Sundaram, Aniruddha Sane, and Akbar Hussain. Heading the organisation as its Chief Executive Officer, Ambar Sur is the man at helm for steering the organisational presence across continents and nations. With over two decades of rich experience in telecom and mobile payments, Ambar Sur possess a sound understanding of the industry, voluminous knowledge of technology, and a keen eye for market and business drivers, Äî a combination that has helped him lead the organisation to capitalize the emerging African markets, create a strong foundation in the some major European countries, and enter into Asian market. His dynamic leadership style, clear sighted vision, and a customer-centric approach has helped TerraPay shoot-up the popularity charts in a short span of 6 years, gaining strong goodwill among investors and stakeholders worldwide. Before founding TerraPay, Ambar Sur worked at Comviva Technologies Ltd. for over 13 years. He had joined Comviva as Chief Marketing Officer in 2002. When he parted ways from the organisation, he had been serving as a Wholetime Director & Sr. Vice President for about 6 years. Prior to joining Comviva, Ambar had founded CellCloud Technologies in in 2000, where he was the key driver of business growth building sales of the company's innovative prepaid solution in India, and helping ensure the company became profitable within a short period. CellCloud merged with Mahindra Comviva in 2002. Ambar began his 19 year career in Washington DC as a project manager with LCC, a pioneer in wireless voice and data services for the telecom industry, where he set up various networks around the world. Having gained experience of the wireless world, Ambar moved to India to work with BPL Mobile, where he oversaw Network Performance & RF Planning for the company. Ambar is a New York University graduate with a MS degree in Electrical Engineering. Prior to that, he had completed his Bachelors in Electrical Engineering from Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University. A voracious reader, Ambar loves spending his personal time amongst books. Other than reading, he is a music and travel enthusiast.

AK joined Myntra from Google, Mountain View where he played an instrumental role in launching Chromecast, one of the best selling electronics devices worldwide. As the former head of Prove India, Amit spearheaded the launch of innovative identity and authentication products in the Indian market. Now, he's channeling his passion for the fintech space and startup growth into venture capital and fund management. Over the past 4-5 years, Amit has made numerous early-stage investments, some of them have grown to be successful businesses and category leaders in Fintech, He has been rated as both Global and Asia Top 100 experts in FinTech by various agencies. He was also responsible for all digital initiatives of BSE, including BSE’s website and its mobile apps. He has been instrumental in monetizing the website and making it a sustainable revenue center. Shri Amit has over 2 decades of experience in management of IT application project portfolios across stock exchanges, depositories, eCommerce, telecom and retail sectors. Shri Amit Mahajan is a Bachelor of Engineering from BITS Pilani, India and an MBA from Mumbai University.

name: Mr. Amitabh Chaudhry
title: Managing Director & CEO
bio: In a long and distinguished career, Amitabh has been unafraid to take risks, challenge norms and push the boundaries of conventional thinking across industries. Amitabh runs Axis Bank, a financial conglomerate, together with a world class leadership team and a clearly defined vision of being a bank that fulfils the aspirations of a new, resurgent India through smart banking solutions. Over the past five years, Axis Bank has turned in industry leading performance on growth, profitability, and sustainability through a mix of deep investments in digital, focus on customer experience, making a strategic bet on Bharat and being prudent on risk. The Bank also acquired the consumer business of Citibank India recently to strengthen its wealth and credit card portfolio. These efforts under his leadership are clearly visible in the upward trajectory of Axis Bank’s performance. Before joining Axis Bank, Amitabh had a long stint as the CEO of HDFC Life, when he built one of the most valued life insurance franchises in the country. He built a culture of product innovation and a digital-first approach, shaping the industry’s thought process and future aspirations. Amitabh started his career with Bank of America where he donned diverse roles like head of technology investment banking for Asia, regional finance head for wholesale bank and CFO (India). After 16 years of banking, he switched careers and became part of the founding leadership team at Infosys BPM in 2003. He built a successful process outsourcing business in his 8 years stint, that set a benchmark on the nature of work that could transition to India along with profitability. He also handled the Validation Services portfolio at Infosys. Amitabh is the Chairperson of the FICCI National Committee on Banking, since 2019. He has also served as Director on the board of several reputed organizations and has received numerous awards and recognitions. Amitabh is an Engineer from Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, and holds a postgraduate degree in Business Management from IIM, Ahmedabad.

Amrish has also worked with other global organizations including First Data, NCR and Siemens Nixdorf. In 2013, Amrish founded CitrusPay which was acquired by PayU in 2016 for USD 150 million. A bachelor in engineering, Amrish has over the years helped build new businesses and new divisions in global companies. Many of these continue to be market leaders in their respective category today. He started his fintech journey in First Data Corporation in 2005. Later, as Managing Director for First Data Asia he helped build a market leading payments joint venture with ICICI Bank. He started his career as a developer in Hughes Software Systems and subsequently was a founding member of the India team of Evolving Systems Inc. He holds an MBA from the Wharton School and an engineering degree from NIT Trichy.
