bio: An IIM-A alumnus and a Chartered Accountant, Anand Kumar Bajaj, is the Founder, MD & CEO of PayNearby. With over 23 years of experience in Digital Payments and Mobility, Anand currently holds six patents in banking technology. Anand founded PayNearby, a DPIIT-certified company and Indiaâ€™s leading branchless banking and digital network in 2016. Operating on a B2B2C model, PayNearby partners with neighborhood retail stores, empowering them to offer digital and financial services to local communities. Steering the company's strategic direction and growth, Anand along with his team, is committed to enabling the reach of digital payments and financial services at the first mile by empowering retailers.. Anand's strategic vision and leadership have propelled PayNearby to serve 75% of India through its tech-led Distribution as a Service (DaaS) network. Prior to founding PayNearby, Anand's journey includes notable stints at YES Bank, ICICI Bank, and Ernst & Young, where he honed his expertise in financial services. At YES Bank, he held the position of President and Chief Innovation Officer, spearheading impactful programs in digital payments. He played a pivotal role in driving insight-based solutions in the FinTech sector, contributing significantly to the bank's innovation landscape. Prior to YES Bank, Anand held various leadership positions at ICICI Bank, where he led initiatives in branch automation, self-service banking, and innovation, securing several patents along the way. Anand is also actively involved in industry associations, serving as the Co-Chair of the Business Correspondent Federation of India (BCFI), where he advocates for operational enhancements in the financial services sector. Additionally, he contributes to academia as the Chairman of the Board of Studies for Business Design Program at Welingkar Institute of Management and as a member of the Board of Studies for the Center of Excellence in Digital Transformation at NMIMS. Anand's remarkable journey showcases his constant focus to driving innovation and digital inclusion in the financial services landscape, making him a prominent figure in the industry.

name: Mr. Anchal Jajodia
title: Co Founder and CEO
bio: Anchal is the Co-Founder and CEO at Cybrilla, a SEBI CAT 1 RTA, which builds modern infrastructure for decentralizing distribution and tokenizing asset management. They power 60+ of the fastest growing digital distributors, AMCs and brokers in India.

name: Mr. Andrew McCormack
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Andrew McCormack, COO of Al Etihad Payments, brings over 20 years of experience in financial services. Known for his contributions to the payments industry, Andrew previously led the Singapore BIS Innovation Hub, focusing on cross-border payments, CBDCs, and regtech/suptech. He holds an Executive MBA from the Richard Ivey School of Business and a Bachelor of Computer Science from Carleton University.

name: Mr. Angaj Bhandari
title: Senior Vice President - Europe, Middle East & Africa
bio: Angaj has 20+ years of experience in the payments, banking and telecom domains, out of which 6 years have been with Fime. Angaj is driving Fimeâ€™s mission of innovation and digital transformation in Europe, Middle East and Africa. He is instrumental in driving Fimeâ€™s growth in the region for payments, smart mobility and digital identity segments, through a portfolio of consulting and test services, designed for central banks, card schemes, payment networks, banks, merchants, smart mobility actors and OEMs. Prior to Fime, Angaj worked with Nokia, Royal Bank of Scotland, Euronet, Airtel and Paycraft.

name: Mr. Angelo M Duarte
title: Head of Department
bio: Graduated in engineering and PhD in Economics from Graduate School of Economics at Fundacao Getulio Vargas (EPGE / FGV). Analyst of the Central Bank of Brazil since 1998, where he was Economic Advisor to the Governor’s Office and is currently Head of the Competition and Financial Market Structure Department. He also served at the Ministry of Finance in the areas economic policy and competition advocacy, and was visiting economist at the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) between 2013 and 2016.

name: Mr. Angira Agrawal
title: India Business Head
bio: Angira heads India Business at Exotel. In his role, he collaborates closely with organizations to identify industry trends, use cases, and growth areas for Exotel, while as India Business Head, he focuses on enhancing customer experience as a connected conversations platform provider. Prior to joining Exotel, Angira held various senior leadership roles at top-tier organizations, including Airtel Business, Skylo, Vodafone Idea, NEC, Tata Communications, Accelerite, Oracle, and HCL Technologies. His passion for technology has driven him to create innovative solutions and processes that transform the way businesses engage internally and with customers. With an MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur and a BE in Electronics from MSU Baroda, Angira is renowned in the industry for driving growth and innovation.

name: Mr. Ani Sane
title: Co-Founder and CBO
bio: A seasoned entrepreneur, Aniruddha Sane is one of the founding members of TerraPay Payment Services, a licensed digital payment infrastructure and solutions provider. With a rich experience of over 20 years in global business development in electronic payments and services, Aniruddha is the Chief Business Development Officer at TerraPay. Before co-founding Terrapay in 2015, Aniruddha made his entrepreneurial debut by co-founding R Worldwide, a payment products and service provider, where he took up the roles of Country Manager and Board of Director in its various subsidiaries across the globe for a period of over 6 years. With his exceptional business development skills and dynamic approach, Aniruddha was the key driver of the successful business set of Rev in India and Middle East. Prior to Rev, Aniruddha was working with Fidelity Information Services (FIS) as Director of Sales, looking after the India markets for the organization’s financial payment products and services business. He has also served in multiple start-ups as a financial and strategic investor and has been associated with several global giants like Diebold, Canon, and Motorola. An MBA from Mumbai University, Aniruddha also has Bachelors in Business Management and Engineering degree from Mumbai University, India.

name: Mr. Anil Singh
title: Country Head - Credit Cards & Merchant Acquiring
bio: Anil Singh is a seasoned Credit card professional having 25+ years of experience with a proven track record of success and a deep understanding of the industry. He is currently the Country Head for Credit Cards and Merchant Acquiring at YES BANK. Previously he has worked as Business Head for the Bajaj Finserv and RBL cobrand credit card.

name: Mr. Anish Achuthan
title: Cofounder & CEO
bio: A tech visionary and a serial entrepreneur, Anish is reimagining the way business banking is done. He co-founded OPEN, the world's fastest-growing digital banking enterprise. Anish has a career spanning over 17 years in the fintech industry. He co-founded his first start-up, iFuturz Wireless, in 2001, which was into mobile value-added services. In 2007, Anish founded CashNxt, which was a plug-and-play mobile payment and financial inclusion platform meant specifically for semi-urban and rural markets. CashNxt was later acquired by a Latin American company. He later built Neartivity Wireless, an NFC-based payment processing platform, in 2009. In 2013, he co-founded Zwitch, which was India's first developer-focused payment platform, later acquired by Citrus Payments in 2015. During his entrepreneurial journey, Anish interacted with many SMEs and realized that banking is broken for small businesses. Business owners struggled to identify and keep track of their income and expenses. This led him to start the OPEN in 2017 along with Mabel Chacko, Ajeesh Achuthan, and Deena Jacob. OPEN is Asia's first neo-banking platform that helps automate business payments, banking, and accounting functions in one unified service for SMEs and startups Anish has spoken at various fintech panels globally, including Singapore Fintech Festival 2020, Money2020, Paris Fintech Forum, and Vision2020. He is also one of the leading think tanks in Asia and globally in the new banking segment. TiE conferred him the ScaleUp Entrepreneur of the Year award.

name: Mr. Anish Patil
title: Vice President
bio: Anish covers Fintech and Financial Services at Matrix Partners India, an early-stage investment firm with more than $1.5 billion under management. He is involved in the firm's investments across multiple companies like DEZERV, Scapia, NAKAD, Stable Money and Seeds Fincap. Anish started his career at McKinsey and Company as a consultant, where he worked primarily in the Global Energy and Materials practice. He was involved in multiple large scale digital transformations where he drove impact for clients by leveraging advanced analytics. He had a short stint with Goldman Sachs in their India investment banking franchise and was covering Banks, NBFCs and E-commerce sectors. Anish holds a B.Tech from IIT Madras and an MBA from IIM Calcutta, where he graduated as the Gold medallist of his batch. He was also awarded the prestigious OPJEMS Scholarship for academic and leadership excellence.

name: Mr. Anjani Rathor
title: Chief Digital Experience Officer
bio: Mr. Anjani Rathor is Group Head and Chief Digital Experience Officer (CDO). He is responsible for customer experience at various channels of the bank including all online banking systems, virtual channels, branches and alternate banking outlets. He is also responsible for leveraging Data as a competency within the bank for improving customer digital adoption and cross sell.In his previous role at the Bank as the Chief Digital Officer, Mr. Rathor was responsible for building digital technologies across the enterprise and the performance of digital channels. Mr. Rathor joined HDFC Bank from Bharti Airtel Ltd., where he worked for 12 years. He joined Airtel in 2007 and spearheaded several transformational initiatives in various capacities during his tenure. He also served as the Chief Information Officer (CIO) of the company’s Consumer Business. An industry veteran with over 25+ years of experience, Mr. Rathor brings with him rich and diverse experience across sectors such as Banking, Telcom, Consulting and Aviation. Prior to Bharti Airtel, he has held leadership positions with organizations such as Boeing International, Accenture, and Citicorp. Mr. Rathor holds a degree in Bachelor of Technology from IIT Kharagpur and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIM-Calcutta.

name: Mr. Ankit Agrawal
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Ankit Agrawal is an entrepreneur, angel investor and mentor and the founder of one of India’s leading insurtech brand- InsuranceDekho, launched in 2017. Ankit’s vision for Insurance in India is to get ‘Bima’ added to the quintessential list of basic necessities and keeping the heartland realities in mind, he dreams of taking insurance directly to 6 lakh villages in India. Ankit is passionate about startups and actively supports new businesses & founders. He has also been a mentor and an angel investor on the popular investment show ‘Indian Angels’ on Jio Cinema. A Delhi University alumnus, Ankit worked for three years in the US before returning to India and is the recipient of several awards including ‘Bharat Fintech Leader of the Year 2023’ and ‘BusinessWorld 40 under 40’ list for the year 2022.

name: Mr. Ankit Gupta
title: President
bio: Ankit Gupta is President at the Manager. In this role, he will drive all aspects of business including corporate strategy, growth and business development, finance and provide strategic oversight required in achieving business objectives. With around two decades of work experience with significant expertise in the real estate sector, Ankit Gupta has previously been a Partner at McKinsey and Co. and Chief Executive Officer at OYO for its India business. In these organizations, he has successfully led revenue and profitability growth, organization building and enabled process efficiency. He has a bachelors' and masters' degree in mechanical engineering from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay.

name: Mr. Antriksh Parmar
title: Product Manager
bio: Antriksh is a seasoned technologist and product builder with 11+ years of experience at organizations such as Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley & Atlassian. During his time, he has built derivatives trading platforms, crypto exchange and B2B Saas product targeting global audience. Currently, Antriksh is a part of ONDC's FS team - pivotal in building digital public infrastructure for credit, insurance, and investments. This effort targets underserved populations, aiming to democratize financial service.

name: Mr. Anubhab Goel
title: Head Digital Innovation
bio: Anubhab is a serial entrepreneur having cofounded and exited 2 startups... currently he is responsible for digital transformation for HDFC ERGO building new age tech stacks and ecosystem offerings. HERE app built at HDFC ERGO is one of the unique super app built by any insurance companies globally and he is amthe co-author of the case study published at London business school.

name: Mr. Anubrata Biswas
title: Managing Director & CEO
bio: Mr. Anubrata Biswas is the MD & CEO of Airtel Payments Bank and an industry stalwart with over two decades of experience in banking and financial services sector. In his current role he has built a sustainable model for India’s first Payments Bank. Airtel Payments Bank today is a significant player in India’s financial ecosystem, large & profitable. The Bank today is operating the largest banking network in the world. It is also India’s largest micro-cash player and fastest growing digital banking proposition. Mr. Biswas started his banking career with ICICI bank in 2001. He led several national and overseas assignments, including building the ICICI Bank brand in the USA and the Middle East, establishing retail banking for ICICI Bank in London and heading the international retail business for ICICI Bank including NRI business and remittances. Mr. Biswas has served on leading industry bodies. He was the Chairman of PCI committee for Payments Bank and Co-Chair of the CII Financial Inclusion and Fintech Committee. He has been a member of the FICCI National Committee on Banking. He was the Co-Chair of the CII Task Force on Fintech for FY 21. In the past, he has also been a member of the EFMA Retail Banking Advisory Council, Europe. Mr. Biswas is an alumnus of Jadavpur University and has completed his degree in Business Administration (PGDBM) from IIM, Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Anuj Bajpai
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Anuj Bajpai is the co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of Liquide, a fintech platform dedicated to transforming how individuals create and manage wealth. With over two decades in the financial services industry, Anuj has consistently demonstrated his expertise in blending technology with finance to develop solutions that empower individual investors. Under Anuj's leadership, Liquide has become a trusted partner for retail investors, offering comprehensive stock research reports, premium screeners, high-accuracy trades, and a wealth of educational content. His commitment to financial literacy and inclusion drives Liquide's mission to democratize access to top-tier investment tools and insights, helping individuals build and secure their financial futures.

name: Mr. Anuj Kacker
title: Co-founder
bio: Anuj Kacker, Co-founder of Freo, combines a diverse entrepreneurial background with advertising expertise. He co-founded SkillWiz, which evolved into Tapstart, a successful job discovery platform. Anuj's career also includes impactful roles in advertising and telecom, particularly as the Head of Customer Acquisitions at Bharti Airtel's Karnataka Circle. An alumnus of ISB Hyderabad and a Mathematics graduate from St. Xavier’s Mumbai, he is lauded for his leadership and community contributions. Anuj's journey reflects a blend of innovative thinking, strategic business acumen, and a commitment to creating value in the fintech sector.

name: Mr. Anup Kumar Agarwal
title: South Asia Fintech Lead
bio: Anup Kumar Agarwal, South Asia Fintech Lead, IFC, currently leads fintech investments for IFC in South Asia across payments, lending, insurtech, wealthtech, etc sub-verticals. In the past, he has led several equity and debt investment transactions for IFC in South Asia, East Asia and Africa across the financial services space, including banks, NBFCs, microfinance, housing finance, broking, PE/VC fund, etc. He has successfully managed exits (including through IPOs) and has experienced full investment cycle. Prior to joining IFC, Anup worked as Group Head - Credit and Deputy General Manager in ICICI Bank and as Assistant General Manager with ICRA Limited. Anup is a Chartered Accountant (Rank Holder), additionally qualified as a CFA (ICFAI), ICWA, and CS with over 25+ years of experience in equity investing, lending, portfolio management, credit rating, and consulting.

name: Mr. Anurag Agrawal
title: Partner
bio: Mr. Anurag Agrawal currently serves as a partner at Aavishkaar Capital, one of the leading Impact focused Investment funds in India. Aavishkaar Capital's investment strategy focus on investing in businesses across 3 core sectors ‚Äì Financial Inclusion, Food &Agriculture, and Essential Services. Anurag has been part of the founding team of Group Company, Intellecap and last served as its CEO. He set up and built the Company's Investment Banking Practice with a specificfocus on assisting early and growth-stage multiple bottom-line enterprises to raise capital. Anurag has the unique distinction of working with most of the leading microfinance institutions in India and has helped many of these institutions in their fund-raising efforts.He was also one of the key architects of creating the current structure of the Aavishkaar Group and led the efforts of the Group in the incubation and acquisition of the 3 NBFCs(IntelleCash, Ashv and Arohan) within the Group. In addition to serving on the Board of the Group Holding Company, Anurag represents the Promoter interest on the Board of Group Companies Arohan and Ashv as well as Aavishkaar Portfolio Companies, Butterfly Fields and Nepra. Before joining the Aavishkaar Group, Anurag worked with the Cash Management Services Division of ICICI Bank. Anurag completed his MBA with a specialization in Finance from TAPai Management Institute, Manipal.

name: Mr. Anurag Chaddha
title: Partner
bio: Anurag Chadha is a partner with Mckinsey & Co. He leads Mckinsey's work in retail banking and financial services across India and SE Asia. He serves clients with bold aspirations of rapid growth, helps build new institutions and fintechs from scratch and enables transformation of leading institutions by leveraging cutting edge data and analytics.

name: Mr. Anurag Gupta
title: Vice President (VP) & Head of Global Merchant & Network Services
bio: "Anurag Gupta has been a part of American Express for over 20 years, working across different businesses, functions, and roles in India and in other global markets. He has a proven and consistent track record of driving the business P&L, managing key partners and large sales teams, leading global operations, customer servicing, as well as leading strategic projects for the company. In his current role as the Head of Global Merchant & Network Services, Anurag is responsible for expanding the Amex merchant coverage and the network that issues American Express Cards via bank partnerships in India. He has been the driver for the exceptional growth of Amex coverage and the issuance of partner bank cards in India. Anurag's leadership extends beyond operational excellence; his foresight in embracing digital innovation and leveraging data analytics has enabled the company to deliver cutting-edge payment solutions, catering to the evolving needs of a dynamic market. He is highly regarded in the payments ecosystem for his ability to anticipate market trends and his commitment to delivering exceptional value to merchants and Card Members."

name: Mr. Anurag Sinha
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Anurag co-founded OneCard in 2019, which is on a mission to re-imagine credit and payments from first principles using data & proprietary technology. OneCard has scaled to more than 2 million customers and is backed by marquee investors such as Sequoia Capital, Matrix Partners, Temasek, GIC, QED Investors amongst others. Prior to this Anurag started his entrepreneurship journey in 2016 as a co-founder at Walnut app building up its lending business, Walnut Prime. Walnut scaled to more than 10 million users and got acquired in 2018. Anurag Sinha is an alumnus of IIT BHU, Varanasi and IIM Bangalore. He is deeply passionate about Payments and Digital Finance. Before deciding to become an entrepreneur he spent 13 years at ICICI Bank scaling up businesses in areas of Cards & Consumer Credit, Digital Banking, Structured Finance and Stressed Assets."

name: Mr. Anuvrat Jain
title: Growth & Late stage Investor
bio: Anuvrat Jain is a Growth and Late stage investor at Lightspeed. He supports the new-age companies that are changing the way we lead our lives daily and has been instrumental in many Lightspeed late stage deals like; Zepto, Yubi, Razorpay, Pocket FM, Aspire etc. He sees investing as a catalyst to bringing transformation across industries and has built significant expertise in identifying the companies and entrepreneurs that can continue to disrupt at a large scale over a long period of time.

name: Mr. Apoorva Goyal
title: Vice President, Investments
bio: Apoorva leads India-DNA investments for Insight Partners, a leading global technology investing firm based out of New York. His focus areas are high-growth fintech, internet and software companies from Series A to pre-IPO stages. He is an operator at heart and enjoys working with founders on everything product, finance and strategy. Before joining Insight, he managed operations for a $300M+ consumer business at ITC and technology investments at a leading Indian early-stage investment fund.

name: Mr. Aravind Maiya
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Aravind Maiya has over 22 years of experience in real estate, capital markets, audit and consulting. Aravind was the Chief Financial Officer at Embassy REIT from May 2019 to May 2022, and played a pivotal role in driving the growth of India's first listed REIT. He rejoined Embassy REIT from Tata Realty, where he was the Chief Financial Officer overseeing the finance and tax functions as well as investor relations. He was also actively involved in the strategic growth initiatives with the CEO. At Embassy REIT, Aravind was a core member of the management team and was responsible for the finance, legal and compliance functions. Prior to that, he was Partner at BSR & Associates LLP, where he specialised in commercial real estate across audit, assurance and capital market transactions including listed companies. Aravind holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Bengaluru University and is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.

name: Mr. Ari Sarker
title: President, Asia Pacific
bio: Ari Sarker joined Mastercard in 2011 and has since held an array of leadership roles across geographies. He is currently president of Asia Pacific, overseeing all of the company’s activities in the region. He is also a member of the Global Management Committee. Ari is an active proponent of Mastercard’s financial inclusion commitments, and a dedicated champion of inclusive growth efforts across a number of Asia’s emerging economies. He also spearheads identifying and managing new equity investment opportunities designed to establish Mastercard as a natural partner of choice for firms in the dynamically evolving fintech landscape. Prior to his current role, Ari was co-president of the Asia Pacific region. Earlier, he helmed Mastercard’s business for South Asia, including India. He started his journey with the company as head of network processing for AP & MEA. Before joining Mastercard, Ari spent over 12 years with GE in a number of roles across key markets in the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.

name: Mr. Arindam Das
title: Chief Executive Officer - Consumer Credit and MSME Loans
bio: Arindam Das has been with DMI Finance since January 2017, serving as the CEO of Consumer & MSME Finance for DMI Finance Pvt. Ltd. He joined the company at its inception and played a pivotal role in building the business from the ground up. Under his leadership, the NBFC arm of DMI Group has grown to become one of the largest digital lending NBFCs in the country. Arindam also serves on the Board of DMI’s Payment Business (Appnit Technologies) and is a member of the Investment Committee of DMI’s Venture Capital Fund (Sparkle). Arindam holds a Master’s in Business Management from K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai. With over two decades of experience in financial services, he has worked with prominent firms such as Citigroup, IIFL, and Capital First (IDFC First Bank). He also co-founded an On Demand local services marketplace during his entrepreneurial stint. Throughout his career, Arindam has been instrumental in conceptualizing, building, and scaling large businesses in Consumer and SME finance across various organizations. His expertise spans strategic leadership, business development, and financial services innovation.

name: Mr. Arindam Das Gupta
title: Interim Chief Program Officer & Director Innovation in Digital Finance
bio: A management graduate with 18 years of experience in Banking and Sales and Marketing and strategy planning. A career banker at Axis Bank and Equitas Small finance Bank led the strategy and the digital initiatives. At Axis Bank handled Review Management Mechanism for the Corporate Relationship Group through CRM module for expanding the book size among the large corporates within the risk compliance framework, Arindam managed SOX compliance for the international business at Axis

name: Mr. Arjun Chowdhry
title: Group Executive - Affluent Banking, NRI, Cards/ Payments & Retail Lending
bio: Arjun Chowdhry Group Executive- Affluent Banking, NRI, Cards/ Payments and Retail Lending - Axis. Arjun Chowdhry is the Group Executive for Affluent Banking, NRI, Cards/ Payments and Retail Lending at Axis Bank. He joined Axis Bank post the acquisition of Citibank India’s consumer business on March 1, 2023. He spearheaded this merger as the Country Consumer Business Head of Citibank India. Arjun has 30 years of very diverse experience across consumer banking businesses, with Citibank India and now with Axis. His experience spans across operations, sales, strategic functions and running large & diversified businesses. During his tenure, he was instrumental in building the cards, wealth and salary franchises at Citibank India. He also set up Citi’s first US-facing offshore consumer operation, growing it rapidly from its inception and leading it for over 5 years. Arjun is an alumnus of St Stephens College, Delhi, and the Indian Institute of Management (IIM),Bangalore.

name: Mr. Arjun Vir Singh
title: Partner & Global Co-Head of Fintech
bio: Arjun is a Partner and Global Co-Head of Fintech with Arthur D. Little. His areas of focus is the Future of Finance and how the sector is evolving due to consumer, technology and regulatory trends . Arjun is deeply involved in the overall Fintech, Payments and Digital Assets Ecosystem across the MENA region and beyond â€“ as an advisor, angel investor, mentor and commentator. He is also a host to one of most well regarded podcasts in the region called â€˜Couchonomics with Arjunâ€™ which focusses on the global financial services sector.

name: Mr. Arpit Chug
title: Chief Financial Officer
bio: Arpit Chug is the Chief Financial Officer at Razorpay. He is responsible for the Finance, Credit Risk, and Legal functions at Razorpay. Arpit is an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad. Prior to joining Razorpay, Arpit has worked at Amex for more than 15 years,holding multiple CFO roles.In addition to this, he was also the Head of Treasury for the Asia Pacific, Japan, and Australia at Amex. While Arpit has always enjoyed working with numbers and crunching and calculating them constantly, what interests him more is being able to tell financial stories through numbers. Arpit also believes as a finance professional, he is usually biased by numbers so he constantly reminds himself that â€˜not everything that canâ€™t be counted counts, not everything that counts can be counted.

name: Mr. Ashish Agrawal
title: Managing Director
bio: Ashish advises on fintech, software, and consumer internet investments for Peak XV Partners in India. He represents Peak XV on the board of companies such as Groww, Leap, Progcap, Pristyn Care, Stanza Living, GoKwik, payGlocal, Toddle and Lightmetrics amongst others. He has also been involved with Peak XV’s investments in Zomato (NSE: ZOMATO), OYO Rooms, Go-Jek (IDX:GOTO), Rebel Foods, Porter and Clevertap amongst others. Previously, Ashish was an entrepreneur, building travel focused mobile apps and has worked as a management consultant with McKinsey & Company. Ashish graduated from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur with a Bachelors and Masters degree in Computer Science. He was awarded the Ratan Swarup Memorial Prize for best all round performance in his graduating class. Ashish is also a Kauffman fellow.

name: Mr. Ashish Choudhury
title: Chief Investment Officer
bio: Ashish joined NABVENTURES team in 2024. Ashish has over 17 years of experience in ICICI Group and has spent last 15 years in investment business (PE/VC) managing growth and early stage transactions across diversified sectors which include BFSI/fintech, Consumers, Agri, healthcare, education etc. He has experience of managing full life cycle of the fund and has evaluated large set of emerging companies across sectors. Ashish holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and MBA degree from NMIMS, Mumbai.

name: Mr. Ashish Gawali
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Serial Technology Entrepreneur. Currently Founder & CEO of ATX Labs, an AI Transformation Labs providing niche AI Services as well as ONDC TSP for Financial Services. Prior to ATX, founded IOPhysics Systems, a Cloud Data Analytics startup which was acquired by Turtlemint. 20+ years of Cloud, Data and AI experience across Bay Area based software product companies as well as running Startups. 10+ US patents granted in Distributed and Information Systems. Graduate of BITS Pilani Computer Science and IIT Kanpur Management Sciences department.

name: Mr. Ashish Kashyap
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Ashish is a serial Technology entrepreneur. He is the Founder of INDmoney, a fast growing personal finance and investment App . Prior to launching INDmoney in 2019, Ashish founded leading travel group, ibibo Group (Goibibo, redBus) and payments fintech platform PayU India. Ashish is also an xGoogler.

name: Mr. Ashish Lone
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Ashish hails from the farming family in Nasik. While growing up, he has seen the transition of economic downside in the farming community. After working 13 years in Dubai & California, he returned to India and founded 'kheti-badi.com' for farmers to market their chemical free or organically grown products online. Ashish has an 'Executive MBA' from the Pepperdine University, Los Angeles. When time permits, Ashish plays leather ball club cricket in and around Mumbai.

name: Mr. Ashish Mehrotra
title: MD & CEO
bio: Ashish Mehrotra is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of our Company. He also serves as the Non-Executive Chairperson of Pragati Finserv, rural finance arm of Northern Arc Group and is the member of the board for Northern Arc Investment Managers, that houses our Alternate Investment Fund and Portfolio Management Service. Ashish has over 25 years of experience across Retail & Commercial Banking, Wealth Management and Insurance. In his last role, he was the MD & CEO of Niva Bupa Health Insurance (previously known as Max Bupa Health Insurance). Before that, Ashish spent over 20 years at Citibank. He was previously a Managing Director and also the Retail Bank Head for Citibank India. Ashish holds a Master of Business Administration Degree.

name: Mr. Ashish Singhal
title: CEO
bio: Ashish is an experienced banker who combines Strategic thinking with execution excellence. He has unique blend of Sales, Marketing, Innovation, Data & Technology. He has held senior level roles across organizations. He was the managing director of SVC Cooperative Bank. 2nd largest cooperative bank in the country as well as Managing Director of Experian Credit Bureau before joining IBDIC, a consortium of 18 leading banks in the country to build digital public infrastructure using block chain and other emerging technologies.

name: Mr. Ashok Hariharan
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Ashok Hariharan is the founder & CEO of IDfy, an Integrated Identity Platform. Our mission is to transform billions of lives by unlocking opportunities for trustworthy people and enterprises. We do this by helping enterprises eliminate fraud and establish trust through products and solutions for KYC, KYB, Background Verifications, Risk Mitigation, Digital Onboarding and Digital Privacy. Ashok has steered IDfy to a market-leading position, trusted by companies like Amazon, Induslnd Bank, HDFC Bank, PhonePe, Dream11, and Hindustan Unilever. Ashok holds an MBA from the Indian School of Business and a BSEE from Penn State University. He has worked in the strategy team, across functions on cost optimization, product strategy/management, and pricing strategy at British Telecom in London.

name: Mr. Ashutosh Singh
title: Managing Director & CEO
org: Asia Index Pvt. Ltd., a BSE group company
bio: Mr. Ashutosh Singh is a CA and an MBA with over 20 years experience in the BFSI sector covering diverse areas such as MFs, Equity Broking and Banking. He is an accomplished business leader and has held various responsibilities over the years including leading sales, business, product and marketing in both the physical and digital domains. Currently, he is the MD&CEO of Asia Index Private limited, a BSE group company which is one of the leading index providers in India.

name: Mr. Ashwini Kumar Tewari
title: Managing Director
bio: Shri Ashwini Kumar Tewari, Managing Director (Corporate Banking and Subsidiaries) Mr. Ashwini Kumar Tewari is a career banker and started his career in SBI in the year 1991 as a Probationary Officer and has spent more than three decades with the bank in India and abroad in various assignments. Presently since 21.11.2023, he is the Managing Director (Corporate Banking and Subsidiaries) of State Bank of India and a Whole Time Director handling the portfolio of Large Corporate and Commercial Credit business of the Bank along with Associates & Subsidiaries of the Bank. This includes major non-bank business like Credit cards, Mutual Fund, Life & General Insurance, Capital Markets, Custodial Services etc. and serving on the boards of all these companies. Prior to this assignment, he was Managing Director (Risk, Compliance and Stressed Assets) since June 2022. There he was focusing on driving Climate Risk Management in the bank and shaping the Stressed Assets Strategy of the bank. Earlier he was the Managing Director, handling International Banking, Information Technology and Non-Bank Subsidiaries of the Bank from January 2021. He was also involved in a big refresh in the technology space in SBI. Prior to becoming Managing Director at SBI, he served as Managing Director and CEO of SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd where he oversaw key partnerships inked with GPay, PayTM, BPCL etc. and steered the company through the immediate aftermath of the Covid period. Earlier, he was the Country Head of the US Operations of State Bank of India from April 2017 to July 2020. Prior to that he was the Regional Head and General Manager, East Asia, for SBI, based in Hong Kong. Over the years, he held other leadership positions at State Bank of India, including, the Deputy General Manager (Operations & Information Systems) International Banking, Head of SBI's Cash Management, Regional Manager, Branch Head, among others. An Electrical Engineer by degree, he is a Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers (CAIIB), Certified Financial Planner (CFP) and has done a Certificate Course in Management from XLRI.

name: Mr. Avdhoot Kajarekar
title: Lead UPI Product Development
bio: Product manager at UPI, NPCI

name: Mr. Avijit Jain
title: Chief Operating Officer, Lending
bio: With a distinguished career spanning over two decades, Avijit Jain serves as the Chief Operating Officer of the credit distribution business at Paytm. Under his stewardship, Paytm has scaled its loan disbursals to millions of Indians, while providing seamless experience to users. He manages a diverse portfolio including consumer and merchant loan distribution with a focus on ensuring superior portfolio quality. An industry veteran, Avijit has held senior leadership roles across HDFC Bank and has led digital transformation in the banking and financial sector. With a proven track record, his extensive experience has provided him with deep expertise across compliance, product management, distribution and lending partnerships.

name: Mr. Avinash Mohan
title: Chief Risk Officer
bio: Avinash has been associated with Exchanges for the major part of his career. Having worked in NSE as a Business Analyst as well as involved in system testing of applications used to access the market, he has been associated with NCDEX for almost the past 20 years in various capacities. Over the past few years at NCDEX he has handled Product Development and Logistics, Business Development and Market Intelligence. Presently, he is overseeing key areas at the Exchange, including, Enterprise Risk, Surveillance and Investigation, InfoSec, Member Tech Compliance and Research.

name: Mr. Avinash Raghavendra
title: President & CIO
bio: Avinash Raghavendra is the Head of Information Technology Department at Axis Bank. He is responsible for driving sustainable growth with profitable business solutions and IT capabilities delivering efficiency, reliability, and operational excellence. Avinash believes that Integrity, customer centricity and persistence are key imperatives for any profession. Being a problem solver, he believes in working in collaboration with teams to deliver technology solutions that achieve high impact business goals. With over 25+ years of experience in Axis Bank across diverse roles in IT Management and technology transformation domain, his expertise includes: IT Strategy and Governance, Core Banking technologies, IT Infrastructure, IT Operations, Mobility, Cloud technology, and Cyber Security, BCP and risk management. Avinash is an avid reader and a movie buff. He likes to spend his free time travelling with his family.

name: Mr. Avinash Shere
title: Assistant Vice President
bio: He is a seasoned finance professional with over 16 years of experience at Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL). As an Assistant Vice President, he has played a crucial role in driving the company‚ Äôs strategic initiatives and expanding its services across various domains. His extensive experience in the securities market, coupled with his innovative approach, has significantly contributed to the growth and development of CDSL. Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including institutional clients, regulatory bodies, and industry partners. Driving technological advancements and innovations to improve service efficiency and security within the depository system. Achieved significant growth in client acquisition and retention rates through strategic client engagement and superior service delivery. In-depth knowledge of the securities market, depository operations, and financial regulations. Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on building and maintaining client relationships. Adept at leveraging technology to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

name: Mr. Avishkar Ghogare
title: Senior Lead Credit Pod
bio: Seasoned professional with a proven track record of managing and leading critical product initiatives at NPCI. Currently advancing India’s Digital Payment Landscape with deep fintech expertise and hands-on experience in large-scale implementations in the intersection of technology and payments.

name: Mr. Baskar Babu Ramachandran
title: MD & CEO
bio: Baskar Babu Ramachandran is the Co-founder, MD & CEO of Suryoday Small Finance Bank. He established Suryoday with the dream of creating a world-class financial institution that would transform customers' lives by positively impacting a sizeable percentage of Indian households. He holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from SRM Engineering College and a master's in business administration from Pondicherry University. He has participated in the management development programme for strategic management & corporate leadership conducted by the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta. With over 25 years of experience in banking and financial services, he has served various renowned banking and non-banking financial organizations in leadership positions in institutions including GE Capital Transportation Financial Services Limited, HDFC Bank Limited and Cholamandalam DBS Finance before co-founding Suryoday Small Finance Bank.

name: Mr. Benjamin Ambrose
title: CISO
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )

name: Mr. Bertram D’Souza
title: Chief Product & Innovation Officer
bio: Bertram has been associated with Protean eGov since February 2022 as part of the senior leadership team in the role of the Chief Product & Innovation Officer. In this role, Bertram is responsible for incubating new Product & Business likes in the space of Open Digital Ecosystems (ODEs), Digital Identity and Data Services. He is responsible for launching and scaling new product lines across both Domestic and Global markets. Prior to joining Protean, in his last role as an EVP of Kotak Mahindra Bank, he was responsible for Digital Banking Products which included Digital Payments, eCommerce marketplaces, Open Banking and Digital Partnerships. He has also worked in various techno-functional capacities in Vodafone m-pesa Ltd. where he launched a consumer facing Prepaid Payments Instrument Wallet for digital and assisted customers of the Vodafone Telecom Network. In addition to above experiences, Bertram has expertise in the areas of technology, platform, and product management with various reputed Payments organizations like Tata Communications Payments Solutions Ltd. (TCPSL), Worldline Global, 63 Moons Technologies (erstwhile ATOM Technologies Ltd.), Kiya.ai (erstwhile Infrasoft Technologies Ltd.) Bertram is passionate about being at the cusp of technology and business, building for population scale and creating social impact.

name: Mr. BG Mahesh
title: CEO
bio: B.G. Mahesh - Mahesh is the CEO of Sahamati, a not-for-profit industry alliance of participants in the Account Aggregator (AA) ecosystem. At Sahamati, Mahesh oversees all programs and works to establish productive relationships between market participants, policymakers, and the citizenry. He‚Äôs been leading the implementation of the Account Aggregator framework, a Digital Public Infrastructure for Data empowerment. AA is a techno-legal framework that gives individuals & small businesses control of their data. It‚Äôs being rolled out in India and is the largest implementation of Open Finance globally. Mahesh has spent nearly three decades enabling technology-driven solutions to digital inclusion problems in India. Before Sahamati, Mahesh founded OneIndia.com, a very successful portal that served content to over 100 million users per month of consumers in Indian languages, which DailyHunt acquired.

name: Mr. Bharat Panchal
title: Chief Industry Relations & Regulatory Officer - India
bio: Bharat Panchal is a prominent industry leader in Cyber Security in India, with 30 years of experience in risk management, mainly in the banking and telecommunication sectors. He is recognized globally as a thought leader and evangelist for enterprise risk, cyber security, and data sovereignty. Bharat has made significant contributions to building a safe and secure digital banking ecosystem in India. At the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), where he served as Chief of Risk Management and a founding member for over 8.5 years, Bharat played a critical role in creating a risk culture across the banking ecosystem by designing, implementing, and monitoring risk controls. He led key functions like Enterprise Risk Management, Cyber Security, Compliance, Operational Risk Management, Fraud Management, and AML for NPCI and its entire digital banking ecosystem. Currently, Bharat serves as the Chief Industry Relations & Regulatory Officer for Discover Financial Services, overseeing and monitoring compliance with applicable laws and regulations of India. Before moving to Discover, he was working as a Chief Risk Officer for APAC, Middle East and Africa with FIS Global. At FIS, he was responsible to ensure risk management & security compliance for their customers across regions. Before joining NPCI, Bharat worked with Kotak Mahindra Bank, Citibank, Reliance Communications, and Tata Telecom. Bharat has received several prestigious awards and recognitions, including the "Security Leader of the Year" Award in 2014 and 2017 by the Data Security Council of India (DSCI) for his significant contribution to cyber security in the banking sector. The Computer Society of India awarded him the "Best CRO of the Year" in 2016. He has been conferred with an award in March 2023 by United Nations& ITU jointly for excellent leadership in Cyberspace.

name: Mr. Bhargav Errangi
title: Founder
bio: Bhargav is a second time entrepreneur and founder of POP. His first startup Spoyl in the social commerce space was acquired by Flipkart in 2020. Further, he has led the rapid development of Flipkart's social commerce initiative, Shopsy. Currently, he is building POP at the intersection of UPI and commerce.

name: Mr. Bhaskar Ramesh
title: Director - Omnichannel Businesses
bio: Bhaskar serves as Director for Omnichannel Businesses at Google India and is a core member of India leadership team. In this role he is building Google's partnerships across Technology, Retail, Finance, CPG & Automotive businesses accelerating technology transformation across these sectors. He is leading the charge Digitization agenda for India with vision to make Google, a gateway for Omni businesses. Also, he is the co-chair of women@google India - A thriving community that helps women googlers across PA's succed in having thriving careers. Previously, Bhaskar built YouTube India business heading their monetization and product strategy that turbocharged YouTube into a $XB business having grown multifold. Prior to this role he served as an Executive Summits Evangelist at Google Partnerplex at their MountainView HQ and started his career building the CPG industry vertical in India from scratch. Before his decade long innings at Google, Bhaskar started his career working with large consumer goods companies like P&G, Godrej and Marico in various Brand Management roles across foods and personal care. He then moved to Media & Entertainment industry having led a variety of roles at Reliance Broadcast Network as VP - Operations - spanning marketing, sales, content planning & programming. He is an avid public speaker sharing his perspectives on Technology, Omnichannel, Video across marquee industry forums like FICCI, CII, IAMAI, UNDP etc.

name: Mr. Bhavesh Jain
title: Chief Revenue Officer
bio: Bhavesh leads sales, member services, marketing and revenue management at TransUnion CIBIL and is responsible for driving strategic planning and business growth. He brings more than two decades of experience in the credit information and data analytics sector with expertise across strategic planning, business development, operations, and an in-depth understanding of the financial services industry. For more than a decade, Bhavesh has driven business development and sales at TransUnion CIBIL while nurturing new business lines and expanding existing ones. He leads a large sales & marketing team which has catalyzed the adoption of data-oriented products and solutions for responsible lending and financial inclusion in Indiaâ€™s credit industry. Bhavesh has also represented TransUnion CIBIL at leading financial industry forums where he has shared his expertise on digital transformation and technology to enhance customer experiences. Bhavesh is an alumnus of the Harvard Business School Senior Executive Leadership Program (SELP)

name: Mr. Bhavin Patel
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Bhavin Patel, Co-founded LenDenClub in 2015 with a vision of having an enhanced investor experience. With a diverse skill set of over a decade, Bhavin is an experienced collector who has worked across varied verticals - lending business, operations, ERP solutions, fundraising, and credit automation. Bhavin likes to understand the consumers and communities by the pulse, sensing their sentiments and fulfilling their needs. He has played a key role in enabling the business operations during the initial phase of the organization to establish a solid foundation of business, vibrant culture, and talent pooling including leadership hiring for various roles. Not only building LenDenClub and InstaMoney, but Bhavin's role also entails mentoring new-age start-ups coming to their platform, similar to his zeal & passion. He stands tall on the fact that a successful business is not only about seed funding but the yearning to be a contributor to the nation by disrupting the FinTech space. After completing his engineering degree, Bhavin pursued a PGDM in Marketing & Finance from the esteemed Kirloskar Institute of Advanced Management Studies, a top-ranked business school in India. He draws inspiration from football and regularly takes part in corporate tournaments. His passion resonates through his endeavors, whether they involve work, football, fitness, or any exciting pursuit. Bhavin's achievements include being honored with titles like the 'Entrepreneur Of The Year' in the 'Business World 40 under 40' and the distinction of being named the 'Most Promising Entrepreneur' by the Economic Times, among others. These accomplishments position Bhavin as an exceptional visionary in the fintech sector.

name: Mr. Bhavin Turakhia
title: CEO & Co-founder
bio: Bhavin Turakhia, serial entrepreneur and the Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Zeta, is an inspiring figure in the technology world, demonstrating that vision, hard work, and hands-on problem-solving can catapult someone from simple beginnings to become one of the most successful entrepreneurs of our time. Bhavin has founded four successful tech companies, including the workplace productivity suite SaaS company and the leading registry for top-level extensions. His first venture, Directi, was started with a loan of $2000 in 1997 and valued at $160 million when he exited it in 2014. He is currently focused on a next-gen banking tech company poised to disrupt the global banking technology sector by replacing 40-year-old banking and payment technology platforms with flexible and scalable modern systems. Zeta already powers millions of payment cards from some of the world‚Äôs largest card issuers in 6 countries and is expanding rapidly into the US card processing market. With a net worth of $1.54 billion, Bhavin was featured in the Forbes list of India's 100 Richest People in 2016 and 2019. As a thought leader, Bhavin has developed a large following on platforms where he delves into thought-provoking discussions on leadership skills, collaboration, and the secrets behind running tech businesses. His north star, in his own words: ‘It is our moral obligation to make an impact that is proportionate to our potential.’ Throughout his journey, Bhavin has accumulated diverse accolades and recognitions. From being recognized as the Serial Entrepreneur of the Year and Entrepreneur of the Year in Innovation and Technology by Entrepreneur magazine in 2016 to receiving the coveted ET Panache Trendsetter Award from The Economic Times in the same year, Bhavin's influence resonates far and wide. He was also honored as a Young Global Leader by the World Economic Forum in Geneva in 2011.

name: Mr. Bhupesh Kumar
title: Global Head Transformation
bio: Bhupesh Kumar has been an integral part of Nucleus Software for over two decades, specializing in core banking and lending product development management. With a profound understanding of the software development life cycle, he possesses expertise across various critical phases of development. Bhupesh is widely recognized as a subject matter expert in the banking and financial services domain, particularly excelling in Retail lending across multiple lines of business (LOBs), SME lending, Core Banking, and MSME lending. He has extensive experience as a Product Owner using Agile methodology, with deep expertise in requirement analysis and specification utilizing object-oriented modelling techniques. Additionally, he excels in requirement detailing through user stories and use case methodology. He has successfully spearheaded the implementation of numerous large and complex Core Banking and Integrated Lending Management products for diverse customers across multiple countries. One of his notable achievements includes leading a transformative project for GM Finance, successfully migrating FinnOne to FinnOne Neo across 15 countries in Europe, Latin America, and Asia. Bhupesh demonstrated exceptional leadership in planning, budgeting, and overseeing multi-country implementations, utilizing project management methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma. A highlight of this project was the deployment of a multi-tenant application across all 15 countries, showcasing his expertise in managing large-scale, complex initiatives. As the head of this transformational project, Bhupesh established a robust project governance model, ensuring stringent delivery quality for this significant account. Additionally, he oversaw the successful implementation of lending platforms for prominent entities such as Eny Finance and Bob Finance in European markets. Bhupesh key role in the original implementation team for ICICI Bank, contributing significantly to the deployment of lending platforms and subsequent production support. Since 2019, Bhupesh has been instrumental in guiding the digital transformation journey of core customers from FinnOne to FinnOne Neo. He has successfully managed this transition for Mahindra Rural Housing Finance, L&T Finance, Mahindra Finance, Edelweiss , HDB Financial services and several other esteemed clients. His dedication, expertise, and leadership continue to drive innovation and excellence in Nucleus Software's offerings.

name: Mr. Bipin Preet Singh
title: Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer
bio: Bipin Preet Singh is the co-Founder & CEO of the MobiKwik Group. He founded MobiKwik with a vision to transform the digital payments landscape in India, which was close to nil when he started in 2009. He believes that the India Fintech opportunity will be at least $1TN by 2025 and that MobiKwik will be a significant part of it. Bipin has often been recognised as one of India’s leading Tech founders. He was featured in the 2016 ‘Fortune 40 under 40’ list of Indian entrepreneurs. He was also featured in the ‘Economic Times 40 under 40’ list of India’s top Business Leaders in 2018. Bipin is a product enthusiast who loves good tech and smart engineers. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi and has 19+ years of experience in technology, payments and financial services. Prior to his entrepreneurial journey, Bipin spent 7 years as a Platform Architect at companies such as Intel, Nvidia, and Freescale. At the age of 29, when faced with a choice to spend his savings on an expensive B-school degree from a top US university versus using the money to invest in his start-up, Bipin chose the latter. It was a decision that saw him making a difficult shift from hardware to software, learning programming from scratch and bootstrapping his way to success.

name: Mr. Camilo Tellez-Merchan
title: Deputy Managing Director, UN_based Better Than Cash Alliance
bio: Camilo Tellez-Merchan is Deputy Managing Director for the Better than Cash Alliance. Prior to joining the Alliance, he worked at CGAP in Washington and the GSM Association in London where he supported providers in the area of digital financial services. He has also worked at the UN Economic Commission for Asia and the Pacific in Bangkok, and at the Microsoft Labs in Bangalore where he conducted ICT4D research in the technology for emerging markets team.

name: Mr. Chaitanya Bal
title: Incharge State Government
bio: Chaitanya has over 20 years of work experience working in the UK, and in India with a career that spans Telecommunications, Consulting, and the Payments domain. At NPCI he is Incharge of State Government Relationships with close involvement with Government Departments of various states across the country. His work involves driving State & National level Digital Initiatives with the Government, Fintechs, Application Service Providers, Transport Authorities, Banks, and numerous stakeholders in the country.

name: Mr. Chandan Khaitan
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Chandan Khaitan is the CEO of Muthoot FinCorp ONE. He is a seasoned leader with over 20 years of experience in building successful businesses across FMCG, Retail, Commerce and Financial Services. Chandan is a Harvard Business School alumni and a Chartered Accountant. He specializes in creating technology-based businesses and P&L Management. He has held various leadership positions across Commerce, Technology, Strategy and Finance domain. In his assignment as the Chief Strategy & Digital Officer for Walmart India/Flipkart Wholesale, he was instrumental in creating its B2B Commerce business, Distribution center led business, Kiana development program, Real estate strategy among many other initiatives. He has been a core team member working on Flipkart's investment and synergies with Walmart India business as the Chief Digital Officer & SVP at Walmart India. He holds the honour of being selected as one of the sixteen high-potential associates globally, across the Walmart International program to develop future leaders, under the direct mentorship of the Walmart International CEO. He has a keen interest in sports and plays tennis regularly, while also being an avid trekker and a mountaineering enthusiast. His previous stints also include working in organizations like Reckitt Benckiser Group, Nestle India Ltd. and Perfetti Van Melle. About Muthoot FinCorp ONE Muthoot FinCorp ONE is an all-in-one digital financial platform that makes getting an MSME & a Gold Loan, buying Digital gold, making payments, and exchanging forex simple and convenient. As an SBU of Muthoot FinCorp Limited, Muthoot FinCorp ONE is backed by a legacy stretching back over 135 years, and the trust of more than 1 crore customers and is building a holistic financial ecosystem using the latest digital products for lending, saving and investing, protection and remittances. Muthoot FinCorp ONE continues to uphold the values of the parent, the Muthoot Pappachan Group by providing its customers with easily accessible services, replete with unmistakable quality. The Muthoot Pappachan Group, is among India‚Äôs most reputed names in the financial services industry, with customers in diverse segments like Automotive industry, Financial Services, Hospitality, Alternate Energy, Real Estate, and Precious Metals.

name: Mr. Chayan Hazra
title: Head of Growth
bio: Chayan has over 20+ years of leadership experience in world class local organizations as well as startups in financial services focused on payments such as Mastercard, Deutsche bank, HDFC bank, Pinelabs. More recent leadership roles for my organizations have seen him as APAC lead and at present is the Global lead for my current organization. His past roles have focused on South/Southeast Asia with an emphasis on Malaysia, South Asia including India, and the current role is the global focus. Past roles have covered businesses in entirety including key functions like product, sales, operations, technology and innovation. It has also required him to set up business entities in the countries, along with setting up world class teams from scratch which were required scale up in a short time period. He has extensive regulatory interactions over his various roles across countries. He has also work ed as an advisor to businesses which want to set up, scale within or across geographies, need advice on overcoming challenges being faced. He is well connected in the payments world across geographies and gives him the unique advantage to adapt best practices from one region to another

name: Mr. Chetan Krishnaswamy
title: Vice President
bio: Chetan joined Amazon India as Vice President of Public Policy in 2020, after an almost7-year stint at Google. He comes with a wealth of public policy and business experience, working in some of the most demanding and challenging Indian corporate policy environments. During his time at Google, he built an exceptionally strong team, initiated many proactive partnerships with Central and State governments, and strategically re-positioned the company and its reputation in India across a diverse setoff political and policy stakeholders, including at the very highest levels. Prior to joining Google, Chetan was Director, Corporate affairs at Dell India for five years, and previously led Public Policy at Intel, including serving as the Technical Assistant (TA) to the President of Intel. At Intel he won the Intel Achievement Award (IAA) “ the company highest award. Less than 1% Intel employees win the coveted award. Chetan began his career as a journalist and has worked for some of India s most renowned publications, including the Times of India, where he headed the newspaper s technology bureau. Chetan graduated with a gold medal in Journalism from Mysore University. He subsequently got a Master s degree in English Literature and then went on to do an MBA from Symbiosis, which he passed with distinction.

name: Mr. Chiranth Patil
title: Co-founder & Director
bio: Chiranth is Co-founder & Director at Riskcovry. With a mission to solve India’s insurance penetration rate by enabling any company to distribute insurance, Riskcovry, incorporated in 2018, is now India's fastest-growing Digital Insurance Infrastructure company. With an inclusive partnership approach with insurers and distributors alike, it has helped cover roughly 3 million Indian lives to date, many of whom are first-time buyers of insurance. This has translated into Rs. 1600 Cr in gross written premium (GWP) being processed digitally on the platform in FY24 alone, which has been doubling each year over the last 3 years. Before co-founding Riskcovry, Chiranth gained over 15 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, investment management, enterprise software, and FinTech sectors through companies like Deloitte Consulting (Boston, MA, USA), Fidelity Investments (Boston, MA, USA), MEDICI (Bangalore, India), YES Fintech (Mumbai, India) etc. As a generalist, he remains excited about areas such as business strategy, corporate development & governance, product management, talent & culture development, advanced data sciences, and marketing. Outside of building Riskcovry, Chiranth is passionate about supporting the early-stage FinTech community of India: as an active angel investor in 40+ startups across FinTech, InsurTech and Enterprise Software sectors, and also as a mentor to the FinTech Meetup, India’s largest FinTech focused ecosystem constituting startup founders, BFSI professionals and Venture Capitalists. Chiranth recently got elected as the Chair of the Insurance Committee at IAMAI’s FCC (FinTech Convergence Council), a leading industry body with more than 250 members, representing some of India’s largest FinTech and allied-FinTech companies, to some of the smallest. He also currently serves on the Governing Council of the body. From an educational background perspective, Chiranth has received an MBA degree from the University of Massachusetts at Boston in the US, where he was granted a full tuition scholarship for assisting senior professors in areas of Finance, Business Analytics and Entrepreneurship. Before the MBA, he also received a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E) in Computer Science degree from Vishveswaraya Technological University in Belgaum, Karnataka. Outside of professional work, Chiranth enjoys spending time with his family which includes 2 young children, fitness training, reading and music.

name: Mr. Chitrabhanu K G
title: Senior Vice President & Country Head
bio: Mr Chitrabhanu K G is a seasoned banking professional with a rich and diverse career spanning over two decades. With around 25 years experience in the Bank, Mr. Chitrabhanu has traversed a remarkable journey, leaving an indelible mark on various facets of the banking industry. Throughout his distinguished career, Mr. Chitrabhanu has demonstrated versatility by working across a spectrum of products, including Retail Liabilities, Insurance/Investment Products, and Collection. His commitment to excellence has been evident in his contributions across diverse geographies, having served in key financial hubs such as Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, and Kerala. In his current role, Mr. Chitrabhanu oversees the management of Retail Assets & Cards portfolio for the Bank. This encompasses a wide array of financial products, including Mortgages, Personal Loans, Auto Loans, and Credit and Debit Cards. His adept management extends to the Alternate Retail Sales channel, a major avenue for sourcing Retail Asset products. Mr.Chitrabhanu has completed his Masterâ€™s in Business Administration . He is also a Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers. His visionary leadership, coupled with a wealth of experience and academic acumen, positions Mr. Chitrabhanu K G as a stalwart in the banking industry.

name: Mr. Chris Bayley
title: Co-Founder
bio: Chris Bayley is the Co-Founder of Cover Genius, a Series E insurtech that has raised US$200m and whose pioneering embedded insurance platform protects close to 100 million customers every year from the worldâ€™s largest digital companies including Ola, Booking.com, Amazon, Make My Trip and Uber. After stepping down from day-to-day work at Cover Genius in 2024, Chris established Deck2.vc, a private equity fund focused on insurance distribution.

name: Mr. Chris Winter
title: Managing Director, Head of APAC International Markets
bio: Chris Winter is Managing Director, Head of Asia Pacific Region for Discover Global Network. His responsibilities include managing existing and developing new franchise relationships to support the growth of Diners Club business and expand acceptance via acquirers and processors for Discover Global Network. He is also responsible for managing all network alliance relationships including China UnionPay, JCB, BCcard, NPCI, NCCC, NAPAS, PayNet, NETS, etc. and building broad alliance partnerships with networks in the Asia Pacific Region. Chris joined Discover in October 2010 with a focus on building DGN acceptance across the EMEA Region. The fact we now have over 120 Acquirers certified with over 10 million outlets serving DGN cardholders is testament to the hard work and great progress he and his team have made. In June 2022 Chris took on the role of VP EMEA Partnerships which broadened his responsibilities to include Issuing activities with current DCI Franchises and active N2N Partners across the region. Since taking on the additional responsibilities, Chris and his team have continued to make great progress in expanding acceptance as well as strengthening our relationships with key DCI Franchises and N2N Partners, successfully negotiating NPA extensions with key Regional Franchises such as DC Spain, DC Austria, and DC Nordics. Prior to joining Discover, Chris has worked for many years in the Payments industry, including spending time with TSYS where he had a global role and Visa, where amongst other responsibilities, he spent a number of years living in South Africa establishing Visa as a Payment Scheme across the Sub-Saharan Region.

name: Mr. Chris Yeo
title: CEO
bio: Chris is CEO of DOKU, a leading online and offline payments fintech with operations in Indonesia and Malaysia and with over 150,000 merchants. As CEO, Chris is responsible for the strategy, P&L and operations for a 500 person company. Prior to this, Chris spent 6 years at Grab, in senior leadership roles as Managing Director for GrabPay, Grab Ventures and Group Strategy. In these roles, Chris covered ride hailing, food delivery, strategic investments, fundraising and launching/ shutting down new ventures within Grab across industries such as cloud kitchens, online media, healthcare and escooter sharing. Before Grab, Chris worked in various regional leadership roles including PayPal, Boston Consulting Group, Arthur D. Little and Singapore Airlines. Chris has an MBA from Kellogg, MSc in Finance from the University of London and a BSc Engineering & BA Economics double degree from the University of California, Berkeley.

name: Mr. Christian Kajeneri
title: Director of Payment Systems
bio: Christian Kajeneri is the Director of Payment Systems at the National Bank of Rwanda. He has significantly contributed to the growth of MoMoPay as a strategic growth opportunity post-COVID19 pandemic during his tenure at Mobile Money Rwanda Limited, a subsidiary of MTN Rwanda. His previous roles include strategic fintech positions at Mobile Money Rwanda Ltd, Equity Bank Rwanda, and participation in key fintech forums and events. Christian is an alumnus of the Africa Leadership University School of Business, where he earned an MBA with a major in Leadership. He also holds a bachelor‚Äôs degree in Engineering in Electronics and Telecommunications from the University of Rwanda.

name: Mr. Christophe Mariette
title: Chairman of Lyra India
bio: Christophe Mariette is an Associate Director of Lyra Group. He is also the co-founder and Chairman of Lyra India since 2008. For 20 years, he has been managing the business of Lyra Group and the growth of Lyra in the landscape of innovative and secure payment which is dealing with more than 20 billion payments per year. Thanks to the Lyra's links between France and India, he has been introducing the Indian Instant payment method UPI in Europe Passionate of international development, Christophe Mariette has travelled all around the world to develop Lyra. Before joining Lyra, he has been working for Thales in R&D and then in international business for telecom and aircraft systems.

name: Mr. Christopher Waller
title: Member
org: Federal Reserve Board of Governors of the United States

name: Mr. David Finch
title: Global Managing Director Fintech
bio: Spearheading FinTech initiatives to grow client portfolios and advance global financial inclusion. Devised and executing accelerated growth strategies across a footprint of 30+ countries. Launched innovative products targeting emerging markets, notably in India UK, LATAM and South Africa. Key note speaker at global events; advising governments and regulatory agencies on FinTech. Expanding into new markets across APAC, Europe and LATAM.

name: Mr. Deepak Jain
title: Co-founder
bio: Deepak Jain is Founder of FlexiLoans.com, one of the market leaders in Digital SME Lending. FlexiLoans is a technology-based online financing platform started with an endeavour to solve the problems that small businesses face in accessing quick, flexible and adequate funds for growing their businesses. FlexiLoans is a market leader in ecosystem-based digital lending for small businesses in India. Disbursed over 80,000 loans worth Rs. 4000 Crs to small businesses across 1,800+ cities without having a single branch! The company has raised over USD 150 Mn in Capital since inception from an excellent pool of Investors and Institutions. Deepak’s key responsibilities at Flexiloans.com include Business Development, Strategic Alliances, Fund Raise Equity & Debt and Corporate Strategy. Deepak has over 15 Years of experience across investment banking, management consulting and corporate finance & strategy roles. Raised over USD 10 Bn across 35 deals across sectors with over 10 deals in BFSI sector. Strong relationships with top Indian Corporates, Private Equity and Capital Markets investors. Deepak was chosen as 40 under 40 by Fortune India in 2022 : https://www.fortuneindia.com/40under40?year=2022 Dell and Observe Now chose Deepak for 40 under 40 Tech Entrepreneurs in India 2022: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/observenow_observenow40under40-observenow-dell-activity-6900447226519273472-D2y8/?originalSubdomain=in Deepak is a qualified Chartered Accountant and holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Management Studies from Indian School of Business, Hyderabad with a specialisation in Finance and Marketing. He is a commerce graduate from the University of Mumbai. Deepak is a Charter Member & part of Fintech SIG for Tie Mumbai, Founding Member of Tech Entrepreneurs of Mumbai (TEAMS), Executive Committee of Digital Lenders Association of India (DLAI), and led Finance Initiatives for Indian School of Business Alumni Association in the past. Regular speaker at various conferences, Deepak have spoken on various events including events for Tie-Con Mumbai, GFF, ET BFSI Conferences, Nasscom Fintech Day, ISB Conclaves, DLAI Annual Conference, Fintegrate, Conferences of leading Investment Banking firms like CLSA, EY, Kotak etc

name: Mr. Deepak Sharma
title: Board Member, Independent Director
bio: Deepak Sharma is a results-driven Techno-commercial digital business leader, with nearly Three (3) decades of proven track record in building & scaling successful ventures within BFSI, Technology and telecom service sectors. He has spent 20+years with leading Indian & International Banks at various leadership position. His dedication lies in incubating & driving transformative businesses by amalgamating strategy, technology, innovation, business model, GTM and cultural dynamics. Globally connected in the tech and innovation realm, he's highly regarded as a preeminent figure in fintech and digital leadership. Deepak works as Board Member & CXO Advisor with several large & growth stage global & Indian firms with special focus on Incubation & Growth of new business in Financial Services, AI & GenAI, Cyber Security, SaaS, Fraud, Risk & Identity Management, Digital Transformation & Platforms. He has helped Jio-Blackrock initial venture build across Wealth management, Asset management & Broking business. He serves on Global Advisory Board of Instabase Inc., a Silicon Valley based AI & GenAI firm, where he helps them build South Asia business. He also serves as Board member (Independent Director) at Suryoday Small Finance Bank. At Suryoday, he chairs IT & Security Committee and is member of Risk Management & several other committees. He is also a Strategic Advisor to Zeta, where he helps them build and scale cloud native financial service software. Deepak has worked with Kotak Mahindra Bank for over 15years (till October 2023), where he was involved in building Priority/HNI, NRI Banking & Forex business. He was instrumental in starting & scaling Digital Initiatives at Kotak for over a decade and served as Bank’s first President & Chief Digital Officer for over 5years. He played a pivotal role in propelling the bank as a digital leader, leaving a multifaceted and transformative impact. His role extended to incubating and operating new ventures & developing Digital Platforms, Product Engineering, Design, Mobile apps, Digital Bank- 811, digital transformation, India stack, Digital payments, Embedded Finance, AI, and Blockchain.

name: Mr. Deval Sheth
title: Managing Director - Asia Pacific
bio: Entrepreneurial, C-level executive with notable success in building sustainable businesses for start-ups and established companies in Asia Pacific region. I have 25 years experience in growing and managing business across Payments, Fintech, Cybersecurity, Hi-Technology & Loyalty Marketing Industries. Utimaco is a leading global Cybersecurity firm. Utimaco protects data, manages privacy rights, builds root of trust and creates a secure digital rights framework in the emerging digital landscape.

name: Mr. Deven Somaya
title: MD & Global Head of Emerging Commerce Solutions
bio: Deven is the Head for the Emerging Commerce Solutions team and is in a global role based out of Singapore. Deven leads a team that works closely with the partnerships, strategic investments, products, sales, and geography teams and is responsible for designing and developing new client solutions as well as creating and incubating new business opportunities across Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) groups and client segments. The role has extensive focus on co-developing new commercial solutions with clients and ecosystem partners, identifying and assessing commercial opportunities in new product and service areas that can unlock long-term strategic value to Citi.

name: Mr. Dhananjay Singh
