org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )

name: Mr. Dharmarajan Sankara Subrahmanian
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Dharmarajan is the Founder & CEO of Impactsure Technologies, an Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) powered document analytics SaaS company providing software solutions for Banks and Enterprises. Banks, Financial Services Institutions and Enterprises use Impactsure’s AI solutions to generate revenue and efficiency across document and data workflows to enhance customer experience. Impactsure empowers global BFSI clients with its award-winning solutions for Intelligent Document Processing, Document Classification and Data Extraction, Scrutiny, Discrepancy Checks and Processing for Transaction Banking, Trade Finance, Credit & Credit Administration, Financial Spreading, Contract vetting etc with integrated workflows. Dharmarajan has 25+ years of Business Leadership with a mix of Corporate, Family Managed Business and Startup experience, including Board Management & Corporate Governance. He is a Certified Corporate Director by the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs and a Fellow of the Institute of Directors. He is currently an official member of the prestigious Forbes Technology Council. He contributes to the communities worldwide as part of the Forbes Technology Council through articles on thought leadership in areas of Digital Transformation, emerging technologies and ESG. He is also a member of many Industry Bodies like CII, ICC and more. He was a National Core member for the Prime Minister’s office(2001-03) in policy development, in the National Policy of Health & Population, through CII and in the Task Force for Education through CII WR. Dharmarajan has worked in leadership positions in multinationals like Philips and Johnson & Johnson and the Top management/of an indigenous manufacturing organisation Telenet Systems. He is also on the Board of Directors/Advisory Board in MSME companies and Startups. He is a Keynote speaker and a visiting faculty to leading management institutes, specialising in Digital Transformation, Marketing, Entrepreneurship & Small & Medium Enterprises(SME). Dharmarajan has done his Professional Degree and Master in Management Studies from Birla Institute of Technology and Science(BITS), Pilani. He has done specialisation programs from IIM Ahmedabad, Advanced Management courses with a Specialisation in Entrepreneurship(Online) from Wharton Business School, University of Pennsylvania.

name: Mr. Dharshan Shanthamurthy
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Dharshan Shanthamurthy is a cybersecurity veteran specializing in digital payments for over two decades. As the Founder and CEO of SISA, he leads one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies, working with 6 of the top 10 digital payment companies in India. Dharshan has served as a payment security assessor, a core payment forensic investigator, and a lead contributor to numerous digital payment security standards globally. His extensive expertise and contributions have been instrumental in shaping the landscape of digital payment security. Born in Mysore, Dharshan is a chartered accountant who fell in love with cybersecurity in the early 2000s. He has been recognized for his contributions to the industry with various accolades and continues to be a thought leader in the field of cybersecurity.

name: Mr. Dheepak Rajoo
title: CIO
bio: Dheepak Rajoo is a senior leader with over 2 decades of experience in Technology Management, Digital and Business Transformation. He has led large transformation outcomes for ING, AXA, and RBL Bank. He is a recipient of Business Transformation Leader of the Year, Big 50 IT Leader, Winner of The Asian Banker Award for Best CORE Banking Implementation for mid-sized Banks among other recognitions. In 2018, Dheepak co-founded a Digital consulting start-up based in Bangalore to help SMEs embrace Digital native technologies. Dheepak is currently the CIO of Royal Sundaram General Insurance overseeing Technology modernization, Digital & Data Transformation initiatives. He is a speaker, panelist and thought leader in FinTech, Digital and keenly follows web3 and Technology consumerization trends in India and the ASEAN region. He loves cycling, hiking, golf and is a music aficionado. Dheepak is an alumnus of SP Jain Global school of Management and a long-standing member of PMI Global, Charter member of Rotary club Inspire, Mumbai, and a lifelong volunteer with Isha Foundation.

name: Mr. Dhruv Bahl
title: Managing Partner
bio: Dhruv Dhanraj Bahl is the Founder & Managing Partner of Eternal Capital, a VC fund focused on establishing early-stage investing in start-ups as an investor-friendly asset class by removing the entry barriers prevalent in the existing VC landscape. Passionate about building and scaling businesses, Dhruv is a thought leader in the finance, consumer-tech, and healthcare spaces, and has been instrumental in accelerating growth for companies such as BharatPe, RoadZen, Airtel Payment Bank, Paytm, and Fortis Healthcare. With his latest stint being the COO / CBO – Lending at BharatPe, Dhruv's business-building trajectory began from his early tenure as one of the early members of core team at Fortis Healthcare followed by a 3-year stint with Bain & Company. For the last 10 years, Dhruv has not only been in key leadership roles in fintech and consumer-tech organizations but has also invested in 50+ start-ups as an active angel investor.

name: Mr. Diego Perez Martin de Almeida
title: President
bio: Diego boasts a robust foundation in banking & capital markets regulation, coupled with extensive experience in law practice within these domains. As a board member and president of ABFintechs (Fintech Association of Brazil), he shoulders the responsibility of engaging with lawmakers and regulatory bodies, particularly concerning Fintech and Blockchain regulatory advancements. Diego stands as a dedicated member of the Fintech movement in Brazil and Latam, advocating for its growth and evolution.

name: Mr. Dilip Asbe
title: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

name: Mr. Dilip Modi
title: Founder & CEO
bio: One of India’s most successful entrepreneurs and amongst its foremost digital experts, Dilip Modi is the Chairman and Group CEO of DiGiSPICE Technologies and Founder of Spice Money. With a deep-rooted passion for technology and a keen understanding of the financial landscape, he has played a pivotal role in transforming the way financial services are accessed and delivered to millions of people across the country. Mr. Modi recognized the gap in delivery of financial products and services in rural India, and the untapped potential these markets hold. Thus, began his journey in the fintech realm with the birth of his brainchild, Spice Money. Spice Money however, was more than a business. It was driven by a social cause, which was to financially and digitally empower the unbanked and underbanked populations of India, with access to affordable and convenient financial services. This was also aligned with the government’s vision of financial inclusion for those living in the hinterlands of the country. Due to this, the company witnessed over 100% growth in the pandemic year, when digital financial services became a necessity. Under Mr. Modi's leadership, Spice Money has emerged as a force to reckon with in India's fintech sector. It is a comprehensive and inclusive financial services platform that leverages technology to bridge the gap between urban and rural communities, empowering them with digital transactions, banking services, e-commerce, and more. Through a vast network of over 12 lakh Spice Money Adhikaris, the company has been instrumental in bringing financial services to 95% of rural pin codes, covering 2,50,000 villages, 700 districts and 5,000 blocks, serving 20 million monthly customers. One of Mr. Modi's key contributions has been his emphasis on financial literacy and education. He firmly believes that true empowerment lies in not just providing access to financial services, but also in equipping individuals with the knowledge and skills to make informed financial decisions. With this in mind, he has spearheaded various initiatives to promote financial literacy among Spice Money retailers and customers, helping them navigate the complexities of the financial world and maximize the benefits of digital transactions. Mr. Modi's vision for Spice Money extends beyond just providing financial services. He envisions a future where technology is harnessed to create a robust ecosystem that supports entrepreneurship and economic growth at the grassroots level. Spice Money aims to foster financial independence by enabling individuals to become entrepreneurs and agents of change in their communities. By providing them with the necessary tools, training, and support, Spice Money is empowering these individuals to generate income, create livelihoods, and contribute to the overall socio-economic development of India. Through his relentless dedication and innovative approach, Mr. Dilip Modi has established Spice Money as a game-changer in the Indian fintech landscape. His vision of inclusive and accessible financial services has helped transform the lives of millions, bringing them closer to the digital economy and paving the way for a financially inclusive India. Mr. Modi was awarded the “BFSI Game Changer Award” for his contribution to the BFSI sector. He holds a First Class Bachelor of Science Degree in Management Technology from Brunel University, London, UK. Mr. Dilip Modi has also done his Master’s in Business Administration from the Management School at the Imperial College, London, with a specialization in Finance.

name: Mr. Dinesh Pai
title: Investments
bio: Dinesh is part of the Founder's office at Zerodha. Apart from spending time on business side of things at Zerodha, he also leads the Rainmatter Investments, where the focus is on Fintech, Climate, Health and Storytelling.

name: Mr. Dirk van Quaquebeke
title: Managing Partner
bio: Dirk van Quaquebeke is a Managing and General Partner at BEENEXT, a Singapore-based early-stage venture capital firm investing in India, Southeast Asia, Japan, and the U.S. He has been living in Asia since 2009 and has been building and investing in early-stage tech companies for over 20 years. He actively participates in over a dozen company boards and has led investments in over 50 companies, such as Trusting Social, Toddle App, M2P Fintech, e6data, Coverself, Lucidity, Netbank.ph Skuad.io, and successful exits of Paystack, Wallex, Coins.ph. He has helped create billions of dollars worth of enterprise value and supported the portfolio to raise hundreds of millions in equity rounds. His portfolio companies have frequently attracted follow-on capital from global blue chip names like Temasek, Google, Tiger Global or Insight Partners. Prior to BEENEXT, he co-founded and led the company builder Alps Ventures out of which more than a dozen incubations and investments were done where he headed in an active operating role in three different ventures. He started his career for 5 years in London's banking and private equity world. Originally from Europe Dirk completed a degree in Computer Science from the University of Hildesheim and a dual MSc. in Corporate Finance & Macro Economics as well as the CEMS degree from Copenhagen Business School & ESADE.

name: Mr. Edward Bass
title: Inward Investment Manager
org: UK Department for Business and Trade
bio: Edward Bass is an Inward Investment Manager for the Department for Business and Trade. Edward’s role is to provide free and confidential support to help internationally owned businesses to set up and grow in the UK. This support is entirely bespoke and dependent on the company’s needs but tends to fall into two broad areas – ‘informing’ and ‘connecting’. Either he shall be showing you information to help form a business case or connecting you to individuals or organisations that can help you achieve your objectives. Edward has been working for the department for nearly three years, having previously held roles with the Canadian Government and MIDAS (Manchester’s Investment Promotion Agency). Edward has experience working with a large variety of financial and professional services (FPS) firms, from up-and-coming FinTech companies to some of the largest global financial institutions. Conversations tend to focus on location strategy and how companies can best utilise different aspects (capabilities/regions/cities) of the UK offer, but over the last 12 months, there has been a particular focus on how UK capabilities in Cyber Security and Sustainability can be used within global FPS firms to help increase their operational resilience, or to develop new products and services – typically done through the expansion of research and development activity within the UK.

name: Mr. Elias Yazbeck
title: Managing Director, Head of Fintech / Finserv
bio: Elias Yazbeck has over 17 years of experience in financial services and fintech sectors where he. Prior to joining Helios in January 2023, he served as Group Director, Head of Growth at VEON, a leading Emerging Market telecom operator. Previously, Elias was Facebook’s Head of Finserv Partnership and Market Development for EMEA and held leadership positions at Mastercard. Earlier in his career, he was also a management consultant advising financial services institutions across Middle East and Africa.

name: Mr. Fares M Alsaleh
title: Fintech Development Division Manager
bio: Fares is the head of Fintech Development within Financial Sector Development Department at Saudi Central Bank, where he is leading the strategic initiatives aimed at developing the Fintech sector and ecosystem in the Kingdom. He also heads the Regulatory Sandbox which is playing a pivotal role in exponential growth of the Fintech sector, in alignment with the national Financial Sector Development Program under Vision 2030. Prior to his current role, Fares held senior positions within Investment Deputyship at Saudi Central Bank, where he played an instrumental role in enhancing SAMA's Asset Allocation Strategy and Investment Policy, and also brought SAMA into compliance with the GIPS. He also spent time in private sector with Morgan Stanley in New York, where he worked closely with their Investment Management on optimizing investment strategies. He holds a BS degree in Financial Technology from the US, and also completed Executive Coursework from MIT Sloan School of Management. He is a subject matter expert in Fiscal and Economic Policies, Sustainable Finance and Investment Risk Management.

name: Mr. Farhan Ahmad
title: Group CEO
org: PayNet - Payments Network Malaysia Sdn Bhd
bio: Mr. Farhan Ahmad is the Group Chief Executive Officer of Payments Network Malaysia Sdn Bhd (PayNet™). He joined PayNet in April 2022, bringing with him over 25 years of financial services experience as an entrepreneur and senior executive in the US and UK. As an entrepreneur, Mr. Ahmad most recently founded Bento for Business, a B2B financial operating platform for SMEs that he successfully grew and sold to US Bank, the fifth largest retail bank in the US. Prior to Bento, he founded 2 other successful start-ups, pioneered several â€˜first of its kind payment solutions, including the very first online Buy Now Pay Later solution, and holds several patents in the payments space. As an executive, Mr. Ahmad most recently ran Digital Card Payments for Europe for Barclays. In the past, he has held various leadership roles with Discover Financial Services, JP Morgan Chase, Bank One, and FirstUSA. An International Baccalaureate scholar, he has a bachelor’s degree in Economics from the University of Pennsylvania and is an Official Member of Forbes Finance Council since June 2019.

name: Mr. G Senthil
title: Chief Business Development Officer
bio: Mr. Senthil Gunasekaran brings an illustrious work experience of over 20 years in the fields of Business Development, Sales, Marketing, and Investment Advisory. He has successfully managed diverse client bases, including Corporates, UHNW Individuals, Trusts, Institutions, and Global Asset Managers. Mr. Senthil holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree and an MBA in Finance. Additionally, he is a CFA and CAIA charter holder. As the Chief Business Development Officer, India & Global Business at KFin Technologies Limited (KFintech), Mr. Senthil leads the Domestic and Global Business Development team for services such as Asset Management, Alternatives Managed Accounts, National Pension System (NPS), and Global Fund Administration. In his current role, Mr. Senthil has successfully collaborated with top-tier clients to identify strategic opportunities in the market. Before joining KFintech, Mr. Senthil served as the Head of Institutional Sales, specializing in BFSI, ETFs, and Retirement Product Solutions at HDFC Asset Management Company Limited. In this role, he led the Institutional Desk, providing expert advice to large bank treasuries, insurance companies, pension funds, and institutions on their investment portfolio and asset allocation within the regulatory framework. Additionally, he was responsible for sales related to passive strategies, including traditional ETFs and multi-factor/smart beta ETFs, as well as new product planning. During the onset of his career, he was associated with Lotus AMC Private Limited (a joint venture between Temasek and Sabre Capital) and Sundaram Asset Management Company Limited. In these roles, he successfully led Sales, Business Development, Client Relationship Management, and overall Business Development efforts.

name: Mr. Ganesh Rengaswamy
title: Managing Partner
bio: Ganesh Rengaswamy, a seasoned entrepreneur and venture investor, leads Quona’s investments in Asia.Before co-founding Quona, Ganesh led Accion Frontier Investments’ work in India. Prior to his time with Accion, Ganesh was a General Partner of Lok Capital, a venture growth fund that invests in financial inclusion and social enterprises. Ganesh previously served as the Asia Director for Unitus Inc., a global organization investing in sustainable solutions in financial inclusion. During these stints, Ganesh invested and advised leading financialinstitutions and banks including SKS/Bharat Financial Inclusion Ltd, Ujjivan, Equitas, IFMR/NorthenArc, Vistaar, TechProcess and Bandhan. He previously led the entry of Greylock Partners, a Silicon Valley-based venture capital fund, into the Indian market and also co-founded Travelguru.com, acquired by Travelocity. Early in his career, Ganesh worked for Infosys, where he was responsible for customer acquisition and growth engagements for US-based Fortune 1000 clients. Ganesh is a frequent speaker at global industry events including Singapore Fintech Festival, Asia Investment Conference, SuperReturn, Global Impact Investing Network (GIIN), India-China Fintech Summit, and LendIt. Ganesh’s exits include IndiaMart (IPO), Coins.ph (Go-Jek), Shubham (Premji Invest), IFMR, TechProcess (Ingenico), Vistaar, Rural Shores, and Securent (Cisco). Ganesh’s current and past investment and entrepreneurial advisory roles include Village Capital, Accion Venture Lab, GSF Accelerator and IIM-Ahmedabad, and he has been featured in Bloomberg, CNBC, The Economic Times, The Mint, and others.

name: Mr. Gaurav Mehta
title: Head (Sr. VP) - Direct & Alternate Lending - Branch led U/S Business
bio: Gaurav Mehta, SVP & Head of Direct & Alternate Lending, has over 18 years of experience in the Financial Services Industry. He brings extensive knowledge and strategic insights into digital and alternate lending. At Credit Saison India, Gaurav aims to drive expansion and innovation in these areas. He is enthusiastic about embarking on this exciting journey with the company.

name: Mr. Gaurav Ramdev
title: Chief Growth and Marketing Officer
bio: Gaurav Ramdev is an award winning, visionary leader and strategist who is passionate about driving growth and building iconic brands leaving a legacy of trailblazing work and empowered teams across FMCG & Technology. As the Chief Growth and Marketing Officer (CGMO) at population-scale, publicly listed Protean eGov Technologies (formerly NSDL eGov, BSE: PROTEAN), Gaurav leads several agendas â€“ the chief brand steward, drives Protean’s D2C retail business, and scaling the B2B through digital channels and citizen-centric digital initiatives. He is also the key strategist behind Protean’s journey towards becoming an iconic brand. With 2 decades of experience, Gaurav excels at building & leading high-performing Marketing teams that are tuned to delivering P&L for business, implementing comprehensive brand strategies, and driving innovative GTMs. His expertise spans across the entire marketing spectrum: full-funnel growth strategies, Brand & product marketing, successful product monetization models, and leveraging consumer insights for brand building. Also, Gaurav currently serves as the Co-Chairperson of the ASSOCHAM National Council on branding and marketing. Renowned for his contributions to the fields of marketing and brand building, he has been the recipient of multiple awards. He is also a prolific speaker and frequently shares his insights at various industry panels. Prior to joining Protean, Gaurav was leading Marketing & Growth for Razorpay’s Neo-Banking. His career includes successful tenures across various brands at The Coca-Cola Company, Britannia Industries, Orkla India & ITC. Gaurav holds an MBA in Marketing from SIBM, Pune and a B.Tech in Electronics from Indraprastha University, New Delhi.

name: Mr. Gaurav Shisodia
title: Vice President - India
bio: Gaurav Shisodia, the Vice President of Payoneer India, is a seasoned professional with 20+ years of extensive experience in the banking and fintech industries. Gaurav has successfully led high-performing teams and contributed to the growth and expansion of multiple organizations. In his current role, Gaurav is responsible for driving the go-to-market strategy and accelerating India’s growth by overseeing the overall business strategies, strategic revenue priorities, and growth initiatives. His vast experience and strategic vision will undoubtedly play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Payoneer as he continues to make significant contributions to the company's India operations. With his leadership, Payoneer is well-positioned to revolutionize the Indian fintech sector and drive innovation in digital payments. Before joining Payoneer, Gaurav held pivotal leadership positions in renowned organizations such as Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, Mashreq Bank, ICICI Bank, and ING VYSYA BANK. Throughout his career, he has demonstrated his ability to identify business opportunities and implement effective strategies, consistently delivering outstanding performance. Gaurav's accomplishments include setting up new channels of business development, establishing high-performance teams, and driving cross-selling efforts. Gaurav has a proven track record of building strategic partnerships and expanding market reach. He is adept at analyzing market trends, designing financial strategies, and proposing policy changes to stay ahead in the ever-evolving industry landscape. His dynamic approach, combined with a deep understanding of customer needs, positions him as a catalyst for success and growth.

name: Mr. Gaurav Zutshi
title: Fintech Consultant
bio: Gaurav is an independent fintech consultant specialising in cross border payments. He has held leadership roles in digital banking/payments for 20+ years across ASEAN & South Asia with Visa, Citi Transaction Banking, First Data, JP Morgan Payments, Aditya Birla Capital and Western Union. Has demonstrated solid track record of business growth. Most recently, Regional VP Southeast & North Asia, Western Union he owned entire P&L of cross border payments (digital, retail in-store and through partners) across 12 countries - grew key markets SG, MY, TH, ID, HK. Optimised fees, Improved customer experience, increased STP rates and overall company profitability. He was a board member of our subsidiaries in Singapore/Japan. As Head of Digital channels (JP Morgan Payments, Singapore, 2019-23) built & commercialised modern internet, mobile, APIs for corporate, Banks and fintech to win new customers and deepen the wallet share in APAC region especially with new economy players & eComm marketplaces. As Chief Digital Officer (Mumbai, 2015-19) built Aditya Birla Capital digital platform to propel digital sales & service, integrating products across lending, insurance, asset management powered by analytics. Scaled up new customers, retention and cross holding across products. Additionally he was CEO of MyUniverse a fintech within AB Group, providing one-view of all financial relationships and Robo advisory of purchasing digital financial services. In this role he reported to the board (Group CEO, IFC & Independent directors)

name: Mr. Gautam Aggarwal
title: Division President, South Asia & Country Corporate Officer, India
bio: With a rich experience of nearly two and a half decades in technology, sales, business development, product management strategy, and mergers & acquisitions, Gautam Aggarwal leads Mastercard’s teams in India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Nepal, and Bhutan. He has been with Mastercard since 2014, and before being appointed as the Division President, he was the company’s Chief Technology Officer for Asia Pacific (AP). Gautam has held several leadership positions in AP and the US and has been instrumental in driving global stakeholder engagements and executions around real-time payments. Before joining Mastercard, he was in the Corporate Finance & Strategy practice at McKinsey & Company in New York. Gautam has an MBA degree from The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. He also holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from the Cornell University and a Bachelor’s degree from the Manipal Institute of Technology, India.

name: Mr. George Sam
title: Co-founder & Business Head
bio: George Sam is a seasoned professional boasting over 20 years of experience in the BFSI industry. As the Co-Founder & Business Head at Mindgate Solutions, his responsibilities include developing robust business strategies, fostering client engagement, and managing the company’s P&L account to ensure profitability across all product and service verticals. Prior to this role, he held the position of Business Head at ByzanSystem Pvt Ltd, where he played a pivotal role in building strong customer relationships and driving revenue growth through robust sales strategies. George's leadership extends to successfully managing teams, emphasizing excellence, and nurturing a positive work culture. With a postgraduate degree in Business Management from IIM Indore, George is dedicated ot only to professional success but also embraces fitness, reflecting a holistic approach to life. Co-founding Mindgate in 2008, George aimed to simplify and secure transactions in the ever-evolving digital payment landscape. Today, under his leadership, Mindgate stands at the forefront, processing approximately 1 out of 5 real-time payments globally and over 50% of the country's real-time payment transactions. With a talent pool of over 1400 professionals and a strong footprint in India, UAE, and SEA. George envisions Mindgate as a leading global player in the Digital Payment ecosystem within the next three years. George Sam, in addition to his illustrious career in the BFSI industry, has demonstrated a commitment to fostering innovation and entrepreneurship by investing professionally and personally in numerous incubator series startups. He actively seeks new avenues for investment, focusing on driving growth and contributing to the betterment of the nation.

name: Mr. Gitau Mburu
title: Head of National Payments Policy Development, Regulation and Data Analysis
bio: Mr. Gitau Mburu is a practicing Economist with over 20 years of experience in economic policy, development research, finance and financial sector policy and financial regulation. Presently, Mr. Gitau serves the people and Government of Kenya as the Head of National Payments Policy Development, Regulation and Data Analysis at the Central Bank of Kenya (CBK). Mr. Gitau has been responsible in leading some of the major payments developments within the CBK and payments ecosystem more broadly. He was responsible for leading and coordinating the formulation of Kenyaâ€™s second National Payments Strategy 2022 - 2025, Kenyaâ€™s feature in the October 2023 edition of the Central Banking Payments News (CBPN), a leading payments publication for the global central banking payments community, among other notable initiatives.

name: Mr. Gopal Srinivasan
title: Chairman & Managing Director
bio: Gopal Srinivasan is the Chairman and Managing Director of TVS Capital Funds (TCF). TCF -- a growth private equity platform set up in 2007, is the largest Indian rupee capital Fund in India, with a corpus of ~₹2,000 Crores. Under the leadership of Gopal, the platform has invested in more than 30 businesses that include companies like Nykaa, RBL, National Stock Exchange (NSE), Indian Energy Exchange (IEX), GoDigit, Yubi and Five Star Business Finance. Gopal is a third-generation member of the illustrious TVS Family; his entrepreneurial career spanning well over three decades, in which he has founded, steered and scaled up over 10 new ventures across diverse verticals. Gopal also believes that the key for building the new India is to energize educational institutions. He has contributed significantly to his alma mater. And he continues to do so as a member of Ross School of Business India Advisory Board. Gopal is also associated as a Governing Board member of Great Lakes Institute of Management-Chennai and IFMR- Chennai. He is also a member of the Governing Council at Loyola Institute of Business Administration (LIBA), Chennai. Gopal has played an extensive role in VC/PE industry’s public and regulatory policy landscape and continues to be a board member of the Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA). Gopal is a member of SEBI’s Alternative Investment Policy Advisory Committee, since 2016 and he is also a Governing Council member of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH), since its inception in Dec’20. Gopal’s pursuit of excellence in creating an environment of intellectual and creative engagement in his hometown of Chennai led him to yet another initiative to bring together diverse groups of people under the auspices of the Chennai International Center (CIC). As its chairman, he has sought to develop CIC into a think tank that brings together a cornucopia of thought leaders from business, economy, policy, science, art, culture, and governing bodies. Gopal is the Honorary Consul General for the Kingdom of Netherlands in Tamil Nadu, in recognition of his standing in the Community. Organizational Positions -Founder, Chairman and Managing Director, TVS Capital Funds P Ltd. - Founder & Chairman of TVS Electronics Ltd. - Director on the Board of TVS & Sons, holding company of TVS Group & other companies in and outside the TVS Group. B. Com, Loyola College, Chennai & MBA from Graduate School of Bus. Admn. University of Michigan, USA.

Morgan‚ Äôs unique global strengths coupled with local capabilities across Treasury Services, Trade Finance and Merchant Services. name: Mr. Hare Krishna Jena
title: Managing Director
org: The Clearing Corporation of India Ltd.
bio: Mr. Hare Krishna Jena is Managing Director of The Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL), Mumbai. CCIL provides an institutional framework for the clearing and settlement of transactions in government securities, money market operations, foreign exchange transactions, derivatives and other related products. CCIL is a Qualified Central Counterparty (QCCP) serving the OTC markets in India. CCIL also functions as a Trade Repository for OTC Derivatives in India. CCIL‚Äôs wholly owned subsidiary, Clearcorp Dealing Systems (India) Ltd. (Clearcorp) operates / manages electronic trading platforms for trading in government securities, forex (spot and forward), money market and derivative instruments. It has also started its services to retail participants by offering retail trading platform for Forex and Government Securities. In addition, LEIL, another wholly owned subsidiary of CCIL has been authorized to issue Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs) in India. Prior to joining CCIL, Mr. Hare Krishna Jena has served State Bank of India for about 35 years and his last assignment at SBI was the Deputy Managing Director (DMD) in-charge of the `Global Markets‚Äô. As DMD, Global Markets, he handled treasury portfolio of India‚Äôs largest bank with significant exposure to various market segments such as foreign exchange, money market, equity, debt securities and derivatives etc. Mr. Jena, joined the Bank as a Probationary Officer in 1985 and held various critical assignments both in India and abroad. Some of the assignments held by him :- * Chief General manager, Global Markets * General Manager, Network, Hyderabad, leading a network of over 450 branches, engaged in Retail Operations, Credit and Cross Selling. * DGM (Treasury Management Group), International Banking, overseeing Treasury operations of overseas branches. * DGM (Market Risk), Risk Management Department heading the bank’s market risk portfolio. * VP (Treasury) in the bank’s Sydney office overseeing forex business, money markets and ALM. Mr. Jena has been nominated to various boards like SBI Macquarie Infrastructure Management Private Limited, Oman India Joint Investment Fund Management Company Pvt. Ltd., SBI-SG Global Securities Services Private Ltd., Foreign Exchange Dealers Association of India (FEDAI), Gujarat State Energy Generation Ltd., SBI DFHI Ltd., Macquarie SBI Management PTE Ltd. He has been Chairman of FEDAI, SBI SG and OIJIF during his nomination to these Boards.

name: Mr. Hari Subramanian

bio: Hari Subramanian is an Engineering and Product leader with two decades of experience with deep tech expertise in ML/AI, Cloud, Data and Distributed Systems domains. He holds 14+ granted patents. Hari volunteers to build India stack in the areas of Data and Privacy and is the founder of Niti AI, which is an innovative startup building in the intersection of AI and Fintech.

He has also taken an entrepreneurial journey as founder of India go solar - India’s 1st Solar Ecommerce marketplace. Harish has done MTech from IIT Delhi & pursued his MBA from NTU Singapore. Through these positions, he led the transformation of the respective organizations, by establishing innovative technologies, services, and products. In 2018, he rejoined Eurobank Group, initially as the Head of Group IT Applications Management and International Activities, until 2022, when he assumed his current role. He holds an MBA from the University of Leicester and a BCs in Accounting & Management Information Systems from the University of Hertfordshire.

The various policies in which he has contributed included Digital Payments, KYC, MSME Lending, Digital Banking, Data and Information Architecture. He also deals with issues related to â€˜India Stackâ€™ and DPI and represents India in G20 GPFI working group meetings deliberating on Digital Financial Inclusion, MSME Financing, Reducing Cost of Remittances etc. As part of his work profile, he is also deals with many bilateral initiatives with many countries in the area of Fintech and also promotes policies for Fintech Investment in startups by identifying gaps or opportunities. His area of work also encompasses cyber frauds, SupTech, RegTech, InsureTech, e-commerce, data aggregation, digital financial literacy etc. as well as keeping track of all the emerging technologies.

name: Mr. Harshil Mathur
title: CEO & Co-founder
bio: Harshil started Razorpay after discovering the dismal state of online payments in India. He graduated from IIT Roorkee in 2013 and started working at Schlumberger. With an idea to change the way online payments functioned in India, Harshil quit his full-time job and founded Razorpay with his Co-Founder, Shashank Kumar in 2014, to simplify online payments. By early 2014, Razorpay was conceptualized with a vision to simplify online payments. Razorpay is one of the only two India-focused companies to be selected for the prestigious Y Combinator (YC) program. Along with 33 reputed investors, the company is also backed by Lone Pine Capital, Alkeon Capital, TCV, GIC, Ribbit Capital, Sequoia Capital India, Tiger Global Management, Y Combinator, Matrix Partners and Mastercard with a funding of $741.5 Mn from Series A, B, C, D, E & F rounds. Three years after its founding, Razorpay rebranded itself in 2017 as Razorpay 2.0, a Converged Payments Solution company with a product suite designed to ease businesses of managing concerns around the flow of money in their financial systems. Over the course of time, Razorpay has acquired eight companies - Ezetap - India’s leading offline POS company, PoshVine - India’s leading fintech startup that provides payments-linked loyalty solutions to payment networks, banks, and businesses, IZealiant - A mobile-first, API-enabled, and cloud-ready payment solution, RazorpayX Payroll (Opfin) - a Payroll and HR Management Software company, to solve for seamless automation of a business’s entire payroll process, Thirdwatch- an Artificial Intelligence (AI) driven company specialising in big data and machine learning for real-time fraud prevention, TeraFin Labs - The AI-based SaaS platform that facilitates digital financing solutions. The company made its first international acquisition last year by acquiring Curlec - A Recurring payment platform, but with the recently announced launch of Razorpay’s first international payment gateway for the Malaysian market, Curlec now becomes a full-stack tech solution provider for payments. Earlier this year Razorpay also launched its first international Payment Gateway for the Malaysian market with Curlec, earlier known as a recurring payment platform, now a PG, known as Curlec By Razorpay . Further strengthening its Omnichannel Play, Razorpay also recently acquired BillMe, A Digital invoice and customer Engagement - Razorpay’s partnership with BillMe is strategically designed to empower businesses with a hybrid model to engage better with end customers. Progressing in its journey that started with Razorpay 2.0, the Company also launched its neobanking platform, RazorpayX, and lending platform, Razorpay Capital - both designed to power the financial systems for disruptive companies. Razorpay has been charting exponential growth since its inception. The company today powers digital payments for over 10 Mn businesses including the likes of Facebook, Airtel, BookMyShow, Lenskart, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme, Tata Consultancy Services, Ola, Zomato, Swiggy, Cred, ICICI Prudential among others. Currently, the company aims to further solidify its position as one of the largest full-stack fintech companies in the country. While Harshil is a mechanical engineer by degree, he has been coding since his school days, some of the codes on which Razorpay runs were written by him. And behind that cool and calm demeanour is a Black Belt in Karate, Harshil likes to practice Karate in his free time. Among other achievements, Harshil has also won EY Entrepreneur of the Year in 2022 & he also got recognized under Forbes 30 Under30 ASIA class of 2021, Entrepreneur magazine’s ‘Top 35 Under 35’ entrepreneurs in 2021, 30 promising young Indian talent under the age of 30 in 2021, by Forbes, 40 Under 40 by Fortune India in 2021, & was also featured as LinkedIn’s Power Profiles in India (Technology) in 2017 & 2018.

Approximately 40% of Xoom‚Äôs remittance volume was to India, representing about 30% of USA-to-India volume at the time, in partnership with 4 major India banks. The business continued its progress when PayPal bought Xoom as its remittance arm in 2015. Mr Allison was the Global Head of Business Development for Xoom under PayPal ownership until March 2024. He joined Pay10 in Dubai in April 2024 as Pay10‚Äôs Head of Global Remittances. Mr Allison also has considerable experience in stablecoins having worked with PayPal to commercialize Paypal‚Äôs stablecoin, PYUSD, with Xoom‚Äôs remittance partners. In this role, he was responsible for driving growth in the retail lending and payments businesses comprising retail lending products (home, car, personal & other loans), cards business (credit, debit & prepaid) and the agriculture & rural lending business. In his 5 years in this role, Axis Bank saw industry leading, 6X growth and emerged as one of the top 5 retail lending institutions in the country. Before that, he helped build and scale an alternative-finance platform leveraging payments transaction data to enable banks and acquirers to profitably offer short-term unsecured loans to underserved small businesses. Currently serving as the Chief Executive Officer of Al Etihad Payments, he leads the team transforming and modernizing the payments ecosystem in the UAE, including the recent launch of a new instant payments platform called Aani. Before his role at Al Etihad Payments, Jan was the Chief Executive Officer at BankservAfrica, Africa's largest clearing house, where he successfully implemented a number of transformative initiatives, including PayShap, a cloud-based domestic instant payments scheme in South Africa. Jan was also at the genesis of Canada's payments modernization journey, having worked at Payments Canada as the Executive Director & Chief Information Office. name: Mr. Jatinder Gupta
title: Executive Vice President & Business Head - Retail Trade and Forex
bio: Jatinder Gupta, Business Head of Retail Trade and Foreign Exchange at HDFC Bank, is a seasoned banking professional whose 29+ years of experience have been instrumental in the bank's expansion and market dominance. Starting his career in 1995, Mr. Gupta has held pivotal roles across various institutions, including Microtech Software, IndusInd Bank, and ICICI Bank, before joining HDFC Bank in 2003. Over two decades, he has risen through the ranks, demonstrating exceptional leadership in branch banking across key regions in North India. Mr. Gupta's strategic wisdom is evident in his remarkable achievement of increasing HDFC Bank's presence in Punjab from 4.5% to 11%. This was accomplished through a combination of securing high-profile clients, such as the Punjab Police, and establishing a strong foothold in key industrial sectors. In 2021, during a period of global market vulnerability and currency fluctuations along with evolving regulatory landscape that was following the pandemic, Mr. Gupta took over the role of Business Head for Trade and Forex vertical in the bank as Executive Vice President. His profound understanding of customers, compliance, technology and cross-border money movement navigated the complexities of international trade, solidifying HDFC Bank's position as the largest private bank in trade and forex in the country. A proponent of technological integration, Mr. Gupta has spearheaded the adoption of digital solutions at the grassroots level, empowering both customers and stakeholders. This emphasis on innovation & tech solutions in Trade & Forex business domain has solidified HDFC Bank's position as a trusted and forward-thinking financial institution. Under Mr. Gupta's leadership, HDFC Bank has experienced responsible and sustainable growth, fuelled by a combination of technological integration and a strong emphasis on compliance and responsible banking. His initiatives, including Padyatra (Catchment Mining) and Grameen (Village Penetration Program), coupled with tailored solutions for government and industrial segments, have made HDFC Bank a household name in Punjab and Chandigarh.

name: Mr. Jay Kotak
title: Co-Head at Kotak811 & SVP Conglomerate Relationships
bio: Jay Kotak Co-Business Head Kotak811. Chief architect of Purpose driven tech and business initiatives, building a legacy that encourages Kotak811 to do what’s right for the business by being responsive to the needs of its customers. His prior experience includes stints at McKinsey & Co, Goldman Sachs Group in New York. Jay has an MBA from Harvard Business School in Boston and an undergraduate history degree from Columbia University in New York. He completed his schooling at the Cathedral & John Connon School in Mumbai. Outside the office Jay is a 90th percentile chess player on chess.com and has completed a half marathon. He is passionate about sports media, macroeconomics, fin-tech and travel.

name: Mr. Jay Surti
title: Division Chief
bio: Jay Surti heads the IMF's Financial Supervision and Regulation division, holding responsibility for the management and execution of the IMF's work program in these areas, covering policy development, implementation assessment, and capacity building. His previous responsibilities at the IMF include management of the work on supervision and regulation of capital markets and nonbank financial institutions and leading the thematic chapters of the Global Financial Stability Report. He has represented the IMF at several committees and working groups of the Financial Stability Board, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, and IOSCO, and has led the IMF's Financial Sector Assessment Programs in Spain and Tanzania. During 2018-20, while on leave from the IMF, he served as special advisor to top management of the Reserve Bank of India. He holds a Ph.D. in economics from Boston University.

name: Mr. Jayprasad Hegde
title: Head - AI/DS
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )
bio: Jayprasad Hegde is Head of Data Science at NPCI. He currently handles new initiatives in the AI and Data Science team. He has 20+ years of experience spanning core AI research, leading large engineering efforts, and engineering and strategy leadership. He has been involved in creating a contemporary AI platform at NPCI for solving population-scale problem statements like Fraud Modelling. These are hard problems that need to be addressed at mammoth scale and lightning speed. Incidentally, early in his career, he has also been among the first few teams at an India level involved in solving complex problems like English-Hindi Machine Translation using Machine Learning. He has completed his Computer Engineering at Mumbai University, and is an alumnus of Berkeley Haas School of Business. He is fascinated by topics in AI that are gathering interest only recently – like Reinforcement Learning, Intelligent Agents, Genetic Algorithms, and also on contemporary topics like Generative AI.

name: Mr. Jens Seidl
title: CEO
bio: Jens has been in the industry for nearly 35 years with senior management roles in sales and marketing, operations, customer service, business development, and general management. He has a background in payments and cash, and led both global business units as well as a number of major change programs on a global scale throughout his career. Jens joined CR in 2018 as Vice President, Business Development and Consulting. In November 2020, he was appointed as CEO & President.

name: Mr. Jeremy Tan
title: CEO
bio: Jeremy is the founder and CEO of Liquid Group Pte Ltd, a non-bank financial institution headquartered in Singapore, that specialises in C2B, B2B/B2C and P2P cross border digital payments. He is currently a member of Singapore’s Payments Council and Chair of the Payment Sub-Committee of Singapore Fintech Association. He also serves as a Co-opted Councillor in SGTech, Singapore‚Äôs premier technology federation. Jeremy is Singapore Representative to the East Asia Business Council (EBAC) and Malaysian Singapore Business Council (MSBC).

name: Mr. Jeremy Wilmot
title: President & CEO
bio: Jeremy Wilmot is the President and CEO of Interac Corp. Appointed to the role in August 2023, he manages all operations at Interac, one of the most trusted financial brands in Canada. Jeremy leverages his more than 30 years of global experience to drive Interac growth and deliver shared value for its Canadian Financial Institution customers and for the millions of Canadians using its debit, money movement and verification services. Prior to joining Interac, Jeremy served as Chief Product Officer at ACI Worldwide, a global software and real-time payments company, where he also held titles including Group President and Chief Marketing & Revenue Officer. Jeremy has held international roles at ACI and ICL (now Fujitsu Services Europe), leading local sales and services teams across five continents. Jeremy has completed the Advanced Management Program at INSEAD and holds a BA in Business Administration from Oxford Brookes University. He prides himself on being a continuous learner and has also completed studies at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and University of Chicago Booth School of Business. Jeremy is a Senior Advisor and Investor at AngeLink, the world’s first social crowdfunding platform powered by women.

Worked on large scale Big-data/Analytics projects and delivered largest telecom, biggest financial transformation project for Gov of India and leading Enterprises. Have lead large scale pre-sales/Delivery/support team and got best technical manager award from Mr. Azim Premji. Specialties on solution designing of: High Performance Computing. Grid Computing/ Scheduler. Parallel File System. GP-GPU based clusters. Big-data Sizing & solutions. ML/DL large scale clusters & end to end solution's.

name: Mr. Jitendra Gupta
title: CEO & Founder at Jupiter
bio: BFSI veteran with ~16 years of experience in payments industry, best known as Founder of Jupiter, Citrus Pay and Lazy Pay. Jiten is CEO and founder of Jupiter, a digital first bank for making money management easy for digitally savvy Indians. Before Jupiter, he served as MD at Pay U India between Sep 2016 to June 2019 Prior to PayU, he was founder of Citrus Pay, as leading digital payments company in India, which he grew into 300 member+ strong team, before selling to Pay U in 2016 in one of the largest fintech exits in India Jiten started his career with ICICI Banks where he worked for ~7 years. He is a qualified CA by education.

name: Mr. John Munn
title: SVP
bio: Visa CURRENT POSITION AND RESPONSIBILITIES John Munn is the SVP of Predictive Fraud Intelligence for Visa. In this role, John leads the Product Management, Machine Learning Science and Machine Learning Operations teams that build, maintain and own all of Visa’s production Fraud AI models. This includes Visa’s models that predict fraud on Visa transactions for Authentication and Authorization decisions, but also models that score non-Visa transactions such as Real Time Payment scores. John’s team is largely based in Bengaluru, London, San Fransisco and Washington DC and includes a fantastic team of problem solvers with a cumulative 1000+ years of fraud modeling experience. PREVIOUS POSITIONS Prior to joining Visa, John spent eighteen years at Capital One in various data science, big data and digital roles. The bulk of his Capital One experience was in the U.S. Credit Card Data Science organization where his primary focus was advancing Capital One’s underwriting methodology and tools. OTHER INFORMATION John studied Statistics and Operations Technology at the University of Denver and lives in Lincoln,Nebraska with his wife Shanon and children Silvy and Ean.

name: Mr. Jorn Lambert
title: Chief Product Officer
bio: As Mastercard’s chief product officer, Jorn Lambert is spearheading the shift to innovative, seamless and secure payments solutions, making Mastercard the best way to pay around the world. Jorn leads Core Payments – a team developing the payments capabilities that are shifting the trajectory of the entire commerce ecosystem. The team encompasses a range of payments products and platforms aimed at providing richer, more secure, and scalable experiences for consumers and businesses. Digital solutions at scale such as tokenization, authentication, real-time payments, digital assets, new acceptance models and optimization support a myriad of in-store and online commerce use cases and set the stage for the next generation of payment experiences. Before stepping into this role in 2024, Jorn was chief digital officer, where he set the company's digital strategy globally. In this capacity, he shaped leading-edge solutions to future-proof the payments ecosystem, serviced the platforms powering them, and embraced partnerships with tech, fintech and digital partners to drive further innovation. Jorn joined Mastercard in 2002 and has held a range of leadership positions across the organization to accelerate the company’s digital vision. Previously, Jorn spent several years in capital markets where he occupied various management positions in product development, product management and corporate strategy. Jorn is a member of Mastercard’s Executive Leadership Team and Management Committee. Originally from Belgium, he resides in London. He holds a degree in Roman Philology at the University of Ghent and the Sapienza University of Rome, and a post-graduate degree in business economics from the University of Leuven.

name: Mr. Joseph Joshy
title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Joseph Joshy is Chief Technology Officer and Chief General Manager, Head of FinTech & IT at International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA), a unified financial sector regulator for IFSCs established as a statutory authority by the Government of India. He is a Senior Technology Leader driving FinTech, Supervisory Technology (SupTech) and other strategic initiatives including contributing to the FinTech Agenda at India UK Financial Partnership, India US Financial Regulatory Dialogue, India Japan Macroeconomic Policy Dialogue, Joint Working Groups on FinTech between India and countries namely Singapore and UK, Global Financial Innovation Network (GFIN), Inter Regulatory Technical Group (IRTG) on FinTech under the Financial Stability and Development Council - Sub Committee (FSDC - SC), FinTech bridges with Overseas Regulators [like Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)] among others.

name: Mr. José-Luis Vásquez
title: Deputy Manager
bio: Jose Luis Vasquez is currently Deputy Manager of Strategy and Development of Retail Digital Payments at the Central Bank. Previously, he served as Head of the Payment Interoperability Project, Head of the Financial Infrastructure Department of the Monetary Operations and Financial Stability Management; Likewise, he served as Head of the Currency Programming Department of the Currency Management of the Central Bank. He has 25 years of experience as a central banker and holds a Master's degree in Applied Economics from the University of Michigan, United States, as well as a Diploma in International Monetary Policy from the Kiel Institute in Germany. He is economist from The Catholic University of Peru.

name: Mr. Joydeep Roy
title: India FS Advisory Leader Global Health Insurance Practice Leader
bio: Joydeep K Roy is the Global Leader of Health Insurance Practice in PwC and also Member of the Global Insurance Practice Leadership Team. He also leads the entire BFSI Advisory business for PwC in India. With three decades plus years of industry and consulting experience, Joydeep combines firsthand experience and knowledge and helps to strengthen and enhance the firm's value propositions in Financial Services. He has worked across Technology, Banking, Insurance and Wealth Management industries prior to joining PwC in 2016. His rich experience in personally building and advising Start Ups and devising afresh Digital perspective on business and Risk Management has garnered him many Awards and Board positions in his prior life, which he continues in PwC for over 8 years.

name: Mr. Julian Gordon

bio: Julian Gordon is VP, Asia Pacific and Middle East, for the Hyperledger Foundation, the open, global ecosystem for enterprise-grade blockchain technologies hosted at the Linux Foundation. Hyperledger Foundation is a collaborative initiative with leading companies, government agencies and academic institutions. Julian is engaged strategically and practically with business leaders and technologists in Asia Pacific and Middle East, developing key blockchain initiatives. He builds and supports Hyperledger membership and communities and links them with global developments. Julian started his career in London, working in technology in banking at HSBC, Lloyds Bank and Kleinwort Benson where he developed risk management, payment and treasury systems. Prior to Hyperledger Foundation he held senior Asia Pacific leadership roles with technology companies including HP, Cisco and Sun Microsystems, working particularly in the financial services space. In financial services and fintech Hyperledger Foundation is engaged in areas including CBDCs, global trade finance networks, digital assets, payments and green bonds. Our member organisations in these areas include NPCI, Bank of England, Banque de France, American Express, Citi, Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Monetary Authority of Singapore, Visa, Accenture, DTCC, Digital Asset, IBM, Infosys, Oracle, Wipro, Zeeve and more.

He is the founder and CEO of bKash, a digital financial service provider that offers millions of unbanked and banked people access to financial services through basic cellphones or smartphones in Bangladesh. Earlier, Kamal founded CellBazaar that introduced cellphone based electronic marketplace for developing countries. Kamal is a founding member of Open World Initiatives, a Lausanne, Switzerland based organization of young thinkers. He received Tech Award for ‘Applying Technology to Benefit Humanity’. He is a First Mover Fellow of The Aspen Institute. In 2023, he has been named as one of the global high-impact leaders in finance by this institute. In 2009, the World Economic Forum and TED respectively selected him as a Young Global Leader and a TED Fellow. He is involved with Anwarul Quadir Foundation and Shireen Quadir Trust that recognize innovations in developing countries. In 2023, he received the Fintech Pioneer and Lifetime Achievement Award from the ICT Ministry for his contribution to the digital finance sector. He is an accomplished artist whose work is in the collection of Bangladesh National Museum. He has a BA from Oberlin College and an MBA from the Sloan School of Management at MIT.

Being an active developer himself, he also contributes to engineering at GitHub.

name: Mr. Kartik Bakshi

bio: Kartik Bakshi is the Head of Merchant Lending at BharatPe, a leading fintech company in India. He is responsible for driving growth in the merchant lending segment, providing essential capital to millions of offline businesses. Kartik brings over a decade of experience, having held leadership roles across various organizations. He joined BharatPe in 2020 as Vice President and Head of Operations (Merchants) and later served as Vice President of Unsecured Lending. Prior to BharatPe, Kartik was the Business Head at Camp K12, where he successfully accelerated growth through strategic consumer acquisition. Kartik's professional journey includes significant contributions at Edelweiss Capital, Boston Consulting Group, and TravelTriangle. An alumnus of XLRI Jamshedpur, he has demonstrated expertise in corporate strategy, market entry, and team leadership across diverse industries.

name: Mr. Kartik Shinde
title: Partner
bio: Kartik is Partner at EY and leads their Cyber security practice for Financial services. In the last two decades, he has investigated some of the largest Cyber breaches in financial services sector and has helped organisations recover and re-think their security strategy. His background in offensive security helps clients envisage unknown pitfalls in tech implementations, including the recent developments in the world of AI and Digital assets.

name: Mr. Kashinath Hariharan
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr Kashinath Hariharan is the MD and CEO of Jio Payments Solutions Limited. Prior to this he has had a rich experience in Banking. He is a Business leader with a proven track record of working in multiple domains across diverse industries with deep appreciation of technology. His Domain Areas of Interest include -Payments, Fintech and digital business. -Enterprise wide digital transformation and running innovation projects. -Transaction Banking, Payments, Trade and Cash Management, Working Capital management including financial supply chain management.

name: Mr. Kaushik Anand
title: Partner
bio: Kaushik is a partner at A91 Partners where he focuses on investments in financial services and technology companies. A91 Partners manages $900M in AUM and invests in building enduring businesses for tomorrow's India. He is involved with A91's investments in Digit, Aye Finance, Ummeed Housing Finance, Finbox, Exotel and others. He was previously the head of CapitalG India (formerly Google Capital) and has worked at Sequoia Capital and McKinsey & Company. He is an alumnus of Harvard Business School and IIT Madras.

name: Mr. Keshav Reddy
title: Founder
bio: Keshav Reddy is the founder of Equal (www.equal.in), a leading digital identity and verification firm and a third-generation family member of the GVK Family. Equal is a consent-first and privacy-focused platform, for Indian enterprises to securely, compliantly and seamlessly manage IDs and personal records of their most important stakeholders. It is built in partnership with India Stack (advanced digital public infrastructure) and is compliant with India’s data protection laws. 30 of India’s top 100 companies and over ~1million users already using Equal. Coming from a lineage of successful entrepreneurs and business pioneers who have served millions of Indians over the years, Keshav’s purpose too, through Equal, is to increase the trust quotient between 100,000 Indian enterprises and 100 million Indians. Keshav is a board member of Reddy Ventures (www.reddy.co.in), which is a family office where he led investments in 30+ high-growth technology companies, of which five achieved Unicorn Status (Cred, Upstox, Hive, Genies & Chipper Cash). Keshav is also board member on India’s second largest pharma contract research organisation, Aragen Life Sciences (www.aragen.com) and India’s largest healthcare foundation, GVK EMRI (www.emri.in). Prior to becoming an entrepreneur and investor, Keshav served in capacity of Vice President at GVK Airports, India’s leading airport operator at the time, where he managed commercial revenues of ~$150 mn dollars whilst also playing a key role in stake sales of the airport business worth ~$1 billion. Keshav holds an MBA from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and a Bachelor of Science in Engineering from the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor. He lives in Hyderabad with his parents, wife and two children.

name: Mr. Ketan Doshi
title: Managing Director
org: Pay Point India Network Pvt. Ltd.
bio: Meet Ketan Doshi, the dynamic Managing Director of Pay Point India Network Pvt. Ltd. With a Masters in Financial Services Management from Mumbai University, Ketan is a visionary entrepreneur who thrives on cultivating a culture of empowerment and leadership within his organization. Ketan's magnetic personality enables him to forge meaningful connections with individuals at all levels, from esteemed C-suite executives to humble retailers. His natural charisma and effortless communication style add a touch of panache to his interactions. As a first-generation entrepreneur, Ketan has meticulously constructed his company from the ground up, endowing him with an intimate understanding of every facet of his business. His astute financial acumen, coupled with a keen technological aptitude, has propelled his company towards continuous growth and resounding success over the past decade. Driven by an unwavering commitment to service excellence, Ketan is always on the lookout for innovative ideas and cutting-edge technology. With impeccable timing, he strategically intervenes to transform potential opportunities into triumphant accomplishments. Ketan's unwavering objective is to revolutionize Last Mile Delivery of Financial & Payment Services through a scalable, technology-driven platform. As a result, his company has built an expansive distribution network spanning India, with a particular focus on rural and semi-urban areas. This network is trusted by over a hundred esteemed service providers, including some of the nation's largest corporations. Guided by Ketan's leadership, his company remains steadfastly dedicated to its social and environmental responsibilities. Through our comprehensive digital solutions and accessible distribution channels across India, we aim to reduce carbon footprints and extend financial literacy to the unbanked and underserved population of Bharat, empowering them to partake in the digital financial revolution. Ketan Doshi epitomizes the perfect blend of business acumen, visionary leadership, and social consciousness, making him a truly inspiring figure in the industry.

name: Mr. Ketan Patel

bio: Ketan Patel has over 24 years of extensive experience in the FinTech, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) industry. Ketan is the co-founder and CEO of Mswipe Technologies. Mswipe offers comprehensive payment solutions, catering to banking institutions, enterprises, and businesses across all categories, reaching the smallest towns in India. Mswipe has gone on to become one of the fastest growing digital payment company, increasing the digital footprint of the merchant community across India.

name: Mr. Keyur Shah

Keyur has over 25 years of experience in advising and assisting private equity firms, banks, fintech's, payment companies, capital markets and asset management companies in establishing an Indian presence and in doing business in India from a tax and regulatory perspective.

He is spearheading the national initiatives of developing the Fintech sector and ecosystem in Saudi Arabia, including the Financial Sector Development Program and the National Fintech Strategy as part of it. He has played a vital role in making the Kingdom emerge as an important player in Fintech space in the region.

name: Mr. Kiran Shetty

Throughout his exemplary career graph, he has spearheaded prominent roles at renowned organizations such as Bank of America, General Electric, Western Union, and is now donning the role of Chief Executive Officer and Regional Head at SWIFT. In the year 2016, Government of India conferred Kiran with the prestigious National Award recognizing his significant contributions made in the field of financial inclusion. Beyond his elaborate corporate achievements, Kiran is also a passionate tech enthusiast and a prominent figure in the startup ecosystem. He has not only remarkably contributed to his own roles but also played a pivotal role in seeding and nurturing successful startups, including Fxmart (now PhonePe), Early Salary (now Fibe), among several others. Kiran's unique and peculiar blend of expertise in banking, finance, and technology, coupled with his entrepreneurial acumen makes him a prominent industry voice.

name: Mr. Kris Gopalakrishnan
title: Chair - GFF2024, Co-founder Infosys and Chairman
bio: Axilor Ventures is an accelerator that helps start-ups during the early stage of their business journey. Kris served as the vice chairman of Infosys from 2011 to 2014 and the chief executive officer and managing director of Infosys from 2007 to 2011. Kris is one of the co-founders of Infosys. Recognized as a global business and technology thought leader, he was voted the top CEO (IT Services category) in Institutional Investor's inaugural ranking of Asia's Top Executives and selected as one of the winners of the second Asian Corporate Director Recognition Awards by Corporate Governance Asia in 2011. He was elected president of India's apex industry chamber Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) for 2013-14 and served as one of the co-chairs of the World Economic Forum in Davos in January 2014. In January 2011, the Government of India awarded Mr. Gopalakrishnan the Padma Bhushan, the country’s third-highest civilian honor. Mr Gopalakrishnan serves on the Board of Governors of Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST), is the Chairman, The Council, IISc Bangalore, and is the Chairman, Board of Governors of IIIT, Bangalore. He is the Chairman of the Vision Group on Information Technology of Karnataka Government, the Chairman of RBIH (Reserve Bank of India Innovation Hub) and the Chairman of CII Centre of Excellence in Innovation, Entrepreneurship and Start-ups (CIES). Mr Gopalakrishnan is the chairman of Itihaasa Research and Digital which publishes history of Indian IT industry as “itihaasa” (http://www.itihaasa.com/) app as well as reports on industrial and academic research in India. He is the Co-author of “Against All Odds – The IT Story of India”. Mr Gopalakrishnan invests in promoting research on Brain sciences, aging related disorders as well as investing in start-ups and start-up ecosystem. His family philanthropy is Pratiksha Trust and investment arm is Pratithi. Mr. Gopalakrishnan holds master’s degrees in physics and computer science from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras. Kris is a Fellow of Indian National Academy of Engineers (INAE) and an Honorary Fellow of Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (IETE) of India.

name: Mr. Krishna Prasad Atluri

His extensive international business experience spans 12 years in the USA and 30 years in India, encompassing leadership roles in financial services, technology sectors, and startups. KP's expertise extends to corporate governance, partnerships, joint ventures, and corporate development. His career includes work in investment banking, M&A, media business development, and financial advisory. As a CFO of a global telecom product company and a strategic advisor to various enterprises, KP has worked to build and deploy effective business strategies. With his MBA from XLRI, Jamshedpur, where he excelled academically, and an engineering degree with distinction, KP brings a wealth of knowledge and innovation to the fields of FinTech, governance, and strategic business development.

M.E (Digital Systems – ECE) – 1992-95 – University College of Engineering – Hyderabad, Osmania University. • Industry Experience: BFSI/Manufacturing/Retail/ Telecom/ IT Delivery & Services • Worked In: Electronics Corporation of India Limited, Syndicate Bank, Reliance Communications, Reliance Retail, Leighton International and Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

name: Mr. Krishnan Iyer
title: Senior Vice President
bio: An accomplished Chartered Accountant with over 26 years of experience in Financial Services and Capital Markets. spanning leading global and domestic organizations. Proven track record of building and scaling businesses, leading large and diverse teams and driving regulatory excellence. currently, heading Investor Services at the National Stock Exchange of India leveraging expertise to foster a robust and transparent investor ecosystem.

name: Mr. Krishnan Vishwanathan
title: Founder and Executive Director
bio: Krishnan, an IIT Delhi graduate with several patents and an MBA from Yale, began his career at McKinsey, serving over 40 financial institutions. He left McKinsey in 2013 to co-found Kissht Finance in 2015 and RING in 2021. Krishnan directs the company's strategic vision and oversees key go-to-market functions. An avid reader, traveler, and squash and football enthusiast, his mantra is, “Build the best product for the customers – Success will automatically follow.

name: Mr. Kshitij Pratihast
title: Specialist - Blockchain
bio: Kshitij brings over 11 years of experience in designing and implementing distributed ledger technology (DLT) solutions, with a proven track record of leading innovative projects across industries such as payments, life sciences, and healthcare. His expertise centers on scaling DLT platforms, blockchain interoperability, and enabling privacy-preserving transactions.

name: Mr. Kulin Shah
title: Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer
bio: Kulin Shah is the co-founder and Chief Operating Officer at Onsurity. With over 12 years of startups experience, he predominantly drives growth and partnerships at the organization. In addition to this, he brings the vision of a changemaker constantly driving the company towards achieving bigger milestones. Along his professional journey, Kulin has been associated with companies such as Reliance Venture Asset Management and FreeCharge. His expertise in pricing strategy for sachet-sized products has helped the actuarial team build customized products for Onsurity’s customers who are today present beyond tier I and II cities. In his last stint at a General Insurance company, Kulin insured nearly 40 million unique users, launched embedded insurance with digital partners, and generated INR 100 crores in gross written premium (GWP). During his stint at FreeCharge, he acquired over 1 lakh digital merchants for the wallet. Kulin completed his MBA in Marketing from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS) in 2006. His previous work with several prominent startups in the areas of digital payments and insurance technology solutions for large enterprises stems from his undying desire to build technology and solutions for startups, SMEs, and emerging businesses. So, when Yogesh discussed his idea of making employee benefits easier to attain, it instantly sparked Kulin's interest, inspiring him to join Yogesh in March 2020. Together, they set out on a mission to launch Onsurity and democratize healthcare for India's missing middle. Kulin took it upon himself to provide a much-needed change in India, where the employee healthcare industry had received little attention. He set out on an ambitious mission with Onsurity: make quality healthcare accessible for all Indian small & medium businesses and their employees alike, thereby transforming how this sector of the population takes charge of its health and wellness. When he's not traveling the world, Kulin can be found lending a helping hand to start-ups as they launch their businesses. He enjoys taking an active role in advising on both growth and product strategy - showing his commitment to being an involved angel investor.

name: Mr. Kunal Jhanji
title: Managing Director and Partner
bio: Kunal Jhanji is a Managing Director and Partner in BCG's Financial Institutions practice in London. He leads BCGâ€™s payments practice in the UK, the Netherlands and Belgium and sits on BCG's Global Payments Management Team. He is the global leader for Digital Assets, Networks and Market Infrastructure segment. He has extensive experience working on payments topics with banks, core payments providers (schemes, acquirers, PSPs) and non-banks (regulators, merchants, fintechs). He regularly contributes to thought leadership and industry events, and is a co-author of BCG's Global Payments Report and a lead contributor into BCG's Global Payments Model. He was the co-lead of the European payments team and was the Global Co-lead of Open Banking at Oliver Wyman London. He also co-authored OW's global payments reports. He served as the Head of Policy at Open Banking Implementation Entity (on secondment from OW) from May 2017 - April 2018, and was also a Strategic Advisor to the Entity. Before joining BCG, he was a management consultant at Oliver Wyman, EY and Deloitte in their FS strategy teams. Kunal has attended Executive Leadership and Management programmes at Wharton and INSEAD. He holds a Masters in Management from Warwick Business School.

name: Mr. Kunal Pande
title: Partner
bio: Kunal is a Partner at KPMG and has been with the firm for over 25 years. He Co-leads KPMG India’s Digital Risk and Cyber business and leads Financial Services for Digital Trust business. He is also part of KPMG Global Payments Leadership Team. He has provided extensive range of services to Banks, Fintechs, Payment Cos, Brokers, Funds, MIIs, Insurance Cos, Central Banks and Telcos on: 1. Defining and implementing their tech enabled operating model, digital transformation, Tech Strategy, Architecture, sourcing and PMO. 2. Advising & building their capabilities to manage risks around cyber security, digital business, data, technology, including from emerging technologies like Blockchain, Cloud, AI. Kunal is a B. Tech (Gold Medalist) & an MBA.

name: Mr. Kunal Rana
title: Director, Merchant Services Partnership
bio: Kunal Rana is the Director of Merchant Services Partnerships for GPay in India. Kunal's team works with online and offline merchants across segments enabling them with a range of payment and financial services.

name: Mr. Kunal Shah
title: Founder
bio: Kunal Shah is the founder of CRED, a platform that brings the benefits of high-trust communities to millions of creditworthy individuals, brands, and financial institutions.Five years since inception, CRED processes over a third of India’s credit card payments and is used monthly by >10 million of India’s most affluent. His previous startup, FreeCharge, pioneered online payments in India over a decade ago. Kunal has advised India’s most influential organisations: the publishers of The Times of India [the world’s highest circulating English daily], Pine Labs [a large fintech unicorn], and Sequoia Capital India (now Peak XV). He has also served as chairman of the Internet and Mobile Association of India. Kunal champions India’s economic opportunity globally, with a focus on technology’s role in driving financial well-being, financial literacy and wealth creation. As a philosophy major in the technology sector, he brings a unique perspective to hundreds of founders whom he actively mentors and has invested in.

name: Mr. Kushal Rastogi
title: Founder and CEO
bio: Knight FinTech is a new age banking technology company that provides full-stack banking tech solutions in the domain of Co-lending, Lending and Treasury. Knight FinTech leverages its cutting edge technologies to simplify the complex banking problems using Cloud-first, API driven solutions, and is currently serving over 70 Financial Institutions (Banks & NBFCs), including 8 out of 12 Public Sector Banks, and holds a commendable 70% Colending infrastructure market share. Kushal leads Strategy, Product and Technology at Knight FinTech and has been instrumental in establishing Knight FinTech at the forefront of the banking technology landscape. He holds B.Tech, M.Tech from IIT Roorkee and has 15+ years of experience, working at the cross section of technology and finance.

name: Mr. Lars Sjogren
title: Ambassador
bio: Lars Sjogren, a key figure in the financial services industry with over 25 years of experience, has built a career as a senior executive, board professional, and senior advisor. His expertise lies in driving digital transformation and fostering innovation within the payments industry. He has held numerous CEO and COO positions at leading banks and payment infrastructures, where he spearheaded significant innovative initiatives.

name: Mr. Lawrence Chan
title: Group CEO
bio: Lawrence Chan brings close to 30 years of deep and diversified experience to his position as Group CEO of NETS. He is responsible for the companies in NETS Group, positioning the organisation as the industry operator, builder of payment infrastructure and winning the hearts and minds of consumers and merchants.
