In line with the organisation's purpose statement‚ ÄI Connecting Communities, Empowering Lives, Lawrence has successfully increased digital payment adoption through NETS wide merchant network domestically and enabled cross-border payments where connectivity with overseas payments rails has been established. Prior to joining NETS, he served as Vice President ‚Äì Regional Client Management, Asia Pacific for Visa. He also previously held leadership positions at PayPal which include serving as Vice President and General Manager for Japan and Southeast Asia and a Director on the Board of PayPal Pte Ltd until 2015. Prior to that, he was based in Japan for four years, where he led the American Express's Merchant business before returning to Singapore and assuming the position of Senior Vice President, Global Payment Options, Asia Pacific. Lawrence currently serves on the Payment sub-committee at the Singapore FinTech Association and as a Fellow at Singapore University of Social Sciences, where he provides advice and serves as a resource in the university's FinTech teaching and research activities.

name: Mr. Lito Villanueva
title: Executive Vice President and Chief Innovations & Inclusion Officer
bio: Lito Villanueva is the Philippines’ award-winning thought leader on digital transformation and inclusive digital finance at scale. As the Executive Vice President and Chief Innovation and Inclusion Officer at RCBC, he spearheaded RCBC's digital revolution, introducing groundbreaking and award-winning innovations. Among its recognitions include the Asiamoney’s Best Bank for Digital for four consecutive years (2020-2023), Gartner’s Eye for Innovation, and YouTube’s Challenger award, to name just a few. Villanueva was recently feted as CX Professional of the Year by The Digital Banker, the Philippines’ Innovator of the Year for Banking in the Asian Management Excellence Awards, the Outstanding Achievement for Marketing Management in the Agora Awards, considered as the ‘Oscars’ of Philippine marketing industry, a two-time Circle of Excellence awardee in the Asia CEO Awards, PhilSec’s Digital Leader of the Year, and as the “Mr. FinTech of the Philippines” by NewsBiz Asia. He bagged triple LinkedIn awards as one of the Top 100 Filipinos on LinkedIn, Philippines’ Top 30 Leaders on LinkedIn, and Top Finance Leader under the LinkedIn Leadership Catalysts Awards in 2023. He is also featured in prestigious lists like the Asian Banker’s Global List of Leading Practitioners (LLP) in Banking and Financial Technology, Seamless Asia's Top 50 Banking and Payments Leaders and Top 100 Fintech Leaders in Asia, amongst his over 70 regional and global accolades. He is the Founding Chairman of Fintech Alliance.PH, Global Chairman of the Alliance of Digital Finance Associations, a trustee at the Philippine Blockchain Council, Asia FinTech Alliance, and an advisory board member at the ASEAN Innovation Business Platform. He has authored publications including the award-winning Inclusive Digital Finance Report and has a regular business column ‘Bytes’ in the Philippine Star. Villanueva holds two graduate degrees from prestigious institutions, and finished the Digital Transformation by Design at the Judge Business School, University of Cambridge, UK.

name: Mr. Lov Loothra
title: Senior Vice President
bio: Mr. Lov Loothra, who has been with Credit Saison for the past two years. He leads the product team for the branch-led vertical, overseeing a diverse portfolio that includes Unsecured Business Loans, Small-ticket Business Loans, Loan Against Property, and Personal Loans. In addition, Lov Loothra manages the product roadmap for Credit Saison India’s mobile app. This app is designed to help customers manage their existing loans, apply for new ones, and track their financial health effectively. Recently, Lov Loothra has also spearheaded the development of a new direct and alternate sourcing vertical. This involves creating an API stack to enable partners to digitally onboard MSMEs for loans, enhancing both efficiency and service delivery.

name: Mr. Madhivanan Balakrishnan
title: CEO, Apollo Health Co . and CDTO

name: Mr. Madhusudanan R
title: Co- Founder
bio: Madhusudanan. R A.K.A Madhu co-founded M2P Fintech with his friends, Muthu and Prabhu in 2014. As CEO, he drives broader strategy and execution, on the back of his deep-rooted experience building payments businesses across Asia, as part of Citibank and Visa earlier. Prior to starting M2P, Madhu was Director of Products at Visa for South Asia, where he incubated and developed several new payment products, including Visa's Aadhaar-based payments system, working closely with the Government of India. Madhu graduated from the Institute for Technology and Management with a Master's degree in Marketing. He also holds a patent with the USPTO for healthcare and prepaid payment processing.

name: Mr. Mahmoud AbuEbeid
title: Chief Executive Officer & Co-founder
bio: Mahmoud is the CEO & Co-Founder of the UAE based Global Software solutions Group, his passion for technology drives him to leverage the opportunities in the fintech world. Mahmoud sits on the board of different software and Fintech companies. He firmly believes ensuring customer satisfaction coupled with high quality delivery is the hallmark of a lasting business. Currently in the middle east and specially the UAE market, his organization is being the leader in the digital payment's domain. With his leadership, GSS Group is one of the main stakeholders to be involved for the Real-time payments (NPSS) in the UAE which was introduced in the year 2022 and came live by October 2023. Mahmoud is very keen about the new FIT program (Financial Infrastructure Transformation) which is led by the CBUAE where he is leveraging on the Real-time payments, Open Finance, Card domestic scheme and the CBDC. Mahmoud within a short time (of close to 3 years) was able to harness his considerable skills working in the largest construction group in the region to lead a Software organization specializing in payments. This is remarkable considering he had to navigate the technology landscape and with his quick grasp and intense hard work he was able to understand the landscape, the market conditions and was able to strategies his organizations direction and roadmap creditably. He obtained two Harvard Business School specializations in Fintech and Leadership skills and came out with Honours. Mahmoud also invests in different Fintech's and IT companies where he believes they will make a positive impact in the society. In May 2024 he was awarded the best Tech CEO in the UAE by MEA Finance Magazine. Mahmoud strong network and well-respected reputation made him gain the trust of different industry leaders in various governmental and financial institutions. His passion is to always serve the UAE and make the world easy and convenient for the end-user. Mahmoud had published different white papers for the digital payment's domain and the Open Finance world. He has singularly impressed the Central Bank of the UAE and Al Etihad payments with his passion and drive to make significant impact to the UAE in any way possible. His ability to draw senior participation in industry events just with his charisma and leadership is unparalleled. Today Mahmoud with his capable team oversees planning market growth, craft product roadmap and strategy, ensure customers are delighted with our delivery, ensure the software is constantly upgraded in line with market trends, design efficient processes to achieve rapid go to market , craft overall P&L and pricing strategy and curate industry partnerships for inorganic growth.

name: Mr. Mandar Agashe
title: Founder and Managing Director
bio: Mandar Agashe is one of India’s leading fintech professionals with over three decades of expertise in the domain. He is the Founder and Managing Director of Sarvatra Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (www.sarvatra.tech), India’s leading provider of fintech and payment platforms, offering solutions like UPI, IMPS, AePS, and BBPS to banks and financial institutions. Mandar has been instrumental in driving payment innovations in India, most notably the sub-member ASP model, which enabled over 700 banks across 27 Indian states and 3 union territories to join the national payments ecosystem via Sarvatra’s unique SaaS platform. Under his leadership, Sarvatra’s EFT Switch has been recognised with several awards, including the Economic Times BFSI Innovation Tribe Award 2018 in the "Technology" category and "Best Banking Tech" of the Year 2019 by IAMAI. Mandar holds a BE in Computer Science from Pune Institute of Computer Technology (PICT). Under Mandar’s leadership, Sarvatra continues its being first and innovation DNA by launching Sarvatra Rewards, India’s first bank-led rewards program for UPI users. The customers of the participating banks automatically collect rewards while making UPI payments via any app, which can be redeemed inside the Sarvatra Rewards app. In addition to his fintech achievements, Mandar is also a renowned musician and composer. His work, includes his hit album on MTV in 1998 called Nazar Nazar Mili Jo Kal (https://youtu.be/aCOrSIf9iJk?si=tg2arnheWAfZWlWu ) and album with Asha Bhosle called 82pop (www.82pop.in ) which was released in 2015.

name: Mr. Manish Agrawal
title: General Manager
bio: Mr. Manish Agrawal is a techno banker with 25 years of experience, currently working as General Manager at Punjab National Bank. Mr. Agrawal heads the Transformation vertical of the Bank with supporting sustainability initiatives. His experience spans in varied domains such as Leading field operations, Core Banking Technologies, Cyber & Information Security, and the Digital Vertical. His profound vision has enabled the bank to achieve a remarkable advancement across various aspects of Banking, including Digital, HR, and Operations.

name: Mr. Manish Bhardwaj
title: Deputy Director General
bio: Shri Manish Bhardwaj belongs to the 1997 batch of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) of the Gujarat Cadre. He holds MTech in Optical Fiber Communication from IIT, Delhi and BE in Electronics & Communication from University of Roorkee (now IIT, Roorkee). Sh Manish Bhardwaj has over 26 years of rich experience of public service in various positions in the State & Central Government with exposure to Urban Governance, Finance, Technical & Vocational Education, Revenue Administration, Developmental Administration & Census. He is presently serving as Deputy Director General, UIDAI- HO, New Delhi from 25 September 2023.

name: Mr. Manmeet Dhody
title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Manmeet Dhody, a leading technologist, is the Chief Technology Officer at Paytm, India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution platform. Dhody has reinforced Paytm's position as a technology pioneer by driving several industry-first innovations that have transformed the lives of its consumers and merchants. He has led initiatives that have significantly reduced infrastructure costs and ensured sustained scalability for Paytm's platform. Dhody is currently spearheading the next phase of Paytm‚Äôs product evolution by harnessing Artificial Intelligence, positioning the company at the forefront of integrating this technology into its daily operations. Prior to joining Paytm, Dhody held key roles at tech giants including Amazon and Microsoft, bringing with him a wealth of experience and expertise.

name: Mr. Manoj Kumar K V
title: Deputy General Manager
org: National Bank of Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
bio: Mr. Manoj Kumar brings over 28 years of extensive experience in the field of development banking and supervision. Currently, He serve as Deputy General Manager in the Department of Supervision at NABARDâ€™s Head Office. In this role, He leads a dedicated team driving transformative initiatives aimed at enhancing NABARDâ€™s supervisory functions, advancing risk management practices, integrating IT solutions into the supervision process, and strengthening the compliance culture across the rural financial sector.

name: Mr. Manoj Mohan
title: ED & Head, WISE Tech, SP Jain Institute of Management & Research
org: SP Jain Institute of Management & Research
bio: Manoj Mohan is a seasoned financial market professional with over 20 years of experience, with deep expertise in finance & innovation. An alumnus of IIT BHU and SPJIMR, Manoj is currently the Executive Director & Head of WISE Tech at SPJIMR. Manoj has been a driving force behind the creation of a pioneering business leadership program in FinTech and AI/ML. This program is designed to help senior leaders understand and leverage emerging technologies to drive transformative change within their organizations. Further, under Manojâ€™s leadership, WISE Tech has become a cornerstone of the startup ecosystem, particularly through its four accelerator programs centered on Responsible Finance and Sustainability. These programs engage with around 100 startups each year, providing crucial support to help them become fundable and successful. Manojâ€™s commitment to fostering innovation and supporting the startup community makes him a key figure in advancing both financial and technological frontiers.

name: Mr. Manoj Varma
title: Director
bio: A dynamic industry professional with 18 years of experience, blending expertise as a production engineer with a unique techno-functional-commercial perspective. With a deep understanding of both technology and business, they bring an entrepreneurial mindset, innovative ideas, and out-of-the-box thinking to every challenge. A key product champion in introducing UPI to France, they also played a pivotal role in securing the Payment Aggregator license for Lyra Network.

name: Mr. Martin MCcann
title: Senior Vice President Partnerships; North America
bio: With over 30 years of experience in the Payments and Fintech space, Martin actively participates in leveraging new technology to transform the world's payment industry. Having worked for various Payment Processors, Card Payment Associations, Banks, Fintech start-ups, hardware manufacturers, and software solution providers, Martin looks to leverage his experience to continue to help drive positive change in the global payments industry. Currently he is focused on making it easier for consumers to spend worldwide by easily accessing their money from back home to pay at the Point of Sale.

name: Mr. Masakazu Osawa
title: Chief Executive for Asia Pacific
bio: As Chief Executive for Asia Pacific in MUFG Bank, Mr.Osawa is responsible for overseeing the safety and soundness of the bank's operations across the region as well as business promotion led by the Global Corporates, Japanese Corporates and Commercial Banking business groups. Prior to the current appointment, he was Head of Digital Service Business Group and Chief Digital Transformation Officer (CDTO), responsible for driving MUFG's digital transformation to achieve sustainable growth and enhance shareholder value over the medium-to-long term.

name: Mr. Mathew George
title: Chief Financial Officer
org: National Highways Infra Investment Managers Pvt. Ltd.
bio: Mr. Mathew George is the Chief Financial Officer of the Investment Manager of National Highways Infra Trust (NHIT). He holds a bachelor’s degree in engineering (electronics and communication) from the University of Mysore and an executive postgraduate diploma in general management from XLRI, Jamshedpur. He has also completed a global leadership development program from the Michigan Ross School of Business, and participated in a program on infrastructure development and financing at the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad. In the past, besides his association with various banks, he had also been associated with the L&T group for over 12 years. In his previous capacity, he held the post of chief financial officer of LTIDPL IndvIT Services Limited, the Investment Manager of Indinfravit Trust (the first privately placed infrastructure investment trust in India). He has close to 3 decades of experience including in leading project finance, treasury and risk functions in the infrastructure sector as well as a wide and varied experience in the banking sector.

name: Mr. Mattia Musetti
title: Business Development Adviser
bio: Business Development Adviser Luxembourg for Finance. Mattia Musetti is an Adviser for Luxembourg for Finance (LFF). Mattia’s role is to advise LFF and its stakeholders on the strategic orientation of the financial centre, specializing on a number of topics including talent, insurance and private equity. He represents the Luxembourg financial industry abroad and helps others understand Luxembourg’s financial services and fund structuring toolbox and the industry in general. He advises international financial services companies, FinTechs and MNEs to develop and scale up globally their cross-border financial operations through Luxembourg as the gateway to Europe. His geographic focus of attracting financial companies to Luxembourg is global, with specialties in North Ameria and India.

name: Mr. Mayank Bathwal
title: CEO
org: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co Ltd
bio: Mayank Bathwal is the Chief Executive Officer at Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Ltd.,a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group and MMI Holdings of South Africa. Mayank has been with the Aditya Birla Group for 30+ years, and has leadership experience across insurance, financial services, manufacturing, energy and power. Mayank was the founding team member of Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance and in his last role, he was the Deputy CEO of ABSLI and had held multiple roles in the business in India and Indonesia. Mayank set up Aditya Birla Health Insurance in 2015, and under his leadership, within a short span of time, ABHI has grown into one of the recognized and fastest growing health insurance company in India. Mr. Bathwal spearheaded a very well diversified strategy of entering the health insurance market with a differentiated ‘health-first’ business model and developed an efficient multi-channel distribution system by leveraging digital opportunities. Mayank is a fellow Chartered Accountant and a member of the ICWA and ICSI. He is the co-chair of FICCI Health Insurance Committee and actively leads insurance industry forum of Nathealth. Mayank is an avid reader, a fitness enthusiast, and passionate about every Indian having an access to good health ecosystem and lead a healthier life.

name: Mr. Mayank Goyal
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Mayank Goyal, an esteemed financial professional with a substantial educational foundation from Imperial College London, boasts a decade of success in London's finance sector, notably in electronic trading and quantitative management at leading firms such as Bank of America. As the Founder & CEO of HOP Financial Solutions, he has led groundbreaking achievements in fintech, including facilitating over $200 million in remittances. Additionally, he is committed to educational philanthropy, significantly supporting the Pratham Education Foundation. His career highlights innovation, leadership, and a deep commitment to positive societal impact.

name: Mr. Mehdi Manaa
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: In January 2020, Mr. Mehdi Manaa was appointed as the Chief Executive Officer of Buna. Prior to his appointment, Mr. Manaa served as the Deputy Director-General of the Market Infrastructure and Payments Directorate General at the European Central Bank (ECB). During his 12-year tenure at the ECB, Mr. Manaa held several other roles, including heading the Market Infrastructure Development Division as well as the T2S Programme, a program in which he was involved since its inception. Prior to his career at the ECB, Mr. Manaa held various managerial and advisory positions in the private sector focusing on payment solutions and financial market infrastructures.

name: Mr. Metesh Bhati
title: Chief Digital Officer
bio: Metesh is a seasoned digital strategist and transformation leader, with over 15 years of experience. An advocate of continuous learning and innovation, Metesh thrives on challenging the status quo to explore new realms and possibilities. His unique ability to blend customer insights, business acumen, and technological prowess makes him a sought-after expert in the domains of digital innovation, artificial intelligence, blockchain, and more to achieve tangible business outcomes. He is currently the Chief Digital Officer at Protean eGov Technologies Ltd. (formerly NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Ltd.), building Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), Strategizing Open Networks and driving the adoption of GenAI and AI to enhance the overall experience. Prior to Protean, Metesh held leadership positions in distinguished organizations, including HDFC Bank, Bajaj Capital Ltd. and Aditya Birla, where he has demonstrated excellence in creating, scaling, and optimizing digital product journeys. Metesh has done master’s degree from NYU and further honed his leadership skills through certifications in Behavioural Economics and Leadership, Transformation, and Change Management from IIM Bangalore. In recognition of his outstanding contributions, Metesh was honored as the Digital Transformation Leader of the Year at the Digital Transformation Summit and Awards in 2019.

name: Mr. Michael Spiegel
title: Global Head, Transaction Banking
bio: Michael Spiegel is the Global Head of Transaction Banking at Standard Chartered and a member of the Corporate, Commercial and Institutional Banking Management Team. He is responsible for the strategic positioning of the business, and delivery of solutions across Cash Management, transactional FX and Trade & Working Capital Financing to corporate and institutional clients. He is also a Member of the Supervisory Board of the Bank’s European Hub in Frankfurt, Standard Chartered AG. Outside the Bank, Michael is a Board Member of Singapore’s Trade Data Exchange (SGTradeX), a digital infrastructure that facilitates trusted and secure sharing of data between supply chain ecosystem partners. He is also the Chair of the Banker’s Association For Finance and Trade’s (BAFT) Transaction Banking Leaders Group. Michael is a veteran transaction banking and client coverage specialist. His career spans more than three decades across Europe, the United States and Asia where he has held senior management positions in Global Transaction Banking and Client Coverage. Prior to joining Standard Chartered in 2020, Michael worked at Deutsche Bank where he shaped the global trade finance and corporate cash management delivery and was a driving force behind the development and roll‐out of a fully integrated vendor finance solution. Michael holds a bachelor’s degree in Banking. He lives in Singapore with his wife and two children.

name: Mr. Milind Pathak
title: Executive VP- Product & Marketing
bio: Milind Pathak is Executive Vice President, Product & Marketing at Route Mobile. He has 25 years of experience in domestic and international markets with OnlineSales.ai, where he was the Chief Revenue Officer, Milind has also worked with blue-chip organizations like Paytm / Madhouse Mobile (GroupM), Comviva, Buongiorno etc. He has a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from Maharashtra Institute of Technology and a Master’s Degree in Business Administration from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies.

name: Mr. Mohit Bedi
title: Chief Business Officer
bio: Mohit Bedi is a banking veteran and a fintech expert with over two decades ofexperience. He is the co-founder of Kiwi, a newly launched fintech startup that isrevolutionizing the Indian credit card landscape by leveraging the newly launched"Credit on UPI" rails by the NPCI. At Kiwi, Mohit (CBO) spearheads Growth by managing Strategic Partnerships alongsideMarketing. Prior to co-founding Kiwi, Mohit was heading the Issuing, and then theAcquiring and Commercial Card business for India's leading banking institution, AxisBank for about seven years. He has also headed the Credit Card business of theStandard Chartered Bank for over three years . In his recent role as Senior VicePresident at the global fintech firm PayU, he was managing strategic business initiativesand the Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS) for the company s India business. Kiwi will help democratizing credit in India, digitally and conveniently.

name: Mr. Mohit Bhatnagar
title: Managing Director
org: PEAK XV Partners Advisors India LLP
bio: Mohit is a Managing Director at Peak XV and has been at the firm since 2006. He is deeply passionate about and dedicated to being a culture carrier and team leader for the firm. At Peak XV, Mohit focuses on backing founders in the earlier stages of their journey from sectors including Consumer Internet, Payments, SaaS, Healthtech and AI. Over the last two decades, Mohit has had a ringside view of the founder’s journey and has served on numerous boards including Zomato, Meesho, Freshworks, Oyo, Prizm Payments, Citrus, Ujjivan Microfinance and many others. Mohit believes that founders who create successful businesses have the entrepreneurial mindset to also solve some of India’s societal challenges. Passionate about giving back to communities, Mohit is one of the co-founders of ACT Grants, a nonprofit venture philanthropy platform providing seed capital and advice to accelerate tech-led innovations for social impact. Prior to joining the firm, Mohit co-founded Bright pod, a wireless startup in the US, by orchestrating a spin-off from Ericsson Mobile Systems. Mohit has an MBA from UNC Chapel Hill and an MSEE from Virginia Tech.

name: Mr. Mohit Gorisariya
title: Co-Founder
bio: Mohit has 11+ years of experience in Financial Services. He started his career as corporate banker with HSBC Bank and later worked with various Large Banks/NBFCs as part of his BCG tenure. Mohit started SalarySe in 2023 with an aim to increase access to financial products for salaried customers and improve their experience of availing these products.

name: Mr. Mohit Jain
title: Executive Vice President
bio: Mohit Jain is an accomplished banking professional with over 20 years of experience in Consumer, Corporate, and Commercial Banking, particularly in the MSME segment and digital space. As Executive Vice President at Axis Bank, Mohit currently leads the Centre of Excellence and Co-lending Business in the Bharat Banking vertical and serves as a Director on the Board of Freecharge Payment Technologies, a leading payments and lending fintech. In his previous role as the MD of Freecharge, he strategically focused on leading Consumer Payments, lending, Merchant business, and PAPG businesses. At Axis Bank, Mohit has been pivotal in developing innovative product lines, including Partnership Models such as Co-Lending and Business Correspondent (BC) relations. He has also incubated new businesses like Nano Loans for affordable housing. His prior achievements include spearheading the Bharat Enterprises Initiatives and Institutional Business, where he managed Corporate Agri and MSME businesses in semi-urban and rural markets. Notably, Mohit played a significant role in the bank's successful $1.8 billion fundraising effort from Bain and other investors. In addition to his current responsibilities, Mohit has contributed significantly to the Axis Group's strategic initiatives. He was instrumental in the acquisition and transition of Freecharge. During his initial years as the head of the Project Advisory Group, he specialized in structuring, debt underwriting for large corporations, mergers and acquisitions, and strategy & investments. Educational Background: â€¢ Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India â€¢ Post-Graduation from Management Development Institute (MDI), Gurgaon

name: Mr. Mohit Mehra
title: Vice President - Primary Markets & Payments
bio: Mohit is the Vice President of Primary Markets & Payments at Zerodha. Previously, he managed investments and led his family's four-generation-old stock brokerage.

name: Mr. Mohit Monga
title: Vice President, Financial Services Products
bio: Mohit is a Product and Business Leader with diverse experience in Product Management, Business Strategy, AI, and P&L Management in Fintech and Deeptech (across Semiconductors and AI). Built and scaled products in Payments, Lending, Insuretech and AI domains. Passionate about creating population scale impact through Finance, technology, and data as key input levers.

name: Mr. Motie Bring
title: CEO
bio: Based in London, Motie joined PPRO in 2023 as Chief Commercial Officer, responsible for advancing the company's global commercial strategy. In October 2023, he was appointed as Chief Executive Officer, and is leading the business into the next phase of growth and delivering industry-leading payment services for PPRO's customers and partners. Motie has over 20 years of experience in payments, having held a number of senior executive positions with renowned companies in the industry. He spent seven years in senior management roles at Worldpay and served as Chief Commercial Officer at payments technology company Nuvei. Motie is a well-known thought leader in the payments sector, regularly speaking at major conferences and frequently quoted in the media on payments, fintech and e-commerce trends.

name: Mr. Motilal Oswal
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Motilal Oswal is the Founder of Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd. (MOFSL). He is a Chartered Accountant and started the business with co-founder Raamdeo Agrawal in 1987. Under their leadership, MOFSL group has grown from a small sub-brokerage unit with zero capital to India's leading and well-respected Financial Services Company with a Market cap of over Rs.35,000 Crores. With over 37 years of experience, MOFSL group has diversified into seven business models such as Distribution & Broking, Institutional Equities, Investment Banking, Asset Management, Private Wealth, Private Equity and Home Finance ably managed by a team of over 11,200 employees catering to over 70 Lakh Customers across 600 cities & Advising on more than Rs.4 Lakhs Crores of Assets. Motilal Oswal Financial Services Ltd is taught as a case study in the highly regarded Harvard Business School, USA.

name: Mr. Movin Jain
title: Founder
bio: Movin is one of the founders at Skydo. He has earlier led Product teams at various startups across industries, and was most recently heading Payments Product at PhonePe. Skydo is a fast-growing Cross-border B2B Payments startup, helping Indian MSMEs and freelancers receive export payments seamlessly.

name: Mr. Mukesh Agarwal
title: Managing Director
bio: Mukesh is a business leader with three decades of experience in financial services industry including Indices, Mutual funds Research, Equity Research, Fixed Income Research, Industry Research & Credit Ratings. Mukesh has been part of various regulatory committees/Sub-committees in India on topics related to Indices, Bond Markets, Mutual Funds, Passive funds etc. Mukesh is presently the Managing Director & CEO of NSE Indices Ltd. and NSE Data & Analytics Ltd., wholly owned subsidiaries of National Stock Exchange of India (NSE), India’s largest stock exchange. Previously, Mukesh was President at CRISIL Limited, a Standard & Poor’s company, and was leading their India Research business with full P&L responsibility. He worked with CRISIL for 20 years in various functions including Credit Ratings for 15 years. Mukesh has a Masters Degree in Management studies from S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research, Mumbai, India and Bachelors Degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering from Birla Institute of Technology & Science (BITS), Pilani, Rajasthan, India."

name: Mr. Muzaffer Hamid
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Muzaffer Hamid is a seasoned banker & business founder with over two and a half decades of extensive experience in Payments, Retail and SME banking across multiple geographies, with a passion for promoting financial inclusion & sovereignty. Mr. Hamid began his career with Citibank in the UAE, where he spent a decade across Middle East & Africa before moving to Fullerton Financial Holdings as Chief of Operations where he was involved in their businesses in China, India, Ukraine, and other Asia Pacific countries. His last stint before joining Mercury, was as the CEO of Saudi based Tas‚Äôheel Finance where he set up a first of its kind end-to-end digital fintech consumer finance company. Outside of his professional endeavours, Mr. Hamid is an avid golfer and enjoys swimming.

name: Mr. N Anand Sri Ganesh
title: CEO
bio: Ganesh is the CEO of NSRCEL - IIM Bangalore‚ Äôs startup incubator. NSRCEL transforms aspirants to successful entrepreneurs by building their entrepreneurial capability and mindsets, bringing together academia and industry. Ganesh is passionate about creating ecosystems that enable innovations to create impact at nation scale. He has extensive global experience in business leadership roles in technology and consumer industries. His prior experience includes Pepsico, HP, Algonomy and BRIDGEi2i. He is a graduate from IIT Madras and IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Nalin Agrawal
title: Co-founder & Director
bio: Nalin, an IIT Bombay alumnus, is the Co-founder and Director of Snapmint, Indiaâ€™sleading Zero Cost EMI app. As a seasoned fintech leader, he has played a pivotal role in transforming and democratising fair EMI shopping in India. Nalinâ€™s leadership is marked by an unwavering commitment to improving financial accessibility and setting new industry standards. Since its inception, Snapmint has revolutionised credit access for over 25 million users, partnered with more than 800 consumer brands, and secured an NBFC licence from the Reserve Bank of India, all while making Zero Cost EMI shopping more accessible to Indian masses.

name: Mr. Naman Kapoor
title: MD & Head - Indian Subcontinent Payments Liquidity
bio: Naman is an experience leader with 17+ years of transaction banking experience across Cash Product, Digital Platforms, Implementation, and TTS Operations. He has been an integral part of the TTS India Leadership team and played a pivotal role in digitizing the overall business. In his current role, Naman is responsible for driving strategic growth across Liquidity Management, Payments & Receivables and Commercial Cards portfolios and leading the Innovation agenda through partnerships with FinTechs. HeÂ joined TTS India business in 2015 as Cash Product Manager managing Cross Border payments, Global Clearing and Liquidity structures. In his last role, Naman was the head of South Asia Digital Platforms and Implementation teams and has led Asia-wide transformational and strategic initiatives.

name: Mr. Nandan Nilekani
title: Co-founder & Chairman
bio: Nandan Nilekani is the Co-Founder and Chairman of Infosys Technologies Limited. He was the Founding Chairman of the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) in the rank of a Cabinet Minister from 2009- 2014. Nandan has co-founded and is the Chairman of EkStep Foundation, a not-for-profit effort to create a learner centric, technology based platform to improve basic literacy and numeracy for millions of children. In Jan 2023, he was appointed as the co- chair of the “ G20 Task Force on Digital Public Infrastructure for Economic Transformation, Financial Inclusion and Development”. Born in Bengaluru, Nilekani received his Bachelor’s degree from IIT, Bombay. Fortune Magazine conferred him with “Asia’s Businessman of the year 2003”. In 2005 he received the prestigious Joseph Schumpeter prize for innovative services in economy, economic sciences and politics .In 2006, he was awarded the Padma Bhushan. He was also named Businessman of the year by Forbes Asia. Time magazine listed him as one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2006 & 2009. Foreign Policy magazine listed him as one of the Top 100 Global thinkers in 2010. In 2014, He won The Economist Social & Economic Innovation Award for his leadership of India’s Unique Identification initiative (Aadhaar). In 2017, he received the Lifetime Achievement Award from E & Y. CNBC- TV 18 conferred India Business leader award for outstanding contributor to the Indian Economy-2017 and he also received the 22nd Nikkei Asia Prize for Economic & Business Innovation 2017. He has been inducted as International Honorary Member of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences in 2019.Business Standard Annual awards 2022 conferred, “The Life Time Achievement Award”. Nandan Nilekani is the author of “Imagining India”, co- authored his second book with Viral Shah, “Rebooting India: Realizing a Billion Aspirations” and co-authored his third book with Tanuj Bhojwani, “ The Art of Bitfulness: Keeping calm in the digital world” released in Jan 2022.

name: Mr. Nandan Venkatachalam
title: Principal
bio: Nandan is a Principal at Axilor Ventures. He leads B2B investing at the fund with a focus on Enterprise Tech, Fintech, Software, Marketplaces and B2B Commerce. He has invested and serves in Board Roles of companies such as Wiz Freight, Metalbook, Boxpay, Capgrid, Securtime, SwitchOn, LeRemitt and Fluxgen, amongst others.

name: Mr. Nasir Zubairi
title: CEO
bio: With 27 years of experience in financial services, Nasir Zubairi is a seasoned Fintech leader who established and leads The Luxembourg House of Financial Technology (LHoFT) Foundation. This not-for-profit organization serves as Luxembourg's national platform for financial services digitalisation. Nasir's career began in the front offices of major financial institutions such as ICAP, HSBC, and EBS, culminating in his role as Director of High Frequency Trading (HFT) at RBS London, where he built the premier trading desk in the FX market, fully automated through Machine Learning. In 2011, Nasir made a strategic shift to Fintech, where he has been spearheading the creation and expansion of ventures in banking, lending, and payments. Having worked across eight countries in the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Nasir brings a broad international perspective. Since moving to Luxembourg in 2016, he has taken on council roles at the British Chamber of Commerce and the British-Luxembourg Society, and has served as a Non-Executive Board Director at SEB S.A, the Scandinavian bank, and at the International School of Luxembourg (ISL). In 2022, Nasir was honoured with the "Officier de l'Ordre M√©rite du Grand Duch√© de Luxembourg" for his contribution to the economy of Luxembourg. Nasir, an alumnus of the London School of Economics and a Sloan Fellow from the London Business School, is dedicated to fostering global financial growth and innovation. His insights have been valued as part of Christine Lagarde’s advisory council for finance and technology at the IMF, and on the Blockchain expert policy advisory board at the OECD.

name: Mr. Naveen Chaluvadi
title: Chief Digital Officer
bio: Naveen Chaluvadi is a Digital Business Leader who is passionate about creating large customer journeys and implement small pieces of the same at great speed He has been working in the space of banking technology since 2003, spending his formative years in the space understanding the nuances of product design and development. Over the last decade he had worked across various facets of Digital Banking and Payments which allowed him to transform into a Digital Banking Enthusiast with a passion for transaction engineering using digital payments. He is a mechanical engineering graduate from M S Ramaiah College, Bangalore who also earned his MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. He is currently working as Chief Digital Officer at YES BANK leading all key initiatives across Digital Channels and Digital Payments with an objective to maintain YES BANK as a preferred banking partner to Fintech Ecosystem.

name: Mr. Naveen Kukreja
title: Co-Founder and CEO
bio: Naveen Kukreja is the Co-founder & CEO of Paisabazaar - India’s largest digital lending marketplace and free credit score platform. Naveen is one of the most prominent faces of India’s fast evolving Fintech Industry. He has an experience of over 2 decades in the financial services markets of India and Europe, having worked in leadership roles at Citibank, Capital One Bank and Aviva Life Insurance. Naveen co-founded Paisabazaar under the PB Fintech Group in 2014. Under Naveen’s strong leadership, Paisabazaar became the market leader within 3 years of inception. Paisabazaar, in the last 9 years, has earned the trust and goodwill of over 37 million consumers from over 820 cities across India. Naveen is an alumnus of IIM Calcutta and the Delhi College of Engineering.

name: Mr. Naveen Mallela
title: Managing Director, Global Co-Head of Onyx

name: Mr. Navin Surya
title: Chairman Emeritus, PCI and Founder & Strategic Partner
bio: Fintech Thought Leader, Investor, Mentor and Board Member Founder and Former Chairman, Payments Council of India Founder and Former Chairman, Fintech Convergence Council Founder and Former Advisory Board Member, Global Fintech Festival

name: Mr. Neelesh Man Singh Pradhan
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Pradhan has over 23 years of proven experience in the area of strategy development, financial management, banking & financial technology implementations and project management at various jurisdictions and at various roles. He has worked with various stakeholders including the central bank, Government departments, banks & financial institutions, and other non-bank institutions at multiple projects. He is the founding CEO of Nepal Clearing House Ltd. (NCHL) for institutionalizing the national clearing house in Nepal and has successfully implemented and managed major national payment systems including electronic cheque clearing system, interbank payment system (ACH), real-time retail payment system, national payments interface (NPI), RTGS gateway, CORPORATEPAY (B2B channel), connectIPS (retail channel platform for A2A). He is currently engaged at NCHL for the implementation of National Payment Switch (NPS) and domestic card scheme (NEPALPAY).

name: Mr. Neelkanth Mishra
title: Chief Economist - Axis Bank & Head of Global Research & Managing Director - Axis Capital
bio: Neelkanth Mishra is Chief Economist, Axis Bank. He is also the Head of Global Research and a Whole Time Director of Axis Capital. He has been consistently rated the best analyst in India in investor polls over the years. A highly respected expert and media columnist on global and Indian macroeconomics, he joined Axis in May 2023 after a long and distinguished two-decade career at Credit Suisse, where he was Co-Head of Asia Pacific Strategy and the India Strategist. He is a part-time member of the Indian Prime Minister's Economic Advisory Council, a part-time Chairman of UIDAI (Aadhaar) and a part-time member of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) . Mishra has also advised government bodies like the India Semiconductor Mission and the 15th Finance Commission. He is a member of the CII's Economic Affairs Council and presents frequently to corporate boards. He has also worked at HUL and Infosys. He is a gold-medalist and Distinguished Alumnus Awardee from IIT-Kanpur, and was ranked fourth in the entrance exam to the IITs.

name: Mr. Neeraj Singh
title: Co-founder & CTO
bio: Neeraj Singh is the co-founder and Chief Technology Officer at Groww. With more than 16 years of experience in consumer technology, Neeraj has been an influential Technology leader in India’s burgeoning startup ecosystem. At Groww, Neeraj is responsible for all things tech. He has been instrumental in building the technology infrastructure across multiple Groww Businesses, such as Mutual Funds, Stocks, Lending, and Payments. An 'engineer-friendly’ leader, Neeraj often mentors technology professionals and entrepreneurs. Prior to Groww, Neeraj worked at Flipkart, where he is credited for developing Flipkart’s customer returns and refund system. He also significantly contributed to the seller marketplace, customer returns, and refund systems, and led a team focused on hyper-local delivery solutions.

name: Mr. Nehal Vora
title: MD & CEO
bio: Shri Nehal Vora is the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer of Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL), India‚Äôs leading Depository. With over 25 years of extensive experience in the Indian Capital Markets, he has held significant roles at esteemed organizations such as BSE, DSP Merrill Lynch, and SEBI before joining CDSL in September 2019. Shri Nehal Vora‚Äôs exemplary leadership has propelled CDSL to its current stature as the trusted custodian of over 120+ million demat accounts, with the distinctive honour of being the first and only depository listed on a Stock Exchange in Asia. Acknowledged for his outstanding contributions, he has received numerous accolades, including the Global Custodian Legend award in May 2024, the prestigious CEO of the Year Asia 2024 award by the Asia Asset Management awards, along with prior recognitions such as the CEO of the Year at the 20th Global Edition Business Leader of the Year Awards in 2022. Under Shri Vora‚Äôs leadership, CDSL has been recognised with distinguished awards such as the ‚ÄòCentral Securities Depository of the Year‚Äô Award at the Asset Servicing Times ‚Äì Industry Excellence Award 2023 and the Highly Recommended Market Infrastructure Institution of the Year at the Regulation Asia Awards 2023. Additionally, CDSL won the Tech Circle Business Transformation Award for excellence in digital execution in October 2023. CDSL also won the Innovation award in ‚ÄòDigital & Market Leadership‚Äô during Custodian Inaugural Leaders in Custody Asia awards held by Global Custodian in May 2023.

name: Mr. Neil Borate
title: Editor, Personal Finance
bio: Neil Borate heads the personal finance team at Mint. He is a graduate in law and economics, with a postgraduate diploma in investments from the University of Birmingham, UK. He has also passed the CFA Level 1 exam.¬†Neil¬†started writing about personal finance in 2016 at Value Research, a mutual fund research portal. After a stint at a fintech,¬†Neil¬†joined Mint in 2019 as a mutual fund reporter. He was made Deputy Editor in 2022 and Editor (Personal Finance) in 2024. He has also co-authored the book¬† - The Big Bull of Dalal Street on Rakesh Jhunjhunwala, one of India's most successful investors.

name: Mr. Nikhil Aggarwal
title: Founder, Group CEO
bio: Nikhil Aggarwal is the Founder, Group CEO of Grip Invest, India's leading high-yield platform for retail investors. Grip is a SEBI regulated platform offering fixed-income instruments offering 10-14% at a minimum investment amount of INR 1,000. Grip has now enabled over 1,000 Cr in investments with 5 lakh investor community. Prior to Grip, Nikhil was a Vice-President at Morgan Stanley's Investment Banking team. He subsequently co-founded Chalo, India's #1 bus transport solution and served as a consultant with the World Bank.

name: Mr. Nikhil Kumar
title: Co-Founder & Chief Evangelist
bio: Nikhil is the Co-Founder and chief Evangelist of Setu - An API infrastructure company for financial services. Before this, Nikhil was a full-time fellow at iSPIRT Foundation until July 2018. As the Head of Developer Ecosystem for IndiaStack, he worked with banks, startups, and developers to help them build financial services using eKYC, eSign, UPI, BBPS, GSTN, and other public digital platforms in India. He worked actively with NPCI to build the ecosystem for UPI & led the team that built BHIM. Previously, Nikhil worked in strategic roles at Tally, Intuit & Exotel forging partnerships across various segments. He was also the Co-Founder of Voyce, a B2B start-up acquired by Exotel in 2015. Nikhil has represented IndiaStack in over 150+ events across the world.

name: Mr. Nikhil Kurhe
title: CEO
bio: Nikhil is the co-founder & CEO of Finarkein (pronounced fin-ark-ane) Analytics, India's leading Data Infrastructure and Analytics company for Digital Public Infrastructure. Commanding over 45% market share in the Account Aggregator Ecosystem, a third in the Ayushman Bharat Digital Health Network and early co-authors and adopters of ONDC-FS & OCEN, Nikhil & the team at Finarkein have been able to lead from the forefront in shaping DPI adoption in India. Over 50+ large enterprises like the Aditya Birla Capital Group, Bajaj Finserv Group, SBI Cards have leveraged the Finarkein platform to build industry leading journeys across financial services and healthcare. Prior to founding Finarkein, Nikhil had a brief stint as a Data Engineer in Pune and before setting sights on the AA space & setting up Finarkein in 2019. Today, Finarkein is an industry leader and are now setting sights on scaling DPIs in India and beyond.

name: Mr. Nikunj Dalmia
title: Editor in Chief
bio: Nikunj Dalmia is the face of ET NOW and is India’s most seasoned Business News anchor who has witnessed the journey of the SENSEX from 2800 to 75000. He anchors important shows like ‘The Market’ and ‘Closing Trades’ and interview-based shows that focus on financial market participants – the weekly show ‘Market Makers’. His "Editor's take" helps viewers in making sense of complex news how it impacts their financial goals.

name: Mr. Nilay Patel
title: Founder & MD
bio: A growth hacker who is ambitious to make a galactic difference in Empowering Micro&Small industry especially in India, aptly describes Nilay Patel - Founder, Easy Pay. His drive to create a homegrown global fintech brand is visible in his arduous efforts in building Easy Pay to be a disruptive new age fintech player. Back in 2014, Easy Pay was launched with a strong conviction of ‘Organizing the Unorganized’ retail sector in India. This would be a one-offbeat platform which supports & escalates the rural belt of India and exclusively extends digital convenience to under-served communities. Fast-forward to the pandemic era, wherein fintech players played a big role in bringing credit access to businesses. Here now lay another opportunity to evolve into a financial services platform for MSMEs, which will drive the next phase of growth for the company. Leveraging their pan India presence and acumen servicing the retail sector, Easy Pay pivoted their product offering to be an embedded finance platform for the MSME segment. Nilay strongly believes new-age entrepreneurs should be driven by desire to bring change and make a difference, rather than be profits driven. Nilay completed his Software Engineering degree from Charles Sturt University Australia and is an avid reader. Apart from spending quality time with family; he loves Cricket, Football, occasional encounters at video games and talking to friends all across the world over the weekends. Nilay is also a strong advocate of conserving the water for generations to come.

name: Mr. Nilesh Pathak
title: CPTO
bio: Nilesh Pathak has a rich professional history of 25+ years spanning NIUM, JP Morgan & Chase, Dentsu Isobar, and LBi India. He's been at the helm of technology development, cross-border payments, treasury, global regulatory and risk management, and healthcare solutions. Nilesh's extensive international experience has equipped him with a deep understanding of local customer needs and risk management solutions across diverse geographies. He's pursued higher education at Mumbai University and C-DAC and holds certifications in Big Data from BITS Pilani. Currently, he is the CPTO of BRISKPE.

name: Mr. Nilesh Shah
title: Managing Director
bio: Nilesh Shah is Managing Director of Kotak AMC. Nilesh lead his team to the Best Fund House of the Year Award at all the mutual funds where he has worked viz. Kotak, ICICI Prudential and Franklin Templeton Mutual Fund. Nilesh is a part time member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister. He is a part time member of Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). He is a member of the Board of Association of Mutua

name: Mr. Nilkanth Hariharan
title: SVP & Country Manager
bio: Nilkanth leads the India operations of KX, a pioneer in high-performance event streaming analytics, data management, and operational intelligence. He is passionate about working with clients to help define their Golden Use cases in the GenAI world. His areas of interest also cover Web 3.0, the third iteration of the internet that promises a free and transparent flow of digital content and data with privacy and decentralization. He has extensive expertise in blockchain, AI, and big data, and works closely with enterprise customers, system integrators, and the start-up ecosystem to leverage the power of these emerging technologies.

name: Mr. Nimit Bhatia
title: Director- Product
bio: Nimit is Director Product at PayU. He comes with 14 years of varied experience onpayments & fintech products with Paytm, Snapdeal (as part of Freecharge team) &Oxigen. He brings in a wholistic experience of embedded payment experiences andjourneys which lead to larger customer retention and organic growth and scale to theplatform. He currently leads Affordability suite, Prepaid Solutions and PaymentOrchestration products like Maximiser. He brings his experience to scale value-addedservices at PayU providing merchants levers for achieving scale and growth throughPayU products.

name: Mr. Niraj Tralshawala
title: Head - Payment Solutions, Consumer Finance & PayLater
bio: Niraj Tralshawala heads the Payment Solutions, Consumer Finance & Pay Later business functions at ICICI Bank. He has over two decades of experience in the cards & payment space. In his two decades at ICICI Bank, he has worked in all Card segments including Credit Cards, Debit Cards and now the Prepaid Card businesses. He has played a vital role during the scale up phase of FASTag in India. Has created a market for feature rich, segment focused suite for Forex Prepaid Cards more recently. Niraj believes that customer focus, continual innovation & win-win partnerships help in building robust businesses that stand test of time.

name: Mr. Nirav Prajapati
title: Founder
bio: I am passionate about building innovative businesses and products, exploring cutting-edge technologies, and contributing to the startup ecosystem. I have a keen interest in Fintech opportunities in India and possess in-depth knowledge of Account Aggregators, OCEN, ONDC Finserv, and digital lending practices.

name: Mr. Nirmal Jain
title: Founder
bio: Mr. Nirmal Jain, Founder of IIFL Group, is a first generation entrepreneur, who is credited with building one of the largest financial services groups in India in just about two decades with a combined market capitalisation over $7 billion, assets under management and advise of over $60 billion and employ over 40,000 people. He is a PGDM (Post Graduate Diploma in Management) from IIM, Ahmadabad, a rank holder Chartered Accountant and a Cost Accountant. Under Mr. Nirmal Jain's visionary direction, today IIFL is one of the largest financial services firms in India with three distinct listed businesses IIFL Finance, 360 ONE (IIFL Wealth) and IIFL Securities. The group companies are backed by marquee global investors like Fairfax Group, Bain Capital and The Capital Group among others. IIFL Group has a customer base of over 10 million. Mr. Jain is also the founder of 5paisa.com, India’s only listed discount broker. The Economic Times recognizes Mr. Jain and one of the most promising business leaders in Asia. He has received the CA Entrepreneur Leader Award in the Financial Services category from The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and is recognized among the most successful IIM alumnus by Business Today magazine. Mr. Jain lives in Mumbai with his wife and three children. He is also passionate about contributing to society, especially in the fields of education and healthcare for the under privileged, for which he has setup the IIFL foundation. IIFL Foundation’s flagship project ‘Sakhiyon Ki Baadi’, is one of the largest girl child education in India and has already brought 36,000 out of school girls into the education fold in Rajasthan. Mr. Jain is an early-stage investor in dozens of Fintechs working towards frugal innovations helping large-impact financial inclusion in India.

name: Mr. Nishant Jasapara
title: CBO
bio: Nishant has been a part of Credit Saison India for the past 4 years, He has helped set up the Direct Partnerships, Branch Led model and Digital Business for Credit Saison India. As a Chief business officer, Nishant has been instrumental in setting up teams, starting locations from scratch and scaling up business. Nishant manages the Business piece and heads teams to thrive and add value across various lending channels. Strengthening the digital foundation and retail business across companies, Nishant has been revolutionising the lending concepts with an aim to make money easier for everyone. Nishant has extensive experience of over two decades across the BFSI domain, recognised for establishing and expanding businesses, building alliances, and leading and mentoring high-performance teams. With 7 years of close experience within the Fintech ecosystem, Nishant has built the foundation of Fintech lending across organisations. His excellence in driving commercial revenue growth, even through tough times, has been instrumental in getting Credit Saison where it is today. Before joining CS India, Nishant was part of the leadership team of OLA, Fullerton India, IIFL and Tata Capital. Nishant has completed his degrees in ACA, ACS, and DBLP from Columbia Business School, New York.

name: Mr. Nithin Kamath
title: Founder and CEO
bio: Nithin bootstrapped and founded Zerodha in 2010 to overcome the hurdles he faced during his decade-long stint as a trader. Over the last decade, Zerodha has changed the landscape of the Indian broking industry. With over 14 million clients and contributing to over 20% of the exchange retail trading volumes, Zerodha is one of the largest stock brokers in India today. Zerodha offers innovative trading & investing solutions that appeal to a wide audience in a bid to reach those sections of society that have stayed away from the capital market so far. Nithin also started Rainmatter, an R&D fintech incubator and fund that has partnered with some of the best investment-tech startups in India. Rainmatter is focused on creating an ecosystem that spurs innovation in India's financial technology industry. More recently, Nithin has also set up the Rainmatter Climate Foundation, an Indian climate fund that funds startups and grassroots organizations working on solutions to mitigate climate change. Outside of work, Nithin enjoys spending time with his family, playing the guitar, poker, basketball, and swimming.

name: Mr. Nitin Bhatnagar
title: Regional Director India, South Asia & Middle East
bio: Mr. Bhatnagar, Regional Director, leads the Council’s efforts in increasing adoption and awareness of the PCI Security Standards in India, South Asia and Middle East. In this role, Mr. Bhatnagar works closely with the PCI Council Management Team, Payment Brands, Assessors Community, Participating Organizations, Government entities and Regulators. Mr. Bhatnagar is an innovative thinker, speaker, television personality, and technical writer and has been often quoted in cybersecurity news stories and has been quoted by news organizations including the BBC, CNBC, Reuters, Economic Times and Times of India. Mr. Bhatnagar has been working in payment security domain for close to two decades and has been recognized amongst the “Top 100 Cyber Security Leaders of India 2022”. He has been constantly part of Research and Development around role of new emerging technologies i.e., Quantum Computing, Artificial intelligence (AI), and Mne Learning (ML), in protecting Payment Infrastructure from Sophisticated Cyber Attacks. Mr. Bhatnagar possess Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science from Bundelkhand University, Jhansi and Master's in "Cyber Law and Information Security" from Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad, India.

name: Mr. Nitin Chugh
title: Deputy Managing Director and Head (Digital Banking & Transformation)
bio: Shri. Nitin Chugh is a career banker with an overall experience of 32 years. He serves as Deputy Managing Director and Head of Digital Banking at State Bank of India. Prior to joining SBI in March 2022, he was the MD and CEO of Ujjivan Small Finance Bank from December 2019 to September 2021. He also served for over 18 years at HDFC Bankfrom 2001 to mid-2019, where he managed several leadership roles in retail banking. His last role at HDFC Bank was that of Group Head for Digital Banking where he oversaw the digital transformation of HDFC Bank from 2013 to 2019. Shri. Nitin Chugh is an accomplished industry leader and well regarded in retail and digital banking. He is an engineer and MBA by qualification. He also serves on the boards of SBI Card, SBI Payments Services Ltd & ONDC.

name: Mr. Nitin Mathur
title: CEO
bio: Nitin Mathur is currently the CEO of Tavaga, a cross-asset Robo Advisory firm which is also launching a venture capital (VC) arm. Prior to this, Nitin worked as a Consumer Research Analyst for over a decade with marquee institutions like Jefferies, SociÃ©tÃ© GÃ©nÃ©rale and Lehman Brothers. Nitin has also dabbled in various financial products (like transaction banking, securitisation and credit cards) for ICICI Bank earlier in his career. He has regularly featured on TV (Bloomberg, CNBC et al) and print media for his analysis of the Indian Consumer, Fintech & Startup universe. Nitin holds a MSc in Banking and International Finance from Cass Business School, UK.

name: Mr. Nitin Motwani
title: Founder & CTO
bio: Nitin Motwani is the founder and CTO of BookMyForex, India,s first and largest marketplace for retail foreign exchange and remittances. Nitin,s focus at the company is to create tech innovations to offer customers unparalleled value and convenience and to raise the benchmark for the retail forex industry. A former Silicon Valley professional, Nitin holds a bachelor,s degree in Computer Science from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign. Before conceptualizing BookMyForex, he helped build TelePresence, Cisco,s ultra-high resolution video conferencing product. He was also a member of several Silicon start-up communities with experience in product ideation, start-up advisory, and building minimum viable products for young ventures. Committed to pushing the envelope of achievement, Nitin has pledged to drive the growth of BookMyForex until the brand becomes inseparably associated with forex transactions of any kind, anywhere in the world. As CTO, he is devoted to working towards this vision by developing innovative products that will help increase the platform's reach, improve customer value and provide a superior experience. In his free time, Nitin likes to compose music and play the guitar. He likes to stay fit and focused by running. Whenever he gets the chance, he likes to satiate his wanderlust!

name: Mr. Nitin Saxena
title: Partner- FS Technology Enablement
bio: Nitin is a seasoned professional with over 16 years of specialized expertise in the financial services industry, focusing on cutting-edge technologies such as data, analytics, AI, and digital ecosystems. As a Partner at KPMG India, he currently leads the Financial Services-Technology Enablement practice. Nitin has a proven track record of successfully managing complex data initiatives, including the development of information strategies and the digital ecosystems for numerous clients in the financial services sector.

name: Mr. Nitya Sharma
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Nitya is the Founder & CEO of Simpl that is revolutionizing ecommerce by building a Postpaid payment platform purpose built for convenience and trust in ecommerce.

name: Mr. Nobutake Suzuki
title: President and CEO
bio: Nobutake joined MUFG Bank in 2018 as a managing director in charge of open innovation of MUFG Group, and he has been the President and CEO of MUIP since January 2019. Before joining MUFG, he started his career as a venture capitalist at Global Brain, an independent venture capital firm in Japan, in 2002. He has experience investing in Japanese and overseas startups and managing KDDI and other corporate venture capital funds. Nobutake started his career as a banker at MUFG Bank, where he was in the Industrial Research Division in the New York Branch and other divisions.

name: Mr. Ofer Tziperman
title: Senior VP; Former CEO of ANAGOG

name: Mr. Oleg Chanchikov
title: CEO
bio: CEO of Capy - A fintech arm of one of the leading MarTech companies, Mitgo Group. It provides publishers of the affiliate market with financial solutions and helps major financial institutions to tap into the vast client base of the marketing industry. Mitgo recently announced its plans to invest $20 million in Capy. In the next three years, these investments will help Capy to become a conduit for more than 7% of the global affiliate transaction volume, which can be valued at $1.5 billion given the sector's growth. Key details about the speaker: 20 years of experience in the IT and financial markets Previously held senior management positions at Visa and other major financial and IT organizations Embedded finance visioner and expert Studied at Stockholm School of Economics, Stanford University and National University of Singapore

name: Mr. Omar Halabieh
title: Director - Technology, Payments MEA
bio: Omar Halabieh is a global technology executive with over 20 years of experience. He is currently Director of Software Engineering at Amazon, leading the Technology function for Payments across the Middle East and Africa and is based in Dubai, UAE. In this role, Omar aims to make the payment experience of merchants (Amazon Payment Services) and customers (Amazon Stores) the most simple, affordable, and trusted. Prior to this role, he led technology teams responsible for automating inventory planning and control for WW Stores at Amazon. Omar holds both a Master's and Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.

name: Mr. Omkar Shirhatti
title: Chief Product Officer
bio: Omkar Shirhatti, a distinguished Chartered Accountant, is the Chief Product Officer at Perfios Software Solutions, India's premier SaaS-based B2B fintech software company, empowering over 900 financial institutions to make real-time, informed decisions. Recognized as one of India's brightest young minds, Omkar has earned his place in the prestigious Fortune 40 Under 40 list and BW Disrupt 40 Under 40 Change Makers. He is celebrated as a dynamic entrepreneur, innovator, and catalyst for change. Driven by his visionary spirit, he co-founded Karza Technologies, setting his sights on revolutionizing the financial services sector. Guided by his forward-thinking leadership, the acquisition of Karza Technologies by Perfios Software Solutions propelled the venture to a valuation of $400 million. In his ongoing role as CPO at Perfios, Omkar remains at the forefront of product ideation and development across diverse business domains, poised to expand these solutions across 20 countries on a global scale.

name: Mr. Osamu Abe
title: CEO and board member
bio: Mr. Abe serves as the CEO of Mars Equity, a Singapore-based equity fund supporting growth-stage tech companies across APAC and EMEA. He is also a board member of Mars Growth Capital, a U$1 billion startup debt fund providing non-dilutive capital for growing businesses. Mars is created through capital support from MUFG Bank combined with AI model by Liquidity, based in Israel and Abu Dhabi. Mr. Abe has over 25 years of experience mainly at MUFG's Corporate and Investment Banking in Tokyo, London, New York, California, and Singapore. Prior to joining Mars, he was also involved in establishing Ganesha Fund, a U$300 million startup fund focused on India startup growth and financial inclusion.

name: Mr. Owureku Asare
title: Head, Group Digital Solutions
bio: Owureku is a Senior Banker and Digital Transformation Specialist with 20+ years in Digital Financial Services, Banking, and Payments. He has held senior roles at Ecobank, key lead in its Digital Financial Services strategy and mobile money partnerships. He has secured mobile money licenses for major telecoms in Ghana and introduced solutions for MSMEs in Africa. Owureku has a strong network of senior executives in Telco, FinTech, financial institutions in Africa and globally.

name: Mr. P Shankar
title: CEO
bio: Shankar’s 25+ years of industry experience range from business planning and analysis to developing and executing complex intelligence systems across the globe for banks, telecoms, and insurance companies. Shankar previously worked for Cognizant, KPMG, and British Aerospace Engineering before founding FRSLABS in 2010. FRSLABS (Fraud Risk and Security Labs) is building identity verification, fraud prevention, and data protection solutions at scale for global customers. Shankar obtained his engineering degree from PSG College of Technology in India and an MBA from the University of Leicester. He has filed for five patents, three of which have already been granted by the Indian Patent Office (Patent Nos: 464857, 467408, and 509753).

name: Mr. Pankaj Gadgil
title: MD & CEO, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited and Head, Digital Platforms and Payments Strategy
bio: Pankaj Gadgil is the MD and CEO, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited and Head, Digital Platforms and Payments Strategy, Aditya Birla Capital. Having joined the Aditya Birla Group in 2022, Pankaj has since been responsible for providing strategic direction to the housing finance company and building it as a material player in the industry. In addition, he has been driving the development of Aditya Birla Capital digital platform and strategy for its payments business. Pankaj has been instrumental in building the omnichannel D2C platform ABCD, which offers a comprehensive suite of financial products and services, and digital payment solutions. Pankaj has over 25 years of experience in managing diverse portfolios across banking and finance. Before joining Aditya Birla Capital, Pankaj was with ICICI Bank for 19 years,working across Retail Assets and Liabilities, Business Banking, SMEs, Payments, and large ecosystems. He is accredited with several industry-first digital propositions, like InstaBIZ, Connected and API Banking, Trade Online, Eazypay and InstaOD among others. These digital propositions have been honoured by leading domestic and international bodies such as the Asian Banker, Gartner Innovation, IBA, Business Today, etc. Pankaj focus on customer insights, distribution efficiency, enabling service architecture, and digital transformations helped create a footprint of more than 2 million customers and led to a significant growth in profit pools and market share in the Small Business segment for the bank. Pankaj has also served as the Bank nominee member on the Board of National Payments Corporation of India, NPCI International, ICICI Merchant Services Ltd., and ICICI Securities Ltd. He is an MBA from the Savitribai Phule Pune University and holds a diploma in foreign trade from the Department of Economics.

name: Mr. Pankaj Gupta
title: Chief Digital & Marketing Officer
bio: With 28 years of extensive experience, Pankaj Gupta has significantly impacted the technology and business sectors. In 2019, he revitalized his career by taking on the role of Chief Digital and Marketing Officer at Karnataka Bank, where he has been instrumental in driving the bank's digital transformation. Mr Gupta has accelerated Cloud@core initiatives and played a crucial role in shaping Sify 3.0 before leading Karnataka bank in its digital transformation. Before this transformative period, Gupta accumulated 16 years of notable achievements at Wipro, where he held various business leadership roles across IT Products and Services. His career foundation was laid during five formative years at Godrej Pacific and Acer, focusing on Channels and Distribution. Throughout his career, Gupta has built enduring professional relationships, including valuable CXO connections, managed revenues totaling 500 million USD, and led teams of up to 1,800 individuals. **Specialties**: Business P&L and Sales Leadership, Strategy & Marketing, Digital Transformation, Analytics, Cloud Computing, Banking, Alliances, and Channels. **Strengths**: Gupta demonstrates a strong techno-commercial acumen, a forward thinking and learning-oriented mindset, and a passionate, achievement-driven approach. He excels in cultivating long-lasting relationships and possesses a dynamic entrepreneurial spirit. **Rounded Skillset**: - **Incubator & Accelerator**: Gupta has spent two-thirds of his career developing and bringing new technologies, practices, and business models to self-sufficiency. In the remaining third, he has effectively innovated and revitalized existing business models to ensure they remain relevant and achieve significant growth. - **Strategist & Executor**: Driven by a purpose-oriented approach, he integrates people, passion, and process, taking ownership of outcomes and extending beyond defined roles to naturally pursue impactful business solutions.

name: Mr. Pankaj Singh
title: Partner
bio: Pankaj has Co-Founded and Partner at YAN Fund, which is India's first fintech focused early stage fund having corpus of ~ INR 100Cr. Earlier, worked with banks and worked with cos like AMEX, GE, ICICI Bank, Kotak and Bank of America Merrill Lynch (BAML) from retail to corporate side, across multiple vertical . Now, he is full time into helping fintech startups and investing into them. He holds B.Com Honours from Hansraj College, University of Delhi and a post graduate degree (MBA) from Indian Institute of Management, Shillong and Fudan University, China.

name: Mr. Parag Desai
title: Chief Information Officer
bio: Since joining Montran in 1998, Parag has played a significant role in driving the company's growth and success. Parag's deep understanding of global payments and clearing & settlement systems has not only contributed to the company's growth but also set industry benchmarks. In 2014, Parag spearheaded the establishment of Montran's subsidiary in India. He is responsible for steering product technology, as well as shaping the company's business strategies.

name: Mr. Parag Mehta
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Parag has built the business, with a focused agenda of providing innovative and ingenious solutions to better the lives of people & also seed entrepreneurship within the organization. A visionary himself, at Evolute, he plays an instrumental role from strategic management to leading the organization to achieve greater milestones with each passing year. His endeavour is to transform the company in building multidimensional capability & achieve commercial success. His business acumen, risk taking capability and an eye for picking on opportunities makes him a sharp businessman. He is a 3rd generation entrepreneur imbibing all natural business attributes. His deep interests in technology & business has evolved him continuously to earn multi-level skills, required for providing direction to Evolute. Parag is focused on propelling Evolute into a fast growing Technology Conglomerate through businesses that uplift the lives of common man by bridging the digital divide in the society. He is presently driving the Product & platform journey for the group focussed in the space of payments, Fintech, Cleantech-energy storage and overlooking family office. With a personal ambition to become an angel investor as well as corporate VC he is scouting for new opportunities in the ecosystem. He has successfully spearheaded launch of India's indigenously designed and patented ANDROID POS terminal along with digital payment platforms & have deep involvement in building battery management and energy storage technologies for EV/ESS. Parag has completed his diploma in electrical engineering from, Bhagubhai Mafatlal Polytechnic 1988-1992 & diploma in business management from Narsee Monji Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS) in 1994-1995. He is an avid global traveller, loves playing indoor sports, enjoy experiencing off-beat adventure sports & meeting new people across the journey of life. He also embraces a continuous learning approach even in his busy work schedule. Currently, Parag resides in Mumbai and lives in a joint family "What drives me every day, what makes me build Evolute, is the knowledge that this business is more than just about profit. It's bringing about a positive social change."

name: Mr. Parag Mukherjee
title: Director- Digital Enablement Financial Services
bio: Parag is a seasoned Digital Payments & Banking transformation professional with over 16 plus years of experience in leading strategy, digital products development and technology driven innovation across the global banking and payments markets With over 16 years of professional services experience, Parag has worked closely with CXOs/Business leaders who are looking to drive unique transformation agendas. The agendas have varied from strategic cost savings to full blown Pan Bank IT transformation programs. Parag has built global digital payments and other banking products and has produced tailored "winning" solutions for global banks and payments market infrastructure companies like World Bank and Bank Serv, South Africa.

name: Mr. Paras Arora
title: Group Product Manager
bio: Paras Arora is Group Product Manager at Google, leading the Google Pay for Business vertical. He is focused on empowering small businesses to thrive in the digital age through digital payments and access to financial services. He has over 15 years of product and leadership experience across diverse sectors, including consumer tech, SaaS, and retail.

name: Mr. Paras Kunwar
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Currently Chief Operating Officer at Fonepay Payment Service Limited , Nepal . The leading payment network company in Nepal with market share of more than 98% of market share in P2M payments and only company to have interoperable payment integration in cross border eco system. Ex Banker with more than 19 years of association with the biggest bank in Nepal with expertise over Transaction Banking , Treasury Market, Payment System and Risk Management.

name: Mr. Paritosh Kashyap
title: President and Head - Wholesale Bank
bio: Paritosh Kashyap, President and Head ‚ÄìWholesale Bank at Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited (Kotak), has been associated with the Kotak Group for over 27 years and through his career, has incubated and grown to scale a number of businesses. On July 1, 2022, Paritosh took charge of the Wholesale Bank business at Kotak. Prior to this role, Paritosh was responsible for all Large Corporates, Structured Finance, Infrastructure, Banking & Financial Institutions Group, Real Estate Lending and Debt Capital Markets. Under his leadership, the Bank grew its franchise and developed capabilities in these businesses which occupy prime positions in the market today. A member of the Kotak Leadership Team, Paritosh has extensive experience dealing with Large Corporates and NBFCs and advising them on capital structuring, financing, and securitization.
