He has originated, structured, and led many structured financingtransactions, including acquisition financing, sponsor financing, securitization, Cross border, High Yield Credit, etc. In his current role, Paritosh is focused on taking the wholesale bank at Kotak to the next level and is driving a number of initiatives towards this purpose including increasing the granularity of the book, leveraging technology to drive innovation and make banking convenient to customers, becoming the preferred Transaction Banker to corporates through best-in-class products and platforms, transforming from Product expertise to a Solutions provider and many more. As a testimony of the initiatives taken, Kotak Mahindra Bank has been awarded as ‚ÄúIndia‚Äôs Best Bank for Corporates‚Äù in the recently announced Euromoney Awards for Excellence 2024. Paritosh is a Chartered Accountant and Cost & Works Accountant.

name: Mr. Patrick Branco Ruivo
title: Directeur général
org: SETE - Société d'Exploitation de la tour Eiffel

name: Mr. Paul van Sint Fiet
title: Head of APAC cross-currency solutions
bio: Paul is the APAC Cross-Currency Solutions Head for J.P. Morgan. Cross-Currency Solutions is a business that combines cash management and foreign exchange to offer end-to-end solutions for our clientele to outsource, manage fx risk and settlement. Based out of Singapore, Paul is responsible for the entire solution suite in the region, which is sits across our Payments and Markets franchise. Paul joined J.P. Morgan in 2018. Prior to that he held senior sales and product management positions at other International Banks, and started his career as a management consultant with a focus on Financial Services and Treasury segment, executing strategic projects across Europe, Middle East, North America and Japan. Paul holds a Bachelor of Business Engineering from the Fontys University of Applied Science, and enjoys his spare time with his family.

name: Mr. Pavel Gurianov
title: Principal
bio: Pavel leads FinSight Ventures activities in India and invests from Seed to Late Stage in BFSI sector.

name: Mr. Piyush Chourasia
title: Chief Regulatory Officer
org: National Stock Exchange of India Ltd
bio: Mr Piyush Chourasia is the Chief Regulatory Officer at the National Stock Exchange of India. He is part of multiple Committees and Working Groups at SEBI and RBI. He has also contributed to various Government committees and reports on financial markets, as well as to various IOSCO, WFE and CCP12 Committees and Working Groups. In his previous assignments, he served as the Chief Regulatory Officer and Head Strategy at NSE Clearing and prior to that as the Chief Risk & Regulatory Officer for Indian Clearing Corporation Limited. Piyush has a B. Tech from NIT Nagpur and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Prabhakar Tiwari
title: Chief Growth Officer
bio: Mr. Prabhakar Tiwari is the Chief Growth Officer at Angel One Ltd. In his role, he holds the baton for Brand Building, Performance Marketing, and Sales at the digital brokerage firm. He is further responsible for client acquisition, sales transformation, and PR initiatives of Angel One. Under his leadership, Angel One has seen rapid improvements in its digital maturity metrics and market share gains with a strong focus on performance marketing and tech integrations includingweb/app analytics and AI/ML-based retargeting strategies. He has been pivotal in the brand's emergence as the largest listed retail stock broking house in India, in terms of active clients on NSE, backed by several award-winning campaigns including 'AageBadhnekaSmartSauda', '#ShagunKeShares', 'EkNayiShuruaat, Very Smart campaign', 'Budgetkamatlab' campaign and the Rebranding campaign to name a few. Through the rebranding campaign, Mr. Tiwari successfully repositioned the company as a Fintech brand that is a one-stopsolution for all financial needs of individuals. SmartSauda 2.0/Very Smart Campaign was another successful campaign led by Mr.Tiwari in 2021.The campaign targeted the new-age investors like GenZ and Millennials and encouraged them to be part of the Capital Market. Prior to Angel One, he has worked with several prominent companies including Marico, PayU, and CEAT alongside others. The core of his professional expertise is built around leading digital & tech-oriented organizations, driving consumer innovation, and ensuring disciplined execution.

name: Mr. Prabhu Kumar
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Prabhu Kumar is the Founder & CEO of Wegofin Digital Solutions Private Limited. The inception of Wegofin was sparked by his firsthand experiences with the challenges and complexities of traditional business banking. While managing his ventures, he encountered numerous challenges. Determined to find a better way, he envisioned a platform that seamlessly integrates all these functions into a user-friendly interface. This vision led to the creation of Wegofin, a revolutionary fintech startup Wegofin is new-age AI-powered connected business banking platform for SMEs and startups. Wegofin is the gateway to a new era of banking excellence in the digital age. At Wegofin, we're rewriting the rules of finance, empowering every Indian with the tools they need to navigate the complexities of modern banking effortlessly.

name: Mr. Prabhu Rangarajan
title: Co-Founder
bio: A deep space tech enthusiast, Prabhu heads Ops and InfoSec. He feels start-ups are game-changers that keep challenging status-quo.

name: Mr. Pradip Gupta
title: Vice President
bio: Mr. Pradip Gupta is an MBA Finance professional with more than 19 years of experience in the Financial Sector. Pradip expertise in Fund Raising, Liquidity Management, Costing & Budgeting, MIS Management, Co-Lending, Securitization and Assignment Deals. Pradip brings with him strong relationships that he has grown with private and public sector banks, Mutual Funds, Domestic and offshore DFIs, Rating agencies and Trustees. Northern Arc enables access to finance for the underbanked in an efficient, scalable and reliable manner. Pradip is part of treasury and is responsible for Fund Raising, Co-Lending and Relationship Management.

name: Mr. Prakash Sikaria
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Entrepreneur with diverse experience across marketing, strategy, finance and general management. Focused on building products & businesses that provide compelling value to Indian consumers. Founder & CEO Super.money Super.money is emerging as a pioneering force in the fintech landscape, supported by a significant $20 million investment from Flipkart and Walmart. Under the leadership of Prakash Sikaria, Former Senior Vice President at Flipkart, the Super.money team is dedicated to revolutionising the financial sector. Their ambitious vision is to establish Super.money as the largest lending platform in the $500 billion fintech industry by offering a diverse range of financial products and services, including lending, insurance, and credit cards. Committed to innovation and market leadership despite regulatory complexities, Super.money leverages its expertise and vast user base to redefine the future of finance. It represents a comprehensive financial ecosystem poised to reshape the fintech landscape in India and beyond. Our Mission UPI has put India at the forefront of real-time payment transactions worldwide and accrued around 300 million users to date. Super.money aims to be at the forefront of this exciting movement, empowering millions of Indians to participate in the digital economy with UPI as its cornerstone. After superUPI, weâ€™ll be offering a suite of financial products for Indians - credit cards, a credit marketplace, FDs, personal loans, secured credit cards for people without a credit score, and a lot more!

name: Mr. Pramod Kumar Dubey
title: General Manager
bio: Mr. Dubey commenced his banking journey at Punjab National Bank in 1993 as an Officer. Over the course of more than three decades, he has gained extensive and diverse experience, including managing branches, overseeing large corporate branches, and handling administrative offices in roles related to compliance and credit. Recognizing his multifaceted expertise, Punjab National Bank assigned him to the Head Office in 2022 within the Digital Banking Transformation Division.

name: Mr. Pranay Jhaveri
title: Managing Director - India & South Asia
bio: Pranay Jhaveri is the Managing Director at Euronet Worldwide for India & South Asia responsible for the P & L growth. He is an engineer and has done his post graduation in Marketing from Jamnalal Bajaj Institue of Management Studies, Mumbai. He has 30 years of varied work experience. He has been with Euronet for 9 years & has held various leadership positions with top notch multinationals prior to Euronet. He has rich experience in digital payments, ATM outsourcing, P & L growth, enterprise sales, business development, channel management and apt at strategic planning and execution. Under his leadership Euronet India businesses, associated revenues and operating income has grown multi-fold making Euronet one of the largest B2B payment enterprise in India. He is passionate about innovations in payments and its relevance to business especially the financial services industry.

name: Mr. Pranit Arora
title: Co Founder & CEO
bio: Co-Founder and CEO of Univest Group, a rapidly growing company that has scaled from INR 0 to 500 Crore in just two years. With a rich background in building and scaling businesses, Pranit has previously held key positions at Otipy, OYO, RB, Rivigo, and GoMechanic. An alumnus of MDI Gurgaon, he is also an active angel investor, supporting innovative startups across various sectors.

name: Mr. Pranjal Kamra
title: Founder
bio: A little about Mr. Pranjal Kamra: Founder of Finology Ventures- A leading Fintech and Financial Education platform ardent to making finance easy. Author of two bestselling books, Mint Your Money and Investonomy. A financial Youtuber with more than 6.1 Million subscribers.

name: Mr. Prashant D
title: Head - AI/DS
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )
bio: A seasoned expert in machine learning, AI, and data science with 20+ years of experience. As Head of Data Science at NPCI, Prashant Devadiga leads teams in developing algorithms to combat fraud, detect anomalies, and prevent money laundering, driving real-world impact.

name: Mr. Prashant Kumar
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr. Prashant Kumar was appointed as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of YES BANK post the Reconstruction of the Bank in March 2020. Under his leadership, the Bank embarked on a transformation journey to emerge as a re-energized, re-capitalized and recalibrated organization, while continuing to fulfill its unwavering commitment towards its customers and stakeholders. This has been one of the rare instances, where an Indian banking institution has seen a real turnaround from the brink of collapse, within an extremely short time frame of a little over two years. Prior to joining YES BANK, Mr. Kumar was the Deputy Managing Director & CFO of SBI, India’s largest Bank. He was associated with SBI in various capacities and has a rich experience in diverse fields ranging from credit to human resources. He joined SBI as a Probationary Officer in 1983 and during his 37 years of service with the Bank, he held various key assignments including Dy. Managing Director - HR & Corporate Development Officer; Dy. Managing Director & Chief Operating Officer; Chief General Manager - Kolkata Circle; General Manager - Local Head Office Mumbai; DGM (Industrial relations) and faculty in Bank’s Apex Training Institute – State Bank Academy, Gurugram. He holds a degree each in Science and Law from Delhi University.

name: Mr. Prashant Mehra
title: Group Head, Retail Portfolio Management & Fraud Control, HDFC Bank
bio: Mr. Prashant is responsible for ensuring the portfolio quality, debt management and NPA control for the retail lending product segments of the bank. (Vehicle loans,Unsecured loans, Mortgages, Cards, Agriculture & Microfinance). Additionally, Prashant also oversees the fraud management framework across the various asset, liability and payment products and ensures adequate controls that lead to better predictive as well as preventive fraud control for the bank. He has been with the bank since December1998 and has since managed various roles in the Credit function to ensure a robust lending architecture is in place. He is a Production Engineer (1993 batch), MBA (1996),from Mumbai University who started his career with Mahindra and Mahindra, Automotive division, moved to GE Countrywide and after a stint of 2.5 years there, joined HDFC Bank in 1998.

name: Mr. Prashant Shah
title: MD, Regional Head, Banks, Broker Dealers, Fintech & Public Sector, South Asia & Country Head, Financial Institutions, India
bio: In a career spanning 20 years with Standard Chartered Bank, Prashant has worked across a number of leadership roles in Wholesale Banking Operations and Corporate & Institutional Banking Client Coverage teams across various segments within Financial Institutions. • In his current role as Regional Head - Banks and Broker Dealers, South Asia & Country Head, Financial Institutions - India, Prashant is primarily responsible for devising and driving the strategy to strengthen the FI franchise in the region. He leads a team of FI Bankers responsible for delivering client revenues, managing credit and compliance functions across Indian & International Banks, Broker Dealers, Non-Banking Financial Institutions and Fintechs. He also oversees the Investors, Insurance, Public Sector & Development Organisations and the Strategic Investor Group segments for India. • In his initial years at SCB, Prashant worked with Wholesale Banking Operations. He worked closely with Reserve Bank of India to lead the implementation of RTGS across Banks in India. He has a strong understanding of the Bank’s systems and processes having had stints in Cash Management Operations & Electronic Banking Project teams. • Prashant is a member of several Business, Governance & Leadership Management Teams in India and globally. He is the co-sponsor of the Generations Group on the D&I Council of India. • Prior to joining Standard Chartered Bank, Prashant has worked with ABN AMRO Bank and Citi group for 3 years. • Prashant is a qualified Chartered Accountant and holds a Bachelors Degree in Commerce from Mumbai University. He is an accomplished sportsman having represented State and University in Volleyball.

name: Mr. Prashant Vagal
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Mr. Prashant Vagal is Executive Vice President and Heads the Business Development and Products and Investor Education department in NSDL. He has completed Bachelor of Engineering and MBA in finance and over 26 years of experience in Capital Markets. Mr. Vagal has been associated with NSDL for 25 years now and handled various activities viz., Business development, Participant and CC Interface, New Product developments, Settlements, Training, Investor Education, Marketing etc. Mr. Vagal has been a speaker at various forums seminars held Internationally. He has been a member of Committees at SEBI and RBI.

name: Mr. Praveen Regmi
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Praveen Regmi is the CEO of IME Pay, a leading digital payment service provider in Nepal. He is a highly accomplished finance and technology professional with expertise in banking, digital payments, remittance, and financial systems. With over 16 years of experience in the industry, he has played a pivotal role in shaping the digital banking and payments in Nepal.

name: Mr. Praveen Shankaran
title: Chief Operating Officer - Domestic Fund Services

name: Mr. Pravin Agarwala
title: Group CEO & Co-Founder
bio: Pravin is the Co-founder & Group CEO of BetterPlace, Asia's largest SaaS and frontline workforce management platform. Looking at the inadequate attention given to the blue collar sector and the large demand and supply gap that has been left unaddressed, Pravin co-founded the company in 2015 with a mission to build a better world for the frontline workers across the globe. Through the years, Pravin has carefully built a team of purpose driven people who aim to achieve the collective vision of the company and work towards a bright future for the blue-collar ecosystem. Pravin has always been interested in solving problems being faced by enterprises when it comes to their workforce and business management. Before co-founding BetterPlace, Pravin was the Vice President and Global Head of Business for SAP Business By Design, a cloud ERP product. Through his professional endeavors, he has gathered 20+ years of experience in SaaS, Cloud Strategy, CRM and People Management. His love for finding solutions through tech has also placed him in a dual role of being an investor and an advisor in several tech-startups. Pravin's dedication and hardwork to solve the problems of enterprises and frontline workers has already started showing results and is paving the way in revolutionizing the frontline industry. In the last 6 years, Pravin and his team have been able to provide benefits to over 30 million frontline workers across 1100 enterprises in India, Southeast Asia, and GCC Countries. He has been instrumental in bringing about a digital adoption revolution among enterprises for managing their frontline workforce. Pravin graduated from Assam engineering college, Guwahati in 1996 with a BE degree in Electronics and Telecommunication. He has also completed an Executive Management program in Innovation and Global Management from Indian Institute of Management, Bengaluru and an Executive Management program in Innovation from Indian School of Business.

name: Mr. Pravin Jadhav
title: Founder & CEO
bio: PJ is Founder & CEO of Raise Financial Services that owns and operates stock investing & trading platform Dhan. Launched in November 2021, Dhan is one of India's fastest growing stock trading platform. PJ is one of the earliest Product Managers in India, prior to Raise he was the Founder, MD and CEO of Paytm Money.

name: Mr. Pravin Kumar
title: CMISO and DPO
bio: With more than 25 years of experience in the field of Cyber security, Privacy controls, Enterprise Risk management, Regulatory compliance , Governance Tech architecture and transformation. Pravin has worked for various well-known organizations in the leadership positions such as HDFC bank, JP Morgan, Barclays , LIC to name a few. As a Tech and Risk transformation professional he has expertise in GRC, Payment technology and architecture, Market Risk, and RBI compliance. When not occupied with work, you will find him enjoying trekking, Scooba diving or sharing his thoughts in different forums.

name: Mr. Pravin Tambe
title: Senior Vice President
bio: With 18+ years of experience working closely in BFSI domain for running multiple Digital transformation programs with help of technology. He was also instrumental in setting up nationwide program with Government vertical to bring Financial inclusion for more than 1CR+ beneficiaries. During his journey so far, he has taken multiple roles and currently leading as Business unit Head at Winjit Technologies Private Limited.

name: Mr. Prem Anup Sinha
title: Deputy Managing Director
bio: Shri Prem Anup Sinha, Probationary Officer of 1994 Batch has taken over the charge of the Deputy Managing Director, Transaction Banking and New Initiatives from 15.07.2024. Shri Sinha over his long illutrious career of 30 years has garnered expertise in all domains of Banking with a prime focus on Credit. He has also worked in London on an overseas assignment. Prior to this posting, Shri Sinha was the Chief General Manager of Kolkata Circle.

name: Mr. Pushkar Mukewar
title: CEO and Co-Founder
bio: Pushkar Mukewar is the CEO and Co-Founder of Drip Capital, a pioneering digital trade finance company with operations in Mumbai and Palo Alto. Under his leadership, Drip Capital is revolutionizing global trade for small businesses, making it simpler and more accessible. Pushkar brings over a decade of rich experience in finance and technology to the table. He holds an MBA from The Wharton School and an MS from Georgia Tech. His professional journey began at Capital One, specializing in risk management and new product development. He later joined Oliver Wyman as a consultant, working on datadriven strategies for retail and technology clients across North America, Europe, and the Middle East. In 2011, Pushkar transitioned to venture capital, serving as an investor at Saama Capital, where he sourced and evaluated investments in technology and consumer services. Drawing on his insights from both finance and consulting, Pushkar co-founded Drip Capital in 2016. Drip aims to revolutionize the traditionally paper-based trade finance industry by empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with seamless access to crossborder financing. Backed by top-tier VC firms including Accel, Sequoia, and Y Combinator, Drip combines expertise in technology, data science, and trade finance to support SME exporters globally. Under Pushkar's leadership, Drip has gathered a world-class team from prestigious institutions like Harvard, Wharton, and the IITs, dedicated to advancing the company's mission. By rebuilding core aspects of international trade finance infrastructure, Drip Capital is committed to levelling the playing field for SMEs in emerging markets and enabling them to navigate international trade with unprecedented ease.

name: Mr. R S Kumar
title: Managing Director & CEO
bio: R Subramaniakumar is the Managing Director & CEO at RBL Bank. He is a veteran in the Banking industry with 40 years of experience. Renowned as one of top bankers in the country, Subramaniakumar has immense depth of knowledge in domains of business transformation, banking technology, risk management, innovation, NBFC management, business process re-engineering, among other areas, across organisations. Prior to joining RBL Bank, he was the Managing Director & CEO and Board Chairman of Indian Overseas Bank, where he spearheaded the transformation across domains. He has also held the position of Executive Director at Indian Bank and Indian Overseas Bank. He was appointed as an Administrator at Dewan Housing Finance Corporation Limited (DHFL), where he successfully resolved the debt, a first of its kind in the country, during the pandemic. Subramaniakumar began his banking career with Punjab National Bank (PNB) in 1980. During his 33-year tenure there, his work reflected the evolution of financial technology. As he rose through the ranks in various managerial capacities, he worked across the bank's spectrum and geography, heading Business Transformation and especially enhancing business areas of Digital, Human Resource, MSME, Retail, overseas Operations, among others. As part of the core team at PNB, he established Banking subsidiaries' operations at UK, Bhutan, Nepal and Kazakhstan. He has held various leadership roles through the course of his career at PNB, including being Director of DRUK-PNB, Bhutan. Over the span of his career, he has also held various board level positions. He was an Independent Director and Chairman of the investment committee of the LIC Pension Fund Limited and Director at Repco Home Finance Limited. Subramaniakumar has received many accolades in the areas of Financial Inclusion, Technology, Retail and HR practices. He is a member of the IDRBT committee of smart card standards and of the IBA-IDRBT committee on Micro ATM and the FI standards. He is also a visiting faculty at multiple training institutes and RBI staff college. Subramaniakumar is a Physics graduate with a PGDCA (Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Application) degree. He has acquired CISA (Certified Information System Audit) & CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) certifications from ISACA, USA. A Banker with CAIIB (Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers), he also holds Advanced Banking Certificate from University of Maryland, USA.

name: Mr. Rahul Bhargava
title: Director, Avivate and Ambassador
bio: Rahul has 21+ years of techno-functional business leadership experience across global banks, payments fintechs, techfins, consulting firms, industry associations and international cooperatives like Swift. His areas of expertise range from retail, SME & wholesale banking to evolution of domestic & international payments, application of emerging forms of money and technologies (like gen AI) plus leading multi-market, public-private sector change initiatives. He is a recognised payments expert, trainer, facilitator and speaker at industry & regulatory forums like Sibos, SFF, World Bank GPW, CBPC, GPS, WEF and has authored thought leadership papers in areas like regional financial integration, CBDCs and emerging payments. His portfolio involves engagement globally with international bodies, innovation hubs/labs, central banks, payment market infrastructures (PMIs), banks, fintechs, vendors, partners & industry consultants. In terms of industry advisory roles, he is currently on the Board of Advisors and Singapore Chapter & Hub Lead for AI2030, a global think tank for Responsible AI, and an Ambassador for both Emerging Payments Association Asia (EPAA) & Currency Research, in addition to being a Director at Avivate, a payments & banking advisory firm based in Singapore. At SWIFT as a Global Payments Strategy Leader he has driven evolution of 117+ Domestic RTGS, ACHs and Instant Payment systems and their communities, delivered strategic multi-market payments initiatives including cross-border instant payments interlinking & interoperability, Swift integration with non-traditional ecosystems and upstream/downstream value chains (e.g. PSPs, CBDCs, Instant payments interlinking & interoperability, stablecoins, wallets, card ecosystems etc.) and payments innovation initiatives exploring new models & technologies (e.g. tokenisation, DLT, AI, cloud, open data, APIs etc.) Prior to SWIFT, he has held various regional portfolios with global banks, fintechs, consulting & payments firms, enabling business & digital transformation in financial and public sector markets in APAC, EMEA and N. America. He holds an MBA in Systems & Marketing.

name: Mr. Rahul Chari
title: Co-founder & CTO
bio: Rahul is the co-founder and CTO at PhonePe. He is a serial entrepreneur in the consumer internet space and has built PhonePe into one of India’s fastest growing and largest fintech companies. He comes with over two decades of experience in consumer internet and enterprise software space. He has strong experience in building world-class tech platforms for web-scale, continuously scaling systems to deal with hyper-growth and evolving the processes and practices to meet the demands of a fast-growing organization. His areas of expertise include digital payments & commerce platforms (Mobile payments, Fintech, Digital Media platforms, Websites/Mobile Apps, ECommerce Supply Chain Systems) and Embedded Systems, Enterprise S/W Development. Prior to PhonePe, Rahul was at Flipkart as Vice President of Engineering. He joined Flipkart in 2011 through the acquisition of Mallers Inc. He spearheaded the Supply Chain technology division at Flipkart. In his role, he was responsible for building the best-in-class supply chain management system for e-commerce covering order management, warehousing & transport management, and eCommerce fulfilment innovation to create value for customers at Flipkart. Prior to Flipkart, Rahul co-founded Mallers, Inc. in 2009 and served as its Chief Technology Officer. He built MIME360, the flagship product of Mallers Inc, which was a platform for the management and distribution of digital content to various legal online streaming sites and apps. Prior to Mallers Inc, Rahul was with the Data Center Business Unit at Cisco Systems. At Cisco Systems, he was part of the team that developed the market changing MDS 9000 family of SAN switches. He was leading a team working on advanced storage solutions for the SAN. He architected and executed the development of solutions such as SAN Based Data Migration and Extended SCSI Copy for the SAN. Rahul came into Cisco through the acquisition of Andiamo Systems, a Storage Area Network (SAN) switching, and SAN based storage services company. He is named on multiple Storage Virtualization related patents and has been actively involved in storage technologies and standards such as SCSI, Fibre Channel, iSCSI and RAID. Rahul holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science from Purdue University, USA and a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering from Bombay University (Gold Medallist).

name: Mr. Rahul Kothari
title: COO
bio: Rahul Kothari is the Chief Operating Officer at Razorpay. With over 21 years of experience in both consultancy and technology in leading companies, Rahul comes with a strategic and analytical mind that is geared towards delivering growth and agility for companies. As a COO at Razorpay, Rahul is focused on further building the company as a customer-centric organisation, providing a more integrated and seamless customer experience to various customer segments and businesses. His role entails guiding the company’s business strategies to achieve sustained and exponential revenue growth across all businesses and revenue lines, in India and Malaysia. His efforts are also dedicated to identifying new opportunities to enhance customer experience and amplify the efficiency and synergy of the internal systems, processes, and business structures. With an ability to approach business from a creative point of view, Rahul’s strength lies in building a highly inclusive work culture that ensures team members with an ecosystem conducive enough to create, build, and thrive and thus enhance employee productivity. He also leads initiatives to strengthen partnerships with external stakeholders, establishing Razorpay at the forefront of innovation in the continually expanding ecosystem. Before joining Razorpay, Rahul was the Chief Business Officer at PayU where he played a critical role in making their payments business profitable. He has also worked with leading global companies like WNS Global Services and The Boston Consulting Group, where he was instrumental in advising businesses across the US, Europe, Australia, and India on their business strategies. He has also had a successful tech career at Symantec where he was responsible for benchmarking and improving the performance of their products. Rahul holds an MBA in Finance and Marketing from the Indian School of Business. He has also completed his B.Tech from IIT Kanpur. When not at work, Rahul enjoys trekking and uses the time to meditate, introspect, read about physics, and spend quality time with family.

name: Mr. Rahul R Mutha
title: CEO
bio: Rahul Mutha is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Aurus, a leader in providing innovative payment solutions that are ranked among the top 5 payment orchestration platforms. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Aurus’ customers include Fortune 500 companies in Retail, Grocery, C-Stores and Restaurant Chains. Aurus’s origins go back to 2000 when it was founded by Rahul in his house garage with 2 employees. Today the company has scaled up to 800 employees. It has been a story of unprecedented growth, where Rahul’s vision to excel and the supportive leadership was the key to script the success story. Under Rahul’s leadership, Aurus has built AurusPay, a PCI PA-DSS and P2PE Certified payment processing platform integrated with the major payment processors in the United States and 20 countries around the world. Over the years Rahul invented and received several patents related to security and PCI scope reduction of POS systems and Fuel Dispensers, (Patent# 9424577, 9171304, 9135615, 8543461). AurusPay platform is installed across thousands of merchants in North America, South America and Europe. Rahul has earned his Graduation in Electronics Engineering from the University of Pune and a Masters in Electrical & Computer Engineering from the University of Massachusetts. Before founding Aurus, Rahul served as the principal consultant at Emergent (Datawarehouse Consulting Group), which was acquired by Keane Consulting (NTT Data). At Emergent, Rahul focused on performance tuning of large scale Datawarehouse systems and high-density computing platforms. As part of his Master's Research Program with NASA and JPL, Rahul has co-published an IEEE paper on ‘Modeling of semiconductor devices degradation in outer space’.

name: Mr. Rahul Rai
title: Partner
bio: Rahul is patner at Incofin India with foucs on private equity investments in financial services and agri food. Rahul is well versed in the Indian financial services and agri-food sectors, with over 18 years of private equity, corporate banking, structured financial and risk assurance experience. Rahul is an alumnus of the Harvard Business School, Boston and has completed the Private Equity Program at the Indian School of Business. He is also a member of Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds an undergraduate degree in economics with Honours from Hindu College, Delhi University.

name: Mr. Rahul Singhal
title: Director- Product
bio: Rahul leads the international payment & post payment product vertical in PayU. As a Product leader, he has led international payments business to over 3X GMV growth inFY'23. He has also led product development & launch of industry first 24*7 priority settlement, solving the working capital needs for the merchant. He has also built manycore platform products like ReconX, billing platform at PayU solving for end-to-end-payment needs for merchant. Prior to PayU, he has been associated with Infosys & Wipro.

name: Mr. Rahul Solanki
title: Senior Lead UPI Product Development
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )

name: Mr. Rai Rohit Prasad
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Rai Rohit Prasad is the Managing Director & CEO of Easebuzz. He brings a wealth of knowledge and experience to the field of digital payments with his experience in varied industries including banking and financial sector. Under his guidance, Easebuzz today has been Series A funded and is one of the largest payment aggregators in India supporting over 1,00,000+ merchants and has a team of over 350+ resources. He has worked with Tata Consultancy Services and Accenture before he became an entrepreneur himself. He was also part of another successful start-up within digital media marketing. His passion is to build a strong deep tech product-based company. Easebuzz was started with this passion since then he is heading all major functions within the organization.

name: Mr. Raj Narayanam
title: Founder & Executive Chairman
bio: Raj is a serial entrepreneur who has built and sold businesses in Financial Services, Retail, Internet, Merchandising, Reward & Recognition, Blockchain, Open Banking, Expense Management and Credit Cards. Raj is the Founder & Executive Chairman of Zaggle, an award-winning FinTech Company which helps companies digitize spends and automate payment processes. Raj recently celebrated one of his biggest professional milestones with the launch of Zaggle’s IPO. The IPO was subscribed 13 times, and the stock price has given handsome returns to the Investors. Raj is also an active Angel Investor, Mentor, and a supporter of the Startup Ecosystem. He has invested in over 47 companies either in his personal capacity or through AIF’s. He has also published a book ‘Made in Hyderabad’ covering the stories of 25 Entrepreneurs from Hyderabad. It was launched by the IT Minister Shri K T Rama Rao and has sold over 10,000 copies. He is onto his next book, titled ‘Glorious Women of Hyderabad’ which will soon be published. Raj was named as the ‘Fintech Leader of the Year’ 2024-2025, by Business World. He was named as one of Top 50 Indian Digital Finance Influencer 2024. He won the Pride of Telangana Award, won the Entrepreneur Excellence Award by the state of Telangana, Accelerator T-Hub. He has been named as one of the Richest Indians in the IIFL Hurun’s Rich Test 2023. He was recently featured by Forbes India in the story of Zaggle: Steady, Heady, Growth. He was awarded the Most Promising Businessperson in Asia by Economic Times. He has been featured on CNBC, ET Now and many other Business Channels, he has also been featured in CNBC Young Turks and won the Entrepreneur of the Year Award. Raj has a B. A in Economics from Delhi University and a PGDBA from prestigious FORE School of Management. He went on to do another MBA from Stern School of Management and was picked up by Price Waterhouse in their consulting practice even before completing his MBA. His interests lie in Angel Investing, Startup Mentoring, Cricket, Golf, Badminton, Growing Organic Vegetables and Building Startup Ecosystem. Raj’s story is one of GRIT, DEDICATION, PERSEVERANCE and HARD WORK."

name: Mr. Raja Debnath
title: Managing Director
bio: Raja Debnath is a global expert and growth hacker for MSME and Retail Banking, having advised over 40 financial institutions and Fintechs internationally in the areas of Digital Transformation, Supply Chain Finance, Data Analytics and Non-Financial services. With over 20+ years of experience, Raja holds various leadership and advisory roles across the financial ecosystem. With his wealth of knowledge in SCF, Raja founded Veefin Solutions Limited (Veefin) in 2018 with a mission to build the #1 Global Supply Chain Technology platform. The start-up builds white labelled Supply Chain Finance (SCF) technology for Banks, Financial Institutions, Fintechs, B2B marketplaces, and corporates. As a strategic advisor to the board of the National Urban Cooperative Finance and Development Corporation, an umbrella organization for Urban Cooperative Banks (UCBs), he is currently spearheading the digital transformation of 1500+ UCBS across India. NUCFDC's vision is to transform UCBs and deepen financial and banking services access at the grassroots in the urban and semi-urban markets. Raja is also the managing partner at Cogence Labs, a global management consultant focused on advising Microfinance, Retail and SME Banking clients. Previously, Raja has served as Global Advisory and Business Development Expert for Supply Chain Finance (SCF) & SME Banking in Asia for IFC, a World Bank Group organization & advised over 25+ lenders globally. Raja has also led IFC's SCF advisory multi bank programs in emerging geographies - Bangladesh, Vietnam, Oman, Jordan, Saudi Arabia & Sri Lanka. Additionally, he has initiated & built Small Business Unsecured Lending vertical at Kotak Mahindra Bank. He is a Marshall Goldsmith certified Performance Coach, and an investor and mentor to multiple Fintechs. He is an MBA graduate from Sa√Ød Business School, Oxford and JBIMS Mumbai. Raja has certifications in MENSA ‚Äì a global High-IQ non-profit.

name: Mr. Rajat Gandhi
title: CEO & Founder
bio: Rajat Gandhi, CEO of Faircent, heads India's largest P2P lending platform. With over 25 years of experience in online domains, he pioneered online P2P lending in India. Under his leadership, Faircent has become the leading NBFC-P2P platform. Rajat founded Faircent.com in 2013, championing tech-driven solutions and prudent regulations, establishing it as India's first RBI-certified NBFC-P2P. Faircent promotes financial inclusion by offering affordable loans to SME/MSME sectors and modern investment opportunities. Rajat, an MBA graduate, has spearheaded the launch and development of various online platforms and communities, including ventures in e-commerce, classifieds, and digital advertising for prominent organizations in the country. A passionate traveller, he enjoys spending leisure time with family and friends. His leadership drives Faircent's growth, focusing on innovation and financial empowerment.

name: Mr. Rajat Mehta
title: COO-PMS
bio: Rajat Mehta is part of Mehta Group, a financial services company into Broking, Investment Banking, Wealth and Asset Management Company. He is 1. Principal Officer & COO - Mehta Equities PMS (MMFS) 2. Principal Officer & CIO - Stargazer Fund 1 (Mehta Alternate Investment Fund) 3. Chairman JITO Incubation & Innovation Foundation (JIIF) JITO Angel Network 4. Co-Founder & Director - Abhiyan Capital 5. Investment Committee - Sistema Asia Fund India Ventures He has been an Angel investor since 2015 in companies like Groww, BluSmart, GetVantage, Creditwise Capital, Capital Setu, Orbit Farming.

name: Mr. Rajdeep Saha
title: Partner
bio: I am part of PwC Financial Services consulting practice and focus on organization transformation and growth charter, leveraging digital and technology enablers. In my 20+ years in the banking and consulting realm, I have partnered with multiple client's in the transformation journey with clear growth, efficiency and governance outcomes. I have extensively collaborated with ecosystem partners (Fintech's and similar) to build embedded platforms, identify new revenue pools or unlock efficiency in the value chain. The MSME segment (and pursuant digitization or the lack of it) is an area of great interest to me, and I will also be launching a PoV in GFF. I am keen to connect with the various participant's and exchange ideas, gain insights and learn new hacks!

name: Mr. Rajeev Ahuja
title: Executive Director
bio: Rajeev Ahuja is the Executive Director of RBL Bank and has over 30 years of experience in the financial services industry. He has been an integral part of the organisation's transformation journey and is responsible for building the overall strategy of the Bank while managing the Retail Banking and Financial Inclusion businesses of the Bank. He is also responsible for the Bank's capital raising, development of new businesses, partnerships and investor relations functions. In the course of his career, Rajeev has held key positions in investment banking and financial markets. Prior to joining RBL Bank, he was heading the investor sales business (South Asia) with Citigroup, India. He also had a long stint in the capital markets and investment banking divisions of Deutsche Bank in Asia. Rajeev holds a master's in business administration from IIM, Ahmedabad and a bachelor's degree in commerce from the University of Delhi.

name: Mr. Rajeev Ranjan
title: Co-Founder
bio: Rajeev Ranjan is the co-founder of Equal (www.equal.in), a leading digital identity and verification firm. Equal is a consent-first and privacy-focused platform, for Indian enterprises to securely, compliantly and seamlessly manage IDs and personal records of their most important stakeholders. It is built in partnership with India Stack (advanced digital public infrastructure) and is compliant with India’s data protection laws. 30 of India’s top 100 companies and over ~1million users already using Equal. Rajeev is a seasoned technical leader with 15+ years of industry experience, adept in conceptualizing, building, leading, and managing software development teams that are innovative initiators, focused and have delivered enterprise wide technology solutions aligned with the business goals. Prior to Equal, Rajeev served as Director of Engineering at Swiggy, overseeing revenue and growth across various categories. He also spent close to a decade at Amazon ascending to the role of Senior Tech Leader and serving as a Technical Advisor to the CTO – India Payments. During his tenure, Rajeev spearheaded the Amazon Retail Core Security platform, prioritizing the privacy and end-to-end security of customer data. Additionally, he managed the core team responsible for building and executing RBI compliant payment platform, popularly known as Amazon Pay and Amazon Gift Card. Rajeev holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science from the esteemed institute of BIT Mesra.

name: Mr. Rajesh Bansal
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr. Rajesh Bansal is the CEO of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) - a wholly-owned subsidiary of theReserve Bank of India (RBI) that was set up to promote innovation in the financial sector. He has more than threedecades of experience across digital financial services and infrastructure in Asia and Africa, and has been a keyarchitect in India s journey towards a cash-lite economy, playing a crucial role in the creation and design of Aadhaar,Direct Benefits Transfer, and IndiaStack.

name: Mr. Rajesh Desai
title: Founder & CEO Lyra India
bio: Introducing Mr. Rajesh Desai, an optimist with unwavering persistence and a visionary leader. Rajesh made a life-changing decision when he took on the challenge of founding Lyra India from the ground up, to establish the company as a major player in the digital payments industry. With over 30 years of experience and field expertise, Rajesh is a results-driven and value-oriented leader. He has a proven track record of building, nurturing, and leading high-performance teams while passionately driving innovation to achieve significant growth and profitability. Rajesh has reached remarkable heights of success throughout his career, earning prestigious accolades such as Global Indian of the Year, Top 10 CEOs of Digital India, Most Admired Professional, and Top 10 Corporate Creative Leaders. He has also made our country proud by expanding the reach of UPI beyond Indian borders, bringing it to France in Europe. Rajesh Desai's leadership and achievements continue to inspire and set new benchmarks in the digital payment industry.

name: Mr. Rajesh Dhuddu
title: Partner Emerging Tech
bio: Rajesh Dhuddu is a prominent figure in the field of emerging technologies, particularly known for his work in blockchain, metaverse and cybersecurity. He currently serves as the Partner ‚Äì Emerging Tech at PwC, responsible for shaping the thought leadership of the firm in Emerging Technologies & Go To The Market. Prior to joining PwC, he was SVP and Global Head of Emerging Tech Practice at TechMahindra. In that role, he was responsible for leading initiatives in blockchain technology, cybersecurity & the metaverse, focusing on creating business use cases and ecosystems around these technologies. At Tech Mahindra, he has been instrumental in several key projects, including the implementation of blockchain solutions to combat spam calls and texts in India, in collaboration with the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) and major telecom operators‚Äã. Before joining Tech Mahindra, Dhuddu founded a payment processing company at Quatrro (promoted by Serial Entrepreneur Raman Roy) that integrated with major financial networks like Mastercard and Visa. This venture marked the beginning of his deep involvement in the fintech and blockchain space‚Äã. Dhuddu has been recognized globally for his contributions to Emerging Technology. Heis listed among the top 100 blockchain influencers by Lattice80 and has been part of the World Economic Forum‚Äôs Expert Network on both cybersecurity and blockchain‚Äã‚Äã. He has been awarded Most Inspiring Web 3 leader, Top 200Technology Leaders in Asia and featured 3 times in a row in Forbes Blockchain 50companies. Additionally, he plays a significant role in industry groups and educational institutions as a steering committee member.

name: Mr. Rajesh Londhe
title: Co-Founder & Head - Payments
bio: Rajesh Londhe is the Co-Founder and Head - Payments at Phi Commerce, India's top payment aggregator. He holds a B.E. in Computer Engineering from Pune University and boasts an impressive 21+ years of experience in implementing retail payment systems. Starting as a banker at Allahabad Bank, Rajesh advanced his career with roles at Euronet Worldwide and ElectraCard Services. Notably, his leadership at Euronet included overseeing global delivery for Standard Chartered Bank. Rajesh's banking background has been instrumental in establishing streamlined operational and settlement teams at Phi ommerce, showcasing his knack for efficiency.

name: Mr. Rajit Bhattacharya
title: Founder & Chief Executive Officer
bio: As Co-Founder & CEO, Data Sutram, Rajit epitomises the transformative power of data science. Inspired by data's potential, he began creating data-driven solutions at 19. Rajit shares Elon Musk's mindset, believing in AI's impact. With Data Sutram's DS Authenticate, he aims to build top anti-fraud solutions, safeguarding businesses against frauds. Recognised under Forbes' 30 Under 30 in Enterprise Technology, Rajit's dedication fuels his quest to revolutionise industries through data.

name: Mr. Rajiv Anand
title: Deputy Managing Director
bio: Rajiv Anand, 58, with an illustrious career spanning more than 35 years, has focused on various facets of the financial services industry. Having held key management positions at leading global financial institutions, he is widely recognized for his strengths in capital markets and for successfully building new businesses to scale. Rajiv joined Axis Asset Management Co. Ltd. in 2009 as its founding Managing Director & CEO, building a robust business model and team in a short span of time. In his next assignment, he was appointed as the President of Retail Banking at Axis Bank, where he spearheaded the business with his sharp acumen leading to the achievement of several key milestones during this five-year stint. Subsequently, he was inducted into the Board of the Bank. He also took over as the Head of Wholesale Banking to steer the business ahead, ensuring growth profitability and sustainability. Currently, he is the Deputy Managing Director of the Bank, leading some of the most critical functions in the Bank, including Wholesale Banking and Digital Banking, along with support functions like Marketing and Corporate Communications. Rajiv is also a member of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee, Committee of Directors, Stakeholders Relationship Committee, and the Committee of Whole Time Directors within the Bank. In addition, he serves on the National Committee of Banking at the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), and has been appointed as Senior Vice President at the Bombay Chamber of Commerce & Industry (BCCI). He holds a degree in Commerce and is a qualified Chartered Accountant.

name: Mr. Rajiv Madane
title: Ambassador
bio: Rajiv has been involved in the Banking, Payments and FinTech ecosystems globally for over 30 years and has created the world’s first touch screen treasury solution. He has held leadership positions in companies like FIS Global, Wipro Technologies, ACI Worldwide, Tata Infotech, Fiserv, and Virtusa. He has helped these companies grow their business with innovative tech solutions for the banking industry in core banking, digital banking, cards, payments, treasury and trade areas. Rajiv was involved in the launch of the APIX platform from Monetary Authority of Singapore, which is the world’s first online collaboration platform between Banks and FinTechs.

name: Mr. Rakesh Singh
title: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

name: Mr. Rama Mohan Rao Amara
title: DMD & CRO
bio: Mr. Rama Mohan Rao Amara is currently CRO in State Bank of India (SBI ) and was also the MD & CEO of SBI Card, a pureplay credit card company, for two and half years, where he steered the company successfully and improved the financial and risk profile of the company. He amassed international experience while handling key assignments for SBI in markets like, Singapore and US. During his stint as CEO at SBI (California), he turned it around and made the operations profitable with significant improvement in risk profile. He has been a part of SBI, India’s oldest and largest banking group, for three decades and handled several key assignments, across India and aboard.

name: Mr. Ramakrishnan Gopalan
title: Vice President & Head of Products, India & South Asia
bio: Ramakrishnan Gopalan is the Vice President, Head of Products & Solutions for India and South Asia. In this role, he leads the product team in developing the strategy and the long-term design for the growth of Visaâ€™s product propositions in the region, including India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan and Maldives.

name: Mr. Ramesh Lakshminarayanan
title: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
bio: Mr. Ramesh Lakshminarayanan is Group Head - Information Technology and Chief Information Officer (CIO) at HDFC Bank. Mr. Lakshminarayanan is responsible for taking the Bank's technological transformation journey to the next level. He leads the entire IT and Digital function of the Bank to unify all the technology and digital developments and create a more holistic core and customer experience layer. His role cuts across verticals at the Bank. He is responsible for technology strategy, strengthening foundational technology, enhancing the digital capabilities and harnessing new age AI/ML technology solutions for the bank. Mr. Lakshminarayanan joined the Bank from CRISIL, where he spent 3 years as Chief Technology and Information Officer. In this role, he was responsible for the transformation of CRISIL businesses by leveraging technology, data and analytics. Prior to this, he co-founded a big data and analytics start-up - Pragmatix Services Pvt Ltd which was acquired by CRISIL in 2017. An industry veteran with over 25 years of experience, Mr. Lakshminarayanan has held leadership positions with organizations such as Citibank, ABN AMRO Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Group. He has also completed a Business Leadership Course from IIM, Ahmedabad & a Strategic Agility Leadership Course from Harvard Business School. With nearly three decades of stellar experience, Mr. Kesh has a track record of leading complex operations including transformation, automation, customer experience, quality improvement & other related functions. He is a hands-on leader who has helped scale and address operational challenges with ease consistently at reputed banking organizations in India namely ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Yes Bank & Axis Bank.

name: Mr. Ravi Kaushik

bio: I lead Flourish Ventures' investment and portfolio in India and Emerging Asia. Looking to partner with the best fintech founders in the region. If you are building in fintech, do reach out. With presence in five geographies and over 250 employees, we aim to transform the way farmers and buyers connect, trade and grow. I have more than 15 years of professional experience in operating businesses and in full cycle investing across venture capital and private equity. I was previously the Founding Member and General Partner at WaterBridge Ventures, as early stage VC with ~$200M in AUM where I invested in sectors such as edtech, fintech, consumer, heathtech, B2B, and marketplaces. Prior to that, I was a growth PE investor where I invested $10-$35M in high-quality growth stage companies across sectors such as financial services, healthcare, education, renewable energy, and manufacturing. I delivered >5X returns to my investors through IPO and M&A exits. I am currently an active global angel investor.

He has played a key role in establishing the customer centricity practice at HDFC Bank by setting up the NPS system across the Bank. He has also worked with Reliance Communications, ICICI Bank and PowerGen in leadership roles, spanning across Strategy, M&A and Business. He was the only CMO from India to be featured in the top 50 list of Forbes 'The World's Most Influential CMOs 2020'. name: Mr. Ravi Shankar

He’s currently the Vice President for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector at Gupshup, the global pioneer in conversational engagement. Ravi’s deep industry knowledge and penchant for innovation is the driving force behind Conversational Engagement led transformation at leading banks and financial institutions.

name: Mr. Ray Harishankar

bio: Ray Harishankar is an IBM Fellow within the Quantum team focused on Quantum Safe. Ray leads the business and technical strategy for IBM Quantum Safe, drives the quantum safe product strategy and product engineering. Ray leverages his deep technical expertise, the broad set of capabilities that IBM has in broader security services and post quantum cryptography and pragmatically applies it to benefit clients. Ray also advocates IBM capabilities and leadership in Quantum Safe with its industry clients. Given his extensive client experience, Ray functions as a mentor for the IBM Quantum Safe delivery team. Ray is actively engaged with customers across multiple industries and with a focus on Banking, Insurance, Tele Communications and Government. Ray is often sought after for providing his perspectives on simplifying complex architectures, pragmatic application of leading-edge technologies and innovative methods and approaches. Ray is on the technology advisory council for selected customers and universities and provides guidance on technology decisions. Ray has been with IBM since 1999. He was nominated as a Distinguished Engineer in 2003 and as an IBM Fellow in 2006. Appointment to IBM Fellow is the highest honor that an employee can receive for technical innovation. Ray is also a member of IBM Academy of Technology. In 2009 Ray was named an Asian American Engineer of the Year. In October 2013, Ray was honored with a Distinguished Alumnus award by the Ohio State University College of Engineering. Ray holds 23 patents and has filed several more.

name: Mr. Reuben Lim
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Reuben is Chief Executive Officer at Singapore FinTech Association (SFA). He leads the secretariat and works with the executive committee to spearhead initiatives that strengthen the FinTech ecosystem in Singapore. With over 18 years of experience in business development and management, Reuben has empowered both large enterprises, SMEs and government agencies in uncovering valuable revenue and growth opportunities through active business partnering and strong leadership.

name: Mr. Ripunjai Gaur

bio: With a distinguished career spanning over 18 years, Ripunjai Gaur serves as the Chief Business Officer for Offline Payments at Paytm. He leads the largest offline payments platform in India, serving over 40 million merchants across various sectors and geographies. Ripunjai has been instrumental in expanding Paytm's offline merchant business from the ground up, spearheading various teams such as Sound Box, EDC, and cash voucher business, significantly increasing the user base. His expertise includes designing and developing full-stack payments and financial solutions for the merchant business, managing the P&L, enhancing operational efficiency, fostering partnerships, and optimizing the merchant lifecycle for cross-selling opportunities. A financial services veteran, Ripunjai is deeply passionate about financial inclusion and firmly believes that digital payments will transform the way people live and work.

name: Mr. Rishi Gupta

bio: Rishi Gupta is the Managing Director and CEO of Fino Payments Bank. He led the bank to profitability within three years of its launch in 2017. He played a pivotal role in Fino becoming the first payments bank to be listed on the Indian stock exchanges in November 2021. He is actively involved in the industry and is a leading voice in the payments bank as well as financial inclusion space. As a founding member of Fino Paytech, the parent company of Fino Payments Bank, Rishi brings valuable experience to his role.

Ronit is an advisor to a leading business school, technology and VC firms based in the U.K., Middle East, Africa and Asia. Prior to joining Citi, Ronit worked for a former UK Prime Minister. Ronit's new book Future Money was published in March.

Retail and Mass Banking, Financial Literacy, Inclusion and Onboarding, Remittance and Cross Border Payments, Digital and Alternate Delivery Channels, Payments and FinTech, Product and Innovation, Retail Lending, Digital Lending, Customer Experience, Business Process Reengineering, Customer Journey Reimagination, Retail Capital Markets, Systems Onboarding and Projects Management. name: Mr. Sangram Singh
title: CEO
bio: Sangram is a financial services professional with over two decades of experience. Prior to joining Indifi as CEO, he was the President & Head of the Commercial Banking Group at Axis Bank. He has also been the head of the Cards & Payments business inAxis Bank and the MD & CEO at Freecharge, a fintech subsidiary of Axis Bank. His earlier experience spans almost a decade at Citibank India and before that, at GE Capital India. Sangram is an alumnus of IIM Calcutta from the class of 1999.

name: Mr. Sanjay Kumar Das
title: ADDITIONAL SECRETARY, STATE INFORMATION SECURITY OFFICER & MD, WEBEL
org: Department Of Information Technology & Electronics, Government Of West Bengal
bio: A bureaucrat from West Bengal with extensive experience in policy framing, project ideation to execution and leading the State in emerging technology adoption. Having done masters in Physics, Management and Law along with specialisation & certifications in cyber strategy, cyber law & cyber forensics, training & development and IPR among others; he is now the Additional Secretary in IT&E Dept, State Information Security Officer & Managing Director, WEBEL. He topped the first National Cyber Security Scholar Programme with Honours in 2020. Led the State to win numerous national laurels for Karmobhumi, the State IT/ITeS Skill Registry, Anumati, the State Single Window Portal for ROW Clearance; Cyber Assurance Programme - State Level Security Resilience for Public ICT Infrastructure among others. Chosen Eminent CIO of India by VAR thrice since 2021 besides winning various accolades down the years of his administrative journey.

name: Mr. Sanjay Tripathy
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Sanjay Tripathy has more than 30 years of experience across geographies, industries and functions, with illustrious names like HDFC Life, Mattel, Pepsi, Reliance and Amul behind him. He has been a part of leadership teams managing strategy, marketing, products, Ecommerce and core business functions across these organisation. He is also a board member of Invesco Mutual Fund. Sanjay is an alumnus of Stanford Business School, Institute of Rural Management (Anand) & Odisha University of Agriculture & Technology. Currently, he is the Co-founder & CEO of BRISKPE.

name: Mr. Sanjeev Moghe
title: President & Head - Cards and Payments
bio: Sanjeev has been with Axis bank since March 2018. He comes with extensive experience in the Cards & Payments domain spanning across two decades in multiple locations & across product, sales strategy & management. Sanjeev earlier was with Citibank as Director & Head - Sales Strategy & management for Cards & Personal Loans business. He joins us from Bajaj Finance Limited where he was the Business Head - EMI Cards. Sanjeev is a post-graduate from IIM - Calcutta and an engineer from IIT Bombay.

name: Mr. Sanjib Subba
title: Founder Chair Fintech Alliance Nepal
bio: Kathmandu based Financial Inclusion professional with proven track record in Banking, Fintech, Green Finance amongst others.

name: Mr. Sanjiv Singhal
title: Founder and COO
bio: Sanjiv Singhal is the Founder and Chief Operating Officer of Scripbox. With a passionate focus on user experience, Sanjiv has been instrumental in conceiving and building the Scripbox App, which has become a leading digital mutual fund investing solution in India. With over 30 years of experience at the intersection of finance and technology, Sanjiv has a deep understanding of how technology and behavioral finance can be combined to deliver better personal finance outcomes for consumers. His expertise spans wealth management, retail banking, and internet payment systems, with significant contributions to financial institutions in India, UK, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Japan. Before founding Scripbox, Sanjiv held leadership positions at renowned financial institutions such as Citibank, ABN AMRO Bank, and Kotak Mahindra, as well as technology pioneers like CyberCash. He served as the Senior Vice President at Polaris Software/Orbitech (Citigroup), Director at Herald Logic, and Owner of Strategis.in, a consulting firm specializing in strategy and technology solutions for financial services. Sanjiv's educational background includes an MBA in Finance and Marketing from the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore and a B Tech in Mechanical Engineering from the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra. Sanjiv's visionary leadership and extensive experience make him a pivotal figure in the financial technology sector, continuously driving innovation and enhancing user experience in personal finance management.

name: Mr. Sanket Deodhar
title: Vice President and Head of Digital Natives
bio: Sanket is the Vice president and Head of Digital Natives at SAP India, focusing on innovation, customer-centricity, and building long-term strategic partnerships with customers. With a renewed focus on India's vibrant Startup ecosystem, Sanket is responsible for the relationship and business with the startup ecosystem in India. With over 20 years of experience in the IT industry, Sanket has held several leadership roles managing high-performing teams in enterprise sales. He began his career in Business development practice with a system integrator, where he identified his passion for helping organizations improve business outcomes through technology. He also spent more than six years at HPE and then moved to SAP. Sanket joined SAP in 2012, where he managed complex and transformational engagements for large enterprise customers and later assumed the role as Global Account Director for SAP India, a part of the strategic customer program focusing on deep engagements with large conglomerates in India. While Sanket has done many leadership roles in SAP managing the enterprise business, he now leads a team of dynamic individuals to build and manage customer relationships for the enterprise business. He is responsible for ensuring value creation for clients and making strategic engagements to fuel growth for the business unit. Sanket excels at helping customers understand the business value of technology investments, supporting them through digital transformations, developing long-term strategic partnerships, and helping them drive the execution of their vision.

name: Mr. Sanket Pradhan
title: Senior Vice President
bio: Sanket Pradhan, based in Mumbai, is a Senior Vice President at HDFC Bank, bringing experience from previous roles at HDFC Bank and NSE Infotech Services Limited. Sanket Pradhan holds an IIM Ahmedabad alumni and is a technology geek, skilled in solutions architecture, SDLC and software project management.

name: Mr. Sanket Sarkar
title: Founder
bio: Introducing Mr. Sanket Sarkar, the visionary Founder of Zeron, whose journey from high school hacking to crafting groundbreaking strategies defines innovation in the digital era. Fueled by an unwavering passion, he is at the forefront of establishing India's inaugural CRQ Consortium. As the driving force behind Zeron's revolutionary cyber risk posture management platform, Sanket redefines how organizations approach cybersecurity challenges. His remarkable journey boasts prestigious certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor and MTA from Microsoft. Moreover, Mr. Sarkar holds distinguished certifications, including Certified Professional in Cybersecurity: Managing Risk in the Information Age from Harvard University and Professional in Entrepreneurship/Entrepreneurial Studies from Wharton Online, reflecting his profound expertise in both entrepreneurship and cybersecurity.

name: Mr. Santosh Kumar
title: Director
bio: Santosh Kumar is the Director, Innovation at SPJIMR WISE Tech enabling the Fintech entrepreneurship through the flagship FinNovate Accelerator program. Prior to this he was the Innovation Head at Citi India Markets. As a serial entrepreneur, he built 3 ventures with 2 exits. As an International Innovation Awardee, Santosh has received investments from Govt of Chile and Govt of India.

name: Mr. Saravanan Nattanmai
title: Partner
bio: Saravanan Nattanmai is the Partner for Financial Services Sector at Premji Invest. PI is investment office sponsored by Mr. Azim Premji, Chairman of Wipro Limited. Saravanan is a seasoned private equity professional with 18+ years of experience in private equity across sectors / stages and Corporate Strategy and Planning and has held leadership positions and been on the boards of regulated companies with best-in-class corporate governance in India. Currently, he leads investments in the financial services sector (traditional and new age) at PI across key areas of focus including insurance, lending, wealth management, payments, and banking infra. Previously, he worked with AION Capital (JV between Apollo Global Management and ICICI Bank) and Nereus Capital and has led investments in diverse sectors including financial services, consumer/retail, technology, and industrials. Saravanan began his career at GE in 2005. During his tenure at GE, he is credited for acting as catalyst for ideating and implementing innovative technologies with high degree of potential for disruption. Saravanan has done his Masters in Technology from IIT Bombay and PGM from Indian School of Business, Hyderabad. He has several technology patents to his credit and is an avid follower of the theory of inventive problem solving and disruptive technology trends.

name: Mr. Sarbvir Singh
title: Joint Group CEO
bio: Sarbvir has over 25 years of global experience across corporate leadership roles. Currently, he is the CEO of Policybazaar.com, India’s leading insurtech platform and Joint Group CEO of the PB Fintech Group. Prior to joining Policybazaar, he was a venture capitalist and served in senior leadership positions with digital and media companies. He was most recently the Managing Partner of WaterBridge Ventures, a leading early-stage venture fund. He had also held leadership positions with JP Morgan and Network18 in India, Citi in New York and Emerson Electric in Hong Kong. Sarbvir is a graduate of IIT Delhi and holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Sashank Rishyasringa
title: Co-founder and Managing Director
bio: Sashank Rishyasringa co-founded axio (formerly Capital Float) in 2013. Under his direction, the company has grown to become India's leading digital finance company. With him as Managing Director, the company has pioneered technological innovations which have altered the digital lending landscape in the country. Before co-founding axio, Sashank was a Senior Engagement Manager at McKinsey & Company, where he advised several Fortune 500 companies, national governments, and non-profits on business strategy, product innovation, and organizational design. He possesses an extensive understanding of the global Fintech space and has prior experience in investments, financial inclusion and mobile technology from his time at McKinsey. Sashank holds an MBA from Stanford University and graduated Magna Cum Laude from Princeton University specializing in Economics and Finance.

name: Mr. Sasidhar Thumuluri
title: MD & CEO
bio: Sasi has over two decades of experience in financial inclusion and capital markets in 20+ countries. He started his career at BASIX Social Enterprise Group where he was instrumental in designing and executing various innovative programs in microfinance and rural livelihoods. Previously, at International Financial Corporation, he led agri, housing and SME finance advisory verticals for South Asia. Prior to IFC, Sasi was with Habitat for Humanity International in Washington DC, where he successfully spearheaded the pioneering work of structuring Microbuild, a global fund for microhousing finance and helped realign business strategies of various country programs. Earlier, at Microvest Capital Management in Bethesda MD, he had built and managed a large impact investment portfolio in Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa and Eastern Europe. He currently runs Sub-K, an inclusion focused Indian fintech. Sasi serves on the board in Business Correspondents Federation of India, board of advisors for Center for Analytical Financial of Indian School of Business. He was a member of B20 Task Force on Financial Inclusion under India G20 Presidency and currently a member of Financial Infrastructure Task Force under Brazil Presidency.

name: Mr. Satish Mohan
title: Founder & CTO
bio: Satish Mohan is a recognized leader with over 25 years of experience driving technology innovation and organizational transformation. As the Founder & CEO of Dhiway, he is at the forefront of developing Open Trust Infrastructure, creating secure, scalable solutions for the digital age. Satish also plays a pivotal role in advancing privacy-respecting digital IDs through his leadership in the MOSIP Technology Committee. MOSIP empowers governments to implement cost-effective, scalable, and secure foundational ID systems, leveraging open-source best. During his impactful tenure at Red Hat, Satish led the creation of cutting-edge open hybrid and multi-cloud storage solutions, including OpenShift Container Storage and Red Hat Gluster Storage. He was also the driving force behind strategic initiatives across Enterprise Linux and Hyper-Convergence, significantly enhancing business outcomes. As a founding member of Red Hatâ€™s India R&D organization, Satish built a collaborative hub of innovation, aligning it with the companyâ€™s global vision. His expertise extends to scaling R&D teams, making strategic acquisitions, and launching successful product lines. An active advocate of open-source collaboration, Satish continues to influence the technology landscape, focusing on innovation, scalability, and customer-driven solutions.

name: Mr. Satyadarshi Behera
title: Head of Data Science
bio: Satyadarshi Behera is a Data Science Leader with 17+ years of experience in leveraging data science and machine learning to deliver value in domains such as fintech, e-commerce and logistics. Currently he leads the data science and machine learning teams at CRED. In his role at CRED he collaborates with multiple teams across personalisation, NLP, risk assessment and elevating customer experience. Prior to CRED, he played pivotal roles leading transformative initiatives and nurturing high-performance ML teams at companies such as Amazon, Media.net, Rivigo and Star India. He has a masters in statistics degree of Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata.

name: Mr. Satyam Kumar
title: CEO and Co-founder
bio: Mr Satyam spearheads Business, Liabilities and Relationship initiatives at LoanTap, in addition to guiding a highly talented team to common objectives. Satyam is a banking industry veteran with enriched experience of more than 20 years. Before founding LoanTap, he was National Head -Mortgages, at IndusInd Bank. His constant drive & team management skills resulted in a loan book of more than Rs. 5,000 crores in LAP in his last assignment. Prior to that he held multiple positions in Product, Business and Credit at ICICI Bank, including Regional Head - Mortgage in ICICI Bank. Satyam was pivotal to launching the Sanction Guarantee Scheme in the Indian Lending ecosystem, the earliest experiment to this effect was run for Corporate Channel Customers at ICICI Bank, Pune and since then extended across Indian and also accepted by competition as means of service differentiation. Satyam built the initial innings of his career at ICI India Ltd and spent a short stint with Deutsche PostBank Home Finance. Satyam also guides an NGO, Purn-Kuti, for setting up an e-school and women livelihood support initiatives in rural areas. Apart from work, he can also be seen engaging himself in Adventure Sports and has successfully completed certification courses in paragliding, rafting, and skiing.

name: Mr. Saugata Chatterjee
title: Chief Business Officer
org: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd.
bio: Saugata Chatterjee holds a Bachelor of Engineering and an MBA in Finance from Mumbai University. Over 30 years in the financial services industry. Extensive experience in building and leading pan India sales team. As Chief Business Officer – Sales & Distribution, he leads and inspires 600-member strong sales team. Pioneered and scaled the SME & HNI segment. Dedicated to continuous learning and inspiring other.

name: Mr. Saurabh Drolia
title: Director of Product Manager
bio: Saurabh Drolia is responsible for the Google Pay India consumer payment experience. He leads the reliability, risk management and UPI initiatives. He is based out of Googleâ€™s Bangalore office. Prior to joining Google, Saurabh was the product leader at Microsoft across Seattle, Hyderabad Bangalore. He has led and worked on several teams across the company - Microsoft Teams, Skype Lite, Bing, MSN and Enterprise Health Care. In between his Microsoft journey, he was in the start-up world for a couple of years. Saurabh holds B.S and M.A degrees in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Austin. During his Masters, he was a Research Assistant working on a next generation processor as part of a TRIPS team.

name: Mr. Saurabh Jain
title: Co-Founder
bio: At Stable Money, we are developing an investment platform that helps you grow your money in the most secure way possible. We comprehend the importance of hard-earned funds, and our approach does not involve pursuing current trends or following waves of FOMO. Rather, we invest in the most reliable instruments to ensure that our clients can sleep soundly at night.

name: Mr. Saurabh Joshi
title: Partner
bio: Partner In the Financial Services Practice at EY. Lead the Wealth and Asset Management Issues for the firm and specializes in Target Operating Model, Customer experience, Digital transformation.

name: Mr. Saurabh Kumar
title: Director- Product
bio: Saurabh is Director Product at PayU. He comes with 14 years of experience from global firms like Goldman Sachs, Unilever, KPMG and Uber. Where he has led multiple consulting programs , established best-practice frameworks, build customer experience platforms that are robust , scalable and have an ecosystem adoption. He brings that value in his current role as he leads merchant experience, partnership programs for value-added payment services and brings service excellence through Risk-related product suites to ensure the merchants and end consumers of PayU are safeguarded against frauds.

name: Mr. Saurabh Mishra
title: Executive Director
bio: Saurabh is an investor and portfolio advisor on the Emerging Markets Equity team focusing on the India Equity strategy. He joined Morgan Stanley in 2018 and has 14 years of investment experience. Prior to joining the firm, Saurabh worked for Ola as part of the Corporate Development team responsible for M&A, investments and leading key strategic negotiations. Previously, he worked as an equity research analyst in India at Barclays and Credit Suisse, respectively. He was also a consultant in India at the Boston Consulting Group. He received an M.B.A. from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, and his B. Tech. degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur.

name: Mr. Saurabh Singhal
title: Chief Commercial Officer & Chief Fintech Officer
bio: Saurabh is the Chief Commercial Officer and Chief Fintech Officer at GIFT city, the first operational smart city, and International financial services center. He was in Singapore for the last 11 years where he was in marketing leadership roles. His last job was as Group Head of Marketing for DBS Institutional Banking Group. Over his career, he has been passionately building high-performance teams, pushing the B2B marketing agenda, and bringing the science and art of marketing together through MarTech.
