Previous to his banking experience he worked in the Tech industry l - both consumer tech and high tech with brands like Cisco, Microsoft, Jabra, Juniper Networks, etc. he is also passionate about grooming young marketers and actively mentors business grads, startup founders and mid-career women leaders. He is an electronics engineer by training and MBA from Indian Institute of Management. Ahmedabad

name: Mr. Sayantan Chakraborty
title: Global Head of Payment Rails
bio: Sayantan Chakraborty is the Global Head of Payment Rails at J.P. Morgan Payments. In this role, he leads all of domestic and cross-currency Payments rails across Real Time Payments, FX Payments, Pay by Bank, ACH, Wires, Disbursements, Commercial Cards etc. Prior to assuming this responsibility, Sayantan has held leadership roles as Global Co-Head of Treasury Services Payments and as Global Head of Cross-Currency Payments business at the bank. Sayantan joined the firm in 2021 from U.S. Bank where he was Head of Product Management & Solutions Engineering for their Global Treasury Management business. In this role, Sayantan led his organization in being the first of two banks to launch Real Time Payments in the United States. Sayantan was also responsible for launching several award winning new products during his tenure. Prior to joining U.S. Bank, Sayantan spent nearly 15 years at Citibank across India and the United States in a variety of leadership roles. In his last role at Citi, he served as the North America Head of Client Implementation with responsibility for onboarding new business across Cash Management, FX Payments Commercial Cards and Trade franchises. In previous roles, he managed the Payments business for North America including all of domestic, cross border and FX payments products. Sayantan has previously served on the board of NACHA and has held advisory roles across many industry bodies. Sayantan holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management, Lucknow and did his undergraduate training in Mechanical Engineering.

name: Mr. Sekhar Rao
title: Executive Director
bio: Mr. Sekhar Rao aged 54 Years, a post graduate in Business Administration and a BE (Chemical), who has 29+ years of overall work experience across various sectors such as Banking, Information Technology, Payment and Settlement Products, Business Management, Strategy & Operations, of which 19 years in the BFSI sector. He also has an experience of 10+ years in CXO roles reporting to MD & CEO and Board Committees. His areas of experience include setting up and managing centralized operation units and technology teams, consulting for projects in business strategy and banking operation, managing the digital/alternate channels of Banks, setting up of new business verticals, distribution channels, branch network expansion, managing large network of Branches & Business Units and setting up and scaling a Fintech start-up. Prior to joining our Bank, he has been associated with a fintech - Savvy India as the co-founder and a director from April 2020. He was also associated with CSB bank Ltd as the Head – Operations & IT for about six years. Earlier, he has worked with RBL Bank Ltd, ING Vysya Bank Ltd, ICICI Bank Ltd., Asian Paints (I) Ltd., Goodlass Nerolac Paints Ltd., (now Kansai Nerolac Paints Ltd) in various capacities. Mr.Sekhar Rao is on our Board as the Executive Director w.e.f. February 01, 2023.

name: Mr. Shailendra Jit Singh
title: Managing Director
bio: Shailendra Singh is a Managing Director at Peak XV, a leading venture capital firm in India and Southeast Asia, that has over $9 billion of assets under management. He joined the firm in 2006 and leads its operations globally. Peak XV (formerly Sequoia India & Southeast Asia) has partnered with over 400 companies in the technology, software, financial services and consumer space. The portfolio has seen 23 IPOs and multiple successful M&As, resulting in $4.8 billion in realised exits so far. Shailendra has led investments in several companies including Pine Labs, CRED, Druva, Carousell, Gojek, Tokopedia and Unacademy. Shailendra has been the driving force behind numerous initiatives and programs aimed at enabling startups across all stages of their journey from seed funding to IPO readiness. Notably Shailendra was responsible for launching Surge, Peak XV’s early stage rapid scale-up program, and the investing business in Southeast Asia. Shailendra was included in the Forbes Midas List from 2018 to 2020. He has received an MBA with distinction from Harvard Business School (HBS) and currently serves on the HBS Board of Dean’s Advisors as well as the Board of the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF). He holds an undergraduate degree in chemical engineering from IIT Bombay, and is also a Kauffman Fellow.

name: Mr. Shaji K V
title: Chairman
org: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
bio: Mr. Shaji K V took over as Chairman, National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) on 07 December 2022. NABARD is the Government of India owned apex bank for agriculture and rural development and acts as a development bank, regulator of agriculture credit and Supervisor of Rural Financial Institutions in the country. Previously, he served as Deputy Managing Director of NABARD from 21 May2020 to 06 December 2022. Prior to joining NABARD, Mr. Shaji was associated with Canara Bank. His area of expertise includes Retail Banking, SME Banking and Corporate Banking in rural, urban and metro areas. Mr. Shaji has also handled banking coordination and policy matters for over 6 years as in-charge of State Level Banker's Committee, Kerala. He was instrumental in the merger of Syndicate Bank with Canara Bank. He also handled amalgamation of two Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) to establish Kerala Gramin Bank. A post-graduate in agriculture science, Mr. Shaji holds a Post Graduate Degree in Management (PGDM) with specialisations in Public Policy and infrastructure finance from the prestigious Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Ahmedabad. He is also a certified associate of the Indian Institute of Banking & Finance (IIBF) and holds a Diploma in Treasury, Investments and Risk Management. Mr. Shaji currently serves as Chairman of subsidiaries of NABARD viz., M/s NABARD Consultancy Services Limited (NABCONS), M/s NABSanrakshan Trustee Company Private Limited, M/s NABVENTURES Limited and M/s NABFOUNDATION. He is also Chairman of the Governing Council of the Bankers Institute of Rural Development(BIRD) and a member of the Board of Directors of Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC). As an industry leader, he was also Director of various organizations such as National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), Canara HSBC OBC Insurance Company Ltd. and Canara Bank Securities Ltd.

name: Mr. Shantanu Pendsey
title: CGM (ABU & GSS)
bio: Mr. Shantanu Pendsey is the head of Agri Business Unit and Govt. Sponsored Schemes(ABU & GSS) in State Bank of India. In a career spanning more than 3 decades, Mr.Pendsey has rich experience in Retail Credit, Retail Operations, SME Credit and Agricultural Credit. Since his leadership role at ABU & GSS Dept, he has been successfully steering the growth in Agri Business and Govt. Sponsored Schemes and has achieved significant improvement in all key metrics of the business unit. Mr. Pendsey is a Science Graduate and has a Diploma in Business Management. He is a strategic thinker and implementer who believes in streamlining processes for impactful growth. Under his helm, the Bank is revamping Agri, Rural and GSS businesses of the Bank with key focus on Partnership and Collaborations, Disruption through Digitization, Optimization of Processes, Products & Platforms.

name: Mr. Sharan Hegde
title: Founder and CEO
bio: In a world where people think finance is boring, Sharan Hegde is on a mission to spread financial literacy in each and every Indian household through comedic shorts and entertaining long-form videos. He has over 7M followers across platforms and his content reaches over 100 Million viewers every month. Sharan is the founder & CEO of 1% Club - India's biggest finance community of over 65,000 members which helps people achieve financial independence. He has been featured in Forbes, Economic Times, Mint, Times of India and many more. He is a Columbia MBA dropout and currently resides in Mumbai.

name: Mr. Sharath Bulusu
title: Director, Product Management Director
bio: Sharath Bulusu leads product management for Google Pay, making simple, secure and reliable payments accessible to people and businesses across India. He is focused on building products that contribute to the growing digital economy through innovative technology and design. He has a rich and varied experience as a product leader for advertising, media and commerce products in different parts of the world. Having started his career with Google in 2005, he went on to lead product teams at The Guardian, Twitter, HouseTrip (acquired by TripAdvisor) and Myntra before returning to Google in 2019.

name: Mr. Shashank Joshi
title: Deputy CEO & Head of Global Corporate & Investment Banking, India
bio: Shashank Joshi is the Deputy CEO of MUFG India and Head of Global Corporate Banking (GCIB) for India. His team is responsible for banking needs of large Indian corporates, financial institutions and multi-national corporations operating in India. He is also responsible for MUFG Ganesha Fund investments in India.

name: Mr. Shashank Kumar
title: MD & Co-Founder
bio: Shashank started Razorpay, along with Harshil Mathur, after discovering the dismal state of online payments in India. He graduated from IIT Roorkee and before taking the entrepreneurial route with Razorpay; Shashank also worked with Microsoft US as a Software Developer. With an idea to change the way online payments function in India, Shashank quit his full-time job. By early 2014, Razorpay was conceptualized with a vision to simplify online payments. Razorpay is one of the only two India-focused companies to be selected for the prestigious Y Combinator (YC) program. Along with 33 reputed investors, the company is also backed by Lone Pine Capital, Alkeon Capital, TCV, GIC, Ribbit Capital, Sequoia Capital India, Tiger Global Management, Y Combinator, Matrix Partners and Mastercard with a funding of $741.5 Mn from Series A, B, C, D, E & F rounds. Three years after its founding, Razorpay rebranded itself in 2017 as Razorpay 2.0, a Converged Payments Solution company with a product suite designed to ease businesses of managing concerns around the flow of money in their financial systems. Over the course of time, Razorpay has acquired eight companies - Ezetap - India’s leading offline POS company, PoshVine - India’s leading fintech startup that provides payments-linked loyalty solutions to payment networks, banks, and businesses, IZealiant - A mobile-first, API-enabled, and cloud-ready payment solution, RazorpayX Payroll (Opfin) - a Payroll and HR Management Software company, to solve for seamless automation of a business’s entire payroll process, Thirdwatch- an Artificial Intelligence (AI) driven company specializing in big data and machine learning for real-time fraud prevention, TeraFin Labs - The AI-based SaaS platform that facilitates digital financing solutions. The company made its first international acquisition last year by acquiring Curlec - A Recurring payment platform, but with the recently announced launch of Razorpay’s first international payment gateway for the Malaysian market, Curlec now becomes a full-stack tech solution provider for payments. Earlier this year Razorpay also launched its first international Payment Gateway for the Malaysian market with Curlec, earlier known as a recurring payment platform, now a PG, known as Curlec By Razorpay . Further strengthening its Omnichannel Play, Razorpay also recently acquired BillMe, A Digital invoice and customer Engagement - Razorpay’s partnership with BillMe is strategically designed to empower businesses with a hybrid model to engage better with end customers. Progressing in its journey that started with Razorpay 2.0, the Company also launched it’s neobanking platform, RazorpayX and lending platform, Razorpay Capital - both designed to power the financial systems for disruptive companies. Razorpay has been charting exponential growth since its inception. The company today powers digital payments for 5Mn businesses including the likes of Facebook, Airtel, BookMyShow, Lenskart, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme, Tata Consultancy Services, Ola, Zomato, Swiggy, Cred, ICICI Prudential among others. Currently, the company aims to further solidify its position as one of the largest full-stack fintech companies in the country. Among other achievements, Shashank also won Best New Age Entrepreneurs by the Asian Center Of Corporate Governance in 2024 EY Entrepreneur of the Year in 2022 & he was also recognized under Forbes 30 Under30 ASIA class of 2021, Entrepreneur magazine’s ‘Top 35 Under 35’ entrepreneurs in 2021, 30 promising young Indian talent under the age of 30 in 2021, by Forbes, 40 Under 40 by Fortune India in 2021, & was also featured as LinkedIn’s Power Profiles in India (Technology) in 2017 & 2018.

name: Mr. Shashank Pandey
title: Managing Director - Consumer & FIG
org: o3 Capital Global Advisory Pvt Ltd
bio: Shashank Pandey currently serves as Managing Director and leads the Financial Services and Consumer Practice at o3 Capital. He is a seasoned investment banker with over 17 years of dealmaking experience and has a deep reservoir of expertise within the financial services sector, including the rapidly evolving fintech startup space. Prior to joining o3 Capital, Shashank worked as a Director at Citigroup Investment Banking in India and Singapore. He has successfully concluded over 100 transactions including public market capital raise, mergers & acquisitions, private capital raises, and strategic partnerships. He has the distinct accomplishment of executing mandates for both industry leading and new-age companies operating in the fields of banking, NBFC, insurance, payment services, and asset & wealth management. Shashank holds an MBA degree from TA Pai Management Institute.

name: Mr. Shashwat Sharma
title: Partner and Financial Services leader at India

name: Mr. Shekhar Bhandari
title: President & Business Head of SME Banking
bio: Shekhar Bhandari is President & Business Head of SME Banking at Kotak Mahindra Bank, spearheading the bank's strategic focus on fostering growth and innovation within the SME sector. Shekhar’s focus is to build comprehensive banking solutions for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs), including open banking and beyond banking services. He is also at the helm of implementing technology-enabled transaction banking solutions tailored to cater to the unique financial needs of the expansive SME market in India. Commencing his journey with Kotak Mahindra Group in 1996, Shekhar's illustrious career spanning over 25 years showcases a trajectory of escalating responsibilities across various facets of the banking domain –Transaction Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury, Insurance, Mutual Fund, Securities, Corporate Finance, Strategy and Compliance. His knack for pioneering new revenue channels and propelling growth has left an indelible mark on Six Businesses he has steered. A recent testament to Shekhar's innovative approach is the inception of Kotak fyn - an enterprise portal designed to provide a comprehensive digital banking experience alongside a plethora of value-added services across different banking products. Shekhar is passionate about technology and endeavours to make Banking “Simple and Fast” across all verticals. His fascination with technology is a cornerstone of his leadership ethos. He is always seeking to harness cutting-edge tech to enhance banking functions. Under his stewardship, Kotak Mahindra Bank has strengthened capabilities in Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Digital Signatures, Open Banking, machine learning, and data analytics, setting a benchmark for digital transformation in the Business banking arena. Honoured as the CA Business Leader by ICAI in 2021 and the "Transaction Banker of the Year in Asia Pacific" by The Asian Banker in 2019, Shekhar's accolades mirror his expertise and forward-thinking approach in the financial sector. Under his leadership, the Bank won Transaction Bank of Year, Cash Management Bank of the Year, Trade Finance Bank of the Year, and innovation awards. Shekhar is a Chartered Accountant by education. He ranked 25th across India in the year of his graduation. He is an Associate Member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, and a Graduate Member of the Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India. He is a regular speaker at various industry forums globally.

name: Mr. Shergeran Roberto Naidoo
title: Head: Stakeholder Engagement
bio: Shergeran has served in a number of capacities at BankservAfrica - from Compliance and Risk to Legal and Governance and now head of Stakeholder Engagement. After starting off as a practicing attorney in Pietermaritzburg, Shergeran relocated to Johannesburg where he joined Nedbank, working in Private Banking and Private Clients, as well as Corporate Finance. He later joined Standard Bank as the Corporate Governance Manager and joined BankservAfrica in 2008. He holds a BA (LLB) from the University of KwaZulu-Natal, was admitted as an Attorney of the High Court of South Africa in 2000 and holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Tax Law from the University of Johannesburg. Shergeran attained a Masters degree in Business Administration from UNISA Graduate School of Business Leadership in 2013. He is passionate about self-development and serving as a mentor. His favourite role is as a father and husband.

name: Mr. Shinichiro Nishikawa
title: Head of Global Payments & Services Division
bio: Shinichiro has 28 years of experience working in the payment industry, especially in digital payment, as a member of NTT DATA Corporation which has operated CAFIS, a major payment platform in Japan, over 30 years. Currently, he is the Head of Global Payments and Services Division of NTT DATA Japan Corporation. Besides that, he is also a member of the Board of Directors of Viet Union Online Services Corporation in Vietnam, iPay88 in Malaysia, NTT DATA Hong Kong, NTTDATA Payment Services India, and GHL Systems Berhad, subsidiaries of NTT DATA Corporation that provide intermediary payment services in each country.

name: Mr. Shireesh Joshi
title: Chief Business Officer
bio: Shireesh brings over 3 decades of expertise to his role as CBO at ONDC. With 25 yrs of experience in India,9 yrs in China (including HK and Taiwan),& 2 yrs in Southeast Asia, he has worked across geographies, cultures and business scale. Prior to this, he has held business leadership positions at Godrej Group, Bharti Airtel Limited, PepsiCo Foods China, and P&G. He has also advised & run growth programs for brand spanning industries including start-ups as an independent growth program mgr.

name: Mr. Shirish Bhandari
title: Head Credit Cards, FASTag and Loyalty
bio: More than 20+ years of experience in Cards and payments – product, portfolio, business development, partnerships, digital business across Consumer and Commercial Credit, Fx, Prepaid Cards. He has build the Credit Card business at IDFC FIRST Bank with an innovative D2C and digital operating model. Prior to this, he was leading Credit Card product management at ICICI Bank Ltd.

name: Mr. Shishir Mankad
title: Partner
bio: Shishir is a Partner with EY Parthenon leading the strategy and commercial diligence practice for Financial Services. He has almost 25 years experience in Financial Services, across management consulting and industry.

name: Mr. Shivakumar Ganesan
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Prior to co-founding Exotel, Shivakumar Ganesan held two prominent positions at Yahoo! as a Product Manager and later as the Vice President of Products and Technology at Flipkart. However, despite his success at these top-tier organizations, Shivku's entrepreneurial spirit persisted.With a mission to address the need of an affordable, easy-to-implement communication solution, Shivku launched Exotel in 2011. Under his leadership, Exotel has grown into a leading customer conversation platform and business-focused virtual telecom operator that drives 70+ million conversations every day for more than 7000 businesses in India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Africa. Exotel brings together an omnichannel contact center, Communication API suite, and Conversational AI on one powerful platform. It offers Gen AI led solutions to improve Enterprise CX with personalized, automated conversations. This progress positions Exotel well for the strategic shifts to serve large-scale enterprises. Shivakumar is committed to ensuring that Exotel remains at the forefront of innovation in the customer engagement space and continues to provide exceptional value to its clients. He is focused on providing enterprises with a comprehensive suite of channels and tools to engage with their customers all in one place. Shivku is known for his technical expertise, business acumen, and leadership skills. He has been recognized as a Young Turk by CNBC and has been featured in various media outlets for his contributions to the technology and entrepreneurship space. He has been featured in ET 40 under 40. He is passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems and is committed to building innovative solutions that make a difference in people's lives. Exotel has won The ET StartUp Awards 2022 under the Comeback Kid category.

name: Mr. Shobhit Mathur
title: Co-founder
bio: Shobhit Mathur is Co-founder, AngelOne Wealth is a tech-led omnichannel wealth management platform that caters to India’s emerging and ultra HNIs. He pivoted to an enterpreneurial journey with AOW after spending about 16 years with Kotak group. Prior to AOW, Shobhit was part of the leadership team at Kotak Cherry, a Digital Investment platform from Kotak. He was responsible for business strategy, investment solutions, user interface & experience, customer service and advisory proposition for digitally native users. That has given him the experience of building a business ground up. It allowed him to bring together his experience of investment advisory and leverage in-house tech talent to deliver investment expertise to users through digital applications.

name: Mr. Shrawan Saraogi
title: APAC Head of Expansion
bio: SK is the APAC Head of Banking and Expansion at Wise, leading a team spread across10 countries. Based in Singapore, he is responsible for expanding and improving Wise's regional product offerings and managing Wise's relationships with regulators,governments, payment systems, and banking partners across the region. He is also the Singapore Country Manager, providing leadership to local teams and functional leads to ensure smooth operations in Wise's APAC Hub. Prior to Wise, SK was the Head of Strategy at Funding Societies, a Singapore-based fintech which provides financial services to SMEs across SEA. SK started his career at DBS Bank, where he gained extensive experience in Corporate and Investment Banking. SK has an MBA from Duke University in the USA and an undergraduate degree in Economics and Finance from Singapore Management University in Singapore. He has also completed all levels of the CFA Program.

name: Mr. Shubhanga Prasad
title: Partner
bio: Shubhanga comes with fifteen years of professional experience predominantly in Business Strategy and Product Management in Financial services. He was instrumental in launching India‚Äôs first bank-led Fintech Accelerator with YES BANK as VP ‚Äì Fintech Strategy and was later Global Head‚ Client Services at MEDICI (acquired by Prove), a Fintech research and Innovation advisory firm. Most recently, he was the Interim COO, and Head of Product and Technology at OakNorth Bank (UK's profitable Fintech unicorn), in London, UK. Currently, Shubhanga continues his passion for building technology products as an advisor, working closely with the Founding teams and Boards of several B2B SaaS and Fintechs companies in the areas of Credit, Cross-border Investments, and Insurance verticals. He is closely involved with growth stage teams across India and the UK, in honing their Business and GTM Strategy, Digital Products design and development, Technology Risk Management among others. He is also the Chief Advisor‚ Digital Transformation to Xebia (Atlanta HQ'd global software services firm) on their Banking & FS foray. Shubhanga continues his focus on startup investments, as Partner at Betaplus‚ a Bangalore based friends & family office investing in angel / pre-seed start-ups. With a portfolio of c. 40 startups, Betaplus boasts of 8 full/ partial exits and 3 startups valued at over $600m, including a unicorn. His focus includes start-ups with a mission to‚ Äúaccelerate access to digital financial services‚ or‚ Äúreduce carbon footprint‚ or ‚Äúimprove quality of life. He also serves on the Investment Committee of Krystal Venture Studios, India's first venture studio for plant based businesses. Shubhanga is a Gold Medallist in B.E. Mechanical from PESIT, Bangalore and has completed M.B.A in Finance from SCMHRD, Pune [Symbiosis International University, Pune]. He has also worked as Product Design Engineer in General Motors Technical Center, Bangalore, prior to his post graduate studies.

name: Mr. Shyam Sundar Singh
title: Co-Founder
bio: Shyam is the Executive Director and Co-Founder of DeHaat, which is recognized as one of the Top50 Global AgTech Brands by Thrive in 2023. Started in 2012, DeHaat focused on creating an impact on millions of smallholder farmers in India by providing 360-degree agri value chain solutions throughout the crop lifecycle. Since its inception, DeHaat has created a strong network of 300+ agri input suppliers and 1200+ agri output buyers to serve more than two million farmers across India. As a Co-Founder, Shyam is instrumental in development and implementation of company strategies so as to operate on the "Farmers' First" principle that enables it to work towards improving agriculture practices and income from produce for farmers at the same time. Shyam spearheads the entire pre-harvest function towards building a full stack agri platform for Indian farmers using data- and network-led new initiatives. He is instrumental in ensuring robust systems and processes are in place so as to build a strong foundation for the organization. Shyam has done his MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and B.Tech from IIT Kharagpur. Prior to DeHaat he has worked as Social Impact Consultant with FSG and as Manager, Marketing with Reliance Industries.

name: Mr. Siddarth Pai
title: Founding Partner | CFO | ESG Officer
bio: Siddarth Pai is the Founding Partner, CFO, and ESG Officer of 3one4 Capital. Siddarth is the youngest Executive Council member of the Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA) â€“ the apex body for Indian funds investing into alternative assets. He also serves as the Co-Chair of the Regulatory Affairs Committee, working on matters related to security markets, Alternative Investment Funds, taxation, foreign exchange, law, and startups. He is the founding member and vice-president of the PEVCFOA, a collective of the CFOS of Venture and Private Equity Funds investing in India and is part of the startup councils of CII and AIMA. He is an expert policy member of ISPIRT, the Indian Software Product Industry Round Table, a Bangalore-based think-tank. Siddarth completed his B.Com from St.Josephâ€™s College of Commerce Bangalore and is a qualified Chartered Accountant.

name: Mr. Siddharth Rungta
title: Managing Director & Country Head - Global Payments Solutions
bio: Siddharth has over 23 years of experience in payments / transaction banking industry and has held various leadership positions within Payments business in Asia and Middle East with HSBC, bringing with him a unique blend of experience across Business Development, Product Management and Operations. In his current role as the Country Head of Global Payments Solutions business in India, he is responsible for providing strategic direction and execution focus within the business, respond appropriately to the dynamic and changing market landscape, and continually build upon the digital treasury transformation work undertaken with both local and global corporates, supporting and enabling them as they look to grow their business in India and beyond. Siddharth is also a nominee Director on the board of National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) as well as NPCI International Payments Ltd.

name: Mr. Solomon Damtew Birhanu
title: Director
bio: Solomon Damtew is the Director of the Payment and Settlement Systems Directorate at the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE); he has demonstrated over 14 years of dedicated service at the NBE. In his current position, Solomon oversees the development and modernization of digital payment systems and financial services in Ethiopia. He has played a pivotal role in leading initiatives to enhance regulatory frameworks, policies, and strategies to promote financial inclusion and advance digital payment systems. Solomon has also been instrumental in modernizing and implementing the interbank payment system, RTGS, a critical component of interbank payment processing in Ethiopia. Before his current role, Solomon served as the principal (Division Head) for payment system oversight and development, where he confidently led efforts to draft various payment system-related regulatory instruments, including the National Payment System Proclamation. He also led the formulation and implementation of the Ethiopian first ever National Digital Payment Strategy (NDPS) 2021-24, which laid down the groundwork for the country's current digital payment landscape.

name: Mr. Somboun Phongsavanh
title: Chairman and Deputy CEO
bio: Mr. Somboun Phongsavanh, deputy CEO and Chairman of Shareholders’ Committee and Chairman of Phongsavanh Group. Mr. Somboun graduated a BA in Finance and Accounting from Sunway University, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in 2013 and from Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology, Melbourne, Australia, 2009. Mr. Somboun is currently the deputy CEO of Phongsavanh Bank Limited and plays the role in initiating the innovation and digitalization of bank now. In addition, he takes lead in many important works of bank and Phongsavanh Group, especially Smart City Development project.

name: Mr. Sopnendu Mohanty
title: Chief Fintech Officer
bio: Sopnendu Mohanty, currently the Chief Fintech Officer at the Monetary Authority of Singapore, is responsible for creating development strategies, public infrastructure, and policies around technology-driven innovation. Mohanty has over two decades of public and private sector experience in technology, operations, digital Finance, and investment strategies. Mohanty extensively engages with global technology and financial services ecosystems and has championed notable collaborative public goods like API Exchange (APIX), Singapore Fintech Festival, Payment Rails, Data exchange platforms, and experimental programs like UBIN. In addition, Mohanty advises many international global advisory bodies on Fintech, Innovation and Inclusion. Within five years of his leadership, Singapore has become a leading global Fintech hub producing unicorns and home to many vibrant fintech companies. He has co-authored several patented works in the application of digital technology in Finance and won many industry recognitions.

name: Mr. Soumendu Sekhar Ganguly
title: Deputy Chief Operating Officer & Chief Product Officer
bio: Soumendu Sekhar Ganguly is the Chief Product Officer and Business Head – New Platforms. He spearheads all the product initiatives at CAMS and is heading the business and strategy for New Platform-led Businesses including MF Central, CRA business and Account Aggregator. Associated with CAMS since 2017, Soumendu has been instrumental in building industry leading platforms and also heads Design, Analytics and AI practices. In his career spanning over 15 years, Soumendu developed vast experience in Product and Business. Prior to joining CAMS, he worked at Infoedge across various brands including Naukri, 99acres and Shiksha, and also led the product and marketing functions at Sulekha. A certified HFI design enthusiast, Soumendu holds a B.Tech (Hons) in Computer Science from NIT, Raipur, and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) from IIM, Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Souparno Bagchi
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Souparno Bagchi is the COO at BalanceHero India. Through his extensive and global experience in Banking and Financial Services, he will lead the operations of True Balance bringing differentiated customer value and ensuring sustainable growth. He works directly with the founder on the high performance of incumbent businesses and on expanding the offerings and customer base. Souparno is an alumnus of the Indian School of Business (ISB), Hyderabad. In his career spanning over two decades, Souparno has played various leadership and multi-functional roles at reputed companies like Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, and Tata Consultancy Services. Souparno is passionate about entrepreneurship and from his vantage point of being a business leader and a technologist, deeply appreciates the convergence of ‘Doing good and doing well…’, an opportunity further emboldened by the Fintech revolution. His areas of interest and advocacy include social impact, diversity & inclusion, education & research, and the nuances of operating in a millennial & digital world.

name: Mr. Sreyamsa Bairiganjan
title: Chief of Programmes
bio: Sreyamsa Bairiganjan currently serves as Chief of Programmes at Shakti Sustainable Energy Foundation. He is a strategic leader with nearly two decades of expertise in sustainable development and energy. His leadership has been instrumental in shaping global discourse and driving impactful initiatives in the sector. As a thought leader,Sreyamsa has contributed to influential reports and shared insights at high-level forums, including the G20, Asia Clean Energy Forum (ACEF), TEDx, and the United Nations Conference on Sustainable Development (Rio+20).His approach to scaling projects emphasises a triple-bottom-line approach, ensuring the streamlining of economic, social, and environmental benefits. Before joining the Shakti Foundation, Sreyamsa was a Senior Energy Expert with the World Bank's Energy and Extractives team, leading engagements across projects in India, Maldives, Bangladesh, and Nepal. He successfully implemented a structured risk mitigation strategy to support renewable energy and storage enterprises scaling up globally. He was also a part of the innovative technology and finance work at the World Bank. His career also includes significant roles at Arc Finance and the World Resources Institute, where he led transformative projects that align investment goals with sustainability imperatives. He is a multiple-time recipient of the World Bank VP awards and "Above and Beyond" recognitions, underscoring his commitment to driving positive change in the global sustainable development landscape.Sreyamsa holds Master of Business Administration from Indian Institute of Forest Management (IIFM).

name: Mr. Sridhar Narayan
title: Chief Business Officer
bio: Sridhar is a seasoned Business and Strategy leader with over two decades of experience in the industry. He leads as the Chief Business Officer at Perfios, where his expertise in driving operational excellence and creating new markets plays a pivotal role in advancing business growth initiatives and enhancing customer experience. Prior to his role at Perfios, Sridhar led the BFSI Business at Adobe India, pioneering the establishment of the Digital Experience vertical for BFSI. Under his leadership, the business flourished to achieve a $30 Million ARR, an impressive ascent from its modest beginnings. Sridhar has managed large cross-functional teams of Sales, Customer Success, Partner team, Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Product Engineering, and aligned product strategy with market opportunities to spearhead the creation of new markets. Before Adobe, Sridhar spent a decade at Microsoft, where he played a key role in driving Consulting Strategy and Sales Excellence across various business units. He began his career journey with ESRI before transitioning to IBM to lead the Mid-Market Business. Beyond his professional achievements, Sridhar's dedication to serving the community is truly inspiring. He is actively involved in mentoring students and young professionals, guiding them to be job-ready and supporting their career progression, by providing them with valuable advice, personalized mentoring, and practical insights to navigate the complexities of today's professional landscape. His efforts also include teaching AI and Mathematics in Kannada to government school children online, which arise from his firm belief in the transformative power of education and mentorship.

name: Mr. Sridhar Srinivasan
title: Co-Founder & CTO
bio: Co-Founder & CTO of Nivesh, a wealth management platform targeted towards distributors and advisors. Prior to Nivesh, he was India operations head of Visible Alpha, a broker research aggregation platform, founded by a consortium of Wall Street Banks. Prior to that, he had stints in Gridstone Research, Hurix Systems and Infosys, crafting technology and data-driven solutions for major wall street firms and educational publishers. Sridhar is an alumnus of IIT Kanpur and IIM Lucknow.

name: Mr. Srikanth Bureddy
title: Co-Founder
bio: Srikanth Bureddy, Co-founder of Valueleaf Group, has steered the company to prominence in AdTech, Martech, and Fintech across both India and the USA. His exceptional business acumen has enabled the Valueleaf Group to become highly profitable without external funding, achieving an impressive $100 million in revenue and creating over 500 jobs. Srikanth's innovative approach and keen market insights have firmly positioned Valueleaf as a leader in digital marketing and financial technology. One notable venture under the Valueleaf Group umbrella is Buddy Loan, a fintech initiative that exemplifies Srikanth's commitment to innovation in financial technology. Buddy Loan has emerged as a significant player in the fintech space, providing seamless and accessible loan services to a broad audience. Srikanth's leadership has been instrumental in driving the growth and success of Buddy Loan, reinforcing Valueleaf's reputation for pioneering solutions in the fintech industry.

name: Mr. Srikanth Rajagopalan
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Currently setting up Anumati - India's fastest growing account aggregator network. Previously led business and product teams at AWS, Amazon, Amex and Nokia. Also serve on the FICCI Task Force on Privacy and Data Protection, serving as the voice of industry in the formulation of the DPDPA '23. Entrepreneur, hobby photographer, biker.

name: Mr. Srinivas Jain
title: Executive Director and Head of Strategy

name: Mr. Srinivasa Raghavan
title: Director - Product Management
bio: Srinivasa Raghavan is the Product Director for ManageEngine Site24x7, a division of Zoho Corporation, with over 22 years of tenure at the company. He plays a pivotal role in making decisions related to product architecture, management, and engineering, and oversees the strategic direction of the entire product suite. Beyond his professional expertise, Raghavan is passionate about programming and troubleshooting, and enjoys singing and sports in his leisure time.

name: Mr. Sriram Krishnan
title: Chief Business Development Officer
bio: Sriram has over 28 years of work experience in the Indian banking and capital markets space. He has spent about 22 years with multinational organisations, across corporate and institutional banking, asset management and securities services at various levels of seniority. His current role with the NSE, as Chief Business Development Officer, entails establishing and managing business strategy and advocacy, product lifecycle and all business alliances and relationships. Sriram also oversees marketing & corporate communication and economic policy & research. In his previous roles, Sriram has worked for over 21 years across HSBC, Citi and Deutsche Bank. In his immediately previous role with Deutsche Bank India, Sriram was Managing Director & Co-Head of Global Transaction Banking. Sriram is a qualified Chartered and Cost Accountant from India.

name: Mr. Sriram Muthu Krishnan
title: Managing Director, Group Head Product Management
bio: "Sriram joined DBS in 2018 as Managing Director, Global Transaction Services. His current remit as Group Head of Product Management covers cash and liquidity management, enterprise-wide payments, trade finance and supply chain finance solutions offered by the Bank. With more than 20 years of banking experience spanning across several key international financial hubs, including Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai and India, Sriram spearheads DBS digital product initiatives across the region. He is responsible for leading overall business performance, strategy and product innovation across the bank’s suite of transaction banking solutions. Since joining DBS, Sriram has led the transformation of its cash management, payments, and trade and supply chain finance businesses into ones that are fast growing, digital, innovative and market leading. He has also led the launch of several innovative payments solutions including DBS Globesend. Sriram is passionate about driving diversity and inclusion in the workplace, besides developing innovative solutions to serve corporates, large and small. Prior to joining DBS, Sriram held several senior leadership roles in global banks such as HSBC and Standard Chartered covering areas such as corporate banking, transaction banking and trade finance."

name: Mr. Srivatsa (Sri) Sreenivasarao
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Srivatsa is the Co-Founder of TraceX Technologies. An alumnus of IIM-Bangalore, Srivatsa has more than 16 years of experience of working with technological solutions in consulting sales and product engineering across domestic and international markets. Before launching TraceX, Srivatsa had worked with organisations like the Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions and the Smarton Learning Solutions.

name: Mr. Stanislav Korop
title: Acting Director - FinTech Department
bio: As an Acting Director of the Financial Technology Department of the Bank of Russia Stanislav Korop is in charge of the development of several digital public infrastructure projects, including national biometric system, digital profile, data exchange platform, Open APIs and consent management platform. Prior to joining the Financial Technology Department Stanislav Korop was Deputy Director of the Reporting Department and later Data Management Department of the Bank of Russia. Mr Korop holds a degree in finance and credit from International University in Moscow.

name: Mr. Subho Moulik
title: Founder and CEO
bio: Subho Moulik is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Appreciate. His vision for Appreciate is to democratize finance for 1 billion plus Indians, enabling them to achieve their financial goals and aspirations. He has over 25 years of experience across global companies (Citigroup, McKinsey, Andersen, Ernst & Young, Whirlpool, Adani, Wayfair), multiple industries and different geographies. His recent experience includes senior leadership roles at leading multinational companies, with extensive experience in scaling businesses. Subho has been on the advisory boards of multiple non-profits and is currently an advisory board member at Samhita - India‚Äôs leading social sector collective focused on livelihoods, health and blended finance. Subho has an MBA from London Business School.

name: Mr. Sudharsan Aravamuthan
title: Head, Systems Engineering, India at Pure Storage
bio: Sudharsan Aravamuthan is the Head of Systems Engineering at Pure Storage India. In this role he and his team are responsible for driving technical strategy to help customers navigate their digital transformation journeys with modern data solutions. He brings with him deep expertise in data solutions having worked in technical leadership roles across the Asia Pacific region. Throughout his career, he has worked closely with Large Enterprises and Government around the region helping them to with initiatives such as data center modernization and digital transformation. Prior to Pure, Sudharsan Aravamuthan has served as an APAC Solution Lead for Data Intelligence, Content and Cloud and Virtualization solutions at Hitachi Vantara. Adept in multiple technology disciplines, he has built a reputation for successfully architecting full stack, resilient, scalable, and agile infrastructure for workloads such as Hybrid Cloud, Containers & Virtualization, SAP HANA & Oracle.

name: Mr. Sudhindra Magadi
title: CTO
bio: Sudhindra has more than 25 years of experience in product and solution architecture. He is passionate about providing cutting-edge solutions and innovation. The fields of private and public clouds (AWS), mobility, virtualization, banking, pharmaceuticals, data centre automation, anti-money laundering, and payments are just a few of the ones in which Sudhindra has a great deal of experience. In addition, he has a wide range of expertise in developing products as a developer, a development architect, and a technical consultant. Sudhindra's presence will enable Wibmo to experience new technological developments.

name: Mr. Sudhir Sehgal
title: Chief Business Officer
bio: Sudhir Sehgal has over two decades of expertise in innovating payment solutions in product and portfolio management, brand management, sales, and distribution. At PayU, Sudhir has scaled up the companyâ€™s enterprise payments business and has successfully led the strategy, development, and distribution of PayUâ€™s domestic and international payments for its enterprise merchant portfolio. With deep expertise in accelerating revenue growth, market share, and profitability for industry-leading organizations, Sudhir has scaled large business verticals such as merchant acquiring, e-commerce, and consumer cards in his previous stints. He has a deep understanding of financial products across the Indian landscape and has not onlyâ€¯been instrumental in setting up business such as mortgage and consumer durable finance, but has also led and scaled large business verticals such as merchant acquiring, e-commerce and consumer cards. Before joining PayU he worked with HDFC Bank and GE Capital. In the course of his professional journey, he has managed the entire range of retail financial products from business development, sales, and product management to merchant acquiring and consumer finance. Sudhir is an Alumni of Symbiosis IMS and a graduate of Delhi University. He operates out of PayUâ€™s head office in Gurugram.

name: Mr. Sudhir Sethi
title: Founder and Chairman
bio: Since 1998, Sudhir and his team have advised on investments into 125+ firms across Deep Tech, Agri Tech, Digital Consumer, SAAS, Fintech and Healthcare Sectors. Key investments include Myntra, Flipkart, FirstCry, Lenskart, PolicyBazaar, Curefit, Agrostar, Emotix, Uniphore and PlaySimple amongst others. Today Chiratae Ventures is a leading tech VC in India with Mr. Ratan Tata, Mr. Kris Gopalakrishnan, Mr. Bruno Raschle and Mr. Manish Choksi as well as Dr. Ferzaan Engineer on its Global Advisory Board and India Advisory Board. Sudhir, today serves on the EC of NASSCOM and is part of the Advisory Group on Tech and Internet Economy, Ministry of State (Meity), Government of India. In 2001, Sudhir was recognized by Red Herring as one of the leading venture capitalists in the country. He has been named among the Top Ten IT Professionals by Dataquest and by Bloomberg UTV as ‘’Visionary Venture Capitalist” in 2011. Sudhir has been featured in Subroto Bagchi’s book ‘’Zen Garden – Conversations with Path makers’’, in 2014. In addition to leading Chiratae Ventures India Advisors, Sudhir has served on EMPEA Venture Capital Council (Emerging Markets Private Equity Association). He has served as Advisor on the Technology Innovation and Productivity Council of the GMR Group. He also served on the Executive Committee of Indian Venture Capital Association (IVCA), Investment Committee of UTI Ventures, on the Board of Ascent Capital and on the Board of Advisors at N.S. Raghavan Centre for Entrepreneurship, IIM Bangalore. With over 30 years of experience, Sudhir has served at various leadership positions at HCL, Wipro and Cyient, as well as Country Head of Walden International India. Sudhir holds a B.Tech in Engineering and an MBA Degree from FMS, Delhi. His interests include wildlife photography and he is a collector of old locks.

name: Mr. Sudipta Roy
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr. Roy is a consumer banking and payments professional with over 24 years of financial services experience. He joined the Company from ICICI Bank, where he served as Group Head and managed diverse businesses like Unsecured Assets, Cards, Payment Solutions, Student Ecosystem, E-commerce and Merchant Ecosystem, Millennial Banking and API Banking. Before his assignment with ICICI Bank since 2010, he has worked for Citibank and Deutsche Bank. Mr. Roy has a deep understanding of consumer finance, cards and retail loans, lending and payments technology systems and associated risk management practices and has worked extensively in India, China and Canada in the consumer lending and payments business, having built green-field lending and cards businesses in all three countries. He was voted as one of the Top 50 Digital Finance Influencers in the country in 2024 as well as the top 30 Fintech Influencers in India in the year 2021 and is a speaker at various forums on Retail Lending and Credit, History of Payments, Risk and Fraud Control and Future of Payments business. Mr. Roy has also been a part of several Government and Reserve Bank of India committees in areas of transit payment systems, banking security and retail payments. He is a chemical engineer from Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur and MBA from XLRI School of Management, Jamshedpur.

name: Mr. Suhas Tuljapurkar
title: Founder Director
bio: Suhas Tuljapurkar, the Compliance Man of India, is an acclaimed lawyer with an extensive experience of over 40 years. His key areas of proficiency are Governance, Risk, Assurance, Compliance & Ethics (GRACE) with a fusion of information technology. Suhas is passionate about techno-legal innovations and after a successful career as an in-house counsel and law firm partner, Suhas founded Legasis Services, India's first legal tech enterprise in the year 2006. At Legasis, Suhas has been instrumental in developing multiple IT-enabled legal support solutions like the Legatrix. As a member of the Executive Committee of UN Global Compact Network India, Suhas was influential in developing groundbreaking solutions. He was a member of the Technical Advisory Committee (TAC) & National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) and has been appreciated at the global and national levels with various awards including the Udyog Ratan Award and leader for outstanding achievement and contribution in the field of Corporate Legal Sector in the House of Commons, British Parliament in London. He is a prolific blogger, an intellectual contributor to legal journals and is an applauded speaker.

name: Mr. Sujai Raina
title: Country Manager, India
bio: Sujai Raina is Visaâ€™s Country Manager for India. He leads the India business, executing Visa's strategic initiatives in India, and partnering with clients and the payment ecosystem. A member of the India and South Asia leadership team, Sujai also leads business development for Visa in India, delivering global capabilities to meet the business priorities of clients and Visa. His focus is on fostering strong client relationships to ensure win-win outcomes.

name: Mr. Sujit Misra
title: Director, Payments - APAC Stores & WW Digital Business
bio: Sujit Misra is the Director of Payments for Amazon and CEO for Amazon Payments Singapore, leading acceptance of payment methods and launch of new payment products for Amazon‚Äôs e-commerce stores across emerging countries in the Asia Pacific. Sujit also runs payments for Amazon‚Äôs digital businesses worldwide (Kindle, Video, Music, Audible) and manages the portfolio of worldwide cash acceptance products across Amazon. Prior to Amazon, Sujit has led payments and remittances for telecommunications operators and internet businesses based in India and US. Sujit holds a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from Delhi College of Engineering and Masters in Business Administration from MDI, Gurgaon.

name: Mr. Sujith Narayanan
title: Co-founder
bio: Mr. Sujith Narayanan Kutty is the Co-Founder and CEO of Epifi Technologies Private Limited (â€œFiâ€/ â€œFi Moneyâ€) and is a veteran of the banking and financial services sector. He has worked with established names such as Google India and Standard Chartered Bank earlier. Before founding Fi Money, Sujith was employed with Google India as the Head of the Financial Services Industry and Co-founded - Tez which is today referred to as â€œGoogle Pay / GPay''. Sujith is the elected Chairman of the Digital Financial Service Providers (DFSP) Committee of the Fintech Convergence Council (FCC).

name: Mr. Sumit Gwalani
title: Co-Founder of Epifi Technologies Private Limited
bio: Mr. Sumit Gwalani is the Co-Founder at Epifi Technologies Private Limited (“Fi”/ “Fi Money”). Before founding Fi Money, Sumit was employed with Google India and Co-founded - Tez what is today referred to as “Google Pay / GPay'', leading it to become one of India's top payment products. Having seen the friction that exists in Financial Services and how technology can play a part in enabling access-led empowerment, Sumit incubated the ideas to start Fi Money. He is also one of the committee members of the “AA Anti-Fraud Guidelines Working Group” led by Sahamati. Sumit is a thought leader and presented a talk on “Banking 2.0 talk of the past, India looking at Banking 3.0” which brought forward the latest trends in digital banking at the 2nd Edition of ETBFSI FinNext 2023. Sumit continues to be a volunteer with iSpirt on an ongoing basis and is helping lay foundations for new-age innovation in the fintech sector.

name: Mr. Sumit Nigam
title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Sumit has over 26 years of experience in the software industry. He has worked with a number of technical companies such as Verisign, EMC, Informatica, Walmart Global Tech and Bigbasket, playing roles spanning that of hands-on technical architect to heading the entire engineering function. He has built strong teams and pioneered engineering best practices across geographies. He has experience building low latency high volume applications, architecting data intensive systems, leveraging mathematics and data science, architecting distributed systems, troubleshooting complex systemic issues and optimizing diverse tech stacks. He has authored multiple award winning technical papers and also presented in various symposiums. Sumit holds a B.E degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from NIT, Calicut.

name: Mr. Sumoth C
title: Head-Fintech Partnerships
bio: Sumoth is a veteran and seasoned banking professional, who has been with Federal Bank for over 28 years in various roles and capacities. Got a diverse experience in Business, Technology and Operations. He is an expert in Retail Payment Systems, with special focus on Realtime Payments, Cards, Merchant Acquiring, Internet/Mobile banking channels etc. In his present role as Fintech Partnerships Head of Federal Bank, he is responsible for building a robust business model through partnerships with prominent Fintechs in the country.

name: Mr. Sundararaman Ramamurthy
title: MD & CEO
bio: Shri Sundararaman Ramamurthy joined BSE in Jan 2023 as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO). He has since been instrumental in leading the strategy, product advancement, regulatory relationship, and business development activities at the exchange. Prior to joining BSE, he was the MD & Chief Operating Officer in Indian arm of Bank of America (BANA) where his responsibilities included global governance and control of the banking entity and the securities segment. He has an extensive, variegated stints, handling all facets of running exchange business in India, with 20 years at NSE, where he was responsible for its significant transformation including hands-on involvement with derivatives, index & data business, and running of its clearing corporation. He began his career with leading Banks - IDBI, State Bank of India and Indian Overseas Bank. He has also been conferred with “Outstanding CEO of The Year in Capital Market-2023” Award by Eternal corporate media. He is a Cost Accountant and member of Indian Institute of Bankers along with being a Bachelor of Science.

name: Mr. Sunil Daga
title: President & Kotak Leadership Member
bio: Sunil Daga is President â€“ Business Banking Assets, Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited. He has been with the Kotak Mahindra Group for over a decade and has been a part of the Key Leadership Team (KLT). As part of Business Banking Assets, he is responsible for Business Loans, Working Capital Solutions and Healthcare Finance Solutions. Sunil has built the Kotakâ€™s Working Capital Division from scratch since 2012, contributing to many MSME success stories along the way. Continuing to work with clients as partners, Sunil has adept knowledge across sectors and understands the financial challenges that emerge for various SME businesses. He closely tracks technology trends & its impact opportunity across sectors. He has over 25 years of experience in the BFSI sector. Prior to Kotak Mahindra Bank, he was working for ICICI Bank in Institutional & Retail Banking businesses. He hails from Bikaner in Rajasthan. Sunil is passionate about sports & is a regular marathon runner.

name: Mr. Sunil Kulkarni
title: CEO
bio: Sunil Kulkarni is CEO of the Business Correspondents Federation of India (BCFI) (https://bcfi.org.in/about-us/who-we-are/ceos-desk/), an industry association for 70 Corporate BCs and 5 Payments Bank servicing close to 3 million BC Agents Pan India, since year 2020 to support BC industry ‚Äôs viability and business interest with finance ministry, regulator and banks. While operating BCFI for BC industry as ‚ÄúDeemed Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO)‚Äù since 2020, he is also driving BC industry towards new revenue streams on emerging financial services business such as Digitisation of SHG business, Digital Credit, Digital Commerce (ONDC), etc. He also advises select banks on Branchless Banking, Digital Payments, Digital Banking, and Digital Distribution, besides being Director/Independent Director on select Fintech‚Äôs boards. His past Advisory roles include The World Bank (CGAP), Facebook for WhatsApp Payments, Euronet Worldwide, and FIS Global. Sunil has over 36 years of cross-industry experience in technology-led businesses. In his last executive assignment (Dec 2019), he was the Joint MD for Oxigen Services, a company he helped build over 15 years. He took charge of Oxigen Services (then known as India Prepaid Services Pvt Ltd) as CEO in 2004. He and the Chairman jointly decided to launch in India‚ Äôs first e-Distribution Network for mobile recharge coupons and its dispensation over Point of Sale (PoS) terminals, PC, and SMS. He launched a viable Branchless Banking business model through a standard PoS as MicroATM with leading banks in India for Financial Inclusion. Sunil is also referred to as the techno-savvy brain behind developing a successful business model, using Technology, for varied services & products, including Oxigen‚Äôs Mobile Wallet, an innovative payment mechanism and prepaid wallet, accessible online/on-mobile way back in 2008 when there were no smartphones. Prior to joining Oxigen, Sunil served as General Manager-Marketing & Business Development in Motorola India‚ Äôs Wireless Infrastructure business for 9 years, starting in 1995. He looked after Business Development, Business Strategy, and Product Management functions for GSM & CDMA wireless technologies. He started his professional journey in 1986 with Siemens Ltd., where he last served as the Head of the Semi-Conductor Division. He is an Engineering Graduate in Electronics & Communication with a Gold medal in 1986 from Jodhpur and has done Management Education Program (1992-93) from IIM Ahmedabad.

name: Mr. Sunil Pandita
title: Vice President - Sales (India and South Asia)
bio: Sunil Pandita manages Newgen's sales and business operations in the South Asia geography. He has 20 years of progressive experience in the technology industry and has worked with several companies, including Samsung, Adobe, and IBM. Sunil is a regular presenter and keynote speaker at various industry forums. He is an alumnus of the Birla Institute of Technology and Science.

name: Mr. Suresh Darak
title: Founder
bio: Suresh Darak is a Chartered Accountant and bond expert with over 20 years of experience in the financial market. He was part of the core to set up L&T Infra Finance in 2006, which has since become the largest entity in its sector. During his tenure at L&T Financial Services, Suresh Darak led one of India's largest Debt Syndication and Credit-Oriented Bond Desks. Later, he founded Bondbazaar with a vision to provide retail investors easy access to the bond market. Bondbazaar has evolved into one of India's most innovative platforms, offering a solution-oriented marketplace where retail investors can buy and sell bonds as easily as equities.

name: Mr. Suresh Rajagopalan
title: CEO
bio: Suresh Rajagopalan, CEO of Wibmo, a PayU company and India's premier PayTech firm, brings over 25 years of invaluable expertise in global banking and payments. Since taking the helm in 2020, he has charted Wibmo's course with foresight, propelling the company to unparalleled growth. With pivotal roles in esteemed organizations like First Abu Dhabi Bank and Infosys Technologies Limited, Suresh has amassed diverse experience across product management, technology, and profit and loss management. In his prior capacities as CIO and COO of MENA banks, he spearheaded transformative initiatives while nurturing talent development. As he leads Wibmo's expansion into global markets, his goal is to reinforce its position as a leader in the PayTech sector, driving forward remarkable growth and technological advancement.

name: Mr. Suresh Sethi
title: Managing Director & CEO
bio: Suresh Sethi has over three decades of diversified global experience in the financial services industry and works extensively in the financial inclusion space, leveraging fintech and digital led innovation to make a difference He is currently the Managing Director CEO of Protean eGov Technologies Ltd. In his last role, as the Founder CEO MD of India Post Payments Bank, he established the largest interoperable banking infrastructure for public good at scale in India. Prior to India Post Payments Bank, as the Managing Director CEO of Vodafone M Pesa, he was responsible for defining and developing the M Pesa business strategy for India and shaping the digital and mobile payments space in the country In his earlier assignments, he has worked with leading financial services companies such as Citigroup and YES Bank across multiple geographies covering India, Kenya, UK, Argentina and US. Suresh has been a key industry spokesperson and closely engages with the government and regulatory institutions to aid policy formulation in a rapidly changing industry. For his contribution to the financial services sector, Suresh has been recognized by The Asian Banker and is part of The Asian Banker's "List of Leading Practitioners" He was also recognized as the CEO of the Year (India Post Payments Bank) at the India Banking Summit Awards, 2019

name: Mr. Sushant Majhi
title: Chief Risk Officer
bio: Mr. Sushant Majhi is the Chief Risk Officer at Indian Clearing Corporation Ltd (ICCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE. He has over 16 years of diverse experience across NBFCs, Investment Banks, and Hedge Funds. His area of expertise is Market Risk and Quantitative Analysis. He has rich experience in conceptualizing tailored risk solutions for Hedge Funds and ensuring compliance with investor and regulatory risk requirements. Prior to ICCL, he was leading the Risk & Portfolio Analytics services of Linedata Gravitas, following stints in the Strategic Risk Management division of Credit Suisse and the Global Risk Group of Edelweiss Financial Services. Educationally, Mr. Sushant holds a Post-Graduate degree in Business Management and a Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering. He is a certified Financial Risk Manager (FRM) by GARP and holds the Professional Risk Manager (PRM) designation from the Professional Risk Managers' International Association. Beyond his professional commitments, Mr. Sushant actively shares his knowledge as a visiting faculty, imparting insights on subjects such as Valuation and Financial Risk Management to MBA students.

name: Mr. Swaroop Kulkarni
title: Vice President - Product
bio: Swaroop is VP of Product Management at PayU. He has more than 12 years of experience in delivering products and solutions in Fintech space. In past he worked on building scalable payment solutions different payment instruments like Cards, UPI, EMI and Wallets. In his current role, he is focused on delivering payment platforms to solve specific use cases by bringing Checkout, Payments and Analytics together. This involves building Affordability Suite, Prepaid Stack, Offer and Reward Management, Subscriptions, Token Hub and Smart Router.

name: Mr. Swastik Nigam
title: Founder and Chief Executive Officer
bio: Swastik ran a multi-billion EUR global trading book on multi-asset products and a proprietary portfolio as a Director at Deutsche Bank, London. He has a decade of trading experience in equities, ETFs, fixed income, lending and currencies and is experienced in regulatory resolution of complex banking issues. He is an IIM-Ahmedabad graduate and previously chaired the IIM-A Alumni London Chapter. Swastik's entrepreneurial journey results from an unrelenting passion for simplifying global banking and investing from India. While in the UK, he had unmitigated access to multiple global financial products, which were inaccessible to developing countries like India. He saw great potential in building a platform that opens borders to Indian businesses and individuals. Essentially, pushing boundaries. If not in finance, Swastik could have been an author or a scientist. Outside of work, Swastik reads non-fiction for insights and spends his weekends enjoying stand-up comedy.

name: Mr. Syed Musheer Ahmed
title: Founder & MD
bio: Musheer has close to two decades of extensive experience in Capital Markets, Fintech and Virtual Assets, Since 2016, Musheer has contributed extensively to building the Fintech and Virtual Assets ecosystem in Asia, particularly as the co- founder & inaugural General Manager of the Fintech Association of Hong Kong and until recently as a regulator with Dubaiâ€™s VARA.

name: Mr. T Koshy
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr Koshy is the MD & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), a first-of-its-kind initiative globally to democratize e-commerce in India. Koshy is erudite with rich professional experience and expertise. An IIM Bangalore alumnus, he was part of the founding team of National Security Depository Limited (NSDL) and served as an Executive Director. He has also marked a remarkable stint in Ernst & Young leading key digital transformation initiatives. Mr Koshy has been a pioneer in Digital ID and social protection initiatives and has played a leadership role in many implementations and consulting projects globally including the UID project of India, the largest ID program in the world, along with many other Digital ID initiatives globally. Mr Koshy played a key role in the many digital transformation projects in India, including the transformation of Pension Systems in India, the development of the Tax Information Network and the formulation of IT strategy and IT architecture for the implementation of Goods & Service Tax in India. Mr Koshy has also assisted the World Bank with pension transformation projects and has been to China as a member of a pension reform mission. Mr Koshy has also served as a member of SEBI committees pertaining to the adoption of dematerialized settlement of securities and mutual funds as well as committees constituted by the RBI with reference to the Online Tax Accounting System for Direct and Indirect Tax. He has also been a member of the Sub Group on Technology of the Tax Administration Reform Commission of the Government of India constituted to recommend measures for reforms required in Tax Administration to enhance its effectiveness and efficiency for both Direct as well as Indirect tax. Mr Koshy played a significant role in several e-Government initiatives, including the Unique ID project, the Expenditure Information Network, the Project PLATINUM for the development of a legal and IT framework for the Ministry of Urban Development's guaranteed land title, the Common Data Repository for the Insurance Sector, the E-Stamping initiative, and the automation of VAT functions in a few Indian states.

name: Mr. Takeshi Kito
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Takeshi is a serial Fintech entrepreneur, and Co-founder & CEO of ELEVANDI Japan, actively spearheading ecosystem building and international collaborations. Additionally, he sits on the committee for the Government of Japan's Regulatory Sandbox and is a member of the experts group, jointly organized by the Digital Agency and the Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry focusing on international data governance. Before starting his own startup in the Fintech industry, Takeshi worked as an investment banker at Merrill Lynch, gaining expertise in capital markets. Prior to joining Merrill Lynch, he worked at Boston Consulting Group. He formerly served as Vice-chair at Fintech Association of Japan, where he played a pivotal role in navigating international collaborations for 6 years.

name: Mr. Tamal Bandyopadhyay
title: Consulting Editor
bio: Tamal Bandyopadhyay is an award winning author and columnist widely known for his weekly column on banking and finance -- Banker's Trust -- currently published in Business Standard every Monday. Starting his career with The Times of India, Tamal has worked with The Economic Times, Financial Express and Mint beside Business Standard. He also a Senior Advisor to Jana Small Finance Bank. He is the recipient of Ramnath Goenka Award for column; one of his seven best-selling books, "Pandemonium: The Great Indian Banking Tragedy" has won Tata Lit Live Award for the Best Business Book.

name: Mr. Tej Kapoor
title: Director / Partner
bio: Tej has over 17 years of experience in the VC industry. He invested in several businesses in e-commerce, logistics, content, media, internet and B2B information industries. Work experience spans in various geographies including the United States Of America, India, China and United Kingdom. Currently, he is Director / Partner at ICICI Venture. Previously he was Managing Partner at IvyCap Ventures, Global partner at Fosun and Head of Fosun RZ Capital India and South East Asia. He managed several portfolio companies and investment teams in multiple geographies. Tej has made 40+ angel investments in personal capacity. He‚Äôs looking to invest in exciting early and growth stage technology companies. At Fosun Tej lead investments in in India and South East Asia. Investments includes Delhivery, Ixigo, Kissht, DOT Pay, Desty, Mylo, Letstransport, Headfone, Makemytrip and Trell. Tej lead exit of Delhivery (IPO), Kissht and Ixigo (IPO bound). Previously Tej was county Head for Daily Mail Group of London where Tej lead investments in B2C and B2B businesses including Propstack, Liases Foras and Skymet (agri risk and data co), Also established Daily Mail India office. Before joining DMG, Tej was working for Naspers India as Strategy head. He was instrumental in expanding Naspers portfolio growth in India. He launched and managed e-commerce b2c businesses including Tradus.com (leading marketplace business) and acquired / invested in key businesses for Naspers including gaadi.com (auto classifieds), Buytheprice.com (e-commerce) and travelboutiqueonline.com. Tej held several key positions at AOL in the United States. He was Sr Manager for AOL e-commerce division. Tej was instrumental in expanding AOL's international presence through driving distribution and content deals in the Asia Pacific region, including India and China. He developed market entry strategies, recommending acquisition, joint venture, merger, and partnership targets. Lead deal origination, due diligence, and valuation processes. Build network of VC, PE and I-Banks. Tej holds Masters Degree in Business management from Johnson & Wales University and Bachelors degree in Business Management from Bangalore University. He also did executive education from Wharton Business School. Specialties: Venture capital / pportfolio management / leading teams / corporate strategy/ Mergers & Acquisitions/ Strategic Planning/ Business development/ / Deal origination and structuring/ Emerging technology

name: Mr. Tejash A Somaiya
title: General Manager
bio: Tejash Somaiya is currently working as General Manager - Trading Development at BSE. His role as a project and product manager encompasses key development projects on the Exchange’s core trading system and other real-time/online applications important for running trading related operations of the Exchange. He has been associated with BSE for 20 years since 2004, spending the initial 6 years in Business Development & Marketing forging strong relationships with market participants and gaining an overall exposure of the securities market ecosystem. Thereafter, moving into the Trading Development role, he has been instrumental in leading the development & implementation of several key milestone and mission critical projects across a diverse range of products and processes having significant market-wide impact. Some of the key projects he has been involved in, include the following among several others - a) Migration of Exchange’s core trading system to the new trading architecture of customized T7 trading system of Deutsche Borse. b) Implementation of real-time, pre-trade risk management features on the trading system. c) Implementation & Rohllout of Exchange’s real-time trading system & other systems supporting operations for India INX - BSE’s international Exchange at GIFT City as well as Hindustan Power Exchange (BSE subsidiary). d) Launch of Currency Derivatives, Commodity Derivatives and Electronic Gold Receipts segments. e) Implementation of systems for enabling online real-time communication between the Exchange trading system and risk management system of Clearing Corporations to facilitate Interoperability of Clearing Corporations. f) Enhancements to support relaunch of trading in Equity Derivatives segment Tejash has done his MBA with specialization in Marketing from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS) and holds a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy.

name: Mr. Tirth Shah
title: Founder
bio: Tirth Shah, Co-Founder of The Fixed Income, is working to revolutionize India's debt market. His mission is to make investment opportunities in the fixed income market accessible across the nation.

name: Mr. Tittu Varghese
title: Specialist Blockchain
bio: Mr. Tittu Varghese is associated with National Payments Corporation of India as a Specialist in Blockchain. His current responsibilities includes solutioning and building scalable and resilient distributed systems and blockchain applications.

name: Mr. Trevor Tay
title: Senior Vice President
bio: Trevor Tay has worked in payments and technology for over 20 years. Currently, he is the Senior Vice President for Card Acquiring Global Expansion at Nuvei, a Toronto Stock Exchange and NASDAQ listed Payment Services Provider that delivers to businesses pay-in and payout options including card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services, and enables them to accept more than 600 alternative payment methods. During his time in payments, Trevor has worked extensively with technology, operations and marketing teams across the payments ecosystem to deliver innovative, consumer centric payment experiences. This includes developing and launching partnerships with Apple Pay, PayPal, Klarna, Stripe, Adyen and AfterPay with Visa as well as expanding acquiring via 3rd party acquiring partnerships and direct acquiring into Latin America, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

name: Mr. Tushar Agnihotri
title: Executive Vice President-India & APAC
bio: Tushar Agnihotri heads the India & APAC regions for Route Mobile and is responsible for driving sales and operations for the India market. He holds a master‚Äôs degree in business management from Bundelkhand University. He has 25 years of overall work experience, with over 16 years of experience in the telecom sector. Prior to joining our Company, he has worked with Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited, Reliance JioInfocom Limited, Arvind Mills Limited, Kodak India Limited, Reliance Infocomm Limited and Blowplast Limited.

name: Mr. Ugur Tigli
title: CTO
bio: Ugur Tigli is CTO at MinIO. In his current role, Ugur oversees enterprise strategy and interfaces with MinIO‚Äôs enterprise client base. He helps them architect and deploy API-driven, cloud native and scalable enterprise-grade data infrastructure using MinIO. Ugur has almost two decades of experience building high-performance data infrastructure for global financial institutions. Prior to MinIO, he was a technology leader at Bank of America, where he served as the Senior Vice President and global Head of Hardware Engineering. Ugur joined BofA through the acquisition of Merrill Lynch where he was the Vice President for Storage Engineering. Ugur has a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Lafayette College.

name: Mr. V Chandrasekar
title: Senior Advisor, Corporate & International Banking
bio: Mr. V Chandrasekar is Senior Advisor at IBA. He has a 33 years€™ experience in banking sector. He retired as General Manager, State Bank of India in 2020. He has handled various portfolios in SBI which includes Corporate Credit (Large), Mid Corporate Accounts, Retail Banking, Agricultural/Rural Banking, Trade Finance, Resolution of Stressed Assets. Later he joined IBA in 2021, wherein he worked in domain of Corporate & International Banking, ESG, Taxation (Direct & Indirect).

name: Mr. Vaibhav Tambe
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Vaibhav Tambe, Co-Founder & CEO of TransBnk, is hustling for enterprising excellence in BFSI & Fintech with combination of Strong functional and Product knowledge & is building TransBnk - Transaction Banking Infrastructure for various Banks, Fintech, Corporate,Commercial, Institutional clients with latest technologies like AI / ML & Blockchain.
