Key Primary vision is on transformation of Transaction Banking Products like Payments, Cash Management, Escrows, Remittances & Trade / Channel Finance, which constitutes the Core Transactional activity for Corporate / Institutions. He is conferred with many International & domestic accolades for his various successful stints & he is also the founding Member of India Blockchain Forum. In Blockchain space, Vaibhav is also the Advisory Board Member for Blostem Fintech & Extolabs USA.

name: Mr. Vaidyanathan Vembu
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr. V. Vaidyanathan took over as the MD and CEO of IDFC FIRST Bank in December 2018 after the merger of Capital First and IDFC Bank. He worked with Citibank from 1990-2000. He joined ICICI Bank in 2000 and set up its Retail Banking division. He was appointed to the Board of Directors of ICICI Bank in 2006 at age 38. He took the branch network to 1411, built a large CASA book, and built retail lending including mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards of â‚¹ 1.35 trillion ($30 bn) by 2009. He became the MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life insurance in 2009. Chasing an entrepreneurial opportunity, he left the ICICI group in 2010 and acquired about 10% equity in a small, listed, real-estate financing NBFC with a market cap of â‚¹ 780 crores ($140m, 2012) with an idea to convert it to a commercial Bank. To raise the required funds of â‚¹ 78 crores ($14m), he pledged the purchased stock and his home as collateral. He then discontinued the NBFC’s existing businesses of Real Estate financing, equity broking, and Forex Business and instead started financing Retail & MSME clients for â‚¹ 5000 to â‚¹ 1 crore($100-$200K), using tech-led algorithms. He demonstrated the proof of concept of Retail and MSME financing to Private Equity players and raised fresh equity of â‚¹ 810 crores ($140m) in 2012, recapitalised the company, and became its Chairman and CEO. He then reconstituted the Board and renamed the company Capital First. Capital First successfully lent to 7 million customers and grew the retail loan book from â‚¹ 94 crores ($14 m) in 2010 to â‚¹ 29,600 crores ($4 b) by 2018, with high asset quality of Gross and net NPA of around 2% and 1% respectively for over 8 years. Between 2010 and 2018, the Company turned around from losses of â‚¹ 30 crores ($5 m) to profit of â‚¹ 358 crores ($50 m). The share price increased 7X from â‚¹ 122 (2010) to â‚¹ 845 (2018), and the market cap increased 10X from â‚¹ 780 crores ($120m) to â‚¹ 8200 crores ($1.2 b). Since his ownership in the company was acquired by him through leverage, he sold 1.5% of Capital First in 2017 at â‚¹ 688 a share to partially close the loan taken to acquire the shares. Having built Capital First to scale, he looked out for a commercial banking license to convert it to a Bank. In 2018, opportunity struck in the form of an offer for merger from IDFC Bank. He led the integration of the two institutions and took over as the MD and CEO of the merged bank, renamed to IDFC FIRST Bank.

name: Mr. Vamsi Madhav
title: CEO
bio: Vamsi is currently the CEO of one of India's leading account aggregators, Finvu AA. He has previously been the COO and a founding team member of DigiSahamati Foundation, a non-profit collective of the account aggregator (AA) ecosystem in India. Vamsi has over 20 years of experience in fintech product management, building award-winning products in the areas of core banking, payment systems and digital financial services. At Finvu and previously at Sahamati, Vamsi has had the opportunity to contribute to the growth of the Open Finance movement in India. He is passionate about enabling financial inclusion, wealth inclusion and empowerment for millions of Indians through the AA framework. Vamsi is an alumnus of IIM Lucknow and NIT Trichy.

name: Mr. Varun Dudeja
title: Head - Business Development APAC
bio: Varun Dudeja is Head of Business Development at Pismo, the cloud-native provider of an all-in-one platform for banking, payments, and infrastructure. With over 15 years of experience in the financial services industry, Varun spearheads Pismo’s goal of bringing next-generation banking and payments to APAC’s financial institutions. He manages the regional expansion of Pismo's platform. This means collaborating with major banks, neo-banks, marketplaces, and fintechs to deliver innovative and scalable solutions.

name: Mr. Vasanth Jeyapaul
title: CEO, CAMSPay
bio: Vasanth is a Driven Professional in a Disruptive Industry with 25+ years of payment and related industry experience. He is part of the Executive Management team of CAMS Group and is the Chief Operating Officer of CAMSPay. Vasanth has thus far managed Large Scale Business Operations, Business Development, Sales & Delivery Management for EFT, ATMs, Payment Gateway, Transaction Processing, and in Payments Domain. The Chicago Booth alumnus has had an exceptional career in the industry with more emphasis on Strategy, Product Development, Commercialisation, etc with BFSI in India, the Middle East, and South Asia. He is qualified to serve as an Independent Director on boards of public companies. He is also an active mentor to various Indian start-ups.

name: Mr. Vasanth Kamath
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Vasanth Kamath is the founder & CEO at smallcase, India's leading provider of investment & technology solutions to capital market players. smallcase's mission is to help every investor build better portfolios and its platforms are trusted by the largest & most respected brands and institutions in the Indian financial services space. He is excited for the confluence of technology & asset management and also serves as a trustee director at Zerodha Fund House - a digital-first passive-only asset manager.

name: Mr. Venkat Bhargav Sreedhara
title: Financial Sector Specialist
bio: Venkat Bhargav Sreedhara is a Financial sector specialist with the South Asia team of the World Bank. He works on development financing and technical assistance projects across financial sector issues such as climate finance, MSME access to finance, housing finance, fintech and others. He has worked on several large projects with the Government of India on green hydrogen, climate finance and MSME financing. Previously, Venkat worked with the Reserve Bank of India on financial regulation and supervision for banks and NBFCs, and with the Ministry of Finance on supporting the Finance track during Indiaâ€™s G20 Presidency in 2023.

name: Mr. Venkataramani Prakash
title: Senior Director Payments
bio: Venkataramani Prakash is a thought leader in the payments and cross-border remittance industry, renowned for his ability to drive innovation and streamline processes in the complex world of cross-border payments. As the Senior Director of Payments at Flywire, Prakash is responsible for shaping the payments strategy not only for India but also for new client markets, positioning him at the forefront of the global payments landscape. His extensive leadership experience at prominent organizations like EBIXCASH and Thomas Cook has seen him spearheading transformative initiatives, particularly in the realm of API-based plugins, which have significantly enhanced the efficiency and scalability of cross border remittances. Prakash's deep expertise is reflected in his widely published works on the evolving global payments ecosystem, featured in prestigious publications like the Journal of Payment Strategy and Systems. His contributions have garnered international acclaim, including his recognition as a Global Talent by the UK's Tech Nation, a prominent catalyst body affiliated with the UK government. With a keen focus on cross-border payments and settlements, Prakash remains a pivotal figure in the payments sector, continually influencing policy, technology, and best practices on a global scale.

name: Mr. Venkatesh Naidu
title: CEO
bio: Venkatesh Naidu is the visionary leader of Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Ltd, bringing over 20 years of experience in the insurance industry. He is known for his strategic insight, passion for excellence and relentless drive for innovation. As CEO, Venkatesh has played a pivotal role in the company's rapid growth and success, positioning Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Ltd as one of the leading insurance broking companies in India. He is deeply committed to providing comprehensive solutions to individuals and businesses and is widely respected for his expertise in insurance broking and risk management. Prior to joining Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Ltd, Venkatesh held various leadership positions in well-known insurance companies in India. He was responsible for managing and growing multiple business lines, and his expertise and leadership helped the company to achieve significant growth. Venkatesh has always been at the forefront of the latest trends and developments in the insurance industry, ensuring that Bajaj Capital Insurance Broking Ltd stays ahead of the curve. Venkatesh's leadership style is characterized by his ability to anticipate and adapt to industry trends, and his unwavering focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. Under his guidance, the company has built a strong reputation for quality, reliability and innovation. He is also actively involved in community service and is a mentor to young professionals in the insurance sector. He holds a bachelor's degree in commerce and a master's degree in insurance and risk management. Venkatesh is a regular speaker at industry events and conferences, where he shares his insights on the latest trends in the insurance industry and provides valuable guidance to fellow professionals.

name: Mr. Vibhav Hathi
title: Co-founder & CBO
bio: Vibhav Hathi is the Co-founder and CBO at FPL Technologies. He is passionate about consumer lending, providing digital first credit solutions for Banks/FIs, customer segmentation, analytics, and digital payments. Vibhav has over 20 years of experience in the banking and financial services industry. During his 15 year tenure at ICICI Bank, he headed multiple businesses related to credit and prepaid cards, consumer payments, transit, etc. He was instrumental in launching FASTAG, India's first Electronic Toll Collection Solution, which currently contributes to 23% of the collection of tolls on National Highways. He pursued Chemical Engineering from The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda and later went on to complete his MBA in Strategy and Marketing from IIM Kolkata.

name: Mr. Vibhor Mundhada
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Vibhor is a seasoned C- level executive, having extensive leadership experience in managing digital payments and fintech businesses with leading banks, fintechs and consulting firms across India and the Middle East. Currently he is the CEO of NEOPAY, which is the digital payments and fintech subsidiary of Mashreq. Vibhor was the Senior Vice President, Head of Acquiring and Wallets business at Mashreq, before being appointed as the CEO of NEOPAY. In his current role as the CEO, he is responsible for managing the acquiring business, digital payments, payment processing as well providing value-added services like data monetization, BNPL etc. Vibhor holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering and an MBA from a top tier B-school in India. In his role as CEO of NEOPAY, he has also led investments for NEOPAY and Mashreq in some of the regions leading fintech: 1. Cashew- BNPL provider 2. NymCard- Saas Based, API first banking/digital payments solution provider 3. TouchÃ©- specialized merchant solution for FnB and Hospitality. In addition, he also provides thought-leadership through many non-executive directorial positions, like: 1. Director and board member of NoonPay- a JV between Mashreq and Noon to drive wallets and digital payments. 2. Shareholder representative for Mashreq at Emirates Digital Wallet. 3. Chairman of the Acquiring and Digital payments committee of the UAE Banks federation (UBF)

name: Mr. Vignesh Mohan
title: Chief Executive Officer
org: IIT Jodhpur Technology Innovation and Startup Center
bio: Vignesh Mohan is a seasoned professional with a remarkable career dedicated to fostering innovation and entrepreneurship. He has played a pivotal role in the Government of Tamil Nadu in shaping the innovation landscape of the state. In this capacity, he oversaw the state's innovation and incubation ecosystem, leaving an indelible mark by facilitating startup grants for over 500 ventures. His commitment to fostering entrepreneurship extends to academia, where he has actively supported numerous universities and academic institutions in establishing incubators. Vignesh's strategic vision and hands-on approach have contributed significantly to the growth of the startup ecosystem in the region. Currently serving as the Chief Executive Officer at the IIT Jodhpur Technology Innovation and Startup Center, Vignesh continues to drive innovation and nurture the next generation of entrepreneurs. His leadership and expertise make him a dynamic force in the world of technology, innovation, and startup development.

name: Mr. Vijay Chandok
title: MD & CEO
bio: Mr. Vijay Chandok is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of ICICI Securities Ltd. from May 2019. He has been with the ICICI Group over 30 years. Prior to his current assignment, he served as the Executive Director on the Board of ICICI Bank. He also served as a Director on the Boards of ICICI Bank UK PLC Ltd, ICICI Bank Canada Ltd., ICICI Bank (Eurasia) Limited and was the Chairman of ICICI Investment Management Company Limited. During his years at ICICI Bank, he was responsible for the International Banking, Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) businesses, Global Markets and Commercial Banking Businesses. He also served the bank in the retail banking group, rural and agri group and the corporate banking group over the years. He was a member of the Advisory Committee of NSE, BSE and NSDL and a member of the Secondary Markets Advisory Committee constituted by SEBI. He is also a Co-Chair of the Capital Market Committee of FICCI and currently in the Expert Panel of ICICI Prudential AMC‚ Real Estate Business. Mr. Chandok holds a Master’s degree of Mumbai University in Management Studies (MMS) from Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai. He also holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University), Varanasi (formerly IT BHU). In 2017, Mr. Chandok was conferred with a Distinguished Alumnus Award from NMIMS University.

name: Mr. Vijay Gupta
title: Executive Vice President
bio: Management professional with more than 25 years of experience in end-to-end leadership of projects while keeping business vision, regulatory assurance, customer service, product & technology innovation at the core. Been associated with e-Governance, automation, industry collaboration, capital markets and payment systems projects. NSDL has been my home.

name: Mr. Vijay Krishnamurthy
title: Interin CEO
bio: Shri. Vijay Krishnamurthy is currently designated as Interim Chief Executive Officer. With rich and varied experience of over 20 years in investment research and products across asset classes, with an expertise in Fixed Income markets. He has worked closely with regulators and institutional clients for the development of capital markets in India. Prior to this assignment, he was General Manager, BSE, Fixed Income. Academically sound, with qualification in PGDBA- Finance and Marketing and a Commerce Graduate from Mumbai University, has been instrumental in leading the development and implementation of Request for Quote (RFQ) platform, security level valuations, debt, and hybrid indices for the Indian markets. His active participation and contribution in several SEBI committees/sub-committees/working group has helped in shaping up some of the policies for debt markets and indices.

name: Mr. Vijay Shekhar Sharma
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Vijay Shekhar Sharma is an Indian technology entrepreneur who has played an instrumental role in revolutionizing the digital payments and financial services landscape in India as the Chairman, Managing Director and CEO of One97 Communications and its consumer brand Paytm. Under his guidance, Paytm is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy. He is a strong believer in the power of emerging technology and a true supporter of Indiaâ€™s journey to become a fully digital economy. With this vision, Paytm pioneered the digital payments revolution in India by taking the QR code to every small shop in the country and is now driving financial inclusion in India with offerings across lending, wealth, insurance and more. He has been featured in â€˜2017 Time 100â€™ list of â€˜hundred most influential people in the worldâ€™ by Time magazine. Vijay has also been bestowed with multiple industry honours such as the â€˜Entrepreneur of the Yearâ€™ award in 2018 by All India Management Association, â€™Entrepreneur of the Yearâ€™ at ET Awards for Corporate Excellenceâ€™ in 2016 and â€˜GQ Man of the Yearâ€™ in 2016.

name: Mr. Vikas Bansal
title: CEO
bio: Vikas is founding member and CEO of Amazon Pay India. In the last 8 years, Vikas has built Amazon Pay verticals including wallet, UPI, Pay Later, co-brand card, Payment aggregator and steered company in the financial services including Insurance and Wealth management. Some of his noteworthy achievements including: pioneering the co-brand card space where he developed unique unlimited value proposition with no hidden T&Cs and getting instant card in 1 minute while checking out for items and using the card for that particular purchase. He drove adoption of digital onboarding journeys and Amazon Pay card was the first credit card to launch Video KYC in India. In less than 6 years, this card has become the leading card portfolio in India surpassing many large bank credit card portfolios. He also invented Pay later proposition which has unique proposition of Pay next month or in EMIs without fees and with full digital journey leveraging India stack. This product has acquired more than 90 lacs users with more than 30% are new to credit. He also drove UPI expansion with the first product of Wallet on UPI in India driving added convenience to customers. Amazon Pay wallet has more than 5 crore users and Amazon Pay UPI has more than 10 crore users. Before India, Vikas drove transformational impact in Fintech industry in USA and many more countries with his global stints with American Express, Visa and Fiserv. Vikas holds MBA degree with Honors from Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania and is a Chartered Accountant from ICAI.

name: Mr. Vikram Vaidyanathan
title: Managing Director
bio: Vikram is a Managing Director at Matrix Partners India, an early-stage investment firm with more than $1.5 billion under management. Vikram has personally led multiple investments and is a board member of market leading companies such as Razorpay, Five Star Finance, Of Business, Daily hunt-Josh, Oxyzo, Mswipe and Jupiter. Vikram was recognized at 40 under Forty by Economic Times and nominated for the Economic Times Midas touch award twice (2021/2022) and is an Aspen Institute fellow. Matrix India has invested in several market leading companies including Ola, One Card, Deal share, Ola Electric, MoEngage and Country Delight. At Matrix for the last ~14 years, he leads the Bangalore office at Matrix India and invests in early start-ups usually before they have a product in market or any meaningful revenue scale. Currently he is exploring ideas in Financial Services, Global software and B2B, and guides Matrix’s teams in these areas. He is an MBA from IIM Bangalore and an engineer trained at RVCE Bangalore. Vikram started out as an engineer in technology companies and was a management consultant at McKinsey. Vikram is on the board for Centre for Wildlife Studies, India’s leading non-profit in the wildlife conservation space.

name: Mr. Vikrant Bangia
title: Chief Operating Officer, Lending
bio: With a distinguished career spanning over two decades, Vikrant Bangia serves as the Chief Operating Officer for Lending Business at Paytm. He has been instrumental in launching and scaling both co-branded credit card and personal loan offerings at Paytm, significantly enhancing the lives of millions of Indian customers and merchants. Drawing on his extensive experience in the lending industry, Vikrant has a deep understanding of the financial services sector and a proven track record of driving business growth. His expertise in execution and strategic leadership is evident from his previous roles at Bajaj Finance Ltd, where he spearheaded Business roles both for Secured and Unsecured loans and also the Centre of Excellence for Rural Lending. Vikrant earned his postgraduate degree from IIM Kolkata and his undergraduate degree from HBTI Kanpur.

name: Mr. Vinay Kumar Sankarapu
title: CEO & Founder
bio: Vinay Kumar Sankarapu is the Founder and CEO of Arya.ai. He did his Bachelor's and Master's in Mechanical Engineering at IIT Bombay, where his research was in Deep Learning. He started Arya.ai in 2013 when he was at IIT B, along with Deekshith, to democratize Deep Learning. Since then, Vinay has been working with multiple enterprises in regulated industries like Banks, Insurers, and Financial Services. Vinay Kumar leads R&D of AryaXAI product where the team is primarily aiming to build Safe Superintelligence. He wrote multiple guest articles on â€˜Responsible AIâ€™, â€˜AI usage risks in BFSIsâ€™ and â€˜AI Governance frameworkâ€™. He presented multiple technical and industry presentations globally - Nvidia GTC (SF & Mumbai), ReWork (SF & London), Cypher (Bangalore), Nasscom(Bangalore), TEDx (Mumbai) etc. He was the youngest member of â€˜AI task forceâ€™ set up by the Indian Commerce and Ministry in 2017. He was listed in Forbes Asia 30-Under-30 under the technology section.

name: Mr. Vineet Chattree
title: Managing Director
bio: Vineet has a rich experience of 25+ years across Operations and Management Consulting in India, USA, and Middle East. His passion for serving the financial excluded segment and strategic thinking has enabled both Svatantra Microfin and Svatantra Micro Housing map out an accelerated, differentiated, and sustainable growth path to emerge as amongst the most impactful and respected entities in their own arena. Svatantra began its journey about a decade ago with a Vision of its Founder and Chairperson Ms Ananya Birla, to offer host of financial services EWS and LIG customers in the informal segment. Vineet has helped realise this vision which has created impact in more than 3.3 Mn household, over the last 10 years, with Svatantra Microfin and Svatantra Micro housing achieve USD 1.1 bn assets under management. Vineet firmly believes that an organization can sustainably grow, only if it creates a meaningful difference in the lives of its customers and this can be achieved by aligning all the 3Ps of business i.e. ‘People, Product, and Processes’ with customers’ needs. A continuous learner, Vineet is a Chemical Engineering graduate and has two master’s degree in business administration and business Laws. He has attended executive program in The Wharton School. Vineet is Managing Director at Svatantra Microfin Pvt. Ltd. and Director on Svatantra Micro Housing Finance Corporation Ltd. He has served on the Board of MFIN, an SRO for the microfinance industry. He loves reading and is an avid trekker and Marathoner.

name: Mr. Vineet Singh
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Vineet Singh is a seasoned entrepreneur with 25+ years of experience in various sectors including Payments, PropTech, E-commerce & Classifieds. He has achieved stupendous success with Naukri & 99acres as market leaders. In his last role at Mobikwik, he served as the Chief Business Officer. Castler is India's largest Trust-as-a-Service platform and provides Escrow Infrastructure to over 600 Enterprises and manages over Rs.10000 cr in escrow transactions every month. Castler has just launched Castler code, India's first Cloud-Native Software Escrow Platform to expand its suite of Escrow Services for Enterprises.

name: Mr. Vineet Sukumar
title: Founder & Managing Director
bio: Vineet Sukumar is the Promoter and MD of Vivriti Group that comprises of Vivriti Capital (VC), a fintech NBFC incorporated in 2017 and Vivriti Asset Management (VAM), a registered asset manager of fixed-income alternative investment funds incorporated in 2019. Vineet has 21 years of experience in financial services and is an industry expert in debt capital markets, performing credits, financial inclusion and asset management. Vineet has completed his education from IIT, Kharagpur and IIM, Bangalore.

name: Mr. Vinit Bajaj
title: EVP & Head- Credit Cards,Debit Cards & Prepaid Cards

name: Mr. Vinod Parmar
title: Group CFO
bio: Vinod heads the finance and strategy functions as the newly appointed Group CFO at Vayana - India’s largest supply chain finance network. He is actively involved in driving investor relations as he brings solid expertise in the domain of M&As. In his previous role at Vayana, Vinod headed the Global Sales & Marketing for the Group. He is established in the Financial Services space for close to two decades, focusing on Trade, SME businesses, and Investment Management. This includes senior roles with leading banks like Barclays and ICICI Bank. As an alumnus of Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore with his engineering degree from the University of Pune, Vinod brings with him a 360-degree view on business and products which makes Vayana well-poised for the next phase of growth.

name: Mr. Vipin V
title: Managing Director & Partner - India Tech in FI Head

name: Mr. Vipul Jain
title: Partner
bio: Vipul Jain is a Partner at AZB & Partners, a premier full-service law firm in India. Vipul specializes in Financial Services & Fintech, Mergers & Acquisitions, Private Equity Investments, General Corporate, and Regulatory Practice & Securities Laws. Vipul represents a broad range of clients that includes banks, non-banking finance companies (NBFCs), FinTechs, asset management companies, securities market intermediaries, multinational corporates and financial institutions on transactional assignments (domestic and cross-border) as well as regulatory aspects. Vipul is also a regular speaker, including on industry forums, on issues/ aspects pertaining to the FinTech and Data Privacy & Protection space in India and has been consistently recognised by Chambers & Partners, IFLR1000 and Legal 500 Asia Pacific for his work in this space.

name: Mr. Vishal Ahuja
title: Director
bio: Vishal is a seasoned professional with over 20 years of experience in financial analysis and strategic consulting for banks and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs). He excels in guiding these institutions through go-to-market (GTM) strategies, competitive benchmarking, and product development. Vishal has a proven track record of helping banks and NBFCs identify and develop competitive products and schemes. His expertise in location intelligence, bolstered by advanced AI and Machine Learning (AI/ML) solutions, enables financial institutions to optimize branch placement and resource allocation, maximizing outreach and profitability. In his previous role as Director of Funds and Fixed Income Research at CRISIL, Vishal contributed significantly to the Investment Product Research practice, developing industry benchmarks and performance metrics for various financial products.

name: Mr. Vishal Anand Kanvaty
title: Chief Technology Officer
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )

name: Mr. Vishal Dalal
title: CEO - International Markets
bio: Vishal Dalal leads global go-to-market and product strategy for Visa's Foundation Solutions. Significantly, this role includes operating as the international CEO (North America, EMEA, and APAC) for Pismo, a next-generation banking platform provider acquired by Visa in 2024. Vishal joined Pismo in 2021 and has spearheaded the firm's expansion overseas into markets including the US, India, Singapore, and the UK.

name: Mr. Vishal Goenka
title: Co-founder
bio: Vishal has over two decades of experience in fixed-income, currency, and credit (FICC) markets. He is a seasoned expert and leader known for his strategic vision and comprehensive understanding of financial markets. His illustrious career spans major international investment banks like Deutsche Bank, Merrill Lynch, and RBS in London and Singapore. Vishal's journey began in Mumbai, but it was at Merrill Lynch in London where he launched his international career, honing his skills as a credit flow trader and establishing the bank's credit proprietary desk. At Deutsche Bank Singapore, he spent 12 years in various leadership roles across Sales & Trading, most notably as Managing Director and Head of Credit for Institutional Clients in the Asia Pacific region. Deeply involved in India's credit market, Vishal has worked on restructuring stories, NCLT resolutions, and corporate financing. An MBA from London Business School, his career also includes a stint as CEO of a stockbroking firm in Mumbai and a role at RBS in London. Today, as a Co-Founder of IndiaBonds, Vishal leverages his vast experience to shape the digital future of India's bond market.

name: Mr. Vishal Gupta
title: Vice President - Digital Transformation
bio: A seasoned professional with over 25 years of experience in business consulting, product design, and development, large transformation program management, and collaborating with Fintechs across the US, Europe, and Asia for Central banks, Central Securities Depositories, Custodians, Investment banks, Brokerage houses, Investment managers, Wealth management firms and 401k benefits administration. As a Vice President of Technology at NSDL, Vishal Gupta is responsible for all the Digital Transformation Initiatives and adoption of innovative technology solutions for delivering digital products and services in the post-trade services domain. Over the last 5 years at NSDL, Vishal has anchored many multi-year transformation programs such as Blockchain-based DLT platform for Security and Covenant Monitoring for Debenture Markets, Integrated Collateral Management Platform, Digital Loan Against Securities, NSDL’s proprietary DEMAT API Gateway with over 200+ successful integrations with NSDL Business Partners and NSDL’s flagship product ‘STEADY’ for Electronic Contract Note Management [similar to OMGEO / OASYS at DTCC]. These programs are targeted at building platform-based solutions for enabling ‘Ease of doing Business’ for NSDL Business Partners. He also anchors the DevOps product roadmap at NSDL. Vishal is also a member of the various capital market industry forums and represents NSDL at the International Securities Services Group [ISSA, Zurich] in the DLT Blockchain Working Group and is also the Convenor of the Technical Task Force at Asia-Pacific CSD Group [ACG]. Prior to NSDL, Vishal was a Consulting Partner in TCS BFS Capital Markets Consulting, US Geography, and responsible for domain-led consulting sales and technology solutions. Vishal was the recipient of NEXT100 Future CIO 2023 by IT NEXT / 9.9 Group and adjudged as the Top 100 Innovators in India at BIG CIO Awards by TRESCON International. As a Technology Owner for NSDL’s Blockchain Platform, Vishal received the award for ‘Best Use of Blockchain in Fintech’ at Fintech India Expo in Jan’24 at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi. Vishal is a Mechanical Engineer from the National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra and a Certified SAFE Product Owner and PMP Practitioner. He has also completed Executive Program from MIT Sloan Institute of Management on ‘Digital Business Essentials, Digital Strategy and Innovation’.

name: Mr. Vishal Kampani
title: Non Executive Vice Chairman
bio: Mr. Kampani joined the JM Financial Group in 1997 in Investment Banking and subsequently worked with Morgan Stanley in New York. Upon his return to India in the year 2000, Mr. Kampani joined JM Morgan Stanley (Joint Venture between JM Financial Group and Morgan Stanley) and pivoted Corporate Finance within the Investment Bank. He went on to head the Corporate Finance Division. Post 2008, Mr. Kampani played an instrumental role in identifying new growth opportunities and further diversifying the business of the JM Financial Group, including private credit business, private equity business and expansion of the capital markets business. Mr. Kampani was appointed as Managing Director of JM Financial Limited in 2016 and was subsequently appointed as non-executive Vice Chairman in 2021. He also strategized JM Financial Group‚Äôs foray into the housing finance business through JM Financial Home Loans Limited in 2017. Under his leadership, JM Financial Limited successfully raised equity funds in 2018 and 2020 from marquee domestic and global investors. In a career spanning over two and a half decades, Mr. Kampani has played a defining role in ideating and consummating several landmark and transformational M&A, fund raising and restructuring transactions. In addition, he has strategized JM Financial Group‚Äôs expansion across the spectrum of financial services. Mr. Kampani has been working extensively with Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) in several roles in the BFSI Sector. He is a member of Primary Market Advisory Committee, SEBI. Mr. Kampani was awarded The Economic Times "40 under 40" in 2016. Mr. Kampani has completed his MS (Finance) from London Business School, University of London.

name: Mr. Vishnu Pillai
title: Partner- Head of Financial Service Technology
bio: Vishnu has 20 years experience in consulting and industry. Having worked in multiple sectors, he now leads KPMG's financial services technology consulting vertical.

name: Mr. Vishranth Suresh
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Vishranth is the Co-founder and CEO of AssetPlus. A graduate of IIT Madras with a passion for finance, he is guided by the conviction that Mutual Fund Distributors play a crucial role in India's wealth management ecosystem. AssetPlus empowers these distributors to better serve their clients and grow their businesses digitally. Today, AssetPlus is one of the leading platforms, partnering with over 10,000 MFDs across India.

name: Mr. Vishwas Patel
title: Joint Managing Director
bio: Vishwas Patel is currently the Chairman of Payments Council of India (PCI), the primary industry body representing all the digital payments providers in India. PCI works closely with the regulators i.e. RBI, Finance Ministry and other government departments and bodies to make ‘India a less cash society’. Vishwas also serves as a member in various RBI committees to deepen digital payments in India. For the past 23 years, he has made significant contributions towards giving shape and direction to the digital payments industry in various capacities. Mr. Patel is also a successful payments entrepreneur and the Executive Director at Infibeam Avenues Limited, the first e-Commerce and Fintech company listed on the Indian Stock Exchange, and one of India’s leading digital payments and e-commerce technology solutions providers with an extensive global footprint. He is also the Founder & CEO of prominent SaaS solutions such as CCAvenue payment gateway, ResAvenue hotel booking platform and BillAvenue, an RBI-licensed operating unit of Bharat BillPay, India’s largest interoperable billing network. CCAvenue is among the top payment aggregators in India and also ranks number 2 in the UAE among non-bank private digital payment companies. Under his able leadership, Infibeam Avenues has developed a full stack payments portfolio covering Payments Acquiring, Payments Issuance, Domestic and International Remittance and Assisted Commerce in financial services. Vishwas has studied law and was a practicing counsel on the original side of the Bombay High Court. In recognition of his path-breaking accomplishments and stellar contributions as an industry leader in the Indian Fintech sector over the past two decades, he has been conferred many awards such as Economic Times Leadership Excellence Awards 2022, ‘Entrepreneur of the Year in Service Business – SaaS & IT’ at the Entrepreneur Awards 2020, Intellectual Explorer Award 2020, ‘Payments Entrepreneur of the Year’ accolade at the Payments & Cards Awards 2019 and the Asia Pacific Information Security Leadership Achievements Award 2007.

name: Mr. Viswanath Krishnamurthy
title: Chief Risk Officer
org: National Payments Corporation of India ( NPCI )

name: Mr. Vivek Belgavi
title: FinTech, Alliances & Ecosystems leader
bio: Vivek established fintech practice in PwC India and has worked with incumbents, startups, policy makers, investors, and accelerators on variety of areas including new market entry, due diligence, digital and ecosystem strategy, and building platforms. He is currently leading alliances and ecosystems through which he is enabling new capabilities and solutions to his customers delivered through collaboration with a community of solvers.

name: Mr. Vivek Gupta
title: President
bio: Vivek Gupta is President, Head - Wholesale Banking Products, Axis Bank. In his current role, Vivek has accountability for Axis Bank’s Product Businesses across Payments and Cash Management, Trade & Supply Chain, Current Account Liabilities, Custody & Capital Markets and Axis's Gift City International Business Unit. He is also on the Management Committee of the Bank. Vivek has extensive international experience in building and transforming Transaction Banking Businesses and in Regulatory Advocacy, across Asia Pacific. Before joining Axis Bank, Vivek was Global Head of Trade & Supply Chain for ANZ and Co-Head of Cash Management Product. He also was a Global Board Member at BAFT and Chair of the BAFT Asia-Pacific Council. Vivek was closely involved with building out eTradeConnect, the Blockchain Platform launched by Banks in Hong Kong with strong support by the Regulator HKMA. Vivek has additionally worked in HSBC, Rabobank and Standard Chartered across Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore, Eastern Europe and India. Vivek holds an MBA from Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad and a Bachelor of Technology from Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) , Dhanbad.

name: Mr. Vivek Mandhata
title: Managing Director & Partner - India Payments Head

name: Mr. Vivek Singh
title: VP - Payments Product
bio: A bureaucrat from West Bengal with extensive experience in policy framing, project ideation to execution and leading the State in emerging technology adoption. Having done masters in Physics, Management and Law along with specialisation & certifications in cyber strategy, cyber law & cyber forensics, training & development and IPR among others; he is now the Additional Secretary in IT&E Dept, State Information Security Officer & Managing Director, WEBEL. He topped the first National Cyber Security Scholar Programme with Honours in 2020. Led the State to win numerous national laurels for Karmobhumi, the State IT/ITeS Skill Registry, Anumati, the State Single Window Portal for ROW Clearance; Cyber Assurance Programme - State Level Security Resilience for Public ICT Infrastructure among others. Chosen Eminent CIO of India by VAR thrice since 2021 besides winning various accolades down the years of his administrative journey.

name: Mr. Vivek Sridhar
title: Chief Business officer
bio: As the Direct of Global Expansion and Strategy at Neokred, Vivek play's a crucial role in shaping the company’s vision and strategy for innovative digital banking and payment solutions across various sectors. With over 24 years of experience in the digital banking space, his strong background in finance and marketing positions you well for this leadership role. His expertise spans a wide range of areas, including UPI, prepaid solutions, virtual accounts, money remittance, Aadhar integration, POS systems, payment gateways, toll and transit solutions, KYC processes, data analytics, and user experience (UX). His track record includes successfully launching and scaling products and services for prominent brands like Amazon, Flipkart, Freo Money, NiyoX, and Googlepay. Additionally, his contribution to designing and architecting a supply chain solution for a leading logistics company, which received recognition at the Asian Bankers Awards for Best Supply Chain Solution, demonstrates hisr impact. Collaborating closely with the product team, customize and optimize solutions to meet the diverse and evolving needs of the country. His passion for leveraging technology to drive financial inclusion, convenience, and efficiency for millions of customers is commendable.

name: Mr. Vivek Tiwari
title: MD, CEO & CIO
bio: Mr. Vivek Tiwari is accomplished leader in the field of microfinance acquiring proficient experience of more than two decades. He has been at the forefront of driving initiatives that promote financial inclusion, social entrepreneurship, and impact investing. As the MD, CEO & CIO of SATYA, he has undertaken the pivotal role of steering the company's strategic endeavours, guiding its ethical expansion, and nurturing entrepreneurial development at the grassroots level. He has also served the Board of Micro Finance Institutions Network (MFIN) as Vice-Chairperson. Under his insightful guidance, SATYA has established a significant presence across 25 states in India, extending its services to over 18 lakhs underserved people through a network of nearly 650 branches in over 55,000 villages. Bolstered by a dedicated workforce of over 7000 employees, SATYA achieved a monumental milestone by achieving assets worth more than INR 6300 Crores. Recognising his impactful contributions, Mr. Tiwari was honoured with “Bharat Jyoti Award” for playing a pivotal role in accelerating the JLG/WSHG movement. Mr. Tiwari has also been recognised as Best CEO of the Year by Prime Insights Magazine in September 2023 for his contributions in Shaping a New Paradigm of Women Empowerment through Microfinance. Under his exceptional stewardship, SATYA has recently been acknowledged as one of the "Most Promising Microfinance Institutions to Watch in 2024" by Entrepreneur One Magazine. His achievements extend to being named among The Most Promising Business Leaders of Asia at The Economic Times Asian Business Leaders Conclave hosted by ET Edge, and as The Most Promising Entrepreneurs of Asia at The Economic Times Asian Business Leaders Conclave in 2021.

name: Mr. William Hockey
title: CEO and Founder
bio: William Hockey is the CEO and Founder of Column, a nationally chartered bank for developers who are building modern financial products and services. After witnessing the bottleneck created by the legacy banking stack, William set out to build the first API-centric bank that gives developers the tools they need to seamlessly provide banking services in any application. Prior to Column, William co-founded Plaid, a $13 billion financial infrastructure company where he was CTO and President. At Plaid, William scaled the company to support over tens of thousands of developers and ushered in the most disruptive era of financial technology software that enables customers from Coinbase and Square to F500 companies. Since its founding, Plaid has reached almost every household in America.

name: Mr. Wriju Ray
title: Chief Business Officer
bio: Wriju has spent over two decades launching products and building businesses for Fortune 500 companies across Europe, the Americas, and Asia. He has an MBA from INSEAD. As Director of Life Sciences at BT, Wriju launched the industry's first R&D cloud service across 11 countries. As Chief Business Officer, he oversaw IDfy's business growth as it went from being an early entrant in an incipient industry, to a leading integrated identity platform provider in Asia and the Middle East. Wriju is an expert and thought leader in Regtech and a strident supporter of the growth and adoption of Fintechs around the world.

name: Mr. Yashraj Erande
title: Managing Director & Partner, Global Head of Fintech and India Head of FI
bio: As part of BCG, Yash is a core member of the Financial Institutions and Corporate Finance and Strategy practice areas. He has advised banks and non banks across topics ranging from long range transformation covering several aspects of banking - digital, strategy, operations, sales force effectiveness, multi-channel strategy, technology architecture, analytics and organization design. He has also participated in government and regulatory committees on payments. During his time as an entrepreneur (2019 and 2020), he co-founded a new age credit platform (NBFC) - Growth Source Financial Technologies. At Growth Source, he led a INR 200 cr lending book across Small enterprises, Emerging enterprise, Digital (retail) lending and FinTech debt using digital operating model and data science based capabilities. Growth Source today operates with over 200 employees across 10 branches, ecosystem partnerships and a healthy well-funded balance sheet. He was recognized by Economic Times for the Indiaâ€™s most influential Young Business Leaders in 2018 and as a distinguished alumnus by ISB. As he steps into this new role as a India Leader- Financial Services, he aims to drive Scale, Edge, and Joy by capitalizing on the immense potential within India's financial industry. He holds an MBA from the Indian School of Business, and a bachelorâ€™s degree in Computer Engineering from Mumbai University.

name: Mr. Yogesh Patil
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Mr Patil currently serves as a CEO of Skymet. Skymet provides weather forecasts and weather graphics services. It also provides weather service information to most of the major insurance companies in India, power sector, and agriculture sector. Yogesh spearheads Skymet offering to support financial institutions in mitigating risks arising due to climate change. The tool from Skymet provides information such as where the land is located, which crop was sown in the last four seasons, the soil condition of the farm, irrigation status of the farm, yield received every season etc. State Bank of India (SBI),HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and few cooperative banks have started using the services of Skymet. At Skymet he held various roles, including Chief-Insurance and Instrumentation Business. Yogesh also worked with the Government of Maharashtra and at NCMSL which is the only country level weather content maker that offer a full range of weather content (viz.,temperature (minimum, maximum and average), rainfall (amount and intensity), dew point,wind direction, wind speed (hourly average and high speed), relative humidity, atmospheric pressure, heat degree-day, cool degree-day, heat index etc.), etc. Yogesh holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics from Padma Shree Dr D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth and PGXPM (Post Graduate Executive Program in Management) from the Greatlakes Institute of Management.

name: Mr. Yoshi Yokokawa
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Yoshi is Co-Founder & CEO at Alpaca, an API-first brokerage that builds a modern infrastructure for Stocks, ETFs, Options, and Crypto trading and serves hundreds of businesses globally. Before starting Alpaca in 2017, Yoshi co-founded businesses in machine learning and data processing. Yoshi started his career in 2004 at Lehman Brothers Securitization team.

name: Mr. Zubin Tafti
title: Managing Director
bio: Zubin is a Managing Director in the Payments Transformation practice at PwC India. He has 17+ years of experience in advising a variety of domestic & global clients that include banks, FinTech s, payment schemes, central banks, payment processors and private equity investors. At PwC India, his mandate is to lead and drive payment transformation practice from non-banking clients domestically and global assignments with PwC network firms. He has a deep domain knowledge on a variety of payments solution that include Cards, ATMs, Wallets, Payment aggregation, digital banking, cross boarder payments, mobility& government payments. He has used this domain experience to help client across various type of assignments that covers business expansion/growth strategy, Business& process transformation, technology buildouts and regulatory compliance. He has played pivotal roles in designing, setting up and launching national payment schemes and infrastructures in multiple countries that include India, UAE, Saudi Arabia and South Africa. He has also helped multiple Fintech s launch their payment businesses by helping them secure regulatory licenses and subsequently scale and transform their businesses. He has spoken at various forums and moderate multiple panels across Middles East, Africa & Southeast Asia. In the past Zubin has worked with firms like IDBI Bank, Ernst & Young & Tata Consultancy Services.

name: Ms. Aarti Nihalani
title: Partner
bio: Aarti Nihalani is a Partner based in Oliver Wymanâ€™s Mumbai office and is the CoLead for Oliver Wyman in India. Aarti specialises in banking, capital markets, market infrastructure, wealth and asset management and public policy practices within Oliver Wyman Financial Services. She has worked extensively with leading financialinstitutions in India, North America and Europe. Aarti has led initiatives linked to digital transformation, digital partnerships & embedding â€˜financial productsâ€™ in customer journeys, ecosystems as growth drivers, platform strategy, India business strategy, sales force effectiveness, cost optimisation and organisation design. Aarti advises Boards of leading financial institutions on topics related to strategy and culture. She is also passionate about topics related to diversity and inclusion. She is currently the executive sponsor of â€˜Women of Oliver Wymanâ€™ across India, Middle East and Africa region. Aarti was a member of SEBI Special Committee on Strengthening Governance of Market Infrastructure Institutions (Mahalingam Committee, April â€“ November 2022). She has been a part of SEBIâ€™s Research Advisory Committee since 2019. She is a regular speaker at industry conferences on topics related to policy, trends and innovation in financial services. Prior to joining Oliver Wyman, Aarti had worked briefly at Lehman Brothers, London. Aarti holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad. She also holds a Degree in Chemical Engineering from Institute of Chemical Technology (UDCT), Mumbai.

name: Ms. Aditi Mittal
title: Director, A K Group and Co-founder
bio: Aditi Mittal, Co-Founder of IndiaBonds and Director at A.K. Group, is the OBPP Chairperson and Co-Chairperson of ASSOCHAM. Aditi is a seasoned Chartered Accountant and a leader in the Indian debt market. With nearly two decades of expertise in the Fixed Income & Credit Market, she has pioneered the development, management and leadership of teams at A.K. Group and IndiaBonds. Throughout her career, Aditi has witnessed the bond market's dominance by institutions and recognizes the immense potential of retail investors. Through IndiaBonds, she aims to democratize the bond market by curating bonds for diverse investor profiles and making relevant information easily accessible on a single platform.

name: Ms. Aishwarya Jaishankar
title: Co-founder & COO
bio: Aishwarya Jaishankar is a digital banker turned entrepreneur, currently building Hyperface.co. Hyperface provides a holistic orchestration and product platform for banks and cobrands looking to offer innovative credit card experiences. In her past roles, she has driven multiple innovations at banks including India's first digital savings account and multiple transformation projects spanning from process automation to AI implementation.

name: Ms. Ana Maria Prieto
title: Director at the Payment System Department
bio: Ana Maria is currently the Head of the Payment System Department at the Central Bank of Colombia. Previously worked at the Unit of Financial Regulation of the Ministry of Finance, the Securities Self-Regulatory Organization and the Colombian Banking Association. In 2020 Ana Maria received a special award of the Prize Juan Luis London, given to economists under 40 who demonstrate significant contributions to the design of social policy. She owned the prize due to her leadership in the implementation of Ingreso Solidario, the Covid-19 G2P emergency program of Colombia. Mrs Prieto holds a Master in Public Policy from Universidad de los Andes (Colombia) a Master in Economics from Universidad Javeriana (Colombia) and has participated in several academic programs in financial inclusion, innovation and leadership at Oxford University, Georgetown University and Harvard University.

name: Ms. Angela Hull
title: VP Global Payment Partnerships
bio: Based in London, Angela joined PPRO in October 2023 as Vice President, Global Payment Partnerships. She leads a global team of senior partner managers, driving PPRO’s payment partner strategy, expanding payment methods and increasing profitability. Angela has over 30 years of experience in all aspects of payments, with a proven track record in strategic partnerships, enterprise relationship management and geographic expansion, gained in a number of senior roles at Worldpay. Angela regularly speaks at industry events and advocates for coaching and mentoring for career growth. She champions the power of team building and the impactful outcomes that diverse teams can achieve.

name: Ms. Anisha Jain
title: Anchor and Deputy Editor
bio: Award winning Journalist with over a decade of experience in Capital Markets, Research ,Communication & Analysis. Anisha currently leads the brain trust at ET NOW as Head of Research. She is an Anchor & Deputy Editor and is responsible for anchoring and curating flagship shows like Closing Trades, Markets@Noon and The Market. Anisha is a Rank Holder Chartered Accountant; and when not poring over the financials of companies or writing articles, she would be engrossed in deep-dive chats with industry stalwarts, sector leaders and experts. Previously worked as an Anchor & Research Analyst at CNBC-TV18. Earlier experience includes working at global corporates like CRISIL - a Standard & Poor's company in the Industry Research Department and as a Financial Analyst at J.P.Morgan in Asset Management Department.

name: Ms. Anita Bhatia
title: Chief Regulatory & Compliance Officer
bio: Ms. Anita Bhatia is the Chief Regulatory & Compliance Officer at Indian Clearing Corporation Ltd. (ICCL), a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE. She has over 30 years of diverse experience in financial services across MNCs and Indian corporates. Prior to joining ICCL, she has held several positions with NSDL, Bank of America, Credit Suisse and others. In her previous assignments, she has held leadership roles in areas of GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance), Audit, Inspection, Operations, Training & Investor Relations. Anita holds a master’s degree in commerce from Mumbai University with a Master’s in Financial Management from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies.

name: Ms. Anoushka Dua
title: MD & Head - Singapore and Asia South Payments
bio: Anoushka Dua is the Head of Payments for Singapore and Asia South. In her most recent role, Anoushka was leading Citi’s Treasury and Trade Solutions (TTS) business for Singapore and ASEAN. She managed the Singapore TTS business, which provides integrated cash management and trade finance services to multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations. She was also responsible for the leadership of the business in the ASEAN cluster of markets, comprising Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam. Anoushka started her banking career with Citi in 2002 as a Management Associate in India and has since worked in Hong Kong and Singapore. She has held several country and regional roles across Banking and Trade, including Sales, Structuring and Product Management. Anoushka holds a Master’s degree in Economics from Mumbai University, and a Master of Business Administration in Finance from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad.

name: Ms. Anuradha Aggarwal
title: Director User Growth & CMO
bio: At Amazon Pay, Anuradha is responsible for driving user growth by acquiring, engaging and retaining users to deliver business results and gain market share in a fast growing, hyper-competitive payments industry. Anuradha leads product, UX design and marketing for all consumer services at Amazon Pay and is the P&L leader for Bill Payments and Money transfers - the 2 largest categories for Amazon Pay. Anuradha has a rich experience of over two decades across sales, marketing and strategy for a host of marquee local and global brands in both Indian and Multinational companies. During her corporate journey, she had held senior roles at Disney India, Mondelez Asia Pacific, Vodafone and Hindustan Unilever where she began as a Management Trainee. Early in her career, Anuradha was covered in Brand Equity as one of India's emerging woman marketing talent. In 2012, She was awarded Marketer of the year (Telecom products)â€ at the IAA Leadership awards. She have also been highly ranked member of the IMPACT magazine's list of â€˜50 Most Influential Women in Advertising and Marketing ever since its inception including being on the jury of the above. Anuradha holds a Post Graduate Degree in Business Administration from IIM, Bangalore and a bachelor's degree in Economics from Sri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University. She was selected to be a part of the Chevening Gurukul Fellowship for Leadership and Excellence 2019-2020 at the University of Oxford. She divides her free time between reading, learning Hindustani classical music, watching spy and sci-fi dramas, upcycling and DIY, and impromptu karaoke sessions with friends and family .

name: Ms. Anuradha Ramachandran
title: Managing Partner
bio: Anuradha Ramachandran is Managing Partner at TVS Capital Funds. Anuradha has rich experience spanning over 18 years and 4 years of M&A and corporate planning. Anuradha is a high calibre investment professional having handled, development of strategy, investing, portfolio management and exits across various sectors like Fintech, Technology (consumer internet, retail tech, B2B platform), Life sciences, consumer products and financial services. She has experience in team building and profile building. Anuradha believes innovation and entrepreneurship can change the lives of millions of individuals and can create massive socio-economic shifts that can benefit a growing economy like India. Prior to joining TCF, Anuradha was with Flourish Ventures a global fintech focussed fund setting up and managing India investments, team and strategy. She was also Investment Director at Omidyar Network leading fintech investments with a combined experience of nearly 10 years. She was earlier with Venture East for over 7 years handling fund raise, investment, portfolio management.

name: Ms. Anushe Khan
title: Senior Operations Officer
bio: Anushe has more than 20 years of private sector experience in financial services in emerging markets, firstly as a banker in the areas of credit, loans and guarantees addressing the needs of SMEs, retail and corporate sectors, followed by extensive experience in IFC, in financing MSMEs through the financial services sector in emerging markets. She has led projects with banks, non-bank Financial Institutions and other financial services providers, focusing on SMEs, Women-owned enterprises and underserved segments in rural areas. Most recently, within IFC‚Äôs Banking on Women program she leads IFC‚Äôs global investment and advisory services facilities for the Financial Institutions Group such as the Women Entrepreneurs Financing Initiative (WEFI), the Women Entrepreneurs Opportunity Facility (WEOF), supported by IFC and the Goldman Sachs Foundation. Anushe holds a Master‚Äôs degree in International Relations from Georgetown University, USA and a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from the Institute of Business Administration in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

name: Ms. Anushka Patel
title: Chief Operating Officer
bio: Chief Operating Officer at BillAvenue, managing business, compliance and strategy. Also overseeing banking relationships and product developments.

name: Ms. Aparna Piramal Raje
title: Writer & public speaker
bio: Aparna Piramal Raje is a writer, public speaker, educator and the author of the national bestseller, Chemical Khichdi: How I Hacked My Mental Health, a book on her experiences of living with a serious mental health condition for the last two decades. Part memoir and part self-help, Chemical Khichdi presents a pathway for healing and recovering for anyone living with a mental health condition and all those who love and care for them. Over 100 organisations, including the Indian Army, NIMHANS, companies, networks such as YPO and nonprofits have invited Aparna to speak since its publication. Her first book, Working Out of the Box: 40 stories of leading CEO, looks at leadership through the lens workspaces and workstyles and was based on her popular column, Head Office, in the Mint newspaper. She has also previously contributed to the UK’s Financial Times Weekend, a leading global newspaper. A visiting faculty member at the Anant National University in Ahmedabad and former CEO of her family’s office furniture business, Aparna studied at Oxford University and Harvard Business School.

name: Ms. Azleena Binti Idris
title: Senior Director, Head of Strategy & ESG

name: Ms. Bhargavi Sridharan
title: Head ABC One
bio: Bhargavi is Head - ABC One at Aditya Birla Capital and is catalysing Omnichannel approach for directly acquiring and servicing ABCs customers across their central call centre and One ABC branches along with refreshed launches of the website and One ABC app. An entrepreneur at heart, she has 17 years of experience across infrastructure, banking and life insurance sectors with across strategy & finance, sales & business development, and digital leadership roles in organisations like the Tata Group, ICICI Bank and her own fintech startup. She has worked hands-on on financial literacy and inclusion with a diverse audiences like factory workers, school children and high flying professionals.

name: Ms. Bhawna Sangwan
title: Chief Legal & Strategy Officer
bio: Bhawna Sangwan is the Chief Legal and Strategy Officer at slice, India‚Äôs leading consumer payments and lending company. An alumnus of Delhi University, she has over 18 years of expertise in fintech, governance, and privacy. Prior to joining slice, Bhawna was the legal, regulatory, and governance lead for Amazon's fintech business in India for over 8 years. Well-known for her ability to identify and unlock new growth levers for the company, she led Privacy and Data Compliance for all Amazon operations in India. She has extensive experience with fintech legal and regulatory compliance, including digital payments, lending, and policies on emerging businesses. At slice, she is instrumental in strengthening the company‚ Äôs legal and compliance function and regulatory processes in a rapidly changing market.

name: Ms. Camilla Bullock
title: CEO
bio: Camilla is an entrepreneur, connector, and influencer in the global payments industry. She leads critical discussions, speaks at industry events, and represents EPAA members on global platforms. Under her leadership, EPA Asia has cultivated a robust community dedicated to enhancing interoperability and harmonization of regulation. Through her work, she connects vital industry players, encourages collaboration, and amplifies innovation opportunities and business growth for members.

name: Ms. Candy Ngula
title: Head: e-Money
bio: "As e-Money Head at Bank Windhoek, Candy is focused on driving the value of Mobile Money; its growth and optimisation of across Retail Banking Services, and across the bank as a whole. Previously, Candy was the Deputy Director of Oversight, Licensing and Policy in the National Payment Systems Department at the Bank of Namibia, where she oversaw the domestic payments ecosystem as well as regional payments infrastructures, and played a catalytic regulatory role which allowed her to shape and influence developments and innovations in the financial sector, particularly digital payments. She served on local and international policy-related platforms. During her tenure at the Bank, Candy was instrumental in driving the Bank‚Äôs digital innovation and transformation strategic efforts at its onset, amongst other pivotal projects that helped advance the payments industry. Candy also actively served on a number of regulatory / policy related platforms domestically, regionally and internationally, including PAN PCHs and the PAN Management Council. She also served as the Bank of Namibia‚Äôs primary representative for the Digital Financial Services Working Group (DFSWG) hosted under the global Alliance for Financial Inclusion (AFI). She served served as co-chair and is the immediate past DFSWG Chair for 2022/2023. Candy‚Äôs former career in consulting and advisory services (KPMG South Africa, PricewaterhouseCoopers South Africa and KPMG Namibia) was primarily focused on Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), and which focus continues in her current role as a regulator of the NPS. Candy is a public speaker, and was a founding board member and former President of the Speakers Association of Namibia, a chapter which also forms part of the Global Speakers Federation."

name: Ms. Carrie Suen
title: Senior Advisor - Global Affairs & Sustainability Strategies
bio: Carrie Suen is the Senior Advisor of Global Affairs and Sustainability Strategies & Head of Public Policy (APAC ex GBA) at Ant International, where she is responsible to drive our global strategies and thought leadership of Ant‚Äôs objectives to bring more open, inclusive and sustainable changes to the ecosystem globally. Carrie is an advisory board member of Emerging Payments Association Asia and sits on the Financial Stability Board Cross-Border Payments Taskforce.

name: Ms. Chandra R. Srikanth
title: Deputy Executive Editor
bio: I have 15 years of experience covering business, technology, startups and entrepreneurship for India’s leading media houses Times Group and Network 18 across print, television, and digital mediums. I currently lead a 12-member technology, startup, and new economy team at Moneycontrol, India's leading business and financial news platform, owned by the Network18 Group, which also operates channels such as CNN News18 and CNBC TV18. I also lead a 5-member team that handles social media for all of Moneycontrol.

name: Ms. Chetna Vijay Sinha
title: Founder & Chairperson
org: Mann Deshi Foundation and Mann Deshi Mahila Bank
bio: Chetna Sinha is the Founder and Chairperson of Mann Deshi Bank and Mann Deshi Foundation, dedicated to empowering rural women and fostering holistic community development. In 1997, Chetna established the Mann Deshi Mahila Sahakari Bank, India's pioneering financial institution designed for and by rural women. Under Chetna's visionary leadership, Mann Deshi Bank pioneered the first pension scheme for women in the informal economy, showcasing an unwavering commitment to the financial well-being of women micro-entrepreneurs. Chetna's impact extends beyond financial services. In 2006, she founded the first business school for rural women in India, providing education as a key empowerment tool. In 2013, she launched a toll-free helpline and established the first Chambers of Commerce for women micro-entrepreneurs in the country, fostering a supportive business ecosystem. Recognizing the importance of community development, Mann Deshi Foundation, under Chetna's guidance, operates a diverse range of programs. These include a community radio station, a healthcare for all initiative, a sports for development program, and a climate-smart agriculture program, all geared towards comprehensive development within the communities it serves. It has also set up women-led farmer-producer companies and organizations. Chetna Sinha's illustrious accolades include being a Yale Fellow, Ashoka Fellow, and Schwab Fellow. In 2018, she co-chaired the World Economic Forum in Davos and the Financial Inclusion segment at the W20 Summit in Argentina. The same year, she received the prestigious Nari Shakti Puraskar, the highest civilian award for women in India, from the President. Chetna is an active member of the BRICS Women's Business Alliance (2022) and the Gender Equality Advisory Council (2022), appointed during Germany's G7 Presidency. Additionally, she chaired the G20 EMPOWER's Working Group on Financial Inclusion and Business Acceleration in 2023. Mann Deshi, headquartered in Mhaswad and operating in Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Silvassa, has positively impacted over 950,000 women. With an ambitious goal, the organization aims to reach one million women in 2024, reflecting Chetna Sinha's tireless dedication to transforming lives and fostering sustainable development within marginalized communities.

name: Ms. Chihiro Ban
title: Section Chief
bio: Chihiro contributes to the planning and management of Japan Fintech Week at Financial Services Agency of Japan, facilitating international collaborations and conducting research on fintech and business trends. She experienced internships at research institutions, think tanks and IT companies with roles focusing on innovation. After graduating from Kyushu University in 2021, she joined Money Forward, Inc., and was in charge of driving digital transformation for regional financial institutions.

name: Ms. Daranee Saeju
title: Assistant Governor
bio: Daranee Saeju is the Assistant Governor in charge of Payment Systems Policy and Financial Consumer Protection Group. She oversees payment systems policies and regulations, as well as supervision of IT/cyber risks, market infrastructures, payment services providers, and non-banks. Fostering innovations in payments and fintech also come under her purview. In addition, she oversees works on market conduct, consumer protection and financial literacy. Daranee has served the Bank for over 20 years in various critical functions including risk management, monetary policy formulation and implementation, foreign exchange policy and intervention strategy, markets and financial sector developments, financial stability, micro- and macro-prudential regulations, as well as international strategy. During 2009-2011, she was seconded to the Monetary and Capital Markets Department at the IMF in her role as an expert on monetary and foreign exchange operations and market developments. Daranee obtained her Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Rochester in the United States, and a B.Sc. in Economics from the London School of Economics and Political Science in England.

name: Ms. Deeksha Kaushal
title: Director, Partnerships
bio: Deeksha Kaushal is Director of Payments and Financial Services Partnerships for GPay in India. She also serves as the CEO of Google India Digital Services.

name: Ms. Deepti Sanghi
title: Co-founder, CEO
bio: Deepti Sanghi is the Co-founder, CEO at Kodo - Spend Management Platform for fast-growing startups and enterprises. Kodo's products include corporate cards, vendor payments, accounts payable automation and procurement platform. Kodo's mission is to empower businesses to scale new heights, with its powerful financial operations automation tools. Deepti brings strong domain expertise in the fintech and financial services ecosystem in India. Prior to Kodo, she worked at Freo as the Head of Partnerships, where she was responsible for product and business decisions related to the company's financial partners. She started her career as an investment banker at SBI Caps (investment banking division of SBI) and Edelweiss (a publicly listed financial services group in India)where she worked on M&A and PE fund raising for mid-large size corporates. An active seed investor, and a former investment banker, she pursued her B.A (Hons) in Economics from Lady Shri Ram College, Delhi and MBA from MDI, Gurgaon.

name: Ms. Devyani Parameshwar
title: Founder, CEO
bio: Devyani is founder of Mera Kal, a secured lending platform for middle India. She spent 15 years in the microfinance and mass market fintech space across Asia and Africa, most recently leading commercial and product for M-Pesa, a $1.5bn revenue business, with 55mn MAUs, >500k agents across 8 countries in Africa. Prior to that she worked with the Aavishkaar Group as a founding member of the advisory practice. Devyani has also been a consultant at the IFC and an active volunteer with iSPIRT. She holds a dual degree in Physics and international relations from Wellesley College in the US, and an MBA from London Business School.

name: Ms. Dipali Padia
title: Director of Business Development
bio: Dipali Padia, leading the charge as Director of Business Development at Neokred, brings over a decade of expertise in banking relationships, strategy management, sales, and business development. Her impactful contributions have been pivotal in driving business management and catalyzing sales growth. Notably adept in team leadership across diverse domains like sales, business support, and customer success, she exemplifies strong and visionary leadership. Her knack for enhancing products and devising effective go-to-market strategies speaks volumes of her strategic acumen and ability to yield tangible results. Previously, she held a distinguished role as AVP at Equitas Small Finance Bank, solidifying her reputation as an industry leader.

name: Ms. Fangfang Jiang
title: Regional Lead for Digital Financial Service

name: Ms. Gayathri Parthasarathy
title: Global FS Technology Leader
bio: Gayathri Parthasarathy is a seasoned senior executive with extensive experience in financial services. At PwC, she is currently the India Financial Services Sector Leader for India and Global Financial Services Technology Leader. Specializing in P&L management, business development, sales enablement, solution architecture, and large-scale service delivery, Gayathri has a proven track record in establishing profitable operations and driving client-centric innovation across multiple industries, including financial services, communications, and high tech. Known for stitching large deals and setting up new business lines, Gayathri is an expert in building and leading successful enterprises.

name: Ms. Geetika Raheja
title: Partner
bio: Geetika is a Partner in the PwC Payments Consulting practice based in India. She has more than 15 years of experience in advising clients on areas like product launch, due diligence, transformation, process design, technology strategy. Geetika leads the banking payments segment for the practice. She has led multiple transformation projects including operationalization of payments and universal banks, roll out of transit payments projects for large public transport operators, launch of credit cards, bill payments and toll payments for multiple banks/non-banks.

name: Ms. Georgia Kyprianou
title: Senior Director Product Development
bio: Georgia Kyprianou has more than 25 years of experience in the fintech and payments industry. Throughout the years, she has focused on several areas such as application development, application design, artificial intelligence, and held leadership roles supporting product delivery across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East and Africa. Today, Georgia holds the position of Senior Director heading the international product development team for TSYS’ PRIME suite of solutions and enabling APIs. Georgia holds a BSc in Computer Science, an MSc in Artificial Intelligence, and an MBA. She is a certified Product Executive and a champion of Women in Payments; International Co-Chair for Global Payments Women's Network (GPWN), member of PayTech Women and a committee member of ETA Mobile Payments.

name: Ms. Harsha Thadhani Rodrigues
title: Global Head, Regional Client Services
bio: Harsha Rodrigues is the Global Head, Regional Client Services at Women’s World Banking, devoted to partner with financial institutions and policymakers to design, develop and implement solutions and programs that facilitate systemic change for women. In this role, she is responsible for overseeing the organization’s work in select markets across South East Asia, South Asia, Africa and LAC. Harsha has worn many hats within the organization but her expertise in the areas of strategy development and implementation and advisory support has resulted in increasing Women’s World Banking’s global footprint, reach and impact to low-income women further advancing the vision of women’s economic empowerment through financial inclusion. Prior to joining Women’s World Banking, Harsha worked as a Management Consultantwith Deloitte and was responsible for leading teams in the Health Care Practice in analyzing and implementing performance improvement strategies for multi-facility healthcare systems nationwide. Harsha leverages both her corporate and not-for-profit experience to gain a thorough understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing our primary stakeholder groups in key markets to design strategies and programs that best deliver on making a difference in the lives of low-income women around the world. Harsha holds a B.A. in Economics from St. Xavier’s College, Mumbai and an MBA in International Business from Case Western Reserve University in Ohio.

name: Ms. Isha Oswal
title: Chief Executive Officer
bio: Isha Oswal, CEO of JISA Softech Pvt. Ltd., is a visionary leader whose strategic acumen is pivotal in steering the company towards excellence in cybersecurity and data protection. With 20 years of extensive experience in the industry, Isha's leadership is characterized by exceptional adaptability, trustworthiness, and a clear strategic vision that drives JISA Softech’s success. Holding a master’s degree in Human Resource Management and currently pursuing a Leadership and Strategic Change Management course from IIM Lucknow, Isha brings a wealth of knowledge across various domains including sales, business development, marketing, HR, finance, and operational strategy. Certified as a Data Protection Officer, Isha’s extensive background in cybersecurity equips her with a deep understanding of the challenges and solutions within the field. Her strategic approach emphasizes enhancing JISA Softech’s performance, driving both short- and long-term growth, and fostering a culture of inclusivity and belonging within the organization. Under Isha’s leadership, JISA Softech is poised for significant advancements in cybersecurity and data protection, with a strong focus on expanding geographical reach and financial growth. Her unwavering commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and maintaining JISA Softech as a leading employer highlights her dedication to organizational excellence and a thriving work environment.

name: Ms. Jaclyn Tsai
title: Honorary Chairperson / Executive Director
org: Taiwan FinTech Association / Asia FinTech Alliance
bio: Jaclyn has a great deal of experience in both the private sector and the public sector. She had previously served as a District Court judge from 1982 to 1991, after which she worked as IBM's General Counsel in Taiwan from 1991 to 1995, and later in the Greater China region from 1995 to 1998. She founded Lee, Tsai & Partners with Dr. Chung-Teh Lee in 1998 and specializes in technology law, M&A and investment matters.
