In 2013, Jaclyn was appointed as the Minister without Portfolio in the Executive Yuan (Cabinet) and became one of the few female ministers in the government. During her term as Minister without Portfolio, she was responsible for a number of inter-ministry affairs, such as the reformation of laws relating to virtual world development, e-commerce, the shared economy, digital convergence, the startup environment, open data, and the maker movement. Jaclyn returned to the firm in 2016, and she is currently serves as the Executive Director of Asia FinTech Alliance (AFA) and the Honorary Chairperson of Taiwan FinTech Association (TFTA).

name: Ms. Janet Salem
title: Founder
bio: Janet Salem is the co-founder of FootprintLab, which integrates sustainability data into FinTech and RegTech. Janet spent 17 years working on sustainability, circular economy and sustainable lifestyles at the United Nations in Vienna, Paris and Bangkok. She is also a PhD candidate with the University of Sydney’s School of Physics, and has a Bachelor of Environmental Engineering and a Masters of Engineering Science from the University of New South Wales. She is the 2022 winner of the Ada Lovelace Medal which recognises excellence in engineering.

name: Ms. Kaku Nakhate
title: President & India Country Head
bio: Kaku Nakhate is the India country executive of Bank of America and is on the Bank's Asia Pacific Executive Committee since 2010. Kaku is an industry veteran with three decades of experience and has deep insights and knowledge of India's growing banking and financial services sector. She has won several awards for her contributions to the sector and recently was recognized as one of India's Most Powerful Women in Business by prestigious Business Today magazine. She has been building the Bank's market-leading franchise in India, responsibly growing its business in the country, and overseeing strategy and direction. In this role, Kaku leverages her international experience. She has been interacting with leading Corporates and Financial Institutions across major markets, nurturing and strengthening existing client relationships, developing new clients, and expanding business opportunities for the Bank. Kaku started her career with Merrill Lynch in 1989 and grew through ranks to eventually head the Global Markets business. Following Bank of America's global acquisition of Merrill Lynch, Kaku was appointed as the chief executive of the merged entity in the country. She briefly worked with JP Morgan, India as vice-chairperson in charge of Equities. In addition to her responsibilities as the India Chief Executive, Kaku is a member of National Executive Board of the American Chambers of Commerce (AMCHAM) and is on the Board of Governors of IIM, Ahmedabad. She is also a member of the CII National Committee on Banking, CII National Committee on MNCs and CII National Council on Corporate Governance. She holds a Bachelor's degree in commerce and a Master's in Management Studies (Finance) from the University of Mumbai. Kaku is a passionate advocate of adolescent girls getting access to quality education, skills development, and sanitation. She also actively participates in various skill-based volunteering programs of the bank over and above spending time mentoring numerous NGO leaders.

name: Ms. Kalpana Ajayan
title: Regional Head- South Asia
bio: Kalpana is the Regional Head, South Asia and comes with 25+ years of experience in financial services in retail banking and Insurance. She has worked in organizations like Citibank, HSBC, Edelweiss Financial Services in various roles across functions. In her various roles in managing strategy, sales & distribution, HR and customer experience, she has developed a keen understanding of customer centricity and approaching solutions through the customer lens. She has also spent time in HR functions and has deep experience in building and supporting leadership development. Kalpana is passionate about supporting women’s empowerment and in an individual capacity is a certified mental health counsellor to low-income women and an advisor to key not-for-profits in India. She also sits on the board of a women-focussed fintech company to shape their strategy.

name: Ms. Kalpana Mali
title: Founder
bio: Industry - Founder, KalpNil Cold Pressed OilsCity - Gondavale, Maharashtra Desperate to support her family during tough times, Kalpana sought out the vast world of YouTube, where she learned the process of making cold-pressed oil. With no support from her family, who were skeptical due to the need for expensive machinery and raw materials, Kalpana faced another significant hurdle: she had no credit score. This made it incredibly difficult to secure a loan from traditional banks. Undeterred, Kalpana mortgaged her gold, took out a loan, and embarked on her entrepreneurial journey. Kalpana sourced raw materials from Kolhapur and Pune, setting up a manufacturing unit in Gondavale. She registered her business with support from Mann Deshi’s Chambers of Commerce, obtained an FSSAI license, and focused on branding and packaging. Her participation in exhibitions and commitment to both B2C and B2B sales began to pay off. Kalpana’s business, Kalpnil Naturals has been thriving for the past four years. Yet, the high commission fees of agents were cutting into her profit margins. Kalpana quickly realized the importance of digital marketing, but the registration fees for online platforms were prohibitively expensive for small rural businesses. Mann Deshi’s partnership with ONDC enabled Kalpana to register her business on the ONDC platform. This expanded her reach beyond Maharashtra, allowing her to sell to consumers across India, including Haryana, Jharkhand, Kolkata, Chennai, Lucknow, and Odisha. Over just four months, she received orders for more than 500 liters of cold-pressed oils, generating Rs 200,000 in revenue.

name: Ms. Kanikka Dewanii
title: Founder & Director
bio: Kanikka Dewanii is a seasoned beauty consultant turned entrepreneur with over 19 years of extensive experience in the beauty and lifestyle industry, embodying a passion for innovation and sustainability. Her professional journey began with a host of legacy brands such as L'Oreal Paris, Benefit Cosmetics (LVMH Group), Reliance Brands Ltd, and Pantaloons, where she honed her skills and gained invaluable insights into the market landscape. Born in Nagpur, Kanikka draws inspiration from her family's hard work and determination. Her parents instilled in her the value of education and the importance of building something to pass on to future generations. This legacy has fueled Kanikka's passion for entrepreneurship and commitment to creating beauty solutions that are path-breaking and innovative. Driven by a vision to revolutionize the beauty industry in 2016, Kanikka began extensively researching the market, testing and developing prototypes to bridge the gap in the industry to high-functioning, good quality products distributed at a mass scale. Eventually in 2018, Mintree was envisaged to be more than just a beauty brand with values that are committed to purity, sustainability, and holistic well-being. Mintree products are certified organic, 100% vegan, and free from harmful chemicals like parabens and sulfates, offering consumers a sensory experience that indulges the senses and nurtures the skin. Her expertise in New Product Development and GTM Strategy has propelled Mintree to success, with a diverse product range of approximately 45 SKUs catering to consumers' evolving needs. Mintree's vision is ambitious and challenging as she wants the brand to be on the scale of a retail giant, having a dominating presence in salons and consumer markets for skin, body and hair care. Within the next five years the brand envisages touching consumers' lives worldwide. With over 3000 salons and availability on leading online platforms, Mintree ensures accessibility for consumers nationwide, inviting individuals of all ages to indulge in premium beauty experiences that prioritize self-care and well-being. Kanikka's journey reflects resilience, creativity, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, which she brings to her brand. As she continues to lead Mintree towards its vision, her legacy of innovation and sustainability inspires aspiring entrepreneurs and beauty enthusiasts alike.

name: Ms. Karen L Miller
title: Head of Strategy and Special Projects
bio: Karen Miller leads organizational strategy and special projects for Women‚Äôs World Banking. In her current role, she looks at the intersection of women's financial inclusion and macroeconomic issues such as climate change, women's health and education. Ms. Miller joined Women‚Äôs World Banking in 2012 and previously led its global marketing and communications team, leadership & diversity programs, and the Women‚Äôs Digital Financial Inclusion Advocacy Hub. Prior to Women‚Äôs World Banking, Ms. Miller worked as a brand strategist in Kenya for ZanaAfrica, a nonprofit addressing root causes of gender inequality. Early in her career, Karen designed campaigns to promote safer sex practices in her role at Ogilvy PR. In her spare time, Karen works with mission-driven start-ups. Karen holds a BA in International Relations from the University of Pennsylvania and an MBA from Duke University.

name: Ms. Lalitha Nataraj
title: CEO
bio: 24 years of experience in banking domain - lending systems, analytics , mobile banking and payments.

name: Ms. Le lan chi
title: CEO
bio: Ms Le Lan Chi is the CEO of ZaloPay, a leading fintech company in Vietnam with more than 600 employees. She joined ZaloPay in 2019 as the Head of Finance and since then has led various roles in product development, user growth, financial services and operations. During her 12-year journey living in the US, Chi expanded her background to different industries where she served different roles: from consulting at Kantar Retail and Boston Consulting Group (BCG) to heading marketing for a new business vertical at Wayfair. Chi graduated from Wesleyan University with degrees in Economics and Film Studies, and has a MBA degree from Harvard Business School.

name: Ms. Lisa Nelson
title: President, International at Equifax
bio: Lisa Nelson is President of International at Equifax, accountable for more than $1 billion of annual revenues across 24 countries. She and her team are delivering insights fueled by unique data, analytics and technology to customers across several industries that include financial services, telco/utility, government, auto and corporate clients. Previously, Nelson acted as Managing Director for two of the largest international regions, Canada and Australia/New Zealand. Most recently, she reinvigorated the recently acquired Australia/New Zealand business by focusing on customers and engaging the team in Equifax's global transformation initiative. Prior to joining Equifax, Nelson was Vice President of Global Scoring Solutions for FICO, overseeing the sale and delivery of scoring services to clients worldwide. While at FICO, she held a variety of executive leadership positions within market strategy, product management, direct and channel partner sales, regulatory compliance and business operations. In addition to her work at FICO, Nelson held executive positions with FIS and Deluxe Corporation. Nelson is a graduate of University of Minnesota, and earned her master’s degree in New Venture Management at the University of St. Thomas.

name: Ms. Lizzie Chapman
title: Co Founder
bio: With a career in finance spanning more than 20 years, Lizzie has led disruptive global technology businesses focusing on financial technology, financial inclusion, and digital public infrastructure. Lizzie has spent the last 13 years in India - having moved to Mumbai in 2012 to set up and spearhead the India operations for Wonga, one of the largest fintech companies in the world at that time. Subsequently, she joined the Development Bank of Singapore and played a pivotal role in the launch of "Digi bank," India's first mobile-app-only bank. In 2015, Lizzie co-founded Zest Money, a groundbreaking digital credit platform offering BNPL, Digital EMI, and personal loans. As CEO, she pioneered a fully digital, data-driven approach to lending. Currently, she is leading the launch of a new Software Infrastructure Company - solving global banks' biggest technology challenges. Her career foundation includes equity research and asset management at Goldman Sachs in London and investment management at the Wellcome Trust. Lizzie's current board memberships include Mahila Money (Financial Services) and Cloud Nine (maternity healthcare). She is on the Investment Committees of DeVC and IndiaQuotient (early-stage investment funds). She spent nearly eight years on the board of IndiaMart (listed). She is a founding member and former President of the Digital Lending Association of India. She has significantly contributed to national policymaking through roles on the Innovation Council of the National Payments Corporation of India and the National Start-Up Advisory Council.

name: Ms. Maha El Dimachki
title: Centre Head
bio: Maha is Centre Head, BIS Innovation Hub Singapore. The centre develops public goods in the technology space to support central banks in how they discharge their roles in a digital economy and improve the financial system using novel ideas and emerging technologies. Prior to this, Maha was Head of Department for Early and High Growth Oversight leading the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) response to the Kalifa review of Fintech. A Senior Leadership Team member, she is setting up this new department from the ground up as part of the FCA’s strategy. Maha served as Chief Payments Officer at Pay.UK on secondment from the FCA, responsible for running the payments operations of BACS, Faster Payments, Image Clearing Services and related managed services. Maha joined the FCA in 2017 to set up the first Payments Department and was responsible for crafting and implementing the FCA supervisory strategy for the UK Payments Sector. This included leading the implementation of the Second Payments Services Directive (PSD2) and Open Banking. Maha has a keen interest in observing and participating in the many exciting changes that are unfolding in the financial services, innovation and fintech environment. She recently sat on the SteerCo developing the strategy and blueprint for the UK’s newly created Centre for Finance Innovation and Technology. Maha is the author of Fintech Regulation in Practice. A book that provides a clear, hands-on guide to the practical considerations that fintechs, banks adopting fintech and other key players in the fintech ecosystem need to take into account when embedding regulation. She has a Degree in Commerce from Macquarie University and a Masters in Public Administration from the London School of Economics and Political Science.

name: Ms. Manasi Shah
title: Vice President
bio: Manasi Shah, Vice President at Accel since 2019, is part of the investment team with a focus on early-stage investments across the consumer and enterprise sectors. She brings a diverse background in management consulting, venture capital, and startups. Manasi has experience across management consulting, venture and startups. She started her career at Bain & Company in New York, working primarily on growth projects and private equity investments in the technology space. More recently, she worked in early stage venture with Learn Capital in the Bay Area (EdTech-focused VC) and Acumen in Mumbai (focused on EdTech and AgriTech), and in operational roles at startups in education (Springboard, EduBridge) and FinTech (FlexiLoans).

name: Ms. Mary Ann Francis
title: Executive Advisor, Industry Consultant & Mentor
bio: Globally respected and awarded strategic thought-leadership and management-delivered Solutions for Payments, Banking, Treasury, Quantum, and blockchain-related solutions for financial institutions and corporates, globally. American Banker Top 20 Most Influential Women in Payments 2023. Money2020 Gold Visionary 2023/2024. Global industry Board representative. A mentor to brilliant, global female executives | RiseUp. "If you're the smartest person in the room, you're in the wrong room".

name: Ms. Mehekka Oberai
title: Fund Manager - Fintech
bio: Mehekka Oberai, Fund Manager- IIFL Fintech Fund. She has a decade plus of experience in financial services industry across investing, fintech, investment banking and strategic leadership. She on the board of 10 fintech companies as an investor director. She is passionate about identifying and nurturing growth opportunities in early stage fintech. She has been recently given the jury award for "women fintech leader of the year at the Bharat Fintech Summit." She is a Mumbai university gold medalist and winners of several other awards in her early career.

name: Ms. Melissa C Frakman
title: CEO & Founding Partner
bio: Melissa Frakman is CEO & Founding Partner of Emphasis Ventures (EMVC), a global earlystage venture capital firm investing in the future of fintech and commerce that is both in and inspired by India innovation. EMVC is a trusted partner to India's local fintech ecosystem as well as leadership of financial services and internet companies around the world, with portfolio companies including Jar, Slice, Khatabook, Bureau, Flash, Clinikk, Tartan, and Monnai. With over a decade in India, Frakman has led Asia investments, new market strategy, and partnerships worth over $1 billion for Fortune 500 companies and top pension funds, including building products in digital banking, payments, and insurtech. Previously, Frakman was Vice President of Zomato prior to its landmark IPO, India Senior Director at Albright Stonebridge Group, Financial Services Director of the US-India Business Council, and program manager with early microfinance institutions. She has been a product advisor to companies including Amazon, Uber, Principal Financial, and Remitly (IPO 2021) and served as guest lecturer on fintech at Harvard Business School, Cornell, and Indian Institute of Management-Bangalore. Frakman is a recipient of the FT Innovation Asia Awards, Colin Powell Leadership Fellowship, Ward Medal for Economics, Global Women in Fintech Powerlist, and mentor to Techstars and the Government of India's Atal Innovation Mission. She has been featured in the Washington Post, Financial Times, Forbes, Times of India and the New York Times.

name: Ms. Monica Jasuja
title: Global Payments and Product Strategy Advisor
bio: Monica Jasuja brings a wealth of experience as a business strategist and product leader in the financial services industry. With a diverse background across markets such as the US, Taiwan, India, Indonesia, and Singapore, she has held leadership positions at prominent Fortune 500 companies and possesses a rare understanding of how to design custom digital financial solutions for a range of user groups. Ms. Jasuja's expertise in business development, building partnerships and alliances, and executing go-to-market strategies has resulted in a track record of setting up new divisions and launching products. A highly regarded thought leader in the fintech industry, Ms. Jasuja has been recognized as a top 50 B2B leader in APAC and one of the top 15 global thought leaders in fintech. She serves on the Executive Committee at the India Fintech Forum, ambassador for the Emerging Payments Association of Asia (EPAA) and, APAC Co-Lead for Merchant Risk Council. As a part of her roles in these associations, she plays a crucial role in connecting, empowering, and influencing the ever-evolving landscape of payments and fraud prevention. Ms. Jasuja's technical acumen is complemented by her unwavering commitment to mentorship and making a positive impact. She invests her time and resources into coaching and guiding mid- to senior-level women seeking to advance in leadership. Her leadership philosophy focuses on building high-performing teams that drive results while prioritizing empathy and giving back. When Monica is not working, she devotes her time to advising startups and nonprofits on their fundraising and growth strategies, foray into emerging markets, and building profitable businesses. Teaching is her newest addition to her passion list, Monica takes great pride in teaching product management on weekends to help more aspiring PMs break into Product and build great products.

name: Ms. Mridula Iyer
title: MD & Head Asia South Treasury and Trade Solution
bio: Mridula is the Head for Asia South, TTS Cluster & Corporate, Commercial, & Public Sector Sales. TTS serves Citi‚Äôs corporate, institutional and mid-market clients, providing them cash management, trade finance and working capital solutions. Mridula started her career with Citi in 1996 and over the past 27 years, has worked in multiple roles in diverse businesses across cash management, trade and securities services, as well as compliance. She has vast experience in banking and financial services, having worked in diverse functions across sales, product management, operations and compliance. She has been a key member of the TTS India and South Asia management team. Mridula has held Director position on the Board of Companies in the payments space like the National Payment Corporate of India (NPCI) & SWIFT India.

name: Ms. Neetu Chitkara
title: Managing Director Partner
bio: Neetu Chitkara is a core member of Boston Consulting Group's Financial Services practice and has worked with firms across banking (public and private sector), securities, and insurance; and in countries across Asia, Europe, and North America. She has functional expertise in operational improvement, customer experience, digital transformation, and human resources. Neetu has been part of the global task force at BCG for internal strategy and has led multiple external panels on topics such as AI, cybersecurity, bankruptcy code, and digital lending. She is also involved in training members of the financial services community on the latest trends and developments in financial services and has done so in industry forums such as CAFRAL. She was one of the coauthors of the FICCI IBA report, Digital and Beyond: New Horizons in Indian Banking.

name: Ms. Neha Juneja
title: CEO
bio: Neha Juneja is the co-founder of IndiaP2P and EquiRize. She is a 2x entrepreneur having previously co-founded & scaled Greenway - India's largest clean cooking & climate action enterprise with ops across rural India and sub-Saharan Africa where she developed multiple credit partnerships focused on women as borrowers.

name: Ms. Nidhi Gupta
title: Head of Product - Payments
bio: Nidhi Gupta, Head of Product - Consumer Payments, PhonePe. Nidhi Gupta is a Product leader with 21+ years of global experience leading high-performance teams in Product, Business, and Operations. Nidhi is a hands-on product leader who has built and scaled products across domains like E-commerce, Retail, Transportation, Supply Chain, Insurance, and Enterprise software. In her current role as Head of Product at PhonePe, she is responsible for making PhonePe as the payments destination of Bharat.

name: Ms. Niharika Bhargava
title: Co-Inventor
bio: An internationally educated Psychology Honours graduate with a Masters from the London School of Economics, certified in more than 18 psychometric tests and creator of 5 psychometric tools, with over 19 years of work experience in multiple aspects of psychometrics, human resource management, management consulting, research and development.

name: Ms. Nilixa Devlukia
title: CEO
bio: Nilixa is a strategic advisor to regulators and industry on CBDC, Open Banking, Open Finance and Digital Assets. Nilixa is an experienced policy maker and regulatory expert and founder and CEO of Payments Solved a consultancy advising on the regulatory frameworks and policy. Nilixa is a qualified lawyer holding a Masters in European Competition Law and has extensive knowledge of banking, payments and payment systems gained from her time in industry and with the UK and EU regulators. Nilixa has worked extensively with UK Government, the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and EU regulators. Nilixa has been appointed to various strategic European level committees including the ECB SecurePay Forum, ECB Digital Euro Market Advisory Group, the EU API Evaluation Group, the UK Payment Strategy Forum, the EU Payments Systems Market Expert Group and the EU Data Expert Group. She is also an Amplify Mentor, a diversity advocate, an Advisory Board member for the European Women in Payments Network and an Ambassador for The Emerging Payments Association Asia. Nilixa is a well-known public speaker and works with industry, regulators, and legislators to influence and drive changes in the digital assets, banking and payments ecosystem for a financial services landscape that is secure, transparent, and inclusive.

name: Ms. Nilufer Mullanfiroze
title: Founder CEO
bio: A Retail banking professional with 25 years of experience across banking, nbfc and hfc, covering savings, lending, credit cards, NRI insurance and Bancassurance. Leadership roles held across various functions like business, product, analytics and risk. Deep understanding of India market as well as South east Asia. Currently part of the leadership team of Groww. Before joining Groww, Ms. Mullanfiroze was heading Retail Banking (deposits, Cards, unsecured, Wealth & Bancassurance) at Federal Bank and was instrumental in growing the asset, NRI and credit card businesses. Prior has worked at Indostar and Standard Chartered Bank managing local and global portfolios.

name: Ms. Nipa Modi
title: Director & Chief Revenue Officer
org: Equifax Credit Information Services Private Limited
bio: Nipa is the country leader for Fintech, NBFC, Insurance and the India Workforce Solution, while being on the Board of Equifax's Analytics organisation. As a part of this role, she is responsible for driving the growth for these verticals for Equifax in the Emerging Markets. Nipa is a veteran from the risk management, due diligence and background screening industry and comes with close to two decades of experience in Business Leadership and Strategic planning roles. Her previous assignments were in the capacity of Director at SecUR Credentials (the first listed background screening company in India) and IntegraScreen Consulting, prior to which she pioneered the Risk Management solutions services in India, with her role as Senior Vice President- Sales and Business Development at First Advantage for the Asia Pacific region.

name: Ms. Nruthya Madappa
title: Partner
bio: Nruthya Madappa is the Partner and Head of Growth and Capital Development at 3one4Capital. She supports investments, topline and capital growth for the portfolio at the firm, and works closely with global institutional and strategic investors to drive growth of 3one4-portfolio companies. Her team partners deeply with portfolio companies in planning and achieving financial and strategic objectives including capital raises, revenue acceleration, M&A, and exits. Over her career in the US and India, Nruthya led global teams across technology, finance, real estate, education, and economic policy. Before 3one4 Capital, Nruthya founded and led The CoWrks Foundry (a business accelerator for early-stage companies) as Managing Partner, investing in over 25companies and establishing global partnerships with Yale and Columbia University. Prior to The CoWrks Foundry she drove the Revenue and Growth orgs at Cuemath. Throughout her career, Nruthya has designed and scaled products, and raised capitalfor high-growth companies - strengths she brings to bear for the 3one4-portfolio. Nruthya holds Bachelor‚Äôs of Science and Master‚Äôs of Science degrees in Electrical Engineering from Stanford University and an MBA from Harvard Business School.

name: Ms. Pallavi Madhok
title: Lead Advisory Solution
bio: Pallavi Madhok is the Lead for Advisory Solutions in India. She works with partner institutions to develop innovative products and solutions that unlock value for both their women customers and their stakeholders. Her prior experience has been in product management and in management consulting. She has completed her graduation in Economics (Delhi University) and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management – Bangalore. Thought leadership and commentary:  Small savings, big impact: Building low-income women’s financial resilience will have wider economic benefits for everyone  COVID-19 may just be the unintended booster shot financial inclusion needed  This New York organisation is empowering low-income women in India through financial inclusion  The Great Indian women banking challenge: Will banks come forward and take it up now?
