Inclusive Finance Summit. 2021  Impact of financial inclusion on women’s agency and household decision-making. CIIE. May 2021  Designing Financial Inclusion Programs for Women. Indian CSR Summit 2020

name: Ms. Pallavi Shrivastava
title: Co-Founder
bio: Pallavi is the Co-founder of Progcap, an award-winning fintech firm empowering underserved microenterprises in India with financing and technology solutions to digitise their supply chains. Progcap aims to be the first full-stack digital bank for SMEs that are excluded from the formal financial ecosystem. Prior to setting up Progcap, Pallavi worked at the International Finance Corporation (World Bank Group) where she led IFC’s South Asia inclusive business investments program. She has over 15 years of experience in SME financing, investing, and consulting across India, South Asia, and Africa. Pallavi has received numerous awards, including ‘Entrepreneur of the Year’ at the Entrepreneur Awards 2022, ‘Startup Women Entrepreneur’ and ‘Fintech Women Entrepreneur of the Year’ at the BW Women Entrepreneur Awards 2022. She was also honoured as ‘Women Leader in Fintech’ at IFTA 2022 and recognised as one of the 50 most impactful global social innovators. She is an engineering graduate and holds an MBA from XLRI, Jamshedpur.

name: Ms. Paroma Chatterjee
title: CEO
bio: Paroma Chatterjee, CEO of Revolut India, a woman known for her groundbreaking innovations and visionary endeavours in the field of banking and fintech. A graduate of IIM-Lucknow, she has over two decades of experience in the industry with banks like ICICI & Kotak, and then at the forefront of the Indian Fintech revolution - from launching India's 1st mobile wallet at Airtel Money, to scaling the marketplace business of Flipkart and subsequently scaling Lendingkart to a book size of USD 400 million, before joining Revolut as the India CEO in April 2021. She has been featured in FinTech Magazineâ€™s list of Top100 Women in FinTech Globally three years in a row 2022, 2023 & 2024, and named among the Top 25 Women Leaders in Financial Technology of Asia for 2020, apart from being conferred with the Global Indian of the Year award in the House of Commons in London in 2023. Apart from her incredible business achievements in Fintech, Paroma is a strong diversity advocate for women in Finance and Technology. She conceptualised and launched the Revolut Ira Scholarship to be awarded to the top female students from leading business schools, which is a significant initiative towards Paroma's vision of achieving true gender equality in the corporate workplace, leading up to an equal number of brilliant men and women eventually occupying boardroom seats.

name: Ms. Prachi Dharani
title: Co-founder & CEO
bio: Prachi Dharani is the Co-founder and CEO of PayGlocal. Over the past three years, she has led the company in developing industry-first products focused on cross-border payments. Her leadership has driven PayGlocal to pioneer innovative solutions that enhance global commerce. With over 20 years of experience in the payments industry, Prachi has held pivotal roles, including Senior Director at VISA, and key positions at First Data and ICICI Bank.

name: Ms. Preeti Chheda
title: Chief Fintech Officer
bio: Preeti Chheda is the Chief Financial Officer of K Raheja Corp Investment Managers Private Limited, Manager to Mindspace Business Parks REIT. Preeti has been associated with K Raheja Corp group for over 17 years across various roles in commercial real estate including equity and debt fund raising, acquisitions, raising private equity for real estate projects, investor relations and financial reporting. Before joining KRC Group she has worked with Marico Limited, Shell Gas (LPG) and Cairn Energy. Preeti is a qualified chartered accountant with over 23 years of work-ex. She is also a Company Secretary and a CFA Charterholder. Preeti has also passed the Uniform CPA Examination from the Colorado State Board of Accountancy, USA. She is also a member of the Hybrid Securities Advisory Committee constituted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India and on the Expert Committee on REITs and InvITs in IFSC. She also won the Economic Times, Best CFO in Financial Leadership Award 2024 and the Business World Best Women CFO Award 2024.

name: Ms. Preety Pandey
title: COO
bio: Preety is a seasoned finance and business leader who is currently building super.money. super.money aims to democratise financial services access to themasses and aims to be a top 5 UPI app in the next 6 months. In her earlier role, Preety was the head of finance at Mobikwik and part of the core teambuilding Mobikwik. She has led the development of high-impact financial services partnership, treasury, and business strategies at MobiKwik, Grofers, and Flipkart, driving multi-million-dollar outcomes. She is a trusted advisor to founders, delivering financial leadership and steering high-growth ventures to success. She has an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth and an engineering undergraduate degree.

name: Ms. Presha Paragash
title: Wholetime Director & CEO
bio: Presha, CEO of Credit Saison India, has been part of Credit Saison India (A subsidiary of a Japanese MNC, Credit Saison) from Day 0. As CEO of the India business, she has been highly instrumental in setting up the business from scratch and scaling up the business. This also includes the journey of venturing into new lending verticals within CS India which will be critical as CS India targets a significant growth in the AUM within the next few years. While Credit Saison India started with more of a partnership approach through the launch of their Wholesale Lending vertical and tech integrated Partnerships vertical with leading NBFCs and FinTechs, today the company is also operating in lending verticals whereby it lending directly to SMEs and Consumers. As the CEO of the company, she has a singular focus on ensuring Credit Saison India truly becomes one of India’s fastest-growing and leading Neo Lending Conglomerate and in the journey of doing so, also helping millions of SMEs and consumers get access to credit. Before Credit Saison India, Presha was the founder of CrediFiable, an asset-light digital lending platform in India. Before that, she co-founded Sol Primero, an early-stage investment firm in India. She also comes with strong expertise in Mergers & Acquisitions having worked with UBS in their London office in the Investment Banking Division. Presha has completed her MBA from Wharton and BSc degree from the London School of Economics.

name: Ms. Priti Rathi Gupta
title: Founder
org: LXME - India's First Financial Platform for Women
bio: Priti Rathi Gupta, Founder of LXME, has led and inspired over 200,000 women towards building their financial acumen and financialization of their small savings. An Alumni of Harvard Business School, she had held leadership positions as M. D. of Anand Rathi, one of India’s largest Financial Services Conglomerate, at YPO, and Founder of Ishka films. She is a reputed expert awarded for setting up the Commodities desk, Currency, and Forex Advisory business with two decades of experience in the BFSI industry & is now focused on bridging the gap between women & wealth. Amongst many recognitions, Priti & LXME were featured in Her Majesty the Queen: The Official Platinum Jubilee Pageant Commemorative Album. This album features a range of outstanding individuals and organizations selected for their transformational contribution around the world. LXME was awarded The "Annual Impact Creator Awards 2021" (ICA2021) as the "Warrior of Change" under the Fintech Innovation category, an initiative by Billennium Divas. Being LXME Facebook Community was one amongst 130 communities globally, to be part of Facebook’s Community Accelerator Program that helps leaders harness the power of their community to turn impactful ideas into action. LXME is one of the 20 women-founded or co-founded startups selected by the Google for Startups Accelerator Program out of nearly 400 applications.

name: Ms. Pushpa Aman Singh
title: Founder
bio: Pushpa founded GuideStar India (www.guidestarindia.org) in 2009 in her quest for building trust and transparency in India’s civil society. After a decade of innovation and growth in India’s retail financial services sector, she crossed over to the social sector in 2001 to lead GiveIndia, India’s first online giving marketplace. Pushpa has established GuideStar India as a friend of the NPO community, working with them to voluntarily embrace transparency and enhancing their capacity to access philanthropic resources. With more than 12,250 Indian nonprofits on GuideStar India, India's most exhaustive NPO information repository, she equips citizens and businesses to discover, engage and support NPOs. In 2001, Pushpa pioneered the development and use of NPO due diligence frameworks in India. In 2015, Pushpa launched a rigorous certification programme for NPOs which is recognised as a standard for identifying credible NGOs in India and is being emulated by other emerging economies. She led India’s most comprehensive NPO Sector Survey 2022-23 for the India’s Million Missions Report and leads GuideStar India as the country partner for the CAP Doing Good Index for Asian economies. In 2017, Pushpa launched in India, #GivingTuesday, a global giving movement to promote generosity. Pushpa worked intensively with the Maharashtra government constituted high-powered committee for reforms in charity administration. She served on the Technical Group constituted by SEBI for the Social Stock Exchange and is engaged in the development of India’s first SSEs through her role as the member of SEBI’s SSE Advisory Committee, BSE’s SSE Governing Council, NISM’s Examination Committee for Social Impact Assessors and advises the Capacity Building Fund for the Social Stock Exchange. Pushpa is an MBA Gold Medalist from Gujarat University and a Senior Global Fellow of the Synergos Institute, New York.

name: Ms. Rana Usman
title: Chief Operations Officer - Clearing & Settlement
org: National Stock Exchange of India Clearing

name: Ms. Rashmi Satpute
title: Country Director of India
bio: Rashmi Satpute is Country Director of India at EBANX, leading the company's market development efforts in the country, with a focus on aligning EBANX's central structure of strategic partnerships, commercial fit, and product alignment with the Indian market. Prior to joining EBANX, Ms Satpute held senior leadership roles at leading fintech, banking, and payments institutions, where she was responsible for driving digital transformation and spearheading innovative payment solutions. Before joining EBANX, her most recent roles were Country Manager for India and South Asia at Wise and Director for India and South Asia at Visa Direct, where she led conversations with fintech companies, issuers, and acquirers to deploy new capabilities and payment flows on Visa's network to enhance customer experience.

name: Ms. Rossana Varesi
title: Planning and Project Chief of Department
bio: MBA, CPA, Expert in Central Banking Strategic Planning and Project Management.

name: Ms. Ruchi Pai
title: Practice Lead AA Adoption
bio: Ruchi is Practice Lead - AA Adoption in Sahamati.

name: Ms. Rupa Mankad
title: MD & Head South Asia & Singapore Liquidity Management Services Head
bio: Rupa leads the Liquidity Management business for South Asia & Singapore. Her role spans across managing the profitability of the balance sheets for the South Asia cluster of countries and liquidity products business management. Over the last few years, she has been leading the real-time & 24*7 liquidity management product innovation, digital assets solutions roll out and liquidity product platform modernisation and digitisation. She is based out of Singapore. She has over 20 years of experience in Banking spanning across Liquidity & Payments Product Management, Sales and Credit & Risk Operations. She has been responsible for the design, launch and commercialization of several new payment products & services for Citi in Asia. In 2013, she registered a patent for Citi in the big data and payment analytics space.

name: Ms. Rupali Shinde
title: Director of Digital Literacy Programme
bio: Rupali started as a housewife but always aspired to make something of herself. She decided to start her own business by making traditional musical instruments made of leather, learning the craft from the male members of her family who had practiced it for generations as part of their caste-based profession. Now, she not only supports her family but also provides employment to ten women. She runs the ‚ "Digital Didi" programme at Mann Deshi Foundation, where she trains women in digital technology. This initiative aims to train rural women to become digital literacy trainers who provide door-to-door digital literacy training in the community using a digital literacy bus. Her motivation for this initiative came after being cheated by a vendor with whom she transacted in cash. Beyond her business, Rupali has given lectures at the Reserve Bank of India and Azim Premji University. She has received the BRICS Women Innovation's Mulan Award in 2021 for her work in facilitating women's access to digital payment tools during the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: Ms. Sagrika Shah
title: Principal
bio: Sagrika Shah is a dynamic finance professional with a strong background in fintech and strategic investments. She is a Principal at Yatra Angel Network, focusing on fintech investments. Additionally, she co-founded Connexdoor, a tech platform enabling angel investment, backed by a SEBI registered fund.

name: Ms. Santosh Dujari
title: MD & Head India subcontinent, Treasury and Trade Solutions
bio: Santosh is a seasoned Transaction Banker with 24 years of experience across varied roles in Sales, Product and Operations covering Local Corporates, Multinationals and Financial Institutions. She is responsible for driving business growth, sales, strategy, client relationships, product innovation and delivery through collaboration and partnership, elevating talent and grooming leaders. Prior to this role she was CCPS & FI Sales Head for India. Before moving to Sales, she managed a Product portfolio as P&L owner and business manager which was preceded by an Operations stint across multiple roles from business development to business process outsourcing. Santosh has been championing various CSR initiatives for Citi, earlier the Akshaya Patra foundation and currently The Hunger Project in India.

name: Ms. Seema Bhardwaj
title: Director India
bio: Seema Bhardwaj is an Indo-German Professional with over two decades of experience in strategic advisory. Before joining GTAI in July 2020, she headed the India Desk of a major German Law firm for 14 years, consulting companies from German speaking countries (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) in their market entry into India. She studied law in India and Germany and holds a Master's degree in Political Science. In her current position as Director India-GTAI, Seema Bhardwaj is responsible for Indian investors providing support on all questions relating to business establishment in Germany. Market data, legal and tax framework information, personnel recruitment and site-selection support are all part of Germany Trade and Invest's service portfolio. She is the author of various publications in German and English on Indian Law and is a regular speaker in international conferences. Further Seema Bhardwaj is: - An Ambassador for the Digital Hub Initiative of the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Climate Action, Federal Republic of Germany. - Head of the German Indian Roundtable (GIRT) in Berlin. - A Founding member of the Indo German Association of Legal Cooperation (IGAL). - A Member of Internationalization Committee of Berlin Chambers of Commerce.

name: Ms. Shalini Warrier
title: Executive Director and Business Head - Retail
bio: Ms. Shalini Warrier was appointed as Executive Director of Federal Bank with effect from 15 January 2020. She joined the Bank on 2nd November 2015 as the Chief Operating Officer, with her primary responsibility being operational excellence, coupled with digital innovation. In May 2019, she took on the additional responsibility of Business Head of Retail Banking Products. Her current role is that of Business Head‚ Retail for Federal Bank, with primary responsibility to drive the Retail Banking agenda of the Bank forward. This, inter alia, covers responsibility over the Bank’s Digital Banking agenda and FinTech partnerships. Ms. Shalini Warrier is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and stood first at the all India level in 1989. She is also a Certified Associate of Indian Institute of Bankers. Ms. Warrier has nearly 3 decades of banking experience. Prior to joining Federal Bank, she worked with Standard Chartered Bank, a leading multinational Bank. She handled multiple disciplines there, across various geographies that included India, Brunei, Indonesia, Singapore and United Arab Emirates. In her current role, she leads the Bank's initiatives designed to enhance market presence in the Retail Banking area. She is responsible for formulating the Bank's future direction and partner with the Board and the Top Management team to drive strategic initiatives designed to enhance shareholder value. She is also a nominee Director on the Board of the Bank associate, Ageas Federal Life Insurance Company Limited. She is a well-known banking personality and has represented the Bank at various fintech and technology platforms in India and abroad.

name: Ms. Sheetal Jain
title: Cofounder & CEO
bio: Sheetal Jain is the CEO and co-founder of LeRemitt, a pioneering cross-border trade platform designed to simplify, economize, and streamline international trade for MSMEs. With a mission to empower small businesses, LeRemitt currently offers solutions for international payments and trade financing, making global commerce more accessible. Sheetal has over 20 years of experience in the Indian financial system, with the last decade dedicated to the fintech space.

name: Ms. Sheryl Chen
title: Head of Content, Asia
bio: Sheryl Chen is the Head of Content, Asia at Money20/20, where she does what she’s the most passionate in: connecting people to ideas, resources, and new connections. Sheryl started her career crafting user-first content and procuring world-class speakers at conferences: Tech in Asia (Singapore, Tokyo, Jakarta); Innovfest Unbound & Smart Nation Summit (anchor events of Singapore’s Smart Nation Innovation Week 2019), Unbound Bahrain (anchor event of Startup Bahrain Week 2019). She was previously a Program Manager at Google Cloud for Startups, and at Qualgro VC - a growth stage fund that invests across Southeast Asia and ANZ.

name: Ms. Shinjini Kumar
title: Co-Founder
bio: Shinjini Kumar is Director and Co-Founder of SALT-mysaltapp, a women-first fintech startup. Prior to this, she was the Country Business Manager for Citibank’s consumer business in India. Shinjini has spent over thirty years in senior leadership positions across organizations including Reserve Bank of India, Bank of America Merryll Lynch, PricewaterhouseCoopers and Paytm Payments Bank. She serves as independent director on the Boards of Paytm Payments Bank, BoB BNP AMC, Nium Forex Private Limited and is a Member-at-large on the Executive Council of CGAP. Shinjini has degrees in English Literature and Public Policy from Delhi University and UT-Austin, USA. In between entrepreneurship, public speaking, contributing articles and points of view on business and finance, she also writes short fiction and is the founder of Indian Novels Collective, an initiative to popularize translation of Indian literature.

name: Ms. Shraddha Kapoor
title: Indian Actress
bio: Shraddha Kapoor is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. Shraddha Kapoor has been featured in Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list since 2014 and was featured by Forbes Asia in their 30 Under 30 list of 2016.

name: Ms. Shubhra Saxena
title: Vice President - Product
bio: Shubhra is VP product at PayU . Shubhra has 18 years of experience in BFSI, with banks,network schemes and also start-up ecosystems on payments consulting across ASEAN countries. She currently leads products like payment orchestration on acquiring channels forcards, netbanking and wallets, authentication services on Issuing banks for Wibmo products ACS and RBA. She also manages treasury automation to ensure pricing and revenue assurance.

name: Ms. Shweta Shetty
title: Partner, Consulting
bio: Shweta is a Partner with Deloitte in Financial Services Consulting and has over 15 years of consulting experience across Banks, Insurers, NBFCs, Fintechs, Asset & Wealth Management Companies, Regulators, and Global Developmental Organisations. She leads large engagements focused on new product development, go to market strategies and digital transformation engagements with a focus on understanding customer needs and helping banks and financial services institutions in re-imagining their people/process/technology operating models. She has provided strategic advisory services to central banks, guiding them through assessments of Open Finance frameworks and fintech sandboxes. She also leads Deloitte’s BankingSuite for India, an accelerator for digital transformation to build experiences authentic to a bank’s needs, strategies, and goals. Her core focus areas include Open Finance, API banking, Payments, MSME lending, Fintech enablement, Regulatory Policy, Customer Experience and Insights. She has led projects across clients in India, UK, Middle East, South-East Asia and Africa.

name: Ms. Sirirat Junwongsasin
title: Deputy Director
bio: Ms. Sirirat Junwongsasin has over 15 years of experience at The Bank of Thailand. She specializes in payment systems policy, Fintech innovation, and regulatory frameworks, fostering a sustainable FinTech ecosystem through open infrastructure and stakeholder collaboration.

name: Ms. Sonali Shelke
title: FinTech Sector Head, India
bio: Sonali Shelke is an Executive Director and leads Fintech sector for JP Morgan Chase in India . In this role she covers both Indian headquartered fintechs as well as large global fintech clients setups in India. Fintech is amongst the fastest growing segments and a key focus area for the firm and Sonali works extensively with product, compliance and tech teams to build and deliver products critical for the segment.She has previously worked in banks like Citi and Barclays and has over 14 years of experience in sales and coverage roles. She has specifically covered the fintech segment for over 8 years and built relationships with key Indian and global players active in India. Sonali has an MBA from Indian Institute of Management, Lucknow and did her undergraduate degree in Electronics Engineering.

name: Ms. Sonika Chandra
title: Cheif Business Officer
bio: Sonika is the Chief Business Officer, Consumer Payments at PhonePe where she oversees all consumer focused business lines such as Online, Recharges, Bill Payments, Peer-to-Peer and the key regulatory relationships. She is passionate about connecting people through great products and driving value in open ecosystems. Sonika brings together deep knowledge and experience in the payments space through her prior experience in the US at organizations like Visa Inc, and Western Union, where she was responsible for opening new business lines, establishing strategic partnerships, and driving product strategy for a global portfolio. Sonika has launched key payment products and partnerships in Asia, Africa and Latin America, and has led several financial inclusion initiatives in partnership with Governments across markets. She is a strong advocate for women in leadership, and for driving gender equality and diversity within company ranks. Sonika has a Bachelor's degree in Science, Master's in Communication from MICA and an MBA degree from Wharton, University of Pennsylvania, USA.

name: Ms. Sophia Furber
title: Research Analyst
org: 451 Research, a part of S&P Global Market Intelligence
bio: Sophia Furber is a research analyst in the 451 Research Fintech research and consulting group within S&P Global Market Intelligence. Based in London, her coverage focuses on Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. She has a particular interest in digital currencies, remittances and fraud prevention. Sophia has more than a decade of experience as a financial journalist and researcher, and previously spearheaded S&P Global Market Intelligence‚Äôs European fintech news coverage. Prior to commencing her journalism career, Sophia worked as a freelance political risk analyst and served as a long-term observer in Nepal with The Carter Center‚Äôs international observation mission during the peace process. She holds an MA in South Asian Area Studies from the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London, and a bachelor‚ Äôs degree in English literature from Cambridge University.

name: Ms. Subbalakshmi Shirali
title: Managing Director & CEO
bio: Mrs. Subbalakshmi Shirali is presently heading TJSB Sahakari Bank Ltd. As Managing Director and CEO. She has approx. 37 years of banking experience having expertise in the areas of Cyber Security, Retail Banking, Corporate Credit, Information Technology, Risk, Operations and Compliance. She has been with TJSB Bank for the last 4 years and has created a major transformation in almost all areas like Digital banking, Customer Service, Human Resources, Regulatory compliance, Technology and Cyber security which has helped the Bank with various awards and accolades in the last 2 years. She was nominated to the RBI’s working group for determining the strategy for securing card-based transactions and presented White paper to Deputy Governor of RBI in June 2011. She was also associated with Cyber Crime cell of Pune Police and has conducted workshops on various types of cybercrime.

name: Ms. Sunali Rohra
title: Senior Executive Vice President - Head Government & Institutional Business, Start-ups & Gig Banking
bio: Sunali Rohra is Senior Executive Vice President, HDFC Bank heading the Government & Institutional business, Start-ups and Gig Banking portfolios. She is an experienced professional who believes in the power of collaboration between Business, Government, social sector, and academia to architect innovations, promote development, and make profits. Prior to HDFC Bank, Sunali has held leadership positions with leading global organizations like Visa, Meta (Facebook) and McKinsey where she was Co-Leader for the India Urban practice. She is an alumnus of the prestigious University of Oxford where she majored in Development studies and was a visiting fellow at the Centre for Emerging Markets at the Indian School of Business, and at the Smith School of Enterprise and Environment, University of Oxford.

name: Ms. Supriya Singh
title: Head of South Asia Investments
bio: Head of South Asia Investments at JAFCO Investment (Asia Pacific) Ltd, Based out of Singapore. Have been investing out of JAFCO Asia since 2012. Been involved in multiple global exits like Anymind Inc (IPO in Japan), Appier Inc. (IPO in Japan), Roadzen (NASDAQ IPO), Tessolve acquisition by Hero Electronix etc.

name: Ms. Sweta Rau
title: General Partner
bio: Sweta is founder and General Partner of White Venture Capital, an early stage fintech fund investing into India and SEA from Idea to pre-series A. She was an active angel investor and has invested in 30 plus companies spanning across Consumer tech- fintech, ed tech, deep tech and some D2C consumer brands. Prior to investing, She worked in cutting edge technologies of its time like Big Data, Business Intelligence, E-Commerce in finance and telecom industry. Early in her career she worked with companies like Wipro, IBM, Teradata, ICICI bank, DBS bank etc and start-ups in fintech and e-commerce space. She holds Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electronics and Fintech and Blockchain from IIM- Kolkata. She is also a Kauffman Fellow '29.

name: Ms. Tan Su Shan
title: Global Head of Corporate and Commercial Banking

name: Ms. Taniya Biswas
title: Co-Founder
bio: Taniya, who wears several hats as an entrepreneur, TEDx speaker, change-maker, and vocal advocate for mindful fashion, is the co-founder of Suta. She has an engineering degree in ceramics from National Institute of Technology, Rourkela, and an MBA from IIM, Lucknow. Taniya was associated with IBM as a strategy consultant, worked as a production manager at Tata Refractories, and was a marketing consultant with Seed Fund’s investee firm before co-founding Suta. She strongly believes in - doing good is contagious.

name: Ms. Tanvi Ratna
title: Founder
bio: Tanvi Ratna was a former blockchain lead at EY India and has deep and global experience in policymaking and emerging technology. Before founding Policy 4.0 she has worked with leading decision-makers such as the Indian Prime Minister, the Foreign Affairs Committee on Capitol Hill, and has developed analyses for financial regulators in 44 countries globally. As the founder & CEO for Policy 4.0, Tanvi is responsible for guiding decisions and achieving rational outcomes for decision-makers and regulatory bodies.

name: Ms. Upasana Taku
title: Co-founder & CFO
bio: Upasana Taku is the chairperson of the MobiKwik Board and the Executive Director, Co-Founder and CFO of MobiKwik. She co-founded MobiKwik with a vision to transform the digital financial services and payments landscape in India. She believes that the India Fintech opportunity will be at least $1TN and that MobiKwik will be a significant part of it. A phenomenal closer, Upasana has an unparalleled record in getting strategic deals/projects done in record time and is an inspiring leader. She has always been passionate about creating an impact at the grassroot levels, which brought her back to India from the US in 2008. Her hard work and desire to serve the community have made her an inspirational figure who has been recognized many times as one of India's leading Tech founders. Upasana holds a Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering from Punjab Technical University and a Master's degree in Management Science and Engineering from Stanford University. She has 18+ years of experience in product, payments and financial services. Prior to her entrepreneurial journey, she worked as a Product Manager at PayPal, San Jose, in the Financial Services, Global Payments and Risk divisions. She also had a stint with HSBC, San Diego, working in the Product team of their auto finance division. Upasana has been featured amongst the top 15 richest self-made women in India in the Kotak Wealth Hurun â€“ Leading Wealthy Women List 2020 and 2021. In 2018, she was felicitated by the President of India as the First woman to lead a payments start-up. In 2019, she was featured in the top 25 accomplished women shaping Asia's business landscape in Forbes Asia's Power Businesswomen list.

name: Ms. Usha Sharma
title: Senior General Manager
bio: Usha Sharma has over two decades of experience in the securities markets which is spread across multiple functions which includes Surveillance, Investigation, Exchange Compliance, Member Compliance, Inspections and Investor Grievances etc. She has been part of discussions framing various policies. Currently, she is responsible for Exchange Compliance and Member Oversight.

name: Ms. Vaisshali J Babu
title: MD & CEO
bio: Ms. Vaisshali Babu has assumed office as the Managing Director & CEO with effect from January 1, 2024. Previously, Vaisshali was the Chief Operating Officer and Chief Risk Officer of the Company. Vaisshali is a capital market veteran with overall capital market experience of over 30 years spread across BNP Paribas, BoFA (ML), State Street, SHCIL, United India Insurance Co Ltd., and Mumbai Port Trust. Her area of expertise is in clearing house operations, custodian business, products and relationship management, operations management, project management including risk, compliance and audit. Vaisshali is very active in various industry groups and has worked closely with Indian regulators on topics related to the development of Indian capital market. She has the credentials of articulating key regulatory changes e.g. foreign investments in India, improving settlement efficiencies, debt market investments etc. Vaisshali holds a master’s degree in commerce from Mumbai University with a business administration qualification from Symbiosis. She has credentials of executive programmes from IIM Bangalore, IIM Rohtak and IIM Calcutta and is member of Institute of Directors. She was recognised as ‘œIndia’s top 100 women in Finance’ by AIWMI in 2019 and awarded ‘Best in Custody’ at the Women in Finance Asia Awards in 2022. Complete believer in changing society via children’s education actively associated with few NGOs.

name: Ms. Vanita Pise
title: Co-founder
org: Mann Deshi Kisan Producer Company, Community Leader and Entrepreneur
bio: Vanita Pise's journey began by working in the family poultry shed. In 2004, she learned about Mann Deshi Bank and took a loan to buy a buffalo, which led to a successful milk-selling venture. Encouraged by her success, she took another loan to purchase a paper cup machine, inspiring ten women in her village to start similar businesses. Despite facing challenges when their supplier stopped working with them, Pise's determination led her back to Mann Deshi, where she enhanced her financial and business skills. She took another loan, overcame the setbacks, repaid her debts, bought the machines from the women she had initially helped, and employed them. Her resilience earned her the CII Foundation Woman Exemplar Award in 2006, presented by Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, and she used the prize money to start two new businesses. In 2012, she became a board member of Mann Deshi Women's Bank, and in 2018, she co-founded Mann Deshi Kisan Producer Company. In 2019, she was invited by Exeter University in the UK to speak about her journey as a community leader and woman entrepreneur and how she is empowering women farmers to access markets and get better prices for their produce.

name: Ms. Vidya Pradeep
title: Sr. EVP Head Credit Cards & Debit Cards Portfolio
bio: Vidya Pradeep has over 23 yearsâ€™ experience in Banking and Payments industry with most of her experience in HDFC Bank. After completing her MBA - Finance from LIBA she pursued her dream of being a banker and specialized in the payments space. As Sr Executive Vice President - Consumer Cards she is driving product innovation incredit cards, stronger market share for credit cards by driving the portfolio and by accelerating efforts on new initiatives & partnerships , co-brands to drive growth in scale of acquisition. She also leads growth of Debit cards portfolio & spends and has also set-up and scaled HDFC Bankâ€™s digital innovations - PayZapp & Smartbuy which are extremely critical payment and engagement platforms for the bank.

name: Ms. Visa Kannan
title: Managing Partner
bio: Visa Kannan is the Managing Partner at Saison Capital. Visa comes with extensive experience scaling companies in the eCommerce industry, having been a zero-to-one operator at two unicorns: Grofers (now blinkit) and Lazada. She was most recently an SVP at Grofers (now blinkit), the largest quick commerce player in India. Prior to Grofers, she was a consultant at BCG and before that an M&A lawyer, which ensures she brings an additional eye for detail to her dealmaking. Visa is a champion for diversity in the venture and startup ecosystem. She holds weekly hours to connect, support and mentor female founders. Visa sees a distinct opportunity to bring more experts into the sector by identifying ways to include more women and minority groups.

name: Ms. Zarin Daruwala
title: Cluster CEO, India & South Asia
bio: Ms. Zarin Daruwala is the Cluster Chief Executive Officer, India, and South Asia markets (Bangladesh, Nepal, and Sri Lanka). In a career spanning over 34 years, she has worked across all areas of banking, ranging from wholesale banking, agri-finance, corporate finance, corporate planning, investment banking, and credit. She was selected as one of the Top 30 most powerful women in Indian business by Business Today seven times. She has been featured in the coveted "BT Hall of Fame" for being a consistent performer. She consistently features in the 50 most powerful Women in Business listing by Fortune India, and Business World has listed her among the 75 Most Influential Women in India. She has also been recognised for "Outstanding Contribution toward Banking and Financial Services" for 2017-18 by the IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry. In addition, Zarin was featured in "Top 100 Most Influential BFSI Leaders", released by the World BFSI Congress and Awards. More recently, she has been recognised as the Banking CEO of the Year for India by The European Global Business Awards 2023. A rank holder in Chartered Accountancy, Zarin has also won the President's gold medal, topping the all-India Company Secretary exams. She has also been conferred the CA Business Achiever award by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. Before Standard Chartered, Zarin worked at ICICI Bank, where she spent 26 years of her career, starting as a management trainee and eventually becoming President and Head of the Wholesale Banking business. She has also served on the Board of Directors of key ICICI group companies, ICICI Lombard General Insurance and ICICI Securities. She was also on the board of JSW Steel for almost eight years.

name: Prof. Douglas W Arner
title: Kerry Holdings Professor in Law
bio: Douglas Arner is the Kerry Holdings Professor in Law and RGC Senior Research Fellow in Digital Finance and Sustainable Development at the University of Hong Kong, where he leads a team focusing on the role of finance, technology and regulation in supporting broader sustainable development. He is a Senior Fellow of the University of Melbourne and a non-executive director of NASDAQ listed biotech firm Aptorum. Douglas has advised dozens of countries and international organisations across the world.

name: Shehnaz Ahmed
title: Senior Resident Fellow and Fintech Lead
bio: Shehnaz Ahmed leadsthe Fintech research at the Vidhi Centre for Legal Policy (Vidhi)– an independent think-tank in India. A lawyer by profession, she has more than a decade of experience in financial regulation, technology laws, and corporate laws. Her work at Vidhi focuses on examining legal and policy issues at the intersection of finance and technology. She currently leads Vidhi’s legal research on central bank digital currencies, cryptoassets and decentralised technologies. At Vidhi, she has worked with the Ministry of Finance, Reserve Bank of India, Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Commerce, and the World Bank on designing legislative reforms for the corporate and financial sector. She is regularly invited to speak at national and international conferences on fintech and writesfrequently for the Financial Express, LiveMint and Hindu BusinessLine.

name: Shri Ajay Prakash Sawhney
title: Former Secretary
org: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

name: Shri Ajit Kesari, IAS
title: Addl.Chief Secreatry, Director, TRI, Bhopal & Backward Classes & Minority Welfare Deptt. Nomadic & SemiNomadic Tribe Deptt. (Addl. Charge)
bio: He is an IAS Officer of 1990 batch. Presently posted as Additional Chief Secretary to Government of Madhya Pradesh in charge of Department of Finance. He was educated as a Mechanical Engineer from IIT Kanpur (Bachelors) and IIT Delhi (Masters). He obtained a Degree of Masters of Public Policy from the School of Public Policy, George Mason University, USA in 2008. His interest there was Comparative Public Policy, especially comparison of various services related to citizens across different countries, major focus on USA and India. He has handled various assignments of District Assignments for 13 years across many parts of Madhya Pradesh. His other assignments include Mela Officer for Kumbh Mela at Ujjain, CMD of Discom, and Registrar of Aadhaar in 2010. He has worked very closely in farmers related work starting from growing of crops by farmers, supply of inputs and credit to farmers and procurement of his produce and support for marketing, in the departments of Food and Public Distribution, Cooperative, Land management, Agriculture and Animal Husbandry. The main emphasis here has been to introduce new concepts, technology, design thinking and breaking away from the indifferent way of working in Government. Outside the Government he runs a group involved in teaching people on avoiding Kidney Related Diseases.

name: Shri Alby John IAS
title: MD & CEO, MTC
bio: Dr Alby John Varghese is an officer from the Tamilnadu cadre of the Indian Administrative Service. He is currently serving as the Managing Director of Metropolitan Transport Corporation, Chennai â€“ agency responsible for bus operations in Chennai Metropolitan areas. Over the last 10 years Dr Alby John has worked in various capacities in Tamilnadu Government as District Collector, Tiruvallur, Deputy Commissioner, Greater Chennai Corporation and Municipal Commissioner, Thoothukudi Corporation. he was awarded the Best District Collector award by the Tamilnadu Government in 2022 and 2023. He was also awarded the Chief Ministerâ€™s Good Governance Award in 2022 for his efforts in rehabilitating bonded labourers in Tiruvallur District.

name: Shri Amarjeet Singh
title: Whole-Time Member
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Mr. Amarjeet Singh, is presently the Whole-time Member at Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). With a career spanning nearly 3 decades with SEBI, he has extensive experience in development, regulation and supervision of securities markets. Mr. Singh has been instrumental in introducing SEBI’s reforms in both primary and secondary securities markets including areas of Initial Public Offerings, Corporate Governance, Stewardship, Financing Reporting, T+1 Settlement and Risk Management. He has led SEBI’s engagements on sustainability reporting in recent years and also the conceptualization and formation of Social Stock Exchange and its related ecosystem in India. Mr. Singh is currently a member on the Board of the International Ethics Standards Board for Accountants (IESBA). He has represented SEBI on numerous Committees set up by Reserve Bank of India and Government of India. He was a part-time member on the Board of the National Financial Reporting Authority (2019-2022) and on the Board of Governors of the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (2019-2023), set up by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. He has also served on the Board of the National Institute of Securities Market. Mr. Singh has been involved in various international regulatory initiatives, including that of International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO). He has acted as Sherpa for SEBI’s representation on the Board of IOSCO. As former Chair of the Assessment Committee of IOSCO (2016-2018) and member of its various policy committees since 2010, he has steered thematic assessments at the global level and contributed to the evolution of IOSCO Principles and Standards. Apart from an MBA, Mr. Singh holds a Master’s degree in Economic Policy Management from Columbia University, NY, USA. He is a recipient of the Rotary Foundation Educational Award, 2000 for promoting leadership development and international understanding by Rotary International, USA and of the Joint Japan – World Bank Graduate Scholarship Award, 2001 – 02.

name: Shri Amod Kumar
title: Deputy Director General
bio: Amod is an Indian Administrative Service officer with M.Tech and B.Tech from Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur, MPA from Harvard Kennedy School, and a PhD from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Lucknow. Amod was the youngest recipient of Prime Minister's Award for excellence in public administration in 2008. India Today (July 2010) and Forbes (August 2012) have featured him as a promising young leader of India. He has 27 years of administrative experience in Uttar Pradesh, the biggest state in India with a population of about 250 million. He has contributed significantly in the fields of Public Policy, e-Governance, Land Administration, Grievance Redressal, Education, Health & Family Welfare, having also received a special mention for his e-Governance project at the Stockholm Challenge award. He was ranked 5th in India in the Civil Services (IAS) Exam. He has also received the United Nations Public Service Award, Golden Icon award and the e-Governance Champion Award besides many other awards. Amod serves on Scientific Advisory Committee of Harvard School of Public Health's Betterbirth trial, IIM Visakhapatnam Digital Governance MBA Program, and the One Health Antibiotic Stewardship in Society Study (OASIS).

name: Shri Ananth Narayan G
title: Whole Time Member
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Mr. Ananth Narayan is currently a Whole Time Member of Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), looking after Market Regulation Department (MRD), Alternative Investment Fund and Foreign Portfolio Investors Department (AFD), Enforcement, Enquiries & Adjudication Department (EAD), Office of Investor Assistance & Education (OIAE), and Department of Economic & Policy Analysis (DEPA). Prior to this current role, Ananth has had extensive experience of academia, governance, and international banking. Between 2018 and 2022, Ananth was an Associate Professor at S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR), Mumbai. He also served on several boards, including as Independent Director on SBI Capital Markets, Additional Director (appointed by RBI) on Yes Bank Ltd., Public Interest Director (appointed by SEBI) on NSE Clearing Limited. Between 2009 and 2017, Ananth was with Standard Chartered Bank, last as Managing Director & Regional Head of Financial Markets, ASEAN and South Asia. Between 2006 & 2009, he was with Deutsche Bank, last as Managing Director, Global Rates, South Asia. Between 1993 & 2005, he was with Citigroup, last as Director, Financial Markets, South Asia. Ananth has also served on several RBI and SEBI committees and working groups. Ananth holds a Post-graduate Diploma in Management from Indian Institute of Management, Lucknow, and is a Bachelor of Technology (Electrical Engineering) from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay.

name: Shri Anantha Krishnan R K
title: Principal Consultant
org: Emerging Technologies, Department of Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, Govt. of Telangana
bio: Anantha Krishnan R K is a seasoned Public Policy professional in Emerging Technologies, Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication (ITE&C), Government of Telangana. Anantha Krishnan works in the intersection of technology, policy and governance for transforming last-mile public service delivery at scale. Anantha Krishnan belongs to the founding batch of Prime Minister’s Rural Development Fellows (PMRDF) and has experience of working in some of the most backward districts in the country like Koraput (Odisha) and Adilabad (Telangana). Anantha Krishnan has spearheaded building India’s first digital governance ecosystem "Real Time Governance" in Andhra Pradesh - thriving on meta-data, ICT & IoT to drive robust citizen engagement and enhance last-mile service delivery. Anantha Krishnan works extensively in the domains of public welfare, policy, financial inclusion, egovernance and digital governance. Anantha Krishnan is currently involved in building Agricultural Data Exchange ADeX - a digital public infrastructure for innovation and revolutionizing data sharing, empowering the farming sector of Telangana.

name: Shri Ashwani Bhatia
title: Whole-Time Member
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Shri Ashwani Bhatia took charge as Whole Time Member, Securities and Exchange Board of India, in Mumbai on June 01, 2022. Prior to this assignment, Shri Bhatia held the position of Managing Director, State Bank of India. Shri Bhatia handles the Department of Debt and Hybrid Securities (DDHS), Corporation Finance Investigation Department (CFID), Corporation Finance Department (CFD), General Services Department (GSD), Regional Offices, PQ Cell, RTI, Board Cell and NISM. Shri Bhatia comes with the experience of over three and a half decades in the State Bank Group where he joined as a Probationary Officer in 1985. Before becoming Managing Director in State Bank of India, Shri Bhatia served as MD & CEO, SBI Funds Management Pvt. Limited. He has wide experience in Treasury Operations, Retail Banking, Credit, Investment Banking and Asset Management. Shri Bhatia completed his schooling from Air Force School, Subroto Park, Delhi and did his Graduation in Physics and Mathematics from Dayalbagh University, Agra. He is an MBA from Podar Institute of Management, Jaipur.

name: Shri Avneesh Pandey
title: Chief General Manager
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Avneesh Pandey is Chief General Manager, Information Technology at Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). At SEBI he is presently leading security and audit practice for the organisation and is responsible for cyber security oversight of the securities markets. He has about three decades of securities market regulatory experience in business process innovation, big data analytics, enterprise IT solutions, IT and Cyber security etc. He has led technology committees on regulatory oversight and strategy implementation. He sees himself as a technology strategist and a process innovator. He has obtained MPhil in Technology Policy from the University of Cambridge, UK, and has been an ADB-Japan Scholar for management studies at Asian Institute of Management, Manila, Philippines.

name: Shri Bithin Mahanta
title: General Manager
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Shri Bithin Mahanta is working as a General Manager in the Market Intermediaries Regulation and Supervision Department and is in charge of the Supervision, Enforcement and Complaints vertical. Shri Bithin Mahanta has worked in various departments at SEBI which include Investigations, Surveillance, Derivatives and New Products, Organisational Restructuring Cell, Systemic Stability Unit, Market Regulation Department and Investment Management Department . Shri Mahanta is a post graduate in Economics and holds a degree in MBA Finance from IISWBM, Kolkata. Shri Mahanta also holds a degree in Public Policy from Graduate Research Institute for Public Studies, Tokyo, Japan and is an FRM.

name: Shri Dammu Ravi
title: Secretary (Economic Relations)
org: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India

name: Shri G P Garg
title: Executive Director
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Mr. Garg has handled several important assignments in SEBI since joining in January 1994. He has been closely associated with SEBI and Government of India’s initiatives on Financial Literacy and Investor Education in the country. He was instrumental in launching of SEBI Complaints Redress System (SCORES), Securities Market Trainers (SMARTs) program for Investor Education, Toll Free Helpline and Financial Education through Resource Persons. He played crucial role in establishment of NISM and setting up of its new campus at Patalganga. Mr. Garg’s current portfolio includes Office of Investor Assistance and Education and Enforcement Department. Mr. Garg is SEBI nominee on the Board of Investor Education and Protection Fund Authority (IEPFA) set up by MCA, GOI and Technical Group on Financial Inclusion and Financial Literacy under FSDC. Mr. Garg holds degree in Engineering, Law and Management.

name: Shri G Ramesh Kumar
title: General Manager
org: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
bio: Shri G Ramesh Kumar is an accomplished banking professional with 27 years of experience in Banking and Finance including Rural/Development Banking and Project/Corporate debt financing. As General Manager, Shri Ramesh Kumar is currently leads the business operations vertical of department of refinance with NABARD involved in refinancing various Banks and NBFCs/NBFC mFIs. He is a Post Graduate in Agriculture with CAIIB from IIBF and Post Graduate Certificate in Advanced Financial Management from XLRI. Shri Ramesh Kumar started his carrier as Rural Development Officer in Union Bank of India gaining insights of rural financing and general banking. As Vice President of NABCONS(Consultancy Subsidiary of NABARD) Shri Ramesh Kumar handled and executed various consultancy Assignments in various developmental areas for national and international clients in areas of project appraisal/formulation, training & capacity building etc. He was CFO, NABSAMRUDDHI Finance (Subsidiary of NABARD) appraised various NBFC proposals, Preparation of Financial Statements, Monitoring of NBFC clients. As District Development Manager he was involved in district credit planning, innovative credit model formulation/implementation, Promotion of Climate resilient Natural Resource Management, Rural Infrastructure and Rural Energy programs, Credit Linkage of JLGs, SHG-II and FPOs/Micro Credit Federations and implementation of Banking Technology and Solutions etc. in Rural Financial Institutions.

name: Shri Goverdhan Singh Rawat
title: Deputy Managing Director
org: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
bio: Shri Goverdhan S. Rawat took charge of Deputy Managing Director of NABARD on 06thNovember 2023. In his previous role, he served as Chief General Manager, Pune, Maharashtra RO,NABARD. He has around three decades of experience in working with the apex development bank in Project Appraisal, Infrastructure Financing, District Credit Planning, Rural Development, Consulting Services, Board Secretaries and HR. He joined NABARD as an officer on September 21, 1992 and served in different capacities in Jammu & Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Maharashtra and the NABARD Head Office located in Mumbai. He had a stint as Faculty Member in Bankers Institute of Rural Development (BIRD) and National Bank Staff College, Lucknow. He has served as Nominee Director on the Boards of Pithoragarh Khetriya Gramin Bank, AFC India Limited and NABSAMRUDDHI Finance Limited, a subsidiary of NABARD. Shri Rawat is a Graduate in Agriculture & Animal Husbandry, CAIIB, and Post Graduate Diploma in Banking and Finance. He also holds an MBA degree in Leadership and Strategy.

name: Shri Gunveer Singh
title: Chief General Manager, Department of Payment and Settlement Systems

name: Shri Jayesh Ranjan
title: Special Chief Secretary
org: Information Technology (IT) & Industries and Commerce (I&C), Government of Telangana
bio: Mr. Jayesh Ranjan is a member of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) of the 1992 batch and working in the state of Telangana. He holds a Masters Degree in Psychology from Delhi University, a degree in Business Management from the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta, and a Masters in Public Management from Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, National University of Singapore. He has also done short courses in the University of Birmingham (on Environmental Policy Analysis), JICA training Institute, Tokyo (on lake remediation), London School of Economics (on Globalization and Leadership), Kennedy School of Government, Harvard University (in Public Policy), and Swedish Institute, Stockholm (on Sustainability and CSR). He is the All-India topper of his IAS batch of 1992. He was awarded World Bankâ€™s Social Capital Visiting Scholarship in 2002 and the British Governmentâ€™s Gurukul Chevening Scholarship in 2005. He has done international consultancy assignments for the World Bank, UN-ESCAP, Sedatu project of Mexico, and for international NGOs working for Youth Issues like YES, Inc of the USA and NMC from Italy. He is a part of the National Pool of Trainers in Leadership constituted by the Government of India, and is involved in training and mentoring newly recruited Civil Servants. Among his other distinctions, he was awarded the Royal Order of the Polar Star by His Majesty The King of Sweden in 2019 for promoting Swedish business interests in India including the opening of IKEAâ€™s first Indian store in Hyderabad. Jayesh Ranjan is the Special Chief Secretary of the Industries & Commerce (I&C) and Information Technology (IT) Departments of the Telangana government. His assignment involves developing policy frameworks, attracting new investments, identifying opportunities for utilizing IT in various government processes, and promoting the digital empowerment of the citizens. His last few assignments have been in the Industrial Promotion sector as Commissioner and MD of the Industries Department, Secretary in the Tourism Promotion Department, and Vice-Chairman of the Hyderabad Urban Development Authority (HUDA), all for 2-3 years each, and various rural assignments in different parts of the state for over 12 years, working in diverse sectors like Tribal Development, Natural Resources Management, Poverty Alleviation and other related Social Development Sectors.

name: Shri Kalyan Kumar
title: Executive Director
bio: Shri Kalyan Kumar assumed charge as Executive Director of the Bank on October 21, 2021. He holds a Post Graduate degree in science and is a Certified Associate Member of the Indian Institute of Bankers (CAIIB) He is presently the Chairman on the Board of two of the subsidiaries of Punjab National Bank, PNB Gilts Ltd. and PNB Cards & Services Ltd He is playing a pivotal role in Profit & Loss delivery across key business and control functions with responsibilities across multiple domains.

name: Shri Kamlesh Chandra Varshney
title: Whole -Time Member
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Shri Kamlesh Chandra Varshney took charge as Whole Time Member, Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) in Mumbai on 20th September, 2023. Prior to this assignment he was Joint Secretary (Tax Policy and Legislation) in the Department of Revenue. Shri Varshney is MBA from IIM, Lucknow and is also a law graduate. He has also worked in Merchant Navy after being trained in T.S.Rajendra. Shri Varshney is 1990 batch Indian Revenue Service Officer who has worked in various capacities in the Income-tax Department and Finance Ministry. He was the first Commissioner of Advance Pricing Agreement and has a distinction of rolling out APA program successfully in India. He is on the panel of tax experts of UNDP. He has worked for five years with tax administration of Papua New Guinea helping them in investigation and capacity building. Shri Varshney is recipient of the Finance Minister Award for his contribution to Indian Tax policy and Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme. Shri Varshney is a sports enthusiast and loves teaching Shri Varshney is handling various departments like Market Intermediaries Regulation and Supervision Department, Legal Affairs Department-LAD1, Integrated Surveillance Department, Information Technology Department, Recovery & Refund Department and Special Enforcement Cell.

name: Shri Kaustubh Dhavse
title: Joint Secretary, Dy.CMO
bio: Kaustubh Dhavse is Joint Secretary in the Government of Maharashtra designated as Officer on Special Duty to the Deputy Chief Minister, Govt. Of Maharashtra. In this role he drives Policy, Investments, Technology and Infrastructure in the state via various programs and Special Projects. Kaustubh is also the Deputy Director General of the Chief Ministerâ€™s War room, unit under the CM to monitor and drive key projects in Maharashtra. From 2014-2019, Kaustubh worked as a JS and OSD to Hon. CM. During his stint in the CMO, Kaustubh led the CM War Room under which 1.8 lakh crore worth of projects were put into execution in record time. He also also helped setup the State IT corporation for speeding up large State IT project execution. Prior to joining the Government, Kaustubh had a successful stint in the corporate world where he worked with large Multinational companies. Kaustubh is an Engineer from D.J Sanghvi College of Engineering, Mumbai University. He has a PGDM from SP Jain Institute of Management Studies and was on the Dean's Merit list and a graduating valedictorian. He also has a Public Policy Degree from the Kennedy School of Government, Harvard University.

name: Shri Mahankali Srinivas Rao (MSR)
title: CEO, T-Hub
bio: Mahankali Srinivas Rao (MSR) is the Chief Executive Officer of T-Hub, which enables and empowers an ecosystem hungry for innovation. An accomplished serial entrepreneur, MSR has built and scaled businesses across geographies over his 33-year stint in the IT industry. At T-Hub, MSR is committed to positioning the organisation to become a stronger innovation ecosystem enabler with high-quality outcomes. To achieve these aims, he will be focused on fund-raising initiatives, higher valuations, robust employment generation and building scale through active community engagement. He wants to raise the bar on innovation to ensure T-Hub transforms Telangana into a leader in innovation. Before T-Hub, MSR served as CEO of GAME (Global Alliance for Mass Entrepreneurship), a social impact entity, where he was responsible for the implementation of the organisationâ€™s programs and expansion plans in its mission to catalyse 10 million mass entrepreneurs by 2030. His areas of focus included rigorous program evaluation, fundraising, communications and actively engaging with key stakeholders in the innovation ecosystem. Earlier, he co-founded Aujas in 2008, with seed funding from IDG Ventures, with a vision to help organisations manage risk and enhance information value through innovation and excellence. He drove the Aujas exit to NSEIT, a 100% wholly owned subsidiary of National Stock Exchange. MSR was part of the promoter team at Network Solutions(Netsol) which he helped scale from a early stage entity to being among Indiaâ€™s top 3 Network Integration entities before its acquisition by IBM in October 2005. At the start of his career, MSR also worked at Sonata, Computer Vision Labs and Microland. MSR is a native of Telangana and currently lives in Hyderabad. He holds an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM-B) and a Bachelorâ€™s degree in Electrical Engg from OU College of Engg. He is a bibliophile, a cricket fanatic and enjoys quizzing. He and his wife, a special educator, are the proud parents of two daughters.

name: Shri Mahaveer Singhvi
title: Joint Secretary (New Emerging and Strategic Technologies Division)
bio: Mr. Mahaveer Singhvi, was appointed to the Indian Foreign Service (the diplomatic service of India) in the year 1999. Since then he has served in several important assignment in the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India including as Joint Secretary (New, Emerging and Strategic Technologies), Joint Secretary (Counter Terrorism), Joint Secretary (Central Europe), Director (SAARC, BIMSTEC and Border Connectivity), Director (East and Southern Africa), Director (Latin America and Caribbean), Director (Multilateral Economic Relations), Deputy Secretary (Technical Cooperation) etc. He has also represented India on several international forums during his various assignments in the diplomatic service. He is a regular speaker on diverse subjects at various national and international conferences, seminars and summits. Mr. Singhvi has been educated and trained at some of the world’s best institutions including the University of Oxford, UK, IIM, Ahmadabad, LBSNAA, Mussoorie, the ICAI, and University of Delhi, Rajasthan and Jodhpur. His qualifications include LL.B., ACA, ACS, ICWA, MBA, MBF, M.St. (Oxford) and B.Com (Hons). Mr. Singhvi has been bestowed with several laurels and accolades including the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India’s CA Achiever in Public Services and Business Leader in a Government Department Award and prestigious British Chevening Fellowship to pursue Foreign Service Programme (FSP) at the University of Oxford where he secured an ‘Overall distinction ', an achievement described as “rare and laudable” by the University in a letter to the Government of India. He also secured University Gold Medal in his Graduation and Rajasthan Board Gold Medal for securing first rank among all the students in 12 th Board Examination. He has also been honoured twice by the Governor of Rajasthan for his academic excellence.

name: Shri Manoj Kumar
title: Executive Director
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
bio: Mr. Manoj Kumar, has been associated with Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), a premier autonomous regulatory body for securities market in India, for more than 27 years. He is currently, as an Executive Director, heading the Investment Management Department of SEBI. He has earlier handled Market Regulations, Integrated Surveillance, Market Intermediaries Regulation and Supervision Departments at SEBI. He has been associated with key SEBI initiatives such as Accounting Standards Committee chaired by Y H Malegam, Corporate Governance Committee chaired by Narayana Murthy. He has been the Member of the core group that successfully designed and implemented Integrated Market Surveillance System. Currently, he is a member secretary of the Mutual Funds Advisory Committee (MFAC). He is the SEBI representative on the Committee on Investment Management of the ‘International Organization of Securities Commissions’ (IOSCO). He has also worked at IFSCA as an Executive Director. He holds a postgraduate in Science and MBA.

name: Shri Manuj Jindal, IAS
title: Joint Managing Director
bio: Manuj Jindal is an IAS officer from Maharashtra cadre. He has a Bachelor of Science degree in Commerce and Finance, and a Master’s degree in Public Management. Before joining the IAS, he has worked in the corporate sector for about 3 years as an investment banking analyst (M&A). In the services, he has worked in Gadchiroli, where he started various initiatives such as Tribal art excellence center, skilling center, and his sub-division became the first to get 100% community forest rights (CFR). In addition, his innovative work during COVID for vaccination drives in tribal areas were widely appreciated. He has also worked in the Rural sector in the Jalna district of Marathawada and then Thane district. Here, his initiatives in skilling and training rural women in drone pilot programs and bringing tangible results in improving nutrition have had positive impact on rural governance. Currently, he is posted as Jt MD, MSRDC, where is looking after key various infrastructure projects as well as technological innovations that MSRDC is doing in the infra sector.

name: Shri Mayank
title: Scientist-E / Director, Cyber Laws and Data Governance Division
org: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India
bio: Mr. Mayank is working as Scientist-E in Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. Currently, he is leading the Techno-Legal matters relating to Social Media and other IT Intermediaries under Cyber Laws and Data Governance Group of the Ministry. He is working with Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre, Deptt of Telecommunications, other Law enforcement agencies, Google, Meta, X Corp, sectoral regulators and others to have Open, Safe, trusted and accountable Cyber Space. In his 20 plus years of career in government, he has worked in different functional areas of Telecommunications, IT and BFSI sector. He was previously working under DIGIDHAN Mission in Ministry of Electronics & IT for 7-8 years and was leading the Digital Banking products, Banking Score cards, Fintechs and others for promotion of Digital payments. He was also working for Globalisation of UPI and RuPay cards across various geographies. He is an alumnus of Faculty of Engineering, Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra. Apart from Digital payments, he has also worked under ' Emerging Technologies Division' and was handling Artificial Intelligence Mission, Startups, Centres of Excellence in Internet of Things, Blockchain, AI and other Emerging Technologies.

name: Shri Navdeep Virk, IPS
title: Principal Secretary - Transport and Sports
bio: I am an officer in the Indian Police Service (IPS) having joined the service in the year 1994. I have worked as the District Police Chief in seven districts of Haryana, including as Commissioner of Police, Gurgaon, which is a big cosmopolitan town, and part of the National Capital Region of Delhi. I have also headed a police training institute, supervised armed police battalions and headed a specialised crime unit. I was also deputed to the elite Central Bureau of Investigation for four years where I worked in a specialised crime unit and vigilance and internal affairs department. During these positions, I have had a long experience in strategic management, prevention and detection of crime, handling of law and order situations, detection of economic and cybercrime, dealing with human trafficking issues, human resource management, internal vigilance, skill development and training, community policing, traffic management, commanded armed police battalions and dealing with public grievances. I have attended various training programmes included eight weeks midcareer training programme in 2011 that was partly conducted in India and UK by Cambridge University, UK. At the field level, I have worked as the District Police Chief in 7 districts of Haryana, including as Commissioner of Police, Gurgaon. I have had a a special interest in policing strategy, promoting use of technology in law enforcement, cybercrime and community policing. At the State Police Headquaters level, I was the ADGP (Law & Order) Haryana for three years from Feb 2019 to Jan 2022. In this role I had a key role in managing the state wide police operations, including during emergency situations like COVID, handled the conduct of multiple Parliament, State and Panchayat level elections in Haryana. In my present role of Principal Secretary, Transport Department, Haryana I have multiple responsibilities: 1. To supervise the working of Directorate of State Transport, that operates about 100 bus depots, sub depots and a fleet of about 4000 passenger buses every day. 2. To regulate the Transport Sector from policy perspective. 3. To supervise the entire range of services to citizens in the field of Drivers licensing, Registration of Motor vehicles and various kinds of permits Specialties: Community Policing, Policing Strategy, Cybercrime, Economic Offences, IT in Police, Human Trafficking Issues, Conduct of Elections, Bus Transport Fleet Operations, Introduction of New Technology projects in Govt. & Bringing efficiency to Public Services delivery.

name: Shri Nitesh Ranjan
title: Executive Director
bio: Shri Nitesh Ranjan is Executive Director of Union Bank of India since 2021. He is leading digital transformation in the Bank towards superior customer experience, enhanced employee engagement and stronger balance sheet. While driving business outcome, he is focused on continuous strengthening of risk and compliance standards in the Bank. He is a member of the Board of Directors of National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), SUD Life Insurance Company Ltd. and also member of IBA Steering Committee on PSB Reforms. Shri Nitesh Ranjan is a post-graduate in Economics and has also completed Leadership Development Programme of IIM Bangalore.

name: Shri P Vasudevan
title: Executive Director
bio: Shri. P. Vasudevan is the Executive Director in Reserve Bank of India, responsible for handling activities relating to FinTechs, Currency Management and Corporate Strategy. He is a career central banker with over 30 years of experience in matters relating to payment and settlement systems, banking, and non-banking supervision, including a stint as Member of Faculty in Bankers’ Training College. He has headed and successfully implemented many large payment system projects in the country like CTS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, BBPS etc. As Executive Director–in–charge of FinTech related activities, he has been instrumental in publishing the framework to recognise Self-Regulatory Organisation for FinTechs (SRO-FT) as well in launch of FinTech and EmTech Repositories, apart from contributing to the pilots on CBDC, organising hackathons, operating the Regulatory Sandbox etc. He has represented Reserve Bank on various international fora including the Committee for Payments & Market Infrastructures (CPMI), the SAARC Payments Council (SPC), the SEACEN Payments Group and the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) Regulatory Oversight Committee. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Commerce and is a Fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He has a master’s degree in Finance and Certifications in Information Systems Audit (CISA), Information Security Management (CISM) and FinTech (National University of Singapore). He is a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers (CAIIB) and an alumnus of the Wharton School.

name: Shri Prabhas Kumar Rath
title: Chief General Manager
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Shri. Prabhas Kumar Rath is a Chief General Manager in the Department of Economic and Policy Analysis in Securities and Exchange Board of India, Mumbai. He brings with him over two decades of experience in the domain of capital market. Currently he oversees Market-wide Data standardization and democratization initiatives under the aegis of SEBI Market Data Advisory Committee, Systemic Risks and Inter-regulatory issues, including matters relating to the Financial Stability and Development Council of India. Shri Rath represents SEBI on the Emerging Risk Committee (ERC) of the International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO). Shri. Rath holds a Ph.D. in Economics of Financial Markets from Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi. He was a Visiting Fellow at the Financial Services Agency (FSA), Japan.

name: Shri Pramod Rao
title: Executive Director
org: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bio: Pramod is an Executive Director at Securities & Exchange Board of India, handling Department of Debt & Hybrid Securities (DDHS), Department of Economic and Policy Analysis (DEPA), Enquiries and Adjudication Department (EAD), Quasi-Judicial Cell & acting as a quasi-judicial authority. He is a member of IFSC Authority (www.IFSCA.gov.in), the Inter-Regulatory Technical Group (IRTG) of the Sub-Committee of the Financial Stability and Development Council & a member of the Assessment Committee of IOSCO (www.iosco.org). Pramod has extensive experience in Indian financial services sector, having served as Group General Counsel at ICICI group, General Counsel for Citi South Asia cluster, as a partner at IndusLaw & as General Counsel of ICICI Bank, with many professional accomplishments in such roles. He also served as a member of Board of Directors of ICICI Securities Ltd, ICICI Prudential Trust Ltd, ICICI Trusteeship Services Ltd, & as a member of National Committee for Regulatory Affairs of Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), of Advisory Council of Sahamati & of SEBI Subcommittee for Regulatory Sandbox. Pramod has a deep interest in Fintech, LawTech & startups: He co-founded a LawTech enterprise, & served as a Board member of 2 startups. He also advised & mentored startups under the aegis of ICICI Bank’s Startup Engagement Team & its Innovation Lab, NSRCEL of IIM Bangalore, SINE of IIT Bombay & of No Changemaker Left Behind program by Agami. He has also led piloting and adoption of innovative approaches and technology-led solutions for various business, operational & legal requirements. He has collaborated on certain iSPIRT projects including Sahay-GeM & Sahamati AA Ecosystem. He has played a pivotal role in conceptualizing & adoption of online dispute resolution (ODR) at ICICI Bank & digital ecosystems such as Sahamati, Sahay GeM, Sahay GST & ONDC. He also engaged with policy makers, the government & the judiciary on ODR, which culminated in Niti Aayog committee report on Designing the Future of Dispute Resolution: The ODR Policy Plan for India, https://bit.ly/3AVS247 , & in the launch of ODR Handbook: www.disputeresolution.online Pramod has also been associated with IDIA – Increasing Diversity by Increasing Access – an NGO dedicated to assisting students from underprivileged backgrounds in attending premier law schools in India. He has served as a founding member of Governing Board of NLSIU Alumni Association from 2015-2020. He has participated in & contributed to various law and regulatory reform initiatives of the government, regulators & industry forums, and written or contributed to several papers containing his personal view and opinions on matters of law and policy including for SCC Blog, IndiaCorplaw Blog, ARIA and for reputed digital business news platforms.

name: Shri Rajesh Kumar
title: Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
bio: Rajesh is the Managing Director and CEO of TransUnion CIBIL with the responsibility for the management, growth and business strategy in India. Prior to joining TransUnion CIBIL, Kumar was the Group Head for Retail Credit and Risk at HDF Bank where he was the key member of the leadership team responsible for conceptualizing, managing and growing the bank’s retail credit portfolio comprising consumption loans, commercial loans, and vehicle loans along with the payment business of the bank. With two decades of experience at HDFC Bank, Rajesh helped grow its retail lending book to USD 50 bn and led teams comprising of more than 3,000 bank officers. Kumar holds a Master’s degree in Business Administration from T A Pai Management Institute, Manipal.
